## 1. proc_360_Account_RetrieveAllManaged

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Account_RetrieveAllManaged] 
@UserManagerID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT DISTINCT
		CA.CostAccountID AS ID,  
		CA.CostAccountName AS AccountName,  
		ISNULL(CA.CostAccountCode, '-') AS AccountCode, 
		CASE (SELECT 1 FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = @UserManagerID AND CostAccountID = CA.CostAccountID)
			WHEN 1 THEN NULL
			ELSE CA.CostAccountParentID
		END AS ParentID, 
		dbo.GetCostAccountHierarchy(CostAccountParentID) AS [Path]
	FROM
		CostAccounts CA
		INNER JOIN dbo.[fn_360_GetCostAccountManaged](@UserManagerID) T ON T.AccountID = CA.CostAccountID
	ORDER BY
		ID, AccountName, AccountCode, ParentID, [Path]
END
```

## 2. proc_360_AccountsGroups_InsertUser

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_AccountsGroups_InsertUser]
@AccountID INT, 
@AccountGroupID INT

AS
	
BEGIN
	
	--Verifica se já existe esse registro
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID AND AccountID = @AccountID)
	BEGIN
		BEGIN TRAN ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
		DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT		
		
		--Verifica se existe crédito para esse grupo
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasRules WHERE AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID AND [Enabled] = 1)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @TBCreditsGroups TABLE (QuotaRuleID INT)
		
			--Busca as regras (de crédito) desse grupo
			INSERT INTO
				@TBCreditsGroups
			SELECT
				QuotaRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasRules
			WHERE
				[Enabled] = 1
				AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
				AND AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCreditsGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID
				FROM
					@TBCreditsGroups
					
				--Insere o crédito
				INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
				SELECT
					@QuotaRuleID,
					@AccountID,
					NULL, --CostAccountID,
					GETDATE(),
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					FinishDate,
					IsCorporative,
					OperatorID,
					1 --[Enabled]
				FROM
					QuotasRules
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBCreditsGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			END
			
			DECLARE @TBRulesGroups TABLE (QuotaRuleID INT)
		
			--Busca as regras com renovação desse grupo e que tenham a opção de crédito imediato habilitada
			INSERT INTO
				@TBRulesGroups
			SELECT
				QR.QuotaRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasRules QR
				INNER JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
			WHERE
				[Enabled] = 1
				AND QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NOT NULL
				AND QP.LastDateRepeated IS NOT NULL
				AND QP.InstantCredit = 1
				AND AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBRulesGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID
				FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
					
				--Insere o crédito
				INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
				SELECT
					@QuotaRuleID,
					@AccountID,
					NULL, --CostAccountID,
					GETDATE(),
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					FinishDate,
					IsCorporative,
					OperatorID,
					1 --[Enabled]
				FROM
					QuotasRules
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			END
		END
		
		COMMIT ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	END
	
END
```

## 3. proc_360_AccountsGroups_RemoveUser

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_AccountsGroups_RemoveUser]
@AccountID INT, 
@AccountGroupID INT

AS
	
BEGIN

	--Verifica se já existe esse registro
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID AND AccountID = @AccountID)
	BEGIN
		BEGIN TRAN ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		--Verifica se existe alguma regra desse grupo
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasRules WHERE AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @TBRulesGroups TABLE (QuotaRuleID INT)
			DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT
		
			--Busca as regras (de crédito) desse grupo
			INSERT INTO
				@TBRulesGroups
			SELECT
				QuotaRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasRules
			WHERE
				--[Enabled] = 1
				--AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
				AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBRulesGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID
				FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
					
				--Verifica se existe algum crédito, para essa regra nesse usuário
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID AND AccountID = @AccountID)
				BEGIN
					--Desabilita as regras
					UPDATE QuotasCredits SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID AND AccountID = @AccountID
					
					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
														
					--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
					INSERT INTO
						QuotasExpires
						(
							QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
						)
					SELECT
						QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
						QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
						QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
					FROM
						QuotasCredits QC
					WHERE
						QC.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
						AND QC.AccountID = @AccountID
						AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
						
					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
				END
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			END
		END
		
		COMMIT ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	END
	
END
```

## 4. proc_360_AccountsPinCodes_RetrieveExpired

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_AccountsPinCodes_RetrieveExpired]
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @DaysExpirePin INT = (SELECT CAST(ParameterValue AS INT) FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'UserPINExpirationDays')
	 	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SELECT [AccountID]
      ,[PinCode]            
      ,[ChangedDate]
	    FROM [AccountsPinCodes] as outside WHERE CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) > (select  dateadd(day,@DaysExpirePin,[ChangedDate])  from [AccountsPinCodes] as inside where outside.AccountID = inside.AccountID) 
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_AccountsPinCodes_RetrieveNotHavePin]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
```

## 7. proc_360_Accounts_ExistsAccountsRemovedToAnonymize

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Accounts_ExistsAccountsRemovedToAnonymize]

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @AnonymizePeriod INT = (SELECT CAST(ParameterValue AS INT) FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'SettingsUserAnonymizationPeriod')

	IF (@AnonymizePeriod = -1) -- Configurado para não remover
	BEGIN
		RETURN 0
	END

	IF (@AnonymizePeriod = 0) -- Configurado para remover imediatamente
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			TOP(1) 1
		FROM 
			Accounts
		WHERE 
			Removed = 1 AND 
			FullName != '[UserRemoved]' AND 
			dbo.TryConvertUniqueidentifier(LogonName) IS NULL
	END
	ELSE -- Configurado para um periodo determinado
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @DateNow DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

		SELECT 
			TOP(1) 1
		FROM 
			Accounts
		WHERE 
			Removed = 1 AND 
			FullName != '[UserRemoved]' AND 
			dbo.TryConvertUniqueidentifier(LogonName) IS NULL AND
			CAST(CAST(ChangedDate AS DATETIME) + @AnonymizePeriod AS DATE) < @DateNow
	END
	
END
```

## 11. proc_360_AnonymizingUsers

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_AnonymizingUsers]

AS

BEGIN
	
	IF ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'DataBaseVersion360') != '645')
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Esta procedure é válida apenas para a versão 645.', 16 ,1)
		RETURN
	END
	
	DECLARE @AccountsIDs TABLE (AccountID INT)

	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Accounts	WHERE Removed = 1 AND FullName != '[UserRemoved]' AND dbo.TryConvertUniqueidentifier(LogonName) IS NULL)
	BEGIN

		BEGIN TRAN -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

		INSERT INTO 
			@AccountsIDs
		SELECT TOP(500000)
			AccountID
		FROM	
			Accounts
		WHERE 
			Removed = 1 
			AND FullName != '[UserRemoved]' 
			AND dbo.TryConvertUniqueidentifier(LogonName) IS NULL

		-- Atualiza o UpdatedDate das contas dos usuários
		UPDATE CostAccounts SET ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs))

		-- Anonimiza os usuários
		UPDATE Accounts SET LogonName = UPPER(NEWID()), FullName = '[UserRemoved]', CostAccountID = NULL, Email = NULL, ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove os usuários das contas selecionáveis
		UPDATE CostAccountsSelectable SET UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE IsAllSelectable = 0 AND ObjectAllowedType = 1 AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs))
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE IsAllSelectable = 0 AND ObjectAllowedType = 1 AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		
		-- Remove o usuário de gerente das contas
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove os usuários das políticas
		INSERT INTO PoliciesMembersRemoved SELECT PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE() FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PolicyMemberType IN (1, 5)	AND ObjectID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		DELETE FROM PoliciesMembers	WHERE PolicyMemberType IN (1, 5) AND ObjectID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove as senhas dos usuários
		DELETE FROM AccountsPassportRequests WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		DELETE FROM AccountsPassport WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove os Aliases dos usuários
		UPDATE Accounts SET ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsAliases WHERE AccountIDMain IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs))
		UPDATE Accounts SET ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountIDMain FROM AccountsAliases WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs))

		DELETE FROM AccountsAliases WHERE AccountIDMain IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		DELETE FROM AccountsAliases WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		
		-- Remove os relatórios agendados dos usuários
		DELETE FROM ScheduledReports WHERE OwnerAccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		DELETE FROM ScheduledAccountSend WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove os usuários dos fluxos de digitalização
		INSERT INTO ScanFlowMembersRemoved SELECT ScanFlowMemberID, GETUTCDATE() FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE MemberType = 1 AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		DELETE FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE MemberType = 1 AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Anonimiza os dados da auditoria dos usuários
		UPDATE Audits SET IPAddress = '-' WHERE UserID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)
		UPDATE AuditObjects SET ObjectText = A.LogonName FROM AuditObjects AO INNER JOIN Accounts A ON AO.UserID = A.AccountID WHERE A.AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Anonimiza os dados dos operadores de cotas
		UPDATE QuotasOperators SET OperatorName = A.LogonName FROM QuotasOperators QO INNER JOIN Accounts A ON QO.AccountID = A.AccountID WHERE A.AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove os usuários dos grupos
		UPDATE AccountsGroups SET UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs))
		DELETE FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove as permissões dos usuários
		DELETE FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove os códigos de cartões dos usuários
		DELETE FROM AccountsCardCodes WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Remove os códigos PINs dos usuários
		DELETE FROM AccountsPinCodes WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		--Incrementar o controle de cache dos usuários 		
		UPDATE PoliciesControls SET PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1 WHERE PolicyControlName = 'AccountAliaseID'
		UPDATE PoliciesControls SET PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1 WHERE PolicyControlName = 'AccountID'
		INSERT INTO PoliciesControlsAccounts SELECT	AccountID, 0, 0, 0, 1 FROM Accounts	WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM @AccountsIDs)

		-- Limpa a tabela temporária
		DELETE FROM @AccountsIDs

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	

		COMMIT ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	END
END
```

## 13. proc_360_Audit_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Audit_Insert]
@AuditDate DATETIMEOFFSET,
@AuditActionResource NVARCHAR(60),
@UserID INT = NULL,
@PartnerUserID INT = NULL,
@PartnerUserEmail NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@PartnerName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@IPAddress NVARCHAR(39),
@ConcatenatedObjectType NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,
@ConcatenatedObjectID INT = NULL,
@AffectedObjectType NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,
@AffectedObjectID INT = NULL,
@AffectedObjectText NVARCHAR(512) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @InsertedConcatenatedObjectID INT = NULL

	IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ConcatenatedObjectText NVARCHAR(512)
		
		IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'Domain')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = D.DomainName FROM [Domains] D WHERE D.DomainID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END
		ELSE IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'User')
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				@ConcatenatedObjectText = D.DomainName + '\' + AC.LogonName
			FROM 
				Accounts AC
				INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			WHERE 
				AC.AccountID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'UserGroup')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = AG.AccountGroupName FROM AccountsGroups AG WHERE AG.AccountGroupID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'Account')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = dbo.GetCostAccountName(CA.CostAccountID) FROM CostAccounts CA WHERE CA.CostAccountID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'Printer')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = PD.PrinterDeviceName + ' - ' + PD.AddressName + CASE WHEN PD.SerialNumber IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' + PD.SerialNumber END FROM PrintersDevices PD WHERE PD.PrinterDeviceID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'PrinterGroup')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = PDG.CostGroupName FROM CostGroups PDG WHERE PDG.CostGroupID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'Machine')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = M.MachineName FROM Machines M WHERE M.MachineID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'Policy')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = P.PolicyName FROM Policies P WHERE P.PolicyID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,  NULL,@ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'Site')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = S.SiteName FROM Sites S WHERE S.SiteID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)   
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'Department')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = SD.SiteDivisionName FROM SitesDivisions SD WHERE SD.SiteDivisionID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'ScanFlowGroup')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = SFG.ScanFlowGroupName FROM ScanFlowGroups SFG WHERE SFG.ScanFlowGroupID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID, NULL)
		END IF (@ConcatenatedObjectType = 'ScanFlow')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ConcatenatedObjectText = SF.ScanFlowName FROM ScanFlows SF WHERE SF.ScanFlowID = @ConcatenatedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
			VALUES (@ConcatenatedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @ConcatenatedObjectID)
		END

		SET @InsertedConcatenatedObjectID = @@IDENTITY
	END
	
	DECLARE @InsertedAffectedObjectID INT = NULL

	IF (@AffectedObjectType IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @AffectedObjectTextFormatted NVARCHAR(512)
		
		IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'Domain')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = D.DomainName FROM [Domains] D WHERE D.DomainID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END
		ELSE IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'User')
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				@AffectedObjectTextFormatted = CASE WHEN @AuditActionResource = '360AUserDeleted' THEN AC.LogonName ELSE D.DomainName + '\' + AC.LogonName END
			FROM 
				Accounts AC
				INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			WHERE 
				AC.AccountID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'UserGroup')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = AG.AccountGroupName FROM AccountsGroups AG WHERE AG.AccountGroupID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)   
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'Account')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = dbo.GetCostAccountName(CA.CostAccountID) FROM CostAccounts CA WHERE CA.CostAccountID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'Printer')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = PD.PrinterDeviceName + ' - ' + PD.AddressName + CASE WHEN PD.SerialNumber IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' + PD.SerialNumber END FROM PrintersDevices PD WHERE PD.PrinterDeviceID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'PrinterGroup')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = PDG.CostGroupName FROM CostGroups PDG WHERE PDG.CostGroupID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'Machine')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = M.MachineName FROM Machines M WHERE M.MachineID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)   
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'Policy')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = P.PolicyName FROM Policies P WHERE P.PolicyID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'Site')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = S.SiteName FROM Sites S WHERE S.SiteID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'Department')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = SD.SiteDivisionName FROM SitesDivisions SD WHERE SD.SiteDivisionID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'ScanFlowGroup')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = SFG.ScanFlowGroupName FROM ScanFlowGroups SFG WHERE SFG.ScanFlowGroupID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID, NULL)
		END IF (@AffectedObjectType = 'ScanFlow')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AffectedObjectTextFormatted = SF.ScanFlowName FROM ScanFlows SF WHERE SF.ScanFlowID = @AffectedObjectID

			INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID)  
			VALUES (@AffectedObjectTextFormatted, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @AffectedObjectID)
		END

		SET @InsertedAffectedObjectID = @@IDENTITY
	END
	ELSE IF(@AffectedObjectText IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO AuditObjects (ObjectText, DomainID, UserID, UserGroupID, AccountID, PrinterID, PrinterGroupID, MachineID, PolicyID, SiteID, SiteDivisionID, NotificationID, ScanFlowGroupID, ScanFlowID) 
		VALUES (@AffectedObjectText, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
		
		SET @InsertedAffectedObjectID = @@IDENTITY
	END

	DECLARE @AuditActionID INT
	SELECT @AuditActionID = AuditActionID FROM AuditActions WHERE AuditActionResource = @AuditActionResource

	INSERT INTO
		Audits (AuditDate, AuditActionID, UserID, PartnerUserID, PartnerUserEmail, PartnerName, IPAddress, ConcatenatedObjectID, AffectedObjectID)
	VALUES 
		(@AuditDate, @AuditActionID, @UserID, @PartnerUserID, @PartnerUserEmail, @PartnerName, @IPAddress, @InsertedConcatenatedObjectID, @InsertedAffectedObjectID)

END
```

## 15. proc_360_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_Reset

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_Reset]
@ResetQuotas BIT,
@ResetPolicies BIT

AS

BEGIN

	IF(@ResetQuotas = 1 AND @ResetPolicies = 1)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		WHERE 
			AccountID IS NOT NULL
	
		UPDATE 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		SET 
			PoliciesPermissionType = 1,
			QuotasPermissionType = 1
		WHERE
			AccountID IS NULL
	END
	ELSE IF (@ResetQuotas = 1)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		WHERE 
			AccountID IS NOT NULL 
			AND QuotasPermissionType <> 1
			AND (PoliciesPermissionType = 1 OR PoliciesPermissionType IS NULL)
	
		UPDATE 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		SET 
			QuotasPermissionType = NULL
		WHERE
			AccountID IS NOT NULL

		UPDATE 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		SET 
			QuotasPermissionType = 1
		WHERE
			AccountID IS NULL
	END
	ELSE IF (@ResetPolicies = 1)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		WHERE 
			AccountID IS NOT NULL
			AND PoliciesPermissionType <> 1
			AND (QuotasPermissionType = 1 OR QuotasPermissionType IS NULL)
	
		UPDATE 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		SET 
			PoliciesPermissionType = NULL
		WHERE
			AccountID IS NOT NULL

		UPDATE 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		SET 
			PoliciesPermissionType = 1
		WHERE
			AccountID IS NULL
	END

END
```

## 16. proc_360_Dashboard_RetrievePagesLastMonth

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Dashboard_RetrievePagesLastMonth]
@AccountID INT

AS

BEGIN
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()

	SELECT
			DATEPART(DAY, C.Data) AS DayValue,
			ISNULL(SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN), 0) AS PagesMono,--Calcula total de páginas mono
			ISNULL(SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN), 0) AS PagesColor --Calcula total de páginas color
	FROM 
		CubeUserAccount C 
	WHERE
		C.AccountID = @AccountID
		AND DATEPART(MONTH, C.Data) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)
	GROUP BY
		DATEPART(DAY, C.Data)

END
```

## 17. proc_360_Dashboard_RetrievePagesLastYear

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Dashboard_RetrievePagesLastYear]
@AccountID INT,
@CountMonth INT

AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @Table TABLE (MonthValue TINYINT, PagesMono BIGINT, PagesColor BIGINT)
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	
	WHILE (@CountMonth > 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@Table
		SELECT
			DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow),
			ISNULL(SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN), 0),--Calcula total de páginas mono
			ISNULL(SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN), 0) --Calcula total de páginas color				
		FROM 
			CubeUserAccount C 
		WHERE
			MONTH(C.Data) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)
			AND YEAR(C.Data) = DATEPART(YEAR, @DateTimeNow)
			AND C.AccountID = @AccountID
			
		SET @DateTimeNow = DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @DateTimeNow)
		
		SET @CountMonth = @CountMonth - 1
	END
	
	SELECT
		MonthValue,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor 
	FROM 
		@Table

END
```

## 18. proc_360_Dashboard_RetrievePagesSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Dashboard_RetrievePagesSummary]
@AccountID INT
AS
BEGIN
	--#######################################################################################################################################################
	-- Busca todas as informações utilizadas no Dashboard do Portal
	--#######################################################################################################################################################
	
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Rodrigo Scopel
	-- Change date: 25/11/2019
	-- Description:	Alterada para trazer o total de páginas apenas dos tipos impressão, cópia e fax recebido (JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3))
	-- =============================================

	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME = GETDATE()

	--Busca os totais de páginas
	DECLARE @TotalPagesColor BIGINT
	DECLARE @TotalPagesMono BIGINT

	SELECT 
		@TotalPagesMono = SUM(PagesMono),
		@TotalPagesColor = SUM(PagesColor) 
	FROM 
		PrintJobs PJ WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
	WHERE 
		PJ.JobDisabled = 0
		AND AccountID = @AccountID 
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)
		AND ((MONTH(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)) AND (YEAR(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(YEAR, @DateTimeNow)))

	DECLARE @TotalPages BIGINT = SUM(@TotalPagesColor + @TotalPagesMono) 

	--Retorna os dados do impacto ambiental
	DECLARE @CalcTree DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcTree = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.')) 
	FROM 
		[Parameters]
	WHERE 
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactTree'
	
	DECLARE @CalcWater DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT 
		@CalcWater = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.'))
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactWater'
	
	DECLARE @CalcEnergy DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcEnergy= CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.')) 
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactEnergy'
	
	DECLARE @CalcCarbonDioxide DECIMAL(19,10)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcCarbonDioxide = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,10), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.'))
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactCarbonDioxide'
	
	--Retorna os dados sumarizados
	SELECT 
		ISNULL(@TotalPagesMono, 0) AS TotalPagesMono,
		ISNULL(@TotalPagesColor, 0) AS TotalPagesColor,
		ISNULL(SUM(CostMono),0) AS TotalCostMono,
		ISNULL(SUM(CostColor),0) AS TotalCostColor,
		COUNT(PrintJobID) AS TotalJobs,
		COUNT(DISTINCT(PJ.PrinterDeviceID)) AS TotalPrinters,
		COUNT(DISTINCT(M.MachineID)) AS TotalMachines,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages / @CalcTree), 0) AS ImpactTree,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages * @CalcWater), 0) AS ImpactWater,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages * @CalcEnergy), 0)AS ImpactEnergy,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages * @CalcCarbonDioxide), 0) AS ImpactCarbonDioxide
	FROM 
		PrintJobs PJ WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PJ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PJ.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID
		LEFT JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID
	WHERE 
		PJ.JobDisabled = 0
		AND AccountID = @AccountID
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)
		AND ((MONTH(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)) AND (YEAR(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(YEAR, @DateTimeNow)))

END
```

## 19. proc_360_Dashboard_RetrieveResumeConsumingPrint

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Dashboard_RetrieveResumeConsumingPrint]
@AccountID INT,
@CostAccountID INT,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren BIT, 
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Lucas Floriani
	-- Create date: 06/09/2019
	-- Description:	Buscar no banco o consumo de impressão do ultimo mês. 
	-- =============================================
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	DECLARE @StartDateTime DATETIME
	DECLARE @EndDateTime DATETIME
	
	SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
	SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	
	--Quando for dia primeiro, só retorna um registro zerado
	IF(@StartDateTime > @EndDateTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @StartDateTime AS DatePrinted, 0 AS TotalPages
		RETURN	
	END
	 
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT
		*
	FROM
		[dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista com as contas que serão usados
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN		
		--Verifica se é marcado a opção pra trazer os filhos da conta 
		IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Se sim continua como era antes
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos da conta informados
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se não insere apenas a conta informada na tabela 
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList VALUES(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	--'BUSCA SÓ DOS CUBOS, DOS PRIMÁRIOS, COM FILTROS'
	DECLARE @TBPrint TABLE (DatePrinted DATETIME, TotalPages BIGINT)
	
	INSERT INTO
		@TBPrint
	SELECT
		C.Data,
		SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
	FROM 
		CubeUser C
	WHERE
		(C.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
		AND
			((
				@UseORMethod = 0
				AND (
						(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
						AND
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
			 )
			 OR
			 (
				@UseORMethod = 1
				AND (
						(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
						OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
			  ))
	GROUP BY 
		C.Data
	ORDER BY
		C.Data
		
	WHILE (@StartDateTime <= @EndDateTime)
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBPrint WHERE DatePrinted = @StartDateTime)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@TBPrint
			SELECT
				@StartDateTime, 0
		END
		
		SET @StartDateTime = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @StartDateTime)
	END

	DECLARE @TotalPages BIGINT
	
    SELECT 
		@TotalPages = SUM(TotalPages) 
	FROM 
		@TBPrint

	--Retorna os dados do impacto ambiental
	DECLARE @CalcTree DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcTree = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.')) 
	FROM 
		[Parameters]
	WHERE 
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactTree'
	
	DECLARE @CalcWater DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT 
		@CalcWater = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.'))
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactWater'
	
	DECLARE @CalcEnergy DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcEnergy= CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.')) 
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactEnergy'
	
	DECLARE @CalcCarbonDioxide DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcCarbonDioxide = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.'))
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactCarbonDioxide'
	--Retorno

	SELECT
		DatePrinted,
		TotalPages		
	FROM
		@TBPrint
	ORDER BY
		DatePrinted

	SELECT TOP(1)
		ISNULL((@TotalPages / @CalcTree), 0) AS ImpactTree,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages * @CalcWater), 0) AS ImpactWater,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages * @CalcEnergy), 0)AS ImpactEnergy,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages / @CalcTree) * @CalcCarbonDioxide, 0) AS ImpactCarbonDioxide	
	FROM
		@TBPrint
END
```

## 20. proc_360_Dashboard_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostAccount

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Dashboard_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostAccount] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Lucas Floriani
	-- Create date: 06/09/2019
	-- Description:	Buscar no banco as top contas do ultimo mês. 
	-- =============================================
	
	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT 
		*
	FROM 
		[dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters
	
	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST( CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)
	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data  BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.CostAccountID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime)
							AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) --Precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND 
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY 
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	
END
```

## 21. proc_360_Dashboard_RetrieveStatisticsTopPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_Dashboard_RetrieveStatisticsTopPrinter] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Lucas Floriani
	-- Create date: 06/09/2019
	-- Description:	Buscar no banco os top impressoras do ultimo mês. 
	-- =============================================

	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	SELECT @StartDateTime = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDateTime AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)
	SELECT @EndDateTime   = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@EndDateTime   AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)

	IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
	END
		
	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END
			
	IF @AccountID <> -1 
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10 
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID,  
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
			PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
			TotalPages,  
			TotalCost 
		FROM 
			( 
				SELECT 
					PJ.PrinterDeviceID, 
					SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono) AS TotalPages,  
					SUM(PJ.CostColor  + PJ.CostMono)  AS TotalCost
				FROM          
					PrintJobs PJ
				WHERE 
					(PJ.DatePrinted between @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
					AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
					AND (JobTypeID in (1,2,3))-- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
					AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
					AND 
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND  (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				GROUP BY 
					PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS DevicesSummary
				 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID
				 INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY 
			TotalPages DESC 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10
				D.PrinterDeviceID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
				PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
				TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalCost
			FROM 
				(

					SELECT
						C.PrinterDeviceID,
						SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
					FROM 
						CubePrinter C
					WHERE
						C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
						AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
						AND
						--//alteração [4.2]
						--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
					GROUP BY
						C.PrinterDeviceID
						
				) AS D
					 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices	PD ON D.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
					 INNER JOIN PrintersModels  PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10
				D.PrinterDeviceID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
				PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
				TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalCost
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT
						PrinterDeviceID, 
						SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
					FROM 
						(  
							SELECT
								C.PrinterDeviceID,
								SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
							FROM 
								CubePrinter C 
							WHERE
								C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
								AND
								--//alteração [4.2]
								--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
							GROUP BY
								C.PrinterDeviceID
							
							UNION ALL
							
							SELECT
								P.PrinterDeviceID, 
								SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
							FROM 
								PrintJobs P 
							WHERE	
								(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR (P.DatePrinted between (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) 
								AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime)) OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
								AND (P.JobDisabled = 0 )
								AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) -- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
								AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))--//alteração [4.2] -- aqui só pode testar os CCs
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							GROUP BY 
								P.PrinterDeviceID
						) AS T
					GROUP BY
						T.PrinterDeviceID		
				) AS D
					 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices	PD ON D.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
					 INNER JOIN PrintersModels  PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC
		END
	END

END
```

```sql
	--/// início

	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE (AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO

	FROM

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)

		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = CAST( CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) +

	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			A.AccountID,
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, A.LogonName, A.FullName) AS AccountName,

				GROUP BY

			) AS T
				 INNER JOIN Accounts A ON T.AccountID = A.AccountID
				 INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON A.DomainID = D.DomainID
		WHERE
```

## 23. proc_360_PoliciesControlsAccounts_CreateByUserGroupID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_PoliciesControlsAccounts_CreateByUserGroupID]
@UserGroupID INT,
@IsRegularCache BIT = 0,
@IsCredentialCache BIT = 0,
@IsRemovedCache BIT = 0,
@IsRemoved BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	-- Remove os caches duplicados
	DELETE FROM
		PoliciesControlsAccounts
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountGroupID = @UserGroupID)
		AND IsRegularCache = @IsRegularCache
		AND IsCredentialCache = @IsCredentialCache
		AND IsRemovedCache = @IsRemovedCache

	-- Insere o cache dos usuários
	INSERT INTO 
		PoliciesControlsAccounts
	SELECT 
		AccountID, @IsRegularCache, @IsCredentialCache, @IsRemovedCache, @IsRemoved 
	FROM 
		AccountsGroupsObjects 
	WHERE 
		AccountGroupID = @UserGroupID

	-- Atualiza o ChangedDate dos usuários
	UPDATE
		Accounts
	SET
		ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountGroupID = @UserGroupID)
END
```

## 24. proc_360_PrintJobsFromPrinter_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_PrintJobsFromPrinter_Remove] 
@PrinterDeviceID INT 
AS
BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Rodrigo Scopel
	-- Create date: 23/07/2021
	-- Description:	Remover do banco os 1000 primeiros trabalhos de impressão relacionados à impressora. 
	-- =============================================
					
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da PrintJobs e da tabela BureauJobs
	
	--Cria tabela auxiliar para guardar os PrintJobIDs 
	DECLARE @PrintJobIDList TABLE (PrintJobID INT)
	--Pega os 1000 primeiros printjobids da impressora e armazena nessa tabela 			
	INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 1000 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobs where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	--Apaga os dados da BureauJobs
	DELETE FROM 
		BureauJobs 
	WHERE 
		PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)

	--Apaga os dados da QuotasPrintJobs
	DELETE FROM 
		QuotasPrintJobs 
	WHERE 
		PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)			
			
	--Apaga os dados da StampLogonJobs
	DELETE FROM 
		StampLogonJobs 
	WHERE 
		PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)			

	--Apaga os dados da PrintJobs	
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintJobs 
	WHERE 
		PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)
				
	--Limpa a tabela de PrintJobIDs				
	DELETE FROM @PrintJobIDList
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintJobsCanceled
		
	--Pega os 1000 primeiros printjobids da impressora e armazena nessa tabela 			
	INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 1000 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobsCanceled where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID	
	
	--Apaga os dados da PrintJobsCanceled	
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintJobsCanceled 
	WHERE 
		PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)
				
	--Limpa a tabela de PrintJobIDs				
	DELETE FROM @PrintJobIDList
END
```

## 26. proc_360_PrintersDevices_Exists

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_PrintersDevices_Exists]
@AddressName NVARCHAR(50)= NULL,
@AddressPort NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@PrinterModelID INT = NULL,
@SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@AddressMAC NVARCHAR(20) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

    IF (@SerialNumber IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 0))
		BEGIN
			SET @SerialNumber = ''
		END
	
	IF (@AddressMAC IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 1))
		BEGIN
			SET @AddressMAC = ''
		END

	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceIDFound INT

	-- Chama a função para validar se a impressora já existe e retorna o ID da impressora caso encontrar
	SET @PrinterDeviceIDFound = [dbo].[GetPrinterDeviceID](-1, @AddressName, @AddressPort, @PrinterModelID, @SerialNumber, @AddressMAC)
	
	SELECT @PrinterDeviceIDFound AS PrinterDeviceID

END
```

## 27. proc_360_PrintersDevices_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_PrintersDevices_Remove] 
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS
BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Maicon Pereira
	-- Create date: 28/05/2014
	-- Description:	Remover do banco a impressora e todos os dados relacionados à ela. 
	-- =============================================
	
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Anderson Tabaldi
	-- Update date: 12/09/2019
	-- Description:	Inserção da impressora removida na tabela PrintersDevicesRemoved
	-- =============================================
	
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Rodrigo Scopel
	-- Update date: 20/09/2019
	-- Description:	Não permitir exluir impressoras consolidadas, apenas principal e incluir data de alteração
	-- =============================================
	
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Héber Savedra
	-- Update date: 19/05/2020
	-- Description:	Remover da tabela PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges a impressora
	-- =============================================

	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Anderson Tabaldi
	-- Update date: 27/07/2020
	-- Description: Inserção da impressora removida na tabela SaveTonerRulePrintersRemoved
	-- =============================================

	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Wesley Lemos
	-- Update date: 14/12/2020
	-- Description: Ignora políticas particulares em ambientes ""Somente Corporativos"" na validação de último membro
	-- =============================================

	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Rodrigo Scopel
	-- Create date: 23/07/2021
	-- Description:	Remove trecho para apagar trabalhos de impressão, agora em [proc_360_PrintJobsFromPrinter_Remove] 
	-- =============================================
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Verifica se a impressora é o último membro de alguma política 
	DECLARE @PoliciesWithMember TABLE 
	(
		PolicyID INT 
	)

	DECLARE @PrivatePolicyEnabled BIT
	SELECT 
		@PrivatePolicyEnabled = ParameterValue 
	FROM 
		PoliciesParameters
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled'

	INSERT INTO 
		@PoliciesWithMember (PolicyID)
	SELECT 
		P.PolicyID
	FROM 
		Policies P
		INNER JOIN PoliciesMembers PM ON PM.PolicyID = P.PolicyID
	WHERE 
		(@PrivatePolicyEnabled = 1 AND
			((PM.ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 3)
			OR (PM.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 5))
		) 
		OR
		(@PrivatePolicyEnabled = 0 AND P.PolicyType != 1 AND
			((PM.ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 3)
			OR (PM.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 5))
		)

	DECLARE @LastID INT = 0

	WHILE(1 = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			@LastID = MIN(PolicyID)
		FROM 
			@PoliciesWithMember
		WHERE 
			PolicyID > @LastID

		IF @LastID IS NULL BREAK

		IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PolicyID = @LastID) = 1)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Esta impressora é último membro de uma política.', 16 ,1)
			RETURN 0
		END

		SELECT @LastID
	END
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Verifica se a impressora é consolidada e não principal
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation WHERE PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceID)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Esta é uma impressora consolidada.', 16 ,1)
		RETURN 0
	END

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Verifica se a impressora possui trabalhos de impressão atrelados
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobs WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Há trabalhos de impressão relacionados a esta impressora.', 16 ,1)
		RETURN 0
	END
	
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobsCanceled WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Há trabalhos de impressão relacionados a esta impressora.', 16 ,1)
		RETURN 0
	END
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados de auditoria relacionados à impressoras e que sejam da impressora a ser deletada do sistema
	DELETE FROM 
		Auditings 
	WHERE 
		AuditingActionID in(13,14,15,47,48) 
		AND ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID
				
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os produtos instalados ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		InstalledProducts 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	--Apaga os dados de alteração de endereço ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados de politicas ligados a impressora
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PolicyMemberType = 3)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO 
			PoliciesMembersRemoved
		SELECT
			PM.PolicyMemberID,
			GETUTCDATE()
		FROM 
			PoliciesMembers  PM
		WHERE
			PM.ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 3
	
		DELETE FROM 
			PoliciesMembers 
		WHERE 
			ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 3
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PolicyMemberType = 5)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO 
			PoliciesMembersRemoved
		SELECT
			PM.PolicyMemberID,
			GETUTCDATE()
		FROM 
			PoliciesMembers  PM
		WHERE
			PM.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 5
	
		DELETE FROM 
			PoliciesMembers 
		WHERE 
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 5
	END
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga as filas de processamento ligadas a impressora
	
	--ProccessQueuesTypes
	--PrinterConsolidation = 7,
	--PrinterDeviceSetDisable = 9,
	--PrinterDeviceSetEnable = 10,
	--PrinterDeviceSite = 11,
        
	DELETE FROM 
		ProcessQueues 
	WHERE 
		ProcessQueueType IN (7,9,10,11) 
		AND ObjectQueueID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga as filas ligadas a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersQueues 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os debitos de quotas ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		QuotasDebits 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os suprimentos não monitorados ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		SuppliesUnmonitored 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	---------------------IMPRESSORAS-----------------------------------------------------	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesAuditings
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesAuditings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Aplicar data de alteração nas impressoras consolidadas antes de remover a principal
	UPDATE
		PrintersDevices 
	SET 
		UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation WHERE PrinterDeviceMainID = @PrinterDeviceID)

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesConsolidation
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesConsolidation 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceMainID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesContractInfo
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesContractInfo 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID		
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela Counters
	DELETE FROM
		Counters
	WHERE
		CounterReadingID in (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID)
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela CountersAuditing
	DELETE FROM 
		CountersAuditing 
	WHERE 
		CounterReadingID IN (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela CountersReadings	
	DELETE FROM 
		CountersReadings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	--Cria tabelas auxiliares para armazenar IDs			
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList TABLE (PrinterDeviceSlotID INT)
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList TABLE (PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID INT)
		
	--Insere os IDs dos slots relacionados a impressora 	
	INSERT INTO @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList 
		SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotID FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			
	--Insere os IDs históricos dos slots relacionados a impressora 				
	INSERT INTO @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList 
		SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList)
			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList)
		
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList)
		
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlots
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlots 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList)
		
	--Limpa tabelas
	DELETE FROM 
		@PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList
		
	DELETE FROM 
		@PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados de leitura de NSL ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		NSLReadings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Insere a impressora removida na tabela de membros do tipo impressora das regras do poupa toner
	INSERT INTO 
		SaveTonerRulePrintersRemoved
	SELECT
		STRP.SaveTonerRulePrinterID,
		GETUTCDATE()
	FROM
		SaveTonerRulePrinters STRP
	WHERE
		STRP.PrinterID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Insere a impressora removida na tabela de Removidas
	INSERT INTO 
		PrintersDevicesRemoved
	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		GETUTCDATE()
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
	WHERE
		PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevices
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevices 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
END
```

## 28. proc_360_PrintersGroups_InsertPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_PrintersGroups_InsertPrinter]
@PrinterID INT, 
@PrinterGroupID INT

AS
	
BEGIN
	
	--Verifica se já existe esse registro
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevices WHERE CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID)
	BEGIN
		BEGIN TRAN ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
		DECLARE @QuotaPrinterRuleID INT		
		
		--Verifica se existe crédito para esse grupo
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintersRules WHERE CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID AND [Enabled] = 1)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @TBCreditsGroups TABLE (QuotaPrinterRuleID INT)
		
			--Busca as regras (de crédito) desse grupo
			INSERT INTO
				@TBCreditsGroups
			SELECT
				QuotaPrinterRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasPrintersRules
			WHERE
				[Enabled] = 1
				AND QuotaPrinterPeriodID IS NULL
				AND CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCreditsGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaPrinterRuleID = QuotaPrinterRuleID
				FROM
					@TBCreditsGroups
					
				--Insere o crédito
				INSERT INTO QuotasPrintersCredits (QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, OperatorID, [Enabled])
				SELECT
					@QuotaPrinterRuleID,
					@PrinterID,
					NULL, --CostAccountID,
					GETDATE(),
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					FinishDate,
					OperatorID,
					1 --[Enabled]
				FROM
					QuotasPrintersRules
				WHERE
					QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBCreditsGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
			END
			
			DECLARE @TBRulesGroups TABLE (QuotaPrinterRuleID INT)
		
			--Busca as regras com renovação desse grupo e que tenham a opção de crédito imediato habilitada
			INSERT INTO
				@TBRulesGroups
			SELECT
				QR.QuotaPrinterRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasPrintersRules QR
				INNER JOIN QuotasPrintersPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPrinterPeriodID = QR.QuotaPrinterPeriodID
			WHERE
				[Enabled] = 1
				AND QR.QuotaPrinterPeriodID IS NOT NULL
				AND QP.LastDateRepeated IS NOT NULL
				AND QP.InstantCredit = 1
				AND CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBRulesGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaPrinterRuleID = QuotaPrinterRuleID
				FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
					
				--Insere o crédito
				INSERT INTO QuotasPrintersCredits (QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, OperatorID, [Enabled])
				SELECT
					@QuotaPrinterRuleID,
					@PrinterID,
					NULL, --CostAccountID,
					GETDATE(),
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					FinishDate,
					OperatorID,
					1 --[Enabled]
				FROM
					QuotasPrintersRules
				WHERE
					QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
			END
		END
		
		COMMIT ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	END
	
END
```

## 29. proc_360_PrintersGroups_RemovePrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_PrintersGroups_RemovePrinter]
@PrinterID INT, 
@PrinterGroupID INT

AS
	
BEGIN

	--Verifica se já existe esse registro
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevices WHERE CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID)
	BEGIN
		BEGIN TRAN ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		
		--Verifica se existe alguma regra desse grupo
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintersRules WHERE CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @TBRulesGroups TABLE (QuotaPrinterRuleID INT)
			DECLARE @QuotaPrinterRuleID INT
		
			--Busca as regras (de crédito) desse grupo
			INSERT INTO
				@TBRulesGroups
			SELECT
				QuotaPrinterRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasPrintersRules
			WHERE
				--[Enabled] = 1
				--AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
				CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBRulesGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaPrinterRuleID = QuotaPrinterRuleID
				FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
					
				--Verifica se existe algum crédito, para essa regra nesse usuário
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintersCredits WHERE QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID)
				BEGIN
					--Desabilita as regras
					UPDATE QuotasPrintersCredits SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID
					
					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
														
					--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
					INSERT INTO
						QuotasPrintersExpires
						(
							QuotaPrinterCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
						)
					SELECT
						QC.QuotaPrinterCreditID, GETDATE(),
						QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
						QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
					FROM
						QuotasPrintersCredits QC
					WHERE
						QC.QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
						AND QC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID
						AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
						
					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
				END
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
			END
		END
		
		COMMIT ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	END
	
END
```
