## 30. proc_360_ProcessQueues_Account_ChangeDomain

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_ProcessQueues_Account_ChangeDomain] 
@DomainID INT,
@UserID INT,
@LastExecution BIT,
@EndNow BIT OUTPUT,
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Alterado para atualizar as tabelas PoliciesMembers e PoliciesMembersRemoved
	-- Wesley Lemos, 2019-08-27
	--
	-- Alterado para enviar ao Host atualização e remoção de usuário ao realizar união de domínios.
	-- Douglas Macedo, 2018-07-25
	--
	-- Inicializado @AuxUserID = NULL e verificado no IF se @AuxUserID não é nulo
	-- Anderson Tabaldi, 2019-04-29
	--
	-- Alterado para atualizar a tabela de AccountsAliases e CostAccountsManagers
	-- Anderson Tabaldi, 2019-04-02
	--
	-- Alterado para deletar notificações dos usuários que estão sendo unidos
	-- Arthur S. Neto, 2020-01-13
	--
	-- Revisado para deletar/atualizar todas as dependências do domínio
	-- Anderson Tabaldi, 2020-09-15
	--
	-- Alterado para não criar usuário vinculado quando for o mesmo logon BUG#47490
	-- Rodrigo Scopel, 2020-09-15
	--
	-- Alterado para não inserir usuário duplicado na teabela AccountsAliases ISSUE#57152
	-- Anderson Felipe de Liz, 2021-09-16

	-- Alterado para corrigir referência com a PrintJobsSaveToner ISSUE#65971
	-- Anderson Felipe de Liz, 2022-10-05

	-- Alterado para corrigir comportamento de herança de permissão
	-- Anderson Felipe de Liz, 2023-01-23
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @AuxUserID INT = NULL
	DECLARE @AccountID INT
	DECLARE @AuxAccountID INT

	--Verifica se o usuário a ser deletado, tem o mesmo logon no domínio para o qual será movido
	SELECT
		@AuxUserID = AccountID,
		@AuxAccountID = CostAccountID
	FROM
		Accounts
	WHERE
		LogonName = (SELECT LogonName FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @UserID) 
		AND	DomainID = @DomainID

	IF(@AuxUserID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndNow = 0
		
		--Atualiza o ID do CostAccountID do usuário que permanecerá
		SELECT @AuxAccountID = CostAccountID FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID
		
		UPDATE
			PrintJobs
		SET
			AccountID = @AuxUserID,
			CostAccountID = @AuxAccountID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @UserID 
			AND	(((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate)) 
			OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate)) 
			OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
			
		UPDATE
			PrintJobsCanceled
		SET
			AccountID = @AuxUserID,
			CostAccountID = @AuxAccountID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @UserID 
			AND (((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate)) 
			OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate)) 
			OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

		UPDATE
			PrintJobsSaveToner
		SET
			AccountID = @AuxUserID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @UserID 
			AND	(((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate)) 
			OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate)) 
			OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

		IF(@LastExecution = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Pega ID da conta do usuário que será deletado
			SELECT @AccountID = CostAccountID FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @UserID
			
			UPDATE
				Accounts
			SET
				CostAccountID = @AccountID
			WHERE
				AccountID = @AuxUserID 
				AND @AccountID IS NOT NULL 
				AND	@AuxAccountID IS NULL
				
			UPDATE	
				ScheduledReports
			SET
				OwnerAccountID = @AuxUserID
			WHERE
				OwnerAccountID = @UserID
				
			UPDATE	
				Policies
			SET
				AccountIDOwner = @AuxUserID
			WHERE
				AccountIDOwner = @UserID

			DECLARE @userPermissionControlId INT

			DECLARE @UserControl INT
			DECLARE @UserAccess INT
			SELECT @UserControl = PermissionControlID, @UserAccess = PermissionAccessID FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @UserID
			
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID)
			BEGIN
			    UPDATE
			        AccountsPermissions
			    SET
			        AccountID = @AuxUserID
			    WHERE
			        AccountID = @UserID
			END
			ELSE IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE PermissionControlID = @UserControl AND AccountID = @AuxUserID)
			BEGIN
			    UPDATE
			        AccountsPermissions
			    SET
			        AccountID = @AuxUserID
			    WHERE
			        AccountID = @UserID
			END
			ELSE IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE PermissionAccessID <> 0 AND PermissionAccessID = @UserAccess AND AccountID = @AuxUserID)
			BEGIN
			    UPDATE
			        AccountsPermissions
			    SET
			        PermissionAccessID = @UserAccess
			    WHERE
			        AccountID = @AuxUserID
			END

			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsPassport WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					AccountsPassport
				SET
					AccountID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID
			END

			--Atualiza o histórico das ações do usuário

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Audits WHERE UserID = @UserID)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					Audits
				SET
					UserID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					UserID = @UserID
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Auditings WHERE AccountID = @UserID)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					Auditings
				SET
					AccountID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AuditObjects WHERE UserID = @UserID)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					AuditObjects
				SET
					UserID = @AuxUserID,
					ObjectText = (SELECT DomainName FROM Domains WHERE DomainID = (SELECT DomainID FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID)) + '\' + (SELECT LogonName FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID)
				WHERE
					UserID = @UserID
			END

			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @UserID)
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @RemainOperatorID INT
				DECLARE @ChangeOperatorID INT
				
				SELECT @RemainOperatorID = OperatorID FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID
				SELECT @ChangeOperatorID = OperatorID FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @UserID

				--Atualiza o ID do operador das tabelas de crédito e regras de cotas
				UPDATE 
					QuotasCredits
				SET
					OperatorID = @RemainOperatorID
				WHERE 
					OperatorID = @ChangeOperatorID
	
				UPDATE 
					QuotasRules
				SET
					OperatorID = @RemainOperatorID
				WHERE 
					OperatorID = @ChangeOperatorID

                DELETE FROM 
					QuotasOperators
				WHERE 
					OperatorID = @ChangeOperatorID
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsAliases WHERE AccountID = @UserID OR AccountIDMain = @UserID)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					AccountsAliases
				SET
					AccountID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID AND (SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsAliases WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID) IS NULL

				UPDATE
					AccountsAliases
				SET
					AccountIDMain = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountIDMain = @UserID
					
				DELETE
					AccountsAliases
				WHERE
					AccountID = AccountIDMain
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = @UserID)
			BEGIN
				IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID))
				BEGIN				
					DELETE FROM
						CostAccountsManagers
					WHERE
						AccountID = @UserID
				END
				ELSE		
				BEGIN				
					UPDATE
						CostAccountsManagers
					SET
						AccountID = @AuxUserID
					WHERE
						AccountID = @UserID
				END
			END
			
			WHILE(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPercentageAlertsSent WHERE AccountID = @UserID))
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @AlertID INT
				SELECT TOP 1 @AlertID = QuotaPercentageAlertID FROM QuotasPercentageAlertsSent WHERE AccountID = @UserID

				DELETE FROM
					QuotasPercentageAlertsCredits
				WHERE
					QuotaPercentageAlertID = @AlertID

				DELETE FROM
					QuotasPercentageAlertsSent
				WHERE
					QuotaPercentageAlertID = @AlertID
			END

			WHILE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE ObjectID = @UserID AND PolicyMemberType IN (1,5)))
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @PolicyMemberType INT
				DECLARE @PolicyMemberID INT
				DECLARE @PolicyID INT
				DECLARE @PrinterID INT

				SELECT TOP 1 
					@PolicyMemberType = PolicyMemberType, 
					@PolicyMemberID = PolicyMemberID, 
					@PolicyID = PolicyID, 
					@PrinterID = PrinterDeviceID
				FROM
					PoliciesMembers 
				WHERE 
					ObjectID = @UserID AND PolicyMemberType IN (1,5)

				IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE ObjectID = @AuxUserID AND PolicyID = @PolicyID AND PolicyMemberType = @PolicyMemberType AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID))
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO 
						PoliciesMembersRemoved 
					VALUES 
						(@PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE())
					
					DELETE FROM 
						PoliciesMembers 
					WHERE 
						PolicyMemberID = @PolicyMemberID
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE
						PoliciesMembers
					SET
						ObjectID = @AuxUserID,
						UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
					WHERE
						PolicyMemberID = @PolicyMemberID
				END
			END

			IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ScheduledAccountSend WHERE AccountID = @UserID) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ScheduledAccountSend WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE 
					ScheduledAccountSend
				SET
					AccountID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID				
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM
					ScheduledAccountSend
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID	
			END

			IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsViewSettings WHERE AccountID = @UserID) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsViewSettings WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE 
					AccountsViewSettings
				SET
					AccountID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID				
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM
					AccountsViewSettings
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID	
			END

			IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE AccountID = @UserID) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE 
					ScanFlowMembers
				SET
					AccountID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID				
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM
					ScanFlowMembers
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID	
			END
			
			IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches WHERE AccountID = @UserID) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches WHERE AccountID = @AuxUserID))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE 
					QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches
				SET
					AccountID = @AuxUserID
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID				
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM
					QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches
				WHERE
					AccountID = @UserID	
			END

			DELETE FROM 
				QuotasCredits 
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID
		
			DELETE FROM 
				QuotasDebits 
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID

			DELETE FROM 
				QuotasRules 
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID
				
			DELETE FROM
				QuotasPayments
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID

			DELETE FROM
				QuotasPercentageAlertsSent
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID

			DELETE FROM
				QuotasUnlimited
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID
	
			DELETE FROM 
				CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID

			DELETE FROM 
				AccountsGroupsObjects 
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID

			DELETE FROM
				AccountsPassportRequests
			WHERE
				AccountID = @UserID

			-- Deleta as atribuições de conta selecionavel
			UPDATE CostAccountsSelectable SET UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE AccountID = @UserID)
			
			IF (@AccountID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @AccountHierarchyIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = (SELECT dbo.GetCostAccountHierarchyIds (@AccountID))
				EXEC ('
					UPDATE
						CostAccountsSelectable
					SET
						UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
					WHERE
						CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE CostAccountID IN (' + @AccountHierarchyIds + '))')
			END

			DELETE FROM
				CostAccountsSelectableObjects
			WHERE
				AccountID = @UserID
			
			DELETE FROM
				GridColumns
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID

			--Deleta o usuário
			INSERT INTO 
				AccountsRemoved (AccountID, RemovedDate) 
			SELECT 
				A.AccountID, GETUTCDATE() 
			FROM Accounts A 
				INNER JOIN Domains D ON D.DomainID = A.DomainID 
			WHERE 
				A.AccountID = @UserID

			DELETE FROM 
				Accounts 
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @UserID

			--Atualiza os caches
			exec [proc_PoliciesControlsAccounts_Insert] @AuxUserID, 1, 1, 0
			exec [proc_PoliciesControlsAccounts_Insert] @UserID, 0, 0, 1
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @EndNow = 1

		UPDATE
			Accounts
		SET 
			DomainID = @DomainID,
			ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
		WHERE
			AccountID = @UserID
	
		-- Atualiza as conta selecionáveis que o usuário pertence
		UPDATE CostAccountsSelectable SET UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE AccountID = @UserID)
		
		SELECT @AccountID = CostAccountID FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @UserID

		IF (@AccountID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @UserAccountHierarchyIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = (SELECT dbo.GetCostAccountHierarchyIds (@AccountID))

			EXEC ('
				UPDATE
					CostAccountsSelectable
				SET
					UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
				WHERE
					CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE CostAccountID IN (' + @UserAccountHierarchyIds + '))')
		END

		--Atualiza os caches
		exec [proc_PoliciesControlsAccounts_Insert] @UserID, 1, 1, 1

		RETURN
	END
END

--##########################################################################################################################################
--FIM DA CRIAÇÃO DAS STORED PROCEDURES
```

## 31. proc_360_ProcessQueues_CreateAuthCodeBatchRequest

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_ProcessQueues_CreateAuthCodeBatchRequest]
@DomainID INT = NULL,
@AccountGroupID INT = NULL,
@ObjectQueueField INT,
@QueueType INT,
@Output INT OUTPUT 

AS

BEGIN

	IF(@QueueType <> 7)
	BEGIN
		--Só é possível ter uma fila de atualização para todos
		--menos a consolidação da impressora
		DELETE FROM
			ProcessQueues 
		WHERE 
			ProcessQueueType = @QueueType 
			AND ObjectQueueID = COALESCE(@DomainID, @AccountGroupID)
	END

	DECLARE @Period CHAR
	SET @Period = dbo.GetProcessQueuePeriod(GETDATE(), @QueueType, COALESCE(@DomainID, @AccountGroupID))

	IF (@Period = 'n')
	BEGIN
		SET @Output = 0
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@DomainID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				ProcessQueues
				(
					ProcessQueueType, 
					ObjectQueueID,
					ObjectQueueField,
					DateIncluded, 
					[Status], 
					ErrorDescription,
					LastDateUpdated,
					LastPeriodUpdated,
					Period
				)	
			SELECT 
				@QueueType,
				Ac.AccountID,
				@ObjectQueueField,
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				'',
				GETDATE(),
				NULL,
				@Period
			FROM 
				Accounts AS AC
				INNER JOIN AccountsGroupsObjects AS AGO ON AGO.AccountID = AC.AccountID 
			WHERE 
				AGO.AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
				AND AC.Removed = 0 
				AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AC.AccountID) = 1

			SELECT 
				@Output = count(1)
			FROM 
				Accounts AS AC
				INNER JOIN AccountsGroupsObjects AS AGO ON AGO.AccountID = AC.AccountID 
			WHERE 
				AGO.AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
				AND AC.Removed = 0 
				AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AC.AccountID) = 1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				ProcessQueues
				(
					ProcessQueueType, 
					ObjectQueueID, 
					ObjectQueueField,
					DateIncluded, 
					[Status], 
					ErrorDescription,
					LastDateUpdated,
					LastPeriodUpdated,
					Period
				)	
			SELECT 
				@QueueType,
				AccountID,
				@ObjectQueueField,
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				'',
				GETDATE(),
				NULL,
				@Period
			FROM 
				Accounts
			WHERE
				DomainID = @DomainID
				AND Removed = 0
				AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AccountID) = 1

			SELECT 
				@Output = count(1)
			FROM 
				Accounts
			WHERE
				DomainID = @DomainID
				AND Removed = 0
				AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AccountID) = 1
		END
	END
	
END
```

## 32. proc_360_ProcessQueues_DeleteDomain

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_ProcessQueues_DeleteDomain]
@DomainID INT

AS
BEGIN
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM
			ScheduledAccountSend
		WHERE
			AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		
		DELETE FROM
			ScheduledReports
		WHERE
			OwnerAccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		DELETE FROM
			QuotasCredits
		WHERE
			AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		DELETE FROM
			QuotasRules
		WHERE 
			AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		INSERT INTO 
			PoliciesMembersRemoved (PolicyMemberID, RemovedDate) 
		SELECT 
			PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE() 
		FROM 
			PoliciesMembers 
			WHERE 
			PolicyMemberType IN (1,5) 
			AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		INSERT INTO 
			PoliciesMembersRemoved (PolicyMemberID, RemovedDate) 
		SELECT 
			PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE() 
		FROM 
			PoliciesMembers 
		WHERE 
			PolicyMemberType = 2
			AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		DELETE FROM 
			PoliciesMembers 
		WHERE 
			PolicyMemberType = 2 
			AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	    
		DELETE FROM 
			PoliciesMembers
		WHERE 
			PolicyMemberType in (1,5) 
			AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountID from Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		INSERT INTO
			ScanFlowMembersRemoved (ScanFlowMemberID, RemovedDate)
		SELECT
			ScanFlowMemberID, GETUTCDATE()
		FROM
			ScanFlowMembers
		WHERE
			MemberType = 1
			AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		INSERT INTO
			ScanFlowMembersRemoved (ScanFlowMemberID, RemovedDate)
		SELECT
			ScanFlowMemberID, GETUTCDATE()
		FROM
			ScanFlowMembers
		WHERE
			MemberType = 2
			AND AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		DELETE FROM
			ScanFlowMembers
		WHERE
			MemberType = 1
			AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		DELETE FROM
			ScanFlowMembers
		WHERE
			MemberType = 2
			AND AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		DELETE FROM
			AccountsGroupsObjects
		WHERE 
			AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @AccountGroupID INT = (SELECT TOP(1) AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

			INSERT INTO AccountsGroupsRemoved (AccountGroupID, RemovedDate) VALUES (@AccountGroupID, GETUTCDATE())

			DELETE FROM
				AccountsGroups
			WHERE 
				AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
		END

		DELETE FROM
			CostAccountsManagers
		WHERE 
			AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		
		DELETE FROM
			CostAccountsHistorics
		WHERE 
			ObjectID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

		DELETE FROM
			DomainsAddresses
		WHERE 
			DomainID = @DomainID

		DECLARE @DomainAccessAdvancedID INT = (
			SELECT 
				DomainAccessSettingsAdvancedID 
			FROM 
				DomainAccessSettings
			WHERE 
				DomainAccessSettingsID = (SELECT DomainAccessSettingsID FROM [Domains] WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)) 

		DECLARE @DomainAccessID INT = (
			SELECT 
				DomainAccessSettingsID 
			FROM 
				Domains
			WHERE 
				DomainID = @DomainID)
	
		DELETE FROM
			[Domains]
		WHERE 
			DomainID = @DomainID

		DELETE FROM
			DomainAccessSettings
		WHERE 
			DomainAccessSettingsID = @DomainAccessID

		DELETE FROM
			DomainAccessSettingsAdvanced
		WHERE 
			DomainAccessSettingsAdvancedID = @DomainAccessAdvancedID

	END

	SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS AffectedRows
END
```

## 33. proc_360_ProcessQueues_PrepToCostAccountTypeChange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_ProcessQueues_PrepToCostAccountTypeChange]
@ProcessQueueID INT,
@LastAccountType INT

AS

BEGIN
	--Se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
	BEGIN
		RETURN 
	END

	DECLARE @CurrentAccountType INT
    SELECT @CurrentAccountType = ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'

	IF(@CurrentAccountType = 1 AND @LastAccountType = 3) -- De selecionáveis para usuários
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsSelectable
	END
	ELSE IF(@CurrentAccountType = 3 AND @LastAccountType = 1) -- De usuários para selecionáveis
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @TempTableAccounts TABLE
		(
			AccountID INT
		)
		INSERT INTO @TempTableAccounts (AccountID) SELECT CostAccountID FROM CostAccounts

		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TempTableAccounts)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @AccountID INT = (SELECT TOP(1) AccountID FROM @TempTableAccounts)
			DECLARE @AccountSelectableID INT = NULL

			INSERT INTO CostAccountsSelectable (CostAccountID, UpdatedDate) VALUES (@AccountID, GETUTCDATE())
			SET @AccountSelectableID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			INSERT INTO CostAccountsSelectableObjects (CostAccountSelectableID, IsAllSelectable) VALUES (@AccountSelectableID, 1)

			DELETE FROM @TempTableAccounts WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@CurrentAccountType = 2) -- De usuários/selecionáveis para impressoras
		BEGIN
			UPDATE Accounts SET ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE CostAccountID IS NOT NULL
			UPDATE Accounts SET CostAccountID = NULL WHERE CostAccountID IS NOT NULL
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN -- De impressoras para usuários/selecionáveis
			UPDATE PrintersDevices SET CostAccountID = NULL WHERE CostAccountID IS NOT NULL		
		END

        INSERT INTO CostAccountsRemoved SELECT CostAccountID, GETUTCDATE() FROM CostAccounts

		DELETE FROM CostAccountsJobsUpdate
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsHistorics
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsManagers
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsSelectable
	END   

    UPDATE 
		PoliciesControls 
	SET 
		PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1 
    WHERE 
        PolicyControlName = 'CostAccountID'
        OR PolicyControlName = 'PolicyParameterID'
		
	DELETE FROM
		ProcessQueues 
	WHERE
		ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID

END
```

## 34. proc_360_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveBalance

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveBalance]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	--Caso não tenha o crédito padrão adiciona
	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT, @TotalPages INT, @PagesMono INT, @PagesColor INT, @MoneyValue DECIMAL (19, 6), @IsCorporative INT, @OperatorID INT
	
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	
	SELECT
		@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID,
		@TotalPages = TotalPages,
		@PagesMono  = PagesMono,
		@PagesColor = PagesColor,
		@MoneyValue = MoneyValue,
		@IsCorporative = IsCorporative,
		@OperatorID = OperatorID
	FROM 
		QuotasRules
	WHERE 
		IsDefaultQuota = 1
		AND [Enabled]  = 1
	
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR AccountID = @AccountID) AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)))
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled]
)
		SELECT
				@QuotaRuleID,
				@AccountID,
				@CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				NULL,
				@IsCorporative,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
	END
		
	DECLARE @TBAccountsGroups TABLE (AccountGroupID INT)
	
	INSERT INTO
		@TBAccountsGroups
	SELECT
		AccountGroupID
	FROM 
		AccountsGroupsObjects 
	WHERE
		AccountID = @AccountID
	
	--Verifica se existe alguma regra dos grupos que o usuário pertence
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @TBAccountsGroups)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasRules WHERE AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM @TBAccountsGroups) AND [Enabled] = 1)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @TBRulesGroups TABLE (QuotaRuleID INT)
			SET @QuotaRuleID = -1
				
			--Busca as regras (de crédito) desse grupo
			INSERT INTO
				@TBRulesGroups
			SELECT
				QuotaRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasRules
			WHERE
				[Enabled] = 1
				AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
				AND AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM @TBAccountsGroups)
				
			--Remove pelo ID da regra, os créditos que o usuário já recebeu
			DELETE FROM
				@TBRulesGroups
			WHERE
				QuotaRuleID IN (SELECT QuotaRuleID FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID IN (SELECT QuotaRuleID FROM @TBRulesGroups) AND AccountID = @AccountID)
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBRulesGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID
				FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
					
				--Insere o crédito
				INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
				SELECT
					@QuotaRuleID,
					@AccountID,
					NULL, --CostAccountID,
					GETDATE(),
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					FinishDate,
					IsCorporative,
					OperatorID,
					1 --[Enabled]
				FROM
					QuotasRules
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			END
		END
	END

	DECLARE @Type INT  
	SELECT @Type = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 1 --QuotasType 
		
	--Busca o balanço
	SELECT 
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 1) THEN (SUM(TotalPages) - SUM(ExpenseTotalPages)) ELSE NULL END AS TotalPages,
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 2) THEN (SUM(PagesMono)  - SUM(ExpensePagesMono))  ELSE NULL END AS PagesMono,
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 2) THEN (SUM(PagesColor) - SUM(ExpensePagesColor)) ELSE NULL END AS PagesColor,
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 3) THEN (SUM(MoneyValue) - SUM(ExpenseMoneyValue)) ELSE NULL END AS MoneyValue,
		IsCorporative
	FROM
		QuotasCredits
	WHERE 
		(@AccountID IS NULL OR AccountID = @AccountID)
		AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND [Enabled] = 1
	GROUP BY
		IsCorporative
	
END
```

## 35. proc_360_QuotasCostAccounts_DebitQuota

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasCostAccounts_DebitQuota]
@AccountID INT,
@CostAccountID INT,
@UsedDateTime DATETIME,
@QuotaDebitHostID BIGINT,
@TotalPages INT = 0,
@PagesMono INT = 0,
@PagesColor INT = 0,
@MoneyValue DECIMAL(19,6) = 0,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@IsCorporative BIT = 1,
@DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID INT = -1,
@PrintJobID BIGINT = NULL,
@ForceDebitQuota BIT = 0,
@Description NVARCHAR(100) = NULL

AS

BEGIN
	
	--Verificamos se esse débito já foi inserido, caso sim inserimos os valores em uma tabela de log, para futuras consultas.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasDebits WHERE QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitHostID AND UsedDateTime = @UsedDateTime AND QuotaDebitHostID <> 0 AND @DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID = -1)
	BEGIN	
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	--Verificando se as cotas compartilhadas estão habilitadas
	DECLARE @Shared BIT
	SELECT @Shared = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS BIT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 3 

	IF (@Shared = 0) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		RETURN
	END

	--Se não informar a conta selecionável busco a conta que o usuário pertence
	IF (@CostAccountID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @CostAccountID = ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AccountID	
	END

	--0 = Desabilitado, 2 = Bloqueante, 3 = Não Bloqueante com aviso, 4 = Não bloqueante
	DECLARE @IsBlocked INT
	SELECT @IsBlocked = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 2 --QuotasState

	DECLARE @Type INT
	SELECT @Type = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 1 --QuotasType

	--Variáveis da tabela de créditos
	DECLARE @OrderID INT, @QuotaCreditID INT
	DECLARE @BCTotalPages INT, @BCPagesMono INT, @BCPagesColor INT, @BCMoneyValue DECIMAL(19, 6)
	
	DECLARE @TBCredits TABLE
		(
			OrderID INT IDENTITY(1, 1),
			QuotaCreditID INT,
			BCTotalPages INT,
			BCPagesMono INT,
			BCPagesColor INT,
			BCMoneyValue DECIMAL(19, 6),
			Updated BIT
		)
	
	BEGIN TRAN --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	--Retorna o ID do débito
	DECLARE @QuotaDebitID BIGINT

	--Verifica se esse débito já possui um PrintJobID
	SELECT
		@PrintJobID = QPJ.PrintJobID,
		@PrinterDeviceID = QPJ.PrinterDeviceID
	FROM
		QuotasPrintJobs QPJ
	WHERE
		QPJ.QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitHostID
		
	--Caso tenha remove ele da tabela de PrintJobs que chegaram antes do débito
	IF (@PrintJobID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM
			QuotasPrintJobs
		WHERE
			PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
			AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitHostID
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
	END
			
	--Quando for para balancear os créditos negativos, deve primeiro remover os débitos desse crédito negativo
	IF (@DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM
			QuotasDebits
		WHERE
			QuotaCreditID = @DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
							
		DELETE FROM
			QuotasCredits
		WHERE
			QuotaCreditID = @DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
	END
	
	--Por total de páginas
	IF (@Type = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@TBCredits
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
			0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		WHERE
			QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QC.FinishDate,
			CASE WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QP.NextDate

		--Executa o desconto dos créditos
		WHILE (@TotalPages > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCTotalPages = BCTotalPages
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID
					
			--Quando o total de páginas for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCTotalPages >= @TotalPages)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseTotalPages = ExpenseTotalPages + @TotalPages WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, @TotalPages, 0, 0, 0)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				SET @TotalPages = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseTotalPages = ExpenseTotalPages + @BCTotalPages WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, @BCTotalPages, 0, 0, 0)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
				
				SET @TotalPages = @TotalPages - @BCTotalPages
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE QuotasCredits SET [Enabled] = 0, DisabledDate = GETDATE() WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) = 0
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso falte créditos para esse débito (pode ser por alguma falha no host ou por estar do tipo 'Ignore')
		IF (@TotalPages > 0)
		BEGIN
			--Adiciona um crédito negativo para ficar registrado esse débito
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasCredits
					(
						QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
						ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
						FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled], DisabledDate
					)
			VALUES
				(
				--confirmar
					NULL, NULL, @CostAccountID, GETDATE(), 0, 0, 0, 0, --Totais
					@TotalPages, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					NULL, @IsCorporative, 1, 1, NULL --OperatorID, [Enabled] e DisabledDate
				)
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			SET @QuotaCreditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
			--Insere o débito			
			INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, @TotalPages, 0, 0, 0)

			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
			END
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
	END
	
	--Por cor
	IF (@Type = 2)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @TBDebitsMonoColor TABLE
			(
				QuotaCreditID INT,
				PagesMono INT,
				PagesColor INT
			)
	
		INSERT INTO
			@TBCredits
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			0,
			QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono,
			QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor,
			0, 0
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		WHERE
			QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QC.FinishDate,
			CASE WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QP.NextDate
			
		--Executa o desconto dos créditos mono
		WHILE (@PagesMono > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCPagesMono = BCPagesMono
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID
			
			--Quando o total de páginas for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCPagesMono >= @PagesMono AND @PagesMono > 0)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesMono = ExpensePagesMono + @PagesMono WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
				INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor(QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
				VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, @PagesMono, 0)
				
				SET @PagesMono = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (@BCPagesMono > 0)
				BEGIN
					--Executa o desconto
					UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesMono = ExpensePagesMono + @BCPagesMono WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
					
					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
					
					--Insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
					INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor(QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
					VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, @BCPagesMono, 0)
					
					SET @PagesMono = @PagesMono - @BCPagesMono
					
				END
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE
				QuotasCredits
			SET
				[Enabled] = 0,
				DisabledDate = GETDATE()
			WHERE 
				QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID 
				AND (PagesMono  - ExpensePagesMono)  = 0
				AND (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) = 0
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Reinicia a tabela dos créditos para descontar as páginas color
		UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 0 
		
		--Executa o desconto dos créditos color
		WHILE (@PagesColor > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCPagesColor = BCPagesColor
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID

			--Quando o total de páginas for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCPagesColor >= @PagesColor AND @PagesColor > 0)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesColor = ExpensePagesColor + @PagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Verifica se já existe um registro ou insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBDebitsMonoColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE @TBDebitsMonoColor SET PagesColor = @PagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor (QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
					VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, 0, @PagesColor)
				END
				
				SET @PagesColor = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (@BCPagesColor > 0)
				BEGIN
					--Executa o desconto
					UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesColor = ExpensePagesColor + @BCPagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID

					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
					
					--Verifica se já existe um registro ou insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBDebitsMonoColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID)
					BEGIN
						UPDATE @TBDebitsMonoColor SET PagesColor = @BCPagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor (QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
						VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, 0, @BCPagesColor)
					END
					
					SET @PagesColor = @PagesColor - @BCPagesColor
				END
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE
				QuotasCredits
			SET
				[Enabled] = 0,
				DisabledDate = GETDATE()
			WHERE 
				QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID 
				AND (PagesMono  - ExpensePagesMono)  = 0
				AND (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) = 0
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso não tenha uma descrição, insere os débitos normalmente
		IF (@Description IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			--Insere os débitos, baseado na tabela de débitos preenchida anteriormente
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			SELECT
				@QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, PagesMono, PagesColor, 0
			FROM
				@TBDebitsMonoColor
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Caso tenha uma descrição, guarda todos os débitos inseridos na tabela temporária e depois insere na tabela de descrições
			DECLARE @IDs TABLE (ID INT)
			
			--Insere os débitos, baseado na tabela de débitos preenchida anteriormente
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			OUTPUT 
				Inserted.IdentityCol INTO @IDs
			SELECT
				@QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, PagesMono, PagesColor, 0
			FROM
				@TBDebitsMonoColor
			
			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
			SELECT
				ID, @Description
			FROM
				@IDs
		END
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Caso falte créditos para esse débito (pode ser por alguma falha no host ou por estar do tipo 'Ignore')
		IF (@PagesMono > 0 OR @PagesColor > 0)
		BEGIN
			--Adiciona um crédito negativo para ficar registrado esse débito
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasCredits
					(
						QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
						ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
						FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled], DisabledDate
					)
			VALUES
				(
					NULL, NULL, @CostAccountID, GETDATE(), 0, 0, 0, 0, --Totais
					0, @PagesMono, @PagesColor, 0, --Expenses
					NULL, @IsCorporative, 1, 1, NULL --OperatorID, [Enabled] e DisabledDate
				)
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
				
			SET @QuotaCreditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
			--Insere o débito
			INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, @PagesMono, @PagesColor, 0)

			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
			END
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
	END
	
	--Por valor
	IF (@Type = 3)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@TBCredits
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			0, 0, 0,
			QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
			0
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		WHERE
			QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QC.FinishDate,
			CASE WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QP.NextDate

		--Executa o desconto dos créditos
		WHILE (@MoneyValue > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCMoneyValue = BCMoneyValue
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID
			
			--Quando o valor for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCMoneyValue >= @MoneyValue)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseMoneyValue = ExpenseMoneyValue + @MoneyValue WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, 0, 0, @MoneyValue)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
			
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				SET @MoneyValue = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseMoneyValue = ExpenseMoneyValue + @BCMoneyValue WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, 0, 0, @BCMoneyValue)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
				
				SET @MoneyValue = @MoneyValue - @BCMoneyValue
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE QuotasCredits SET [Enabled] = 0, DisabledDate = GETDATE() WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) = 0
		
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso falte créditos para esse débito (pode ser por alguma falha no host ou por estar do tipo 'Ignore')
		IF (@MoneyValue > 0)
		BEGIN
			--Adiciona um crédito negativo para ficar registrado esse débito
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasCredits
					(
						QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
						ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
						FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled], DisabledDate
					)
			VALUES
				(
					NULL, NULL, @CostAccountID, GETDATE(), 0, 0, 0, 0, --Totais
					0, 0, 0, @MoneyValue, --Expenses
					NULL, @IsCorporative, 1, 1, NULL --OperatorID, [Enabled] e DisabledDate
				)
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			SET @QuotaCreditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			--Insere o débito			
			INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, 0, 0, @MoneyValue)

			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
			END
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
	END
	
	COMMIT TRAN -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	SELECT 1
	
END
```

## 36. proc_360_QuotasCostAccounts_HasPositiveCredit

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasCostAccounts_HasPositiveCredit]
@CostAccountID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		COUNT(1)
	FROM
		QuotasCredits QC
	WHERE
		QC.OperatorID <> 1
		AND [Enabled] = 1
		AND CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
		AND (
				((TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0 )
				OR ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
				OR ((MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0)
			)
	
END
```

## 37. proc_360_QuotasCostAccounts_RetrieveBalance

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasCostAccounts_RetrieveBalance]
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @QuotaObjectType INT  
	SELECT @QuotaObjectType = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterName = 'QuotasObjectType' 
		
	-- Retorna -1 caso o tipo de cota for diferente de compartilhada (2)
	IF (@QuotaObjectType <> 2)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			-1 AS TotalPages,
			-1 AS PagesMono,
			-1 AS PagesColor,
			CAST(-1 AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS MoneyValue

		RETURN
	END

	--Caso não tenha o crédito padrão adiciona
	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT, @TotalPages INT, @PagesMono INT, @PagesColor INT, @MoneyValue DECIMAL (19, 6), @OperatorID INT
	
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	
	SELECT
		@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID,
		@TotalPages = TotalPages,
		@PagesMono  = PagesMono,
		@PagesColor = PagesColor,
		@MoneyValue = MoneyValue,
		@OperatorID = OperatorID
	FROM 
		QuotasRules
	WHERE 
		IsDefaultQuota = 1
		AND [Enabled]  = 1
	
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)))
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO QuotasCredits 
		(
			QuotaRuleID, 
			AccountID, 
			CostAccountID, 
			CreatedDateTime, 
			TotalPages, 
			PagesMono, 
			PagesColor, 
			MoneyValue, 
			ExpenseTotalPages, 
			ExpensePagesMono, 
			ExpensePagesColor, 
			ExpenseMoneyValue, 
			FinishDate, 
			IsCorporative, 
			OperatorID, 
			[Enabled]
		)
		SELECT
			@QuotaRuleID,
			NULL,
			@CostAccountID,
			@DateTimeNow,
			@TotalPages,
			@PagesMono,
			@PagesColor,
			@MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			NULL,
			1,
			@OperatorID,
			1 --[Enabled]
	END

	DECLARE @Type INT  
	SELECT @Type = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 1 --QuotasType 
			
	--Busca o balanço
	SELECT 
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 1) THEN (SUM(TotalPages) - SUM(ExpenseTotalPages)) ELSE NULL END AS TotalPages,
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 2) THEN (SUM(PagesMono)  - SUM(ExpensePagesMono))  ELSE NULL END AS PagesMono,
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 2) THEN (SUM(PagesColor) - SUM(ExpensePagesColor)) ELSE NULL END AS PagesColor,
		CASE WHEN (@Type = 3) THEN (SUM(MoneyValue) - SUM(ExpenseMoneyValue)) ELSE NULL END AS MoneyValue
	FROM
		QuotasCredits
	WHERE 
		(@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND [Enabled] = 1
	
END
```

## 38. proc_360_QuotasCredits_RetrieveNegative

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasCredits_RetrieveNegative]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	--Busca os créditos negativos
	SELECT
		QC.QuotaCreditID,
		COALESCE(QC.AccountID, QD.AccountID, -1) AS UserID,
		ISNULL(QC.CostAccountID, -1) AS AccountID,
		QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
		QC.ExpensePagesMono,
		QC.ExpensePagesColor,
		QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		QC.IsCorporative,
		QC.OperatorID,
		
		QD.QuotaHostID,
		QD.QuotaDebitHostID,
		ISNULL(QD.PrintJobID, -1) AS PrintJobID,
		ISNULL(QD.PrinterDeviceID, -1) AS PrinterID,
		QD.UsedDateTime		
	FROM
		QuotasCredits QC
		INNER JOIN QuotasDebits QD ON QD.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
	WHERE
		QC.OperatorID = 1
		AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
		AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR QC.AccountID = @AccountID)
		AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND (
				QC.AccountID IN (
					SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0) 
				OR QC.CostAccountID IN (
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0)
			)
END
```

## 39. proc_360_QuotasHosts_SetQuotaHostID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasHosts_SetQuotaHostID]
@StrongName NVARCHAR(32) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @QuotaHostID INT = -1

	SELECT @QuotaHostID = QuotaHostID FROM QuotasHosts WHERE StrongName = @StrongName

	IF(@QuotaHostID = -1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @LastID INT = NULL, @NewID INT = NULL

		SELECT TOP 1 @LastID = QuotaHostID FROM QuotasHosts ORDER BY QuotaHostID DESC

		IF(@LastID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @NewID = 1
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @NewID = @LastID + 1
		END

		INSERT INTO 
			QuotasHosts (QuotaHostID, StrongName) 
		VALUES 
			(@NewID, @StrongName)

		SET @QuotaHostID = @NewID
	END

	SELECT @QuotaHostID

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasPrinterCredits_RetrieveNegative]
@PrinterID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	--Busca os créditos negativos
	SELECT
		QC.QuotaPrinterCreditID,
		COALESCE(QC.PrinterDeviceID, QD.PrinterDeviceID, -1) AS PrinterID,
		ISNULL(QC.CostAccountID, -1) AS AccountID,
		QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
		QC.ExpensePagesMono,
		QC.ExpensePagesColor,
		QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		QC.OperatorID,
		
		QD.QuotaPrinterDebitHostID,
		ISNULL(QD.PrintJobID, -1) AS PrintJobID,
		QD.UsedDateTime,
		QD.AccountID AS UserID
	FROM
		QuotasPrintersCredits QC
		INNER JOIN QuotasPrintersDebits QD ON QD.QuotaPrinterCreditID = QC.QuotaPrinterCreditID
	WHERE
		QC.OperatorID = 1
		AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
		AND (@PrinterID IS NULL OR QC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID)
		AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND (
				QC.PrinterDeviceID IN (
					SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0) 
				OR QC.CostAccountID IN (
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0)
			)
END
```

## 42. proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_Insert] 
@PrinterID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
@PrinterGroupID INT = NULL,
@TotalPages INT,
@PagesMono INT,
@PagesColor INT,
@MoneyValue DECIMAL (19,6),
@FinishDate DATETIME = NULL,
--QuotasPeriods
@PeriodType INT = NULL,
@PeriodQuantity INT = NULL,
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@StartDay INT = NULL,
@StartMonth INT = NULL,
@RepeatTimes INT = 0,
@IsExpire BIT = NULL,
@InstantCredit BIT = 0,
--QuotasOperators
@OperatorID INT

AS

BEGIN

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	DECLARE @QuotaCreditOrRuleID INT
	DECLARE @QuotaPeriodID INT
	SET @QuotaPeriodID = NULL

	-- Caso tenha recorrência, primeiro cria o registro na tabela de recorrências
	IF (@PeriodType IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersPeriods
				(
					PeriodType,
					PeriodQuantity,
					StartDate,

					StartDay,
					StartMonth,
					NextDate,
					RepeatTimes,
					RepeatedTimes,
					IsExpire,
					LastDateRepeated,
					InstantCredit)
		VALUES
			(
				@PeriodType,
				@PeriodQuantity,
				@StartDate,
				@StartDay,
				@StartMonth,
				ISNULL(@StartDate, dbo.GetQuotasFirstNextDate(@PeriodType, @StartDay)),
				@RepeatTimes,
				0, --RepeatedTimes
				@IsExpire,
				NULL, --LastDateRepeated,
				@InstantCredit
			)
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
			

		SELECT @QuotaPeriodID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	
	-- Caso não tenha recorrência e o crédito não seja para um grupo, adicionar apenas o crédito
	IF (@QuotaPeriodID IS NULL AND @PrinterGroupID IS NULL)
	BEGIN		
		--Insere o crédito
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersCredits
				(
					QuotaPrinterRuleID,
					PrinterDeviceID,
					CostAccountID,
					CreatedDateTime,	
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					ExpenseTotalPages,
					ExpensePagesMono,
					ExpensePagesColor,
					ExpenseMoneyValue,
					FinishDate,
					OperatorID,
					[Enabled]
				)
		VALUES
			(
				NULL,
				@PrinterID,
				@CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				@FinishDate,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
			)
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)	
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		SET @QuotaCreditOrRuleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
				
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--Insere a regra de cota
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersRules
				(
					PrinterDeviceID,
					CostAccountID,
					CostGroupID,
					CreatedDateTime,
					TotalPages,
 					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					QuotaPrinterPeriodID,
					FinishDate,
					OperatorID,
					IsDefaultQuota,
					[Enabled]
				) 
		VALUES
			(
				@PrinterID,
				@CostAccountID,
				@PrinterGroupID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				@QuotaPeriodID,
				@FinishDate,
				@OperatorID,
				0, --IsDefaultQuota,
				1  --Enabled
			)
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		SET @QuotaCreditOrRuleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
		
		--Caso seja apenas um crédito para o grupo, já adiciona esses créditos
		IF (@QuotaPeriodID IS NULL AND @PrinterGroupID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN		
	
			--Insere o crédito
			INSERT INTO QuotasPrintersCredits (QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, OperatorID, [Enabled])
			SELECT
				@QuotaCreditOrRuleID,
				PD.PrinterDeviceID,
				NULL, --CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				@FinishDate,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
			FROM
				PrintersDevices PD
			WHERE
				CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END
		END		

	END
	
	SELECT @QuotaCreditOrRuleID

	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END
```

## 43. proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_ProcessCredits

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_ProcessCredits]
@DateProcess DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @TBQuotasRules TABLE
		(
			QuotaRuleID INT,
			QuotaPeriodID INT,
			RepeatTimes INT,
			RepeatedTimes INT,
			IsExpire BIT,
			Updated BIT
		)
	
	--Busca todas as regras habilitadas, com o último processamento e próxima adição dos créditos igual a data indicada
	INSERT INTO
		@TBQuotasRules
	SELECT
		QR.QuotaPrinterRuleID,
		QP.QuotaPrinterPeriodID,
		QP.RepeatTimes,
		QP.RepeatedTimes,
		QP.IsExpire,
		0 --Updated
	FROM
		QuotasPrintersRules QR
		INNER JOIN QuotasPrintersPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPrinterPeriodID = QR.QuotaPrinterPeriodID
	WHERE
		[Enabled] = 1
		AND (QP.LastDateRepeated IS NULL OR QP.LastDateRepeated < @DateProcess)
		AND (QP.NextDate = @DateProcess)

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT, @QuotaPeriodID INT, @RepeatTimes INT, @RepeatedTimes INT, @IsExpire BIT
	
	--Processa cada regra
	WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @TBQuotasRules WHERE Updated = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1
			@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID,
			@QuotaPeriodID = QuotaPeriodID,
			@RepeatTimes = RepeatTimes,
			@RepeatedTimes = RepeatedTimes,
			@IsExpire = IsExpire
		FROM 	
			@TBQuotasRules 
		WHERE
			Updated = 0
		
		--Se for com expiração dos créditos, desabilita todos os créditos recebidos por essa regra
		IF (@IsExpire = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
			INSERT INTO	
				QuotasPrintersExpires
				(
					QuotaPrinterCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
				)
			SELECT
					QC.QuotaPrinterCreditID, GETDATE(),
					QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
					QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
			FROM
				QuotasPrintersCredits QC
			WHERE
				QC.QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN	
				RETURN
			END	
			
			--Desabilita todos os créditos dessa regra, pois já foi criado as expirações necessárias
			UPDATE QuotasPrintersCredits SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN			
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso tenha repetido as vezes necessárias e a regra era para expirar, somente vai desabilitar essa regra
		IF (@RepeatTimes > 0 AND @RepeatTimes <= @RepeatedTimes AND @IsExpire = 1)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE QuotasPrintersRules SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE QuotasPrintersPeriods SET NextDate = NULL WHERE QuotaPrinterPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0			
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE @TBQuotasRules SET Updated = 1 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		
			CONTINUE
		END
		
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
		
		--Insere os créditos para as regras que não são de grupo e não é a padrão
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersCredits
			(
				QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono,
				ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT
			QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			FinishDate, OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersRules
		WHERE
			QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND CostGroupID IS NULL
			AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
			
		--Insere os créditos para a regra padrão
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersCredits
			(
				QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
				ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT DISTINCT
			QR.QuotaPrinterRuleID, QC.PrinterDeviceID, QR.CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			QR.TotalPages, QR.PagesMono, QR.PagesColor, QR.MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			QR.FinishDate, QR.OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersRules QR
			INNER JOIN QuotasPrintersCredits QC ON QC.QuotaPrinterRuleID = QR.QuotaPrinterRuleID
		WHERE
			QR.QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND QR.QuotaPrinterPeriodID IS NOT NULL
			AND QR.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.IsDefaultQuota = 1
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Insere os créditos para as regras que são de grupo
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersCredits
			(
				QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
				ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT
			QuotaPrinterRuleID, P.PrinterDeviceID, QR.CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			FinishDate, OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersRules QR
			INNER JOIN CostGroups AG ON AG.CostGroupID = QR.CostGroupID
            INNER JOIN PrintersDevices P ON AG.CostGroupID = P.CostGroupID
		WHERE
			QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Atualiza a data do próximo crédito e número de repetições
		UPDATE
			QuotasPrintersPeriods
		SET		
			LastDateRepeated = NextDate,
			NextDate = dbo.GetQuotasNextDate(PeriodType, PeriodQuantity, StartDay, NextDate),
			RepeatedTimes = RepeatedTimes + 1
		WHERE
			QuotaPrinterPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
			
		--Caso tenha repetido AS vezes necessárias e a regra era para manter os créditos, somente vai desabilitar essa regra
		IF (@RepeatTimes > 0 AND @RepeatTimes <= @RepeatedTimes + 1 AND @IsExpire = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE QuotasPrintersRules SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE QuotasPrintersPeriods SET NextDate = NULL WHERE QuotaPrinterPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		UPDATE @TBQuotasRules SET Updated = 1 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
	END
	
	--Processa os créditos expirados das impressoras
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintersCredits WHERE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(FinishDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME) <= @DateProcess AND [Enabled] = 1 AND QuotaPrinterRuleID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersExpires
			(
				QuotaPrinterCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
				QC.QuotaPrinterCreditID, GETDATE(),
				QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
				QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersCredits QC
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.QuotaPrinterRuleID IS NULL
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita todos os créditos que tenham data de expiração anterior a data indicada
		UPDATE
			QuotasPrintersCredits
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		WHERE
			FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND QuotaPrinterRuleID IS NULL
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Processa os créditos expirados dos grupos
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintersRules WHERE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(FinishDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME) <= @DateProcess AND [Enabled] = 1 AND CostGroupID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersExpires
			(
				QuotaPrinterCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
				QC.QuotaPrinterCreditID, GETDATE(),
				QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
				QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersCredits QC
			INNER JOIN QuotasPrintersRules QR ON QR.QuotaPrinterRuleID = QC.QuotaPrinterRuleID
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.CostGroupID IS NOT NULL
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita todos os créditos que tenham data de expiração anterior a data indicada
		UPDATE
			QC
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersCredits QC
			INNER JOIN QuotasPrintersRules QR ON QR.QuotaPrinterRuleID = QC.QuotaPrinterRuleID
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.CostGroupID IS NOT NULL
					
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita a regra também, já que ela expirou
		UPDATE
			QuotasPrintersRules
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		WHERE
			FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND CostGroupID IS NOT NULL
			AND QuotaPrinterPeriodID IS NULL
		
	
	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
	END

	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	SELECT 1

END
```

## 44. proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_Remove] 
@QuotaPrinterRuleID INT

AS

BEGIN

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	UPDATE
		QuotasPrintersCredits
	SET
		[Enabled] = 0
	WHERE
		QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
				
	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
		
	--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
	INSERT INTO
		QuotasPrintersExpires
		(
			QuotaPrinterCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
		)
	SELECT
		QPC.QuotaPrinterCreditID, GETDATE(),
		QPC.TotalPages - QPC.ExpenseTotalPages, QPC.PagesMono - QPC.ExpensePagesMono, 
		QPC.PagesColor - QPC.ExpensePagesColor, QPC.MoneyValue - QPC.ExpenseMoneyValue

	FROM
		QuotasPrintersCredits QPC
	WHERE
		QPC.QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID
		AND QPC.QuotaPrinterCreditID NOT IN 
		(SELECT QuotaPrinterCreditID FROM QuotasPrintersExpires WHERE QuotaPrinterCreditID IN 
		(SELECT QuotaPrinterCreditID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits WHERE QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID))

	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
	
	UPDATE
		QuotasPrintersRules 
	SET
		[Enabled] = 0
	WHERE
		QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaPrinterRuleID

	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
	
	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END
```

## 46. proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_SetDefaultQuota

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_360_QuotasPrintersRules_SetDefaultQuota]
@TotalPages INT,
@PagesMono INT,
@PagesColor INT,
@MoneyValue DECIMAL (19,6),
@OperatorID INT,
--QuotasPeriods
@PeriodType INT = NULL,
@PeriodQuantity INT = NULL,
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@StartDay INT = NULL,
@StartMonth INT = NULL,
@IsExpire BIT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()

	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT
	SELECT @QuotaRuleID = QuotaPrinterRuleID FROM QuotasPrintersRules WHERE IsDefaultQuota = 1 AND [Enabled] = 1
	
	DECLARE @QuotaPeriodID INT
	SET @QuotaPeriodID = NULL

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	-- Caso tenha recorrência, primeiro cria o registro na tabela de recorrências
	IF (@PeriodType IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersPeriods
			(
				PeriodType,
				PeriodQuantity,
				StartDate,
				StartDay,
				StartMonth,
				NextDate,
				RepeatTimes,
				RepeatedTimes,
				IsExpire,		
				LastDateRepeated,
				InstantCredit
			)
		VALUES
			(
				@PeriodType,
				@PeriodQuantity,
				@StartDate,
				@StartDay,
				@StartMonth,
				ISNULL(@StartDate, dbo.GetQuotasFirstNextDate(@PeriodType, @StartDay)),
				0, --RepeatTimes,
				0, --RepeatedTimes
				@IsExpire,
				NULL, --LastDateRepeated,
				0  --InstantCredit
			)
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
			
		SELECT @QuotaPeriodID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	
	--Quando não tiver uma cota padrão, não precisa realizar esses passos
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPrintersExpires
			(
				QuotaPrinterCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
			QPC.QuotaPrinterCreditID, @DateTimeNow,
			QPC.TotalPages - QPC.ExpenseTotalPages, QPC.PagesMono - QPC.ExpensePagesMono, 
			QPC.PagesColor - QPC.ExpensePagesColor, QPC.MoneyValue - QPC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersCredits QPC
		WHERE
			QPC.QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND QPC.[Enabled] = 1

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		UPDATE
			QuotasPrintersCredits
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		WHERE
			QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)

		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
				
		UPDATE
			QuotasPrintersRules 
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		WHERE
			QuotaPrinterRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
	END
	
	--Insere a regra padrão

	INSERT INTO
		QuotasPrintersRules
		(
			PrinterDeviceID,
			CostAccountID,
			CreatedDateTime,
			TotalPages,
			PagesMono,
			PagesColor,
			MoneyValue,
			QuotaPrinterPeriodID,
			FinishDate,
			OperatorID,
			IsDefaultQuota,
			[Enabled]	
		) 
	VALUES
		(
			NULL, --PrinterID,
			NULL, --CostAccountID,
			@DateTimeNow,
			@TotalPages,
			@PagesMono,
			@PagesColor,
			@MoneyValue,
			@QuotaPeriodID,
			NULL, --FinishDate,
			@OperatorID,
			1, --IsDefaultQuota,
			1 --Enabled
		)
		
	-- Atualiza o saldo dos usuários com a nova regra padrão caso já existia uma regra padrão configurada
	IF(@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PrinterID INT)
		INSERT INTO @Printers SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM QuotasPrintersCredits WHERE PrinterDeviceID IS NOT NULL

		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Printers)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @PrinterID INT = (SELECT TOP(1) PrinterID FROM @Printers)

			DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(100) = 'proc_QuotasPrinters_RetrieveBalance ' + CAST(@PrinterID AS NVARCHAR)
			EXEC(@SQL)

			DELETE @Printers WHERE PrinterID = @PrinterID
		END
	END
		
	SELECT @QuotaRuleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
	--Adiciona a regra padrão aos usuários que já tinha débitos
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL AND @QuotaPeriodID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO QuotasPrintersCredits (QuotaPrinterRuleID, PrinterDeviceID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, OperatorID, [Enabled])
		SELECT DISTINCT
				@QuotaRuleID,
				QPD.PrinterDeviceID,
				QPD.CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				NULL, --FinishDate
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasPrintersDebits QPD
			INNER JOIN QuotasPrintersCredits QPC ON QPC.QuotaPrinterCreditID = QPD.QuotaPrinterCreditID
		WHERE
			QPC.QuotaPrinterRuleID <> @QuotaRuleID
				
	END

	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	SELECT 1
END
```

```sql
AS

BEGIN

	BEGIN

	END
```

```sql
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	DELETE FROM
		QuotasPrintersRules
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	COMMIT -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END
```
