## 107. proc_AccountsPinCodes_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_AccountsPinCodes_Update]
@AccountID INT,
@PinCode NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@SecurePinCode NVARCHAR(24) = NULL,
@IDCardCode NVARCHAR(255) = NULL
AS	
BEGIN
	--Se não tiver id do cartão, vai atualizar os PINs
	IF (@IDCardCode IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Se já existe um registro para esse usuário, vai atualizar
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPinCodes WHERE AccountID = @AccountID)
		BEGIN
			--Se tem PIN é pra atualizar
			IF (@PinCode IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				-- Se já existe esse PIN cadastrado e o mesmo é diferente de '-1'('-1' é utilizado para indicar que foi setado com 
				-- vazio o PinCode na InterfaceWeb e tem que atualizar como NULL) é utilizado , vai atualizar o ID do usuário
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPinCodes WHERE PinCode = @PinCode AND @PinCode <> '-1')
				BEGIN
					--Remove esse PIN do usuário que utiliza ele
					UPDATE
						AccountsPinCodes
					SET
						PinCode = ''
					WHERE
						PinCode = @PinCode
												
					--Atualiza esse PIN para o usuário que vai utilizar ele
					UPDATE
						AccountsPinCodes
					SET
						PinCode = @PinCode
					WHERE
						AccountID = @AccountID
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN --Se o PIN não existe, somente atualiza
					UPDATE
						AccountsPinCodes
					SET
						-- Se o PIN veio '-1' então é para atualizar como NULL, pois na interface
						-- o mesmo foi setado como vazio, senão atualiza com o PIN
						PinCode = CASE @PinCode WHEN '-1' THEN NULL ELSE @PinCode END
					WHERE
						AccountID = @AccountID
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN --Se não existe um registro para esse usuário, vai criar
				UPDATE
					AccountsPinCodes
				SET
					SecurePinCode = @SecurePinCode
				WHERE
					AccountID = @AccountID
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se já existe esse PIN cadastrado, vai atualizar o ID do usuário
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPinCodes WHERE PinCode = @PinCode)
			BEGIN
				--Remove esse PIN do usuário que utiliza ele
				UPDATE
					AccountsPinCodes
				SET
					PinCode = ''
				WHERE
					PinCode = @PinCode
			END
						
			--Cria um PIN para esse usuário
			INSERT INTO
				AccountsPinCodes(AccountID, PinCode, UseSecurePinCode, SecurePinCode)
			VALUES 
				(@AccountID, @PinCode, CASE WHEN @SecurePinCode IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, @SecurePinCode)
		END
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		--Insere os identificadores para esse usuário
		INSERT INTO
			AccountsCardCodes (AccountID, IDCardCode)
		VALUES
			(@AccountID, @IDCardCode)
	END
END
```

## 108. proc_Accounts_ChangeDomain

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_ChangeDomain]
@ChangeAccountID INT,
@RemainDomainID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Alterado para remover os trabalhos de impressão cancelados também.
	--
	-- Héber Savedra, 2012-08-06
    --
	-- Alterado para enviar ao Host atualização e remoção de usuário ao realizar união de domínios.
	--
	-- Douglas Macedo, 2018-07-25
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @ChangeCostAccountID INT
	DECLARE @RemainAccountID INT
	DECLARE @RemainCostAccountID INT

	SET @RemainAccountID = -1

	--Verifica se o usuário a ser deletado, tem o mesmo logon no domínio para o qual será movido
	SELECT
		@RemainAccountID = AccountID,
		@RemainCostAccountID = CostAccountID
	FROM
		Accounts
	WHERE
		LogonName = (SELECT LogonName FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @ChangeAccountID) AND
		DomainID = @RemainDomainID

	IF(@RemainAccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		--Pega ID do CostAccountID do usuário que será deletado
		SELECT @ChangeCostAccountID = CostAccountID FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @ChangeAccountID
		
		UPDATE
			Accounts
		SET
			CostAccountID = @ChangeCostAccountID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @RemainAccountID AND
			@ChangeCostAccountID IS NOT NULL AND
			@RemainCostAccountID IS NULL

		--Atualiza o ID do CostAccountID do usuário que permanecerá
		SELECT @RemainCostAccountID = CostAccountID FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @RemainAccountID
		
		UPDATE
			PrintJobs
		SET
			AccountID = @RemainAccountID,
			CostAccountID = @RemainCostAccountID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID
			
		UPDATE
			PrintJobsCanceled
		SET
			AccountID = @RemainAccountID,
			CostAccountID = @RemainCostAccountID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID		

		--Se o usuário que permanecerá, não tem permissão nenhuma, assumirá AS permissões do usuário que será deletado
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @RemainAccountID)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				AccountsPermissions
			SET
				AccountID = @RemainAccountID
			WHERE
				AccountID = @ChangeAccountID
		END

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsPassport WHERE AccountID = @RemainAccountID)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				AccountsPassport
			SET
				AccountID = @RemainAccountID
			WHERE
				AccountID = @ChangeAccountID
		END
		
		--Atualiza o histórico das ações do usuário
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Auditings WHERE AccountID = @ChangeAccountID)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				Auditings
			SET
				AccountID = @RemainAccountID
			WHERE
				AccountID = @ChangeAccountID
		END
		
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @RemainAccountID)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @RemainOperatorID INT
			DECLARE @ChangeOperatorID INT
			
			SELECT @RemainOperatorID = OperatorID FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @RemainAccountID
			SELECT @ChangeOperatorID = OperatorID FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

			--Atualiza o ID do operador das tabelas de crédito e regras de cotas
			UPDATE 
				QuotasCredits
			SET
				OperatorID = @RemainOperatorID
			WHERE 
				OperatorID = @ChangeOperatorID

			UPDATE 
				QuotasRules
			SET
				OperatorID = @RemainOperatorID
			WHERE 
				OperatorID = @ChangeOperatorID
		END
		
		DELETE FROM 
			QuotasCredits 
		WHERE 
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID
		
		DELETE FROM 
			QuotasDebits 
		WHERE 
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

		DELETE FROM 
			QuotasRules 
		WHERE 
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

		DELETE FROM 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions 
		WHERE 
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

		DELETE FROM 
			AccountsGroupsObjects 
		WHERE 
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

		DELETE FROM
			AccountsPassportRequests
		WHERE
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

		--Deleta o usuário
		DELETE FROM 
			Accounts 
		WHERE 
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

		--Atualiza os caches
		exec [proc_PoliciesControlsAccounts_Insert] @RemainAccountID, 1, 1, 0
		exec [proc_PoliciesControlsAccounts_Insert] @ChangeAccountID, 0, 0, 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			Accounts
		SET 
			DomainID = @RemainDomainID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @ChangeAccountID

		--Atualiza os caches
		exec [proc_PoliciesControlsAccounts_Insert] @ChangeAccountID, 1, 1, 1
	END
	
	--Atualiza o AccountsID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountID
	END

END
```

## 110. proc_Accounts_GetMobileInfo

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_GetMobileInfo]
@AccountID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--#######################################################################################################################################################
	-- Busca todas as informações utilizadas no web service para mobile
	-- Não é utilizada no business, somente diretamente no projeto nMWS_5
	--#######################################################################################################################################################

	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME = GETDATE()

	--Busca os totais de páginas
	DECLARE @TotalPagesColor BIGINT
	DECLARE @TotalPagesMono BIGINT

	SELECT 
		@TotalPagesMono = SUM(PagesMono),
		@TotalPagesColor = SUM(PagesColor) 
	FROM 
		PrintJobs PJ WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
	WHERE 
		PJ.JobDisabled = 0
		AND AccountID = @AccountID 
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND ((MONTH(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)) AND (YEAR(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(YEAR, @DateTimeNow)))

	DECLARE @TotalPages BIGINT = SUM(@TotalPagesColor + @TotalPagesMono) 

	--Retorna os totais
	SELECT 
		ISNULL(@TotalPagesMono, 0) AS TotalPagesMono,
		ISNULL(@TotalPagesColor, 0) AS TotalPagesColor,
		--ISNULL(@TotalPages, 0) AS TotalPages,
		ISNULL(SUM(CostMono),0) AS TotalCostMono,
		ISNULL(SUM(CostColor),0) AS TotalCostColor,
		COUNT(PrintJobID) AS TotalJobs,
		COUNT(DISTINCT(PJ.PrinterDeviceID)) AS TotalPrinters,
		--COUNT(DISTINCT(PJ.AccountID)) AS TotalUsers,
		COUNT(DISTINCT(M.MachineID)) AS TotalMachines
	FROM 
		PrintJobs PJ WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PJ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PJ.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID
		LEFT JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID
	WHERE 
		PJ.JobDisabled = 0
		and AccountID = @AccountID
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND ((MONTH(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)) AND (YEAR(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(YEAR, @DateTimeNow)))

	--Retorna os tipos de trabalho
	SELECT 
		JT.JobTypeID, 
		--JT.TypeName, 
		COUNT(JT.JobTypeID) AS Total 
	FROM 
		PrintJobs PJ WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN JobTypes JT ON PJ.JobTypeID = JT.JobTypeID
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PJ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
	WHERE
		PJ.JobDisabled = 0
		AND AccountID = @AccountID
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND ((MONTH(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)) AND (YEAR(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(YEAR, @DateTimeNow)))
	GROUP BY
		JT.JobTypeID, 
		JT.TypeName
	ORDER BY 
		JT.JobTypeID

	--Retorna as composições
	DECLARE @Composition TABLE 
	(
		PrintWayID INT, 
		PaperSizeID INT,
		DatePrinted DATETIME,  
		JobOriginID INT,
		PagesMono INT, 
		PagesColor INT 
	)
		
	DECLARE @TimeWorkMorningBegin TIME 
	DECLARE @TimeWorkAfternoonEnd TIME 
	
	SELECT @TimeWorkMorningBegin = (SELECT CONVERT(TIME, ParameterValue,8) AS BeginHour FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'TimeWorkMorningBegin')
	SELECT @TimeWorkAfternoonEnd = (SELECT CONVERT(TIME, ParameterValue,8) AS EndHour FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'TimeWorkAfternoonEnd')
	
	INSERT INTO
		@Composition
	SELECT
		PJ.PrintWayID, 
		PJ.PaperSizeID, 
		PJ.DatePrinted, 
		PJ.JobOriginID, 
		PJ.PagesMono, 
		PJ.PagesColor 
	FROM
		PrintJobs PJ WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PJ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
	WHERE
		PJ.JobDisabled = 0
		and AccountID = @AccountID
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND ((MONTH(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(MONTH, @DateTimeNow)) AND (YEAR(PJ.DatePrinted) = DATEPART(YEAR, @DateTimeNow)))
		
	SELECT
		(SELECT 
			ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,2), (CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), SUM(PagesMono + PagesColor)) * 100) / @TotalPages), 0)
		FROM 
			@Composition 
		WHERE 
			PrintWayID = 1) 
		AS Duplex,
		
		(SELECT 
			ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,2),(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6),SUM(PagesMono + PagesColor))  * 100) / @TotalPages), 0)
		FROM 
			@Composition 
		WHERE 
			PaperSizeID <> 9) 
		AS NotA4,
		
		(SELECT 
			ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,2),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6),SUM(PagesMono + PagesColor) * 100) / @TotalPages), 0)
		FROM 
			@Composition 
		WHERE 
			CONVERT (TIME,DatePrinted, 8) NOT BETWEEN @TimeWorkMorningBegin AND @TimeWorkAfternoonEnd)
		AS OutOfTime, 
		
		--(SELECT 
		--	ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,2),(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6),SUM(PagesMono + PagesColor)) * 100) / @TotalPages), 0)
		--FROM 
		--	@Composition 
		--WHERE 
		--	JobOriginID > 4) 
		--AS Copy,
		
		(SELECT 
				ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,2),(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6),SUM(PagesColor)) * 100) / @TotalPages), 0)
		FROM 
			@Composition) 
		AS Color

	--Retorna os dados do impacto ambiental
	DECLARE @CalcTree DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcTree = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.')) 
	FROM 
		[Parameters]
	WHERE 
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactTree'
	
	DECLARE @CalcWater DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT 
		@CalcWater = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.'))
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactWater'
	
	DECLARE @CalcEnergy DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcEnergy= CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.')) 
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactEnergy'
	
	DECLARE @CalcCarbonDioxide DECIMAL(19,6)
	
	SELECT
		@CalcCarbonDioxide = CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,6), REPLACE(ParameterValue, ',', '.'))
	FROM
		[Parameters]
	WHERE
		ParameterName = 'CalcEnvironmentImpactCarbonDioxide'
	
	SELECT
		ISNULL((@TotalPages / @CalcTree), 0) AS ImpactTree,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages * @CalcWater), 0) AS ImpactWater,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages * @CalcEnergy), 0)AS ImpactEnergy,
		ISNULL((@TotalPages / @CalcTree) * @CalcCarbonDioxide, 0) AS ImpactCarbonDioxide

	-- Retorna os totais de impressões do meses anteriores
	SELECT 
		MonthValue, 
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor 
	FROM 
		dbo.getTotalPagesMobile(@AccountID)

END
```

## 112. proc_Accounts_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_Remove]
@AccountID INT

AS

BEGIN

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @AccountID)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @OperatorID INT
		
		SELECT @OperatorID = OperatorID FROM QuotasOperators WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
		
		UPDATE QuotasRules SET OperatorID = NULL WHERE OperatorID = @OperatorID
	END

	DELETE FROM ScheduledAccountSend WHERE AccountID = @AccountID

	DELETE FROM ScheduledReports WHERE OwnerAccountID =  @AccountID
	
	--Deleta este membro das politicas de impressão
	WHILE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PolicyMemberType IN (1,5) AND ObjectID = @AccountID))
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @PolicyMemberID INT
		SELECT TOP 1 
			@PolicyMemberID = PolicyMemberID
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers
		WHERE
			PolicyMemberType IN (1,5) AND ObjectID = @AccountID

		INSERT INTO PoliciesMembersRemoved VALUES (@PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE())
		DELETE FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PolicyMemberID = @PolicyMemberID
	END
	
	--Deleta este usuários dos membros do fluxo de digitalização
	INSERT INTO ScanFlowMembersRemoved(ScanFlowMemberID, RemovedDate) SELECT ScanFlowMemberID, GETUTCDATE() FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE MemberType = 1 AND AccountID = @AccountID
	DELETE FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE MemberType = 1 AND AccountID = @AccountID
	
	--Deleta este usuário das contas selecionáveis e atualiza a data de atualização da conta selecionavel
	UPDATE CostAccountsSelectable SET UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE AccountID = @AccountID)
	DELETE FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
	
	--Deleta este usuário se esta relacionado há algum grupo de usuários
	DELETE FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountID = @AccountID 
	
	--Deleta este usuário se esta relacionado com alguma solicitação de senha
	DELETE FROM AccountsPassportRequests WHERE AccountID = @AccountID 

	--Deleta este usuário se esta relacionado com alguma permissão de gerente
	DELETE FROM CostAccountsManagersPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AccountID 

    --Desabilitar e remover PIN e PIN Seguro 
	IF((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ClearPinCodeOnAccountRemove') = 1)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE AccountsPinCodes SET PinCode = NULL, UseSecurePinCode = 0 WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
	END
	
	UPDATE Accounts SET Removed = 1, ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
	--DELETE FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AccountID

    --Atualiza os caches
    EXEC [proc_PoliciesControlsAccounts_Insert] @AccountID, 0, 0, 1
      
	--Atualiza o AccountsID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountID
	END
END
```

## 113. proc_Accounts_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_Retrieve] 
@AccountID INT = 0,
@DomainName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@LogonName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@Email NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@ReturnAllProperties BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	--Issues 8878 e 8873
	IF(@AccountID = -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			-1 AS AccountID,
			'' AS DomainName,
			'' AS LogonName,
			'' AS Email,
			'' AS FullName,
			CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Removed,
			1 AS DomainID,
			-1 AS CostAccountID
	END
	ELSE IF(@AccountID <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			AC.AccountID,
			D.DomainName,
			AC.LogonName,
			ISNULL(AC.Email, '') AS Email,
			AC.FullName,
			AC.Removed,
			D.DomainID,
			ISNULL(AC.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID
		FROM
			Accounts AC
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON AC.DomainID = D.DomainID
		WHERE
			AccountID = @AccountID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--Feito desse modo para utilizar os respectivos indices
		IF (@Email IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				AC.AccountID 
			FROM
				Accounts AC
			WHERE
				AC.Email = @Email
				AND AC.Removed = 0
		END
		ELSE IF (@ReturnAllProperties = 1)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				AC.AccountID,
				D.DomainName,
				AC.LogonName,
				ISNULL(AC.Email, '') AS Email,
				AC.FullName,
				AC.Removed,
				D.DomainID,
				ISNULL(AC.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID
			FROM
				Accounts AC
				INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON AC.DomainID = D.DomainID
			WHERE
				AC.LogonName = @LogonName
				AND D.DomainName = @DomainName
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				AC.AccountID 
			FROM
				Accounts AC
				INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON AC.DomainID = D.DomainID
			WHERE
				D.DomainName = @DomainName
				AND AC.LogonName = @LogonName
		END
	END

END
```

## 114. proc_Accounts_RetrieveAccountsIDFromObject

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_RetrieveAccountsIDFromObject]
@ObjectID INT,
@Type BIT

AS
	
BEGIN

	IF(@Type = 0)
	BEGIN
		--0 Pega os usuários de determinado grupo
		SELECT 
			AC.AccountID
		FROM 
			Accounts AS AC
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroupsObjects AS AGO ON AGO.AccountID = AC.AccountID
			LEFT JOIN AccountsPassport AS AP ON AP.AccountID = AC.AccountID
		WHERE 
			AGO.AccountGroupID = @ObjectID 
			AND	AP.[Password] IS NULL 
			AND AC.Removed = 0 
			AND AC.Email <> '' 
			AND AC.Email IS NOT NULL 
			AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AC.AccountID) = 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--1 Pega os usuários de determinado dominio
		SELECT 
			AC.AccountID
		FROM 
			Accounts AS AC
			LEFT JOIN AccountsPassport AS AP ON AP.AccountID = AC.AccountID
		WHERE
			AC.DomainID = @ObjectID
			AND	AP.[Password] IS NULL
			AND Removed = 0 
			AND Email <> '' 
			AND Email IS NOT NULL 
			AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AC.AccountID) = 1
	END
END
```

## 115. proc_Accounts_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_RetrieveAll]
@DomainID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		AC.AccountID, 
		AC.LogonName, 
		AC.FullName, 
		D.DomainName, 
		dbo.GetCostAccountName(CA.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
		D.DomainName + '\' + AC.LogonName AS PathAccount, 
		HasPassword = CASE ISNULL(AP.[Password], '') WHEN '' THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END,
		ReportPermission = (SELECT PermissionAccessID FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE PermissionControlID = 1 AND AccountID = AC.AccountID),
		AccessPermission = (SELECT PermissionAccessID FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE PermissionControlID = 2 AND AccountID = AC.AccountID),
		CostCenterManager = CASE ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = AC.AccountID),'') WHEN '' THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END
	FROM
		Accounts AC
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON AC.DomainID = D.DomainID
		LEFT  JOIN AccountsPassport AP ON AC.AccountID = AP.AccountID
		LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts CA ON AC.CostAccountID = CA.CostAccountID
	WHERE
		AC.DomainID = @DomainID
		AND AC.Removed = 0
	ORDER BY
		AC.LogonName ASC

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_RetrieveTotalAccountsIDFromObject]
@ObjectID INT,
@Type BIT

AS
	
BEGIN

		IF(@Type = 0)
		BEGIN
			--0 Pega os usuários de determinado grupo
			SELECT 
				COUNT(1)
			FROM 
				Accounts AS Ac
			INNER JOIN 
				AccountsGroupsObjects AS Ago ON Ago.AccountID = Ac.AccountID 
			WHERE 
				Ago.AccountGroupID = @ObjectID AND 
				Ac.Removed = 0 AND
				dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(Ac.AccountID) = 1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--1 Pega os usuários de determinado dominio
			SELECT 
				COUNT(1) 
			FROM 
				Accounts 
			WHERE
				DomainID = @ObjectID AND 
				Removed = 0 AND
				dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AccountID) = 1
		END

END
```

## 118. proc_Accounts_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Accounts_Update]
@AccountID INT = 0,
@DomainID INT,
@LogonName NVARCHAR(255),
@FullName NVARCHAR(255),
@Email NVARCHAR(255),
@Removed BIT,
@AccountGuidID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

AS
	
BEGIN

	--Se o e-mail não estiver em branco 
	IF (@Email <> '')
	BEGIN
		--Verifica se o e-mail já está sendo utilizado, se tiver vai deixar em branco
		IF ((SELECT dbo.[GetUserEmailExists](@AccountID, @Email)) > 0)
		BEGIN
			--Se existe esse e-mail cadastrado, deixa nulo.
			SET @Email = NULL
		END
	END
		
	IF (@AccountID = 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			Accounts (DomainID, LogonName, FullName, Email, Removed, ChangedDate, AccountGuidId)
		VALUES 
			(@DomainID, @LogonName, @FullName, @Email, @Removed, GETUTCDATE(), @AccountGuidID)

		SELECT @AccountID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			Accounts 
		SET 
			DomainID = @DomainID, 
			LogonName = @LogonName, 
			FullName = @FullName, 
			--Email = @Email, 
			Email = CASE WHEN @Email = 'unknown' THEN Email ELSE @Email END,
			Removed = @Removed,
			ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
		WHERE
			AccountID = @AccountID
	END 
	
	--Atualiza o AccountsID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountID
	END
	
	-- Deleta este membro das politicas de impressão, das contas selecionáveis e dos membros dos fluxos de digitalização se foi atualizado para removido.
	IF (@Removed = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO PoliciesMembersRemoved (PolicyMemberID, RemovedDate) SELECT PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE() FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PolicyMemberType IN (1,5) AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) = @AccountID
		DELETE FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PolicyMemberType IN (1,5) AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) = @AccountID

		INSERT INTO ScanFlowMembersRemoved(ScanFlowMemberID, RemovedDate) SELECT ScanFlowMemberID, GETUTCDATE() FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE MemberType = 1 AND AccountID = @AccountID
		DELETE FROM ScanFlowMembers WHERE MemberType = 1 AND AccountID = @AccountID
		
		--Deleta este usuários se foi relacionado com contas selecionáveis e atualiza a data de atualização da conta selecionavel
		UPDATE CostAccountsSelectable SET UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE() WHERE CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE AccountID = @AccountID)
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
		
		--DELETE este usuário se esta relacionado há algum grupo de usuários
		DELETE FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountID = @AccountID 
	END
	
	SELECT @AccountID
END
```

## 122. proc_Aliases_RetrieveAliases

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Aliases_RetrieveAliases]
@AccountIDUser INT,
@AccountIDMain INT

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@AccountIDMain <> @AccountIDUser)
	BEGIN
		SELECT   
			AC.AccountID, 
			AC.FullName, 
			AC.LogonName, 
			@AccountIDMain AS AccountIDMain, 
			D.DomainName 
		FROM     
			Accounts AC
			LEFT JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		WHERE  
			AC.AccountID = @AccountIDMain
			
		UNION
		
		SELECT   
			AC.AccountID, 
			AC.FullName, 
			AC.LogonName, 
			AA.AccountIDMain, 
			D.DomainName 
		FROM     
			Accounts AC
			LEFT  JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			RIGHT JOIN AccountsAliases AA ON AA.AccountID = AC.AccountID
		WHERE  
			AA.AccountIDMain = @AccountIDMain
			AND  AA.AccountID <> @AccountIDUser
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT   
			AC.AccountID, 
			AC.FullName, 
			AC.LogonName, 
			AA.AccountIDMain, 
			D.DomainName 
		FROM     
			Accounts AC
			LEFT  JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			RIGHT JOIN AccountsAliases AA ON AA.AccountID = AC.AccountID
		WHERE  
			AA.AccountIDMain = @AccountIDMain
			AND AA.AccountID <> @AccountIDUser
	END

END
```

## 132. proc_CostAccountHistoric_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountHistoric_Insert]
@ObjectID INT,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
@StartDate DATETIME = '2001/01/01'

AS

BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Correção para buscar corretamente o último centro de custo.
	--
	-- Héber Savedra, 2012-07-27
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @StartDateAux DATETIME  
	SET @StartDateAux = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) AS DATETIME)

	--Descobre se o CC que ele estava antes é o mesmo que está inserindo agora. se for nao insere o registro
	DECLARE @LastCostAccountID INT
	SET @LastCostAccountID = 0 --quando nao tem registro é -1 (NULL)

	SELECT 
		@LastCostAccountID = ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) 
	FROM 
		CostAccountsHistorics
	WHERE 
		ObjectID = @ObjectID
		AND StartDate <= @StartDateAux
	ORDER BY
		StartDate

	IF (@LastCostAccountID <> 0 ) --se nao achou valor anterior deixa inserir
	BEGIN
		IF (@CostAccountID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			IF (@LastCostAccountID = -1)
			BEGIN
				print '1'
				SELECT -1
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF (@LastCostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
			BEGIN
				print '2'
				SELECT -1
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	DELETE FROM
		CostAccountsHistorics
	WHERE 
		ObjectID = @ObjectID
		AND StartDate = @StartDateAux

	--Insere o registro original 
	INSERT INTO
		CostAccountsHistorics (ObjectID, CostAccountID, StartDate) 
	VALUES		
		(@ObjectID, @CostAccountID, @StartDateAux )

	DECLARE @CostAccountHistoricID INT
	SELECT @CostAccountHistoricID = CONVERT(INT, @@IDENTITY)

	DECLARE @LastCostAccount INT
	SELECT @LastCostAccount = CostAccountID FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE ObjectID = @ObjectID ORDER BY StartDate
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
	
	IF(@CostAccountsType = 2)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND (((CostAccountID IS NULL AND @LastCostAccount IS NOT NULL) OR (CostAccountID <> @LastCostAccount)) OR (@LastCostAccount IS NULL AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PrintersDevices 
			SET 
				CostAccountID = @LastCostAccount 
			WHERE 
				PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID
		END
		
		--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
		IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
			   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PoliciesControls
			SET
				PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
			WHERE
				PolicyControlID = 5 --PrinterDeviceID
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND (((CostAccountID IS NULL AND @LastCostAccount IS NOT NULL) OR (CostAccountID <> @LastCostAccount)) OR (@LastCostAccount IS NULL AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				Accounts 
			SET 
				CostAccountID = @LastCostAccount,
				ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() 
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @ObjectID

			DECLARE @AccountHierarchyIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = (SELECT dbo.GetCostAccountHierarchyIds (@LastCostAccount))
			EXEC ('
				UPDATE
					CostAccountsSelectable
				SET
					UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
				WHERE
					CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE CostAccountID IN (' + @AccountHierarchyIds + '))')

			--Atualiza o AccountsID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
			IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
				   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					PoliciesControls
				SET
					PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
				WHERE
					PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountID
			END
		END
	END	

	--Atualiza o CostAccountID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 3 --CostAccountID
	END
	
	SELECT @CostAccountHistoricID		
END
```

## 133. proc_CostAccountHistoric_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountHistoric_Remove] 
@CostAccountHistoricID INT

AS

BEGIN 

	DECLARE @ObjectID INT	
	SELECT @ObjectID = ObjectID FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE CostAccountHistoricID = @CostAccountHistoricID

	DELETE FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE CostAccountHistoricID = @CostAccountHistoricID

	DECLARE @LastCostAccount INT
	SELECT @LastCostAccount = CostAccountID FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE ObjectID = @ObjectID ORDER BY StartDate

	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
	
	IF(@CostAccountsType = 2)
	BEGIN
		IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND (((CostAccountID IS NULL AND @LastCostAccount IS NOT NULL) OR (CostAccountID <> @LastCostAccount)) OR (@LastCostAccount IS NULL AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL))))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PrintersDevices
			SET 
				CostAccountID = @LastCostAccount
			WHERE 
				PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID
				
			--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
			IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
				   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					PoliciesControls
				SET
					PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
				WHERE
					PolicyControlID = 5 --PrinterDeviceID
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND (((CostAccountID IS NULL AND @LastCostAccount IS NOT NULL) OR (CostAccountID <> @LastCostAccount)) OR (@LastCostAccount IS NULL AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL))))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				Accounts
			SET 
				CostAccountID = @LastCostAccount,
				ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @ObjectID

			--Atualiza o AccountsID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
			IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
				   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					PoliciesControls
				SET
					PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
				WHERE
					PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountID
			END
		END
	END

	--Atualiza o CostAccountID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 3 --CostAccountID
	END
	
END
```

## 135. proc_CostAccountHistoric_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountHistoric_RetrieveAll] 
@ObjectID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SET DATEFORMAT ymd

	SELECT 
		CAH.CostAccountHistoricID,
		CAH.ObjectID, 
		ISNULL(CAH.CostAccountID,0) AS CostAccountID,   
		CAH.StartDate ,
		CONVERT(CHAR,CAH.StartDate,103) AS StringDate, 
		ISNULL(CA.CostAccountName, '-') AS CostAccountName, 
		ISNULL(CA.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode, 
		(ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR, CAH.CostAccountID, 103),'-') + 'x' + ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR, CAH.StartDate, 20), '-') + 'x' + ISNULL(CONVERT(CHAR, CAH.CostAccountHistoricID, 103), '-')) AS CostAccountHistoricIDString 
	FROM 
		CostAccountsHistorics CAH
		LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = CAH.CostAccountID
	WHERE
		CAH.ObjectID = @ObjectID
	ORDER BY
		CAH.StartDate DESC

END
```

## 137. proc_CostAccountSelectable_RemoveObject

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountSelectable_RemoveObject] 
@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
@Type INT = NULL,
@ObjectID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @CostAccountSelectableID INT = (SELECT TOP(1) CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectable WHERE CostAccountID = CostAccountID)

	--Remove usuário ou conta de conta selecionavel
	DELETE FROM 
		CostAccountsSelectableObjects
	WHERE 
		CostAccountSelectableID = @CostAccountSelectableID 
		AND (CostAccountID = @ObjectID OR AccountID = @ObjectID) 
		AND ObjectAllowedType = @Type
		
		--Atualiza o CostAccountID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 3 --CostAccountID
	END
	
END
```

## 138. proc_CostAccountSelectable_SetObject

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountSelectable_SetObject] 
@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
@Type INT = NULL,
@ObjectID INT = NULL,
@FilterByChildren BIT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Exist INT = 0
	DECLARE @CostAccountSelectableID INT = NULL
	
	--Verifica se é selecionavel vendo se tem algum registro na tabela CostAccountsSelectable
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CostAccountsSelectable WHERE CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			CostAccountsSelectable			
			(
				CostAccountID, 
				UpdatedDate
			) 
		VALUES
			(
				@CostAccountID,
				GETUTCDATE()
			)

		SET @CostAccountSelectableID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @CostAccountSelectableID = (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectable WHERE CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
	END


	--Verifica se é selecionavel vendo se tem algum registro na tabela CostAccountsSelectableObject
	SELECT 
		@Exist = COUNT(1)
	FROM 
		CostAccountsSelectable CAS
		INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.CostAccountSelectableID = CAS.CostAccountSelectableID
	WHERE 
		CAS.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID 
		AND	(CASO.CostAccountID = @ObjectID OR CASO.AccountID = @ObjectID) 
		AND	CASO.ObjectAllowedType = @Type

	IF(@Exist <> 0)
	BEGIN
			DECLARE @FilterByChildrenCurrent BIT = (SELECT 
														FilterByChildren 
													FROM 
														CostAccountsSelectableObjects
													WHERE 
														CostAccountSelectableID = @CostAccountSelectableID 
														AND (CostAccountID = @ObjectID OR AccountID = @ObjectID) 
														AND ObjectAllowedType = @Type)
			
			-- Somente atualiza caso o parametro for diferente do atual e o tipo do selecionável for CostAccount(2)
			IF (@FilterByChildren <> @FilterByChildrenCurrent AND @Type = 2)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					CostAccountsSelectableObjects
				SET
					FilterByChildren = @FilterByChildren
				WHERE
					CostAccountSelectableID = @CostAccountSelectableID 
					AND (CostAccountID = @ObjectID OR AccountID = @ObjectID) 
					AND ObjectAllowedType = @Type

				UPDATE	
					CostAccountsSelectable
				SET
					UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
				WHERE
					CostAccountSelectableID = @CostAccountSelectableID
			END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN 
		INSERT INTO
			CostAccountsSelectableObjects
			(
				CostAccountSelectableID,
				AccountID,
				CostAccountID, 
				FilterByChildren,
				ObjectAllowedType,
				IsAllSelectable
			)
		VALUES
			(
				@CostAccountSelectableID,
				CASE WHEN @Type = 1 AND @ObjectID <> -2 THEN @ObjectID ELSE NULL END,
				CASE WHEN @Type = 2 AND @ObjectID <> -2 THEN @ObjectID ELSE NULL END,
				CASE WHEN @Type = 2 AND @ObjectID <> -2 THEN @FilterByChildren ELSE NULL END,
				CASE WHEN @ObjectID <> -2 THEN @Type ELSE NULL END,
				CASE WHEN @ObjectID = -2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
			)
			
		UPDATE	
			CostAccountsSelectable
		SET
			UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
		WHERE
			CostAccountSelectableID = @CostAccountSelectableID
	END
	
	--Atualiza o CostAccountID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 3 --CostAccountID
	END	
END
```

## 139. proc_CostAccount_CountJobsOutside

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_CountJobsOutside]
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@ObjectID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Alterado para verificar também na PrintJobsCanceled.
	--
	-- Héber Savedra, 2012-07-27
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
	
	IF(@CostAccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		IF (@CostAccountsType = 2)
		BEGIN
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobsCanceled WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL))))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
			
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobs WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL))))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobsCanceled WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL))))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
			
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobs WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL))))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@CostAccountsType = 2)
		BEGIN	
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobsCanceled WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
			
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobs WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobsCanceled WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
			
			IF((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintJobs WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)))
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT 0
	
END
```

## 143. proc_CostAccount_QuotasRetrieveObjects

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_QuotasRetrieveObjects]
@CostAccountID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
	
	IF (@CostAccountsType = 2)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			CA.CostAccountID AS ObjectID,
			CA.CostAccountName AS [Description], 
			CAST(CA.CostAccountCode AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description2,
			CAST(CA.CostAccountParentID AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description3,
			CAST(CA.Removed AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description4,
			'CostAccount' AS ObjectType
		FROM 
			CostAccounts CA
		WHERE 
			CostAccountParentID = @CostAccountID
			AND Removed = 0
			
		UNION
			
		SELECT
			PD.PrinterDeviceID AS ObjectID,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName AS [Description], 
			PD.AddressName AS Description2,
			PD.AddressMAC AS Description3,
			PD.SerialNumber AS Description4,
			'PrinterDevice' AS ObjectType
		FROM 
			PrintersDevices PD
		WHERE
			PD.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			--AND PD.Removed = 0
		ORDER BY 
			ObjectType,
			[Description]
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			CA.CostAccountID AS ObjectID,
			CA.CostAccountName AS [Description], 
			CAST(CA.CostAccountCode AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description2,
			CAST(CA.CostAccountParentID AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description3,
			CAST(CA.Removed AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description4,
			'CostAccount' AS ObjectType
		FROM 
			CostAccounts CA
		WHERE	
			CostAccountParentID = @CostAccountID
			AND Removed = 0
		
		UNION
		
		SELECT
			AC.AccountID AS ObjectID,
			AC.[FullName] AS [Description],
			AC.[LogonName] AS Description2,
			CAST(D.[DomainName] AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description3,
			CAST(D.[DomainID] AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description4,
			'Account' AS ObjectType
		FROM 
			Accounts AC
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		WHERE
			AC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			AND AC.Removed = 0
		ORDER BY 
			ObjectType DESC,
			[Description]
	END
	
END
```

## 145. proc_CostAccount_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_Retrieve]
@CostAccountID INT = 0,
@CostAccountCode NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
@CostAccountName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@CostAccountParentID INT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@CostAccountID <> 0)
	BEGIN 
		SELECT
			CostAccountID,
			CostAccountName,
			CostAccountCode,
			CostAccountParentID, 
			Removed
		FROM 
			CostAccounts
		WHERE 
			CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
	END
	ELSE IF (@CostAccountID = 0 AND @CostAccountCode IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		IF (@CostAccountParentID <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				CostAccountID,
				CostAccountName,
				CostAccountCode,
				CostAccountParentID, 
				Removed
			FROM 
				CostAccounts
			WHERE 
				CostAccountCode IS NULL
				AND CostAccountName LIKE @CostAccountName
				AND CostAccountParentID = @CostAccountParentID 
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN  
			SELECT
				CostAccountID,
				CostAccountName,
				CostAccountCode,
				CostAccountParentID, 
				Removed
			FROM 
				CostAccounts
			WHERE 
				CostAccountCode IS NULL
				AND CostAccountName LIKE @CostAccountName
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			CostAccountID,
			CostAccountName,
			CostAccountCode,
			CostAccountParentID,
			Removed 
		FROM 
			CostAccounts
		WHERE
			CostAccountCode LIKE @CostAccountCode
			AND (@CostAccountName IS NULL OR CostAccountName LIKE @CostAccountName)
	END	
END
```

## 149. proc_CostAccount_RetrieveAllManaged

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_RetrieveAllManaged] 
@AccountID INT,
@RetrieveAllManagedChild BIT = 1,
@IsOrdered BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	IF(@IsOrdered = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			CA.CostAccountID AS ObjectID,
			CA.CostAccountID,
			CA.CostAccountName AS [Description],
			CA.CostAccountCode
		FROM 
			CostAccounts CA
			INNER JOIN CostAccountsManagers CAM on CAM.CostAccountID = CA.CostAccountID
		WHERE
			(@RetrieveAllManagedChild = 1 AND AccountID = @AccountID)
			OR (@RetrieveAllManagedChild = 0 AND ISNULL(CA.CostAccountParentID, -1) NOT IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = @AccountID))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			CA.CostAccountID AS ObjectID,
			CA.CostAccountID,
			CA.CostAccountName AS [Description],
			CA.CostAccountCode
		FROM 
			CostAccounts CA
			INNER JOIN CostAccountsManagers CAM on CAM.CostAccountID = CA.CostAccountID
		WHERE
			(@RetrieveAllManagedChild = 1 AND AccountID = @AccountID)
			OR (@RetrieveAllManagedChild = 0 AND ISNULL(CA.CostAccountParentID, -1) NOT IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = @AccountID))
		ORDER BY
			[Description] ASC
	END

END
```

## 156. proc_CostAccount_RetrieveJobs

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_RetrieveJobs] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT, -- 0=Todas, -1=Todas sem conta ou ID da conta mesmo
@ObjectID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @AccountID INT
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceID INT
	
	SET @AccountID = -1
	SET @PrinterDeviceID = -1	

	--Verifica qual tipo de conta esta utilizando
	IF ((SELECT CAST(ParameterValue AS INT) FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType') = 2) --Impressoras
	BEGIN
		SET @PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @AccountID = @ObjectID
	END

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	
	--preenche a lista de contas que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			  INSERT INTO @CCIDList SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario           
		END
	END
	
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	SELECT
		PrintJobID,
		CostAccountID,
		CostAccountName,
		LogonName,
		Title,
		DatePrinted
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				TOP 1000
				PJ.PrintJobID,
				CA.CostAccountID,
				ISNULL(CA.CostAccountName, '@@WithoutCostAccount') AS CostAccountName,
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.LogonName,
				PJ.Title,
				PJ.DatePrinted
			FROM         
				PrintJobs PJ
				LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = PJ.CostAccountID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJ.AccountID
			WHERE
				(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)
				AND ((@CostAccountID = -1 AND PJ.CostAccountID IS NULL) OR (@CostAccountID = 0 AND 1 = 1) OR (PJ.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID))
				AND
					(@CostAccountID = 0 OR (
						(@UseORMethod = 0 AND ((@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))
					OR
						(@UseORMethod = 1 AND ((@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						OR  (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))
					))
				AND PJ.PrintJobID NOT IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM CostAccountsJobsUpdate)
				AND PJ.IsCorporative = 1 --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
		) AS TB
	WHERE
		(@AccountID = -1 OR TB.AccountID = @AccountID)
	ORDER BY
		TB.CostAccountName,
		TB.LogonName
			
END
```

## 157. proc_CostAccount_RetrieveManagedNodes

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_RetrieveManagedNodes]
@CostAccountID INT,
@AccountID INT,
@IsCostAccountParent BIT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT DISTINCT
		CA.CostAccountName AS [Description],
		CA.CostAccountID AS ObjectID,
		CA.CostAccountCode,
		'CostAccount' AS ObjectType,
		ISNULL(CA.CostAccountCode, '') AS Description2, 
		CostAccountParentID
	FROM
		CostAccounts CA
		INNER JOIN dbo.getCostAccountManaged(@AccountID) CAM ON CAM.CostAccountID = CA.CostAccountID
	WHERE
		(@IsCostAccountParent = 0 AND CA.CostAccountParentID = @CostAccountID)
		OR (
			@IsCostAccountParent = 1
			AND (CA.CostAccountParentID NOT IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.getCostAccountManaged(@AccountID))
				OR CA.CostAccountParentID IS NULL)
		)
	ORDER BY
		ObjectType DESC,
		[Description]

END
```

## 160. proc_CostAccount_RetrieveNumberOfManagers

## 161. proc_CostAccount_RetrieveObjects

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_RetrieveObjects] 
@CostAccountID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'

	IF (@CostAccountsType = 2)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			CA.CostAccountID AS ObjectID,
			CA.CostAccountName AS [Description], 
			CAST(CA.CostAccountCode AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description2,
			'CostAccount' AS ObjectType
		FROM 
			CostAccounts CA
		WHERE 
			CostAccountParentID = @CostAccountID
			AND Removed = 0
			
		UNION
			
		SELECT
			PD.PrinterDeviceID AS ObjectID,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName AS [Description], 
			PD.AddressName AS Description2,
			'PrinterDevice' AS ObjectType
		FROM 
			PrintersDevices PD
		WHERE
			PD.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		ORDER BY 
			ObjectType,
			[Description]
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			CA.CostAccountID AS ObjectID,
			CA.CostAccountName AS [Description], 
			CAST(CA.CostAccountCode AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS Description2,
			'CostAccount' AS ObjectType
		FROM 
			CostAccounts CA
		WHERE 
			CostAccountParentID = @CostAccountID
			AND Removed = 0
		
		UNION
		
		SELECT
			AC.AccountID AS ObjectID,
			AC.[FullName] AS [Description],
			AC.[LogonName] AS Description2,
			'Account' AS ObjectType
			--D.[DomainName]
		FROM 
			Accounts AC
			--INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		WHERE
			AC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			AND AC.Removed = 0
		ORDER BY 
			ObjectType DESC,
			[Description]
	END
	
END
```

## 162. proc_CostAccount_SetAccount

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_SetAccount]
@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
@ObjectID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Update BIT
	SET @Update = 0
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'

	IF (@CostAccountsType = 2)
	BEGIN
		IF (@CostAccountID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL))
			BEGIN
				SET @Update = 1
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL)))
			BEGIN
				SET @Update = 1
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@CostAccountID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL))
			BEGIN
				SET @Update = 1
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL)))
			BEGIN
				SET @Update = 1
			END
		END
	END

	DELETE FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE ObjectID = @ObjectID

	IF (@Update = 1)
	BEGIN
		IF (@CostAccountsType = 2)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PrintersDevices
			SET 
				CostAccountID = @CostAccountID 
			WHERE 
				PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID
				
			--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
			IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
				   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					PoliciesControls
				SET
					PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
				WHERE
					PolicyControlID = 5 --PrinterDeviceID
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				Accounts
			SET 
				CostAccountID = @CostAccountID,
				ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE 
				AccountID = @ObjectID

			DECLARE @AccountHierarchyIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = (SELECT dbo.GetCostAccountHierarchyIds (@CostAccountID))
			EXEC ('
				UPDATE
					CostAccountsSelectable
				SET
					UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
				WHERE
					CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE CostAccountID IN (' + @AccountHierarchyIds + '))')
					
			--Atualiza o AccountsID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
			IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
				   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					PoliciesControls
				SET
					PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
				WHERE
					PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountID
			END
		END
	END	
END
```

## 163. proc_CostAccount_SetAccountType

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_SetAccountType]
@CostAccountType TINYINT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Garantir que todas as tabelas sejam alteradas, caso contrário podem ocorrer inconsistências
	BEGIN TRAN
	
		DECLARE @CostAccountTypeOld TINYINT;
		
		-- Pega o tipo de configuração de conta atual
		SELECT 
			@CostAccountTypeOld =  ParameterValue 
		FROM 
			[Parameters]
		WHERE
			ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
	
		
		-- Atualiza o parâmetro da configuração
		UPDATE
			[Parameters]
		SET
			ParameterValue = @CostAccountType
		WHERE
			ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
			
		
		-- Se for mudar de usuário para selecionavel ou 
		-- de selecionavel pra usuário não é preciso apagar as contas
		IF((@CostAccountType = 1 OR @CostAccountType = 3) AND (@CostAccountTypeOld = 1 OR @CostAccountTypeOld = 3))
		BEGIN
		
			-- Somente se for de contas selecionaveis pra usuários que deleta as 
			-- configurações de contas selecionaveis senão não vai ser de usuários 
			-- para contas selscionaveis e então insere todos os usuários nas contas selecionaveis 
			-- com o tipo 2, selecionál por qualquer um.
			IF(@CostAccountType = 1 AND @CostAccountTypeOld = 3)
			BEGIN
				--Remove todas as configurações de conta selecionavel
				DELETE FROM
					CostAccountsSelectable
			END
			--ELSE
			--BEGIN
			--	-- Insere todas as contas atuais como selecionaveis por qualquer um.
			--	INSERT INTO 
			--		CostAccountsSelectable
			--	SELECT
			--		CostAccountID,
			--		-2,
			--		--2,
			--		--0
			--	FROM
			--		CostAccounts
					
			--END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN			
			-- Atualiza todos os usuários pra sem conta
			UPDATE
				Accounts
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL,
				ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
				
			-- Atualiza todos os jobs da Printjobs
			UPDATE
				PrintJobs
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL
			WHERE
				CostAccountID IS NOT NULL
				
			-- Atualiza todos os jobs da PrintJobsCanceled
			UPDATE
				PrintJobsCanceled
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL
			
			-- Atualiza todas as impressoras pra sem conta
			UPDATE
				PrintersDevices
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL
				
			-- Remove todas as filas do tipo de atualização de conta
			DELETE FROM
				ProcessQueues
			WHERE
				ProcessQueueType = 12 -- CostAccountJobUpdate
				
			-- Remove todas as atualizações de conta
			DELETE FROM
				CostAccountsJobsUpdate
				
			-- Remove todos os históricos dos usuários
			DELETE FROM
				CostAccountsHistorics
				
			-- Remove todos os gerentes das contas
			DELETE FROM 
				CostAccountsManagers
			
			-- Remove todas as configurações de conta selecionavel
			DELETE FROM
				CostAccountsSelectable
				
			-- Remove todas contas
			DELETE FROM
				CostAccounts
		END
		
		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			SELECT 0
			RETURN
			
		END	
	
		-- Atualiza o CostAccountID e PolicyParameterID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
		IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
			   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PoliciesControls
			SET
				PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
			WHERE
				PolicyControlID = 3			--CostAccountID
				OR PolicyControlID = 17		--PolicyParameterID
		END
	
	------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	COMMIT
	
	SELECT 1
	
END
```

## 164. proc_CostAccount_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccount_Update] 
@CostAccountID INT,
@CostAccountName NVARCHAR(255),
@CostAccountCode NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
@CostAccountParentID INT = NULL,
@IsImportFile BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN
	
	IF(@IsImportFile = 0)
	BEGIN
		-- Atualiza o ChangedDate da conta
		UPDATE
			CostAccounts
		SET
			ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
		WHERE
			CostAccountID = @CostAccountID

		-- Atualiza o ChangedDate da conta selecionável
		DECLARE @AccountHierarchyIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = (SELECT dbo.GetCostAccountHierarchyIds (@CostAccountID))
		EXEC ('
			UPDATE
				CostAccountsSelectable
			SET
				UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE
				CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE CostAccountID IN (' + @AccountHierarchyIds + '))')
			
		IF(@CostAccountParentID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			-- Atualiza o ChangedDate da conta filha
			UPDATE
				CostAccounts
			SET
				ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE
				CostAccountID = @CostAccountParentID

			-- Atualiza o ChangedDate da conta selecionável e suas filhas
			DECLARE @AccountHierarchyChildrenIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = (SELECT dbo.GetCostAccountHierarchyIds (@CostAccountParentID))
			EXEC ('
				UPDATE
					CostAccountsSelectable
				SET
					UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()
				WHERE
					CostAccountSelectableID IN (SELECT CostAccountSelectableID FROM CostAccountsSelectableObjects WHERE CostAccountID IN (' + @AccountHierarchyChildrenIds + '))')
		END
	END
	
	-- Atualiza a conta
	UPDATE 
		CostAccounts
	SET 
		CostAccountName = @CostAccountName,  
		CostAccountCode = @CostAccountCode, 
		CostAccountParentID = @CostAccountParentID  
	WHERE 
		CostAccountID = @CostAccountID

	-- Atualiza o ChangedDate dos usuários da conta
	UPDATE 
		Accounts 
	SET 
		ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE() 
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
	
	--Atualiza o CostAccountID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 3 --CostAccountID
	END	
END
```

## 169. proc_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_Retrieve]
@AccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @QuotasPermissionType TINYINT = 0
	DECLARE @PoliciesPermissionType TINYINT = 0
	DECLARE @QuotasPermissionInherit BIT = 0
	DECLARE @PoliciesPermissionInherit BIT = 0
			
	SELECT 
		@QuotasPermissionType = ISNULL(CAMP.QuotasPermissionType, 0),
		@PoliciesPermissionType = ISNULL(CAMP.PoliciesPermissionType, 0)
	FROM 
		CostAccountsManagersPermissions CAMP
	WHERE 
		ISNULL(AccountID, -1) = ISNULL(@AccountID, -1)
			
	IF (@QuotasPermissionType = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			@QuotasPermissionType = CAMP.QuotasPermissionType,
			@QuotasPermissionInherit = 1
		FROM 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions CAMP
		WHERE 
			AccountID IS NULL
	END
		
	IF (@PoliciesPermissionType = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			@PoliciesPermissionType = CAMP.PoliciesPermissionType,
			@PoliciesPermissionInherit = 1
		FROM 
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions CAMP
		WHERE 
			AccountID IS NULL
	END
	
	SELECT
		@QuotasPermissionType AS QuotasPermissionType,
		@PoliciesPermissionType AS PoliciesPermissionType,
		@QuotasPermissionInherit AS QuotasPermissionInherit,
		@PoliciesPermissionInherit AS PoliciesPermissionInherit

END
```

## 170. proc_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_Set

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_Set]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@QuotasPermissionType TINYINT = NULL,
@PoliciesPermissionType TINYINT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CostAccountsManagersPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AccountID) OR @AccountID IS NULL
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions
		SET
			QuotasPermissionType = COALESCE(@QuotasPermissionType, QuotasPermissionType),
			PoliciesPermissionType = COALESCE(@PoliciesPermissionType, PoliciesPermissionType)
		WHERE
			AccountID = @AccountID
			OR (@AccountID IS NULL AND AccountID IS NULL)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			CostAccountsManagersPermissions (AccountID, QuotasPermissionType, PoliciesPermissionType)
		VALUES 
		(
			@AccountID,
			COALESCE(@QuotasPermissionType, NULL),
			COALESCE(@PoliciesPermissionType, NULL)
		)
	END

END
```

## 171. proc_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_SetInherit

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostAccountsManagersPermissions_SetInherit]
@AccountID INT,
@IsQuotaInherit BIT

AS

BEGIN

	UPDATE
		CostAccountsManagersPermissions
	SET
		QuotasPermissionType   = (CASE WHEN @IsQuotaInherit = 1 THEN NULL ELSE QuotasPermissionType   END),
		PoliciesPermissionType = (CASE WHEN @IsQuotaInherit = 0 THEN NULL ELSE PoliciesPermissionType END)
	WHERE
		AccountID = @AccountID

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CostAccountsManagersPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AccountID AND QuotasPermissionType IS NULL AND PoliciesPermissionType IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM CostAccountsManagersPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
	END

END
```

## 173. proc_CostGroups_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostGroups_Insert] 
@CostGroupName NVARCHAR(100),
@CostMono DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostColor DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostDuplexColor DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostDuplexMono DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostScan DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostSentFax DECIMAL(19,6)

AS

BEGIN

	INSERT INTO 
		CostGroups
			(
				CostGroupName,
				CostMono,
				CostColor,
				CostDuplexMono,
				CostDuplexColor,
				CostScan,
				CostSentFax,
				IsDefault
			)
	VALUES
		(
			@CostGroupName,
			@CostMono,
			@CostColor,
			@CostDuplexMono,
			@CostDuplexColor,
			@CostScan,
			@CostSentFax,
			0 --Sempre é criado sem ser o padrão
		)

	--Atualiza o CostGroupID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 8 --CostGroupID
	END
	
	SELECT CONVERT(INT, @@IDENTITY)

END
```

## 178. proc_CostGroups_RetrievePrinters

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostGroups_RetrievePrinters]
@CostGroupID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName, 
		PD.AddressName, 
		CASE PD.IsLocal 
			WHEN 1 THEN '@@Local' 
			ELSE '@@Network' 
		END AS TypePrinterID
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
	WHERE 
		PD.CostGroupID = @CostGroupID 
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0
	GROUP BY
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.IsLocal

END
```

```sql
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 8 --CostGroupID
	END

END
```

## 184. proc_CounterTypes_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CounterTypes_Retrieve]
@CounterTypeID INT = -1, 
@CounterTypeName NVARCHAR (255) = '',
@CounterUnitID INT = 1

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@CounterTypeID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			CounterTypeID,
			CounterTypeName,
			[Description],
			CounterGroupID,
			CounterUnitID
		FROM
			CounterTypes 
		WHERE
			CounterTypeID = @CounterTypeID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Found INT
		SET @Found = -1
		
		SELECT
			@Found = CounterTypeID
		FROM 
			CounterTypes 
		WHERE 
			CounterTypeName = @CounterTypeName
			AND CounterUnitID = @CounterUnitID
		
		IF (@Found = -1)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @LastID INT
			SELECT @LastID = Max(CounterTypeID) FROM CounterTypes
			
			DECLARE @NewID INT
			DECLARE @CounterGroupID INT
			
			SET @NewID = @LastID + 1
			SET @CounterGroupID = 6 -- Other
			
			INSERT INTO
				CounterTypes (CounterTypeID, CounterTypeName, [Description], CounterGroupID, CounterUnitID)
			VALUES
				(@NewID, @CounterTypeName, @CounterTypeName, @CounterGroupID, @CounterUnitID)

			SELECT
				@NewID AS CounterTypeID,
				@CounterTypeName AS CounterTypeName, 
				@CounterTypeName AS [Description],
				@CounterGroupID AS CounterGroupID,
				@CounterUnitID AS CounterUnitID
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				CounterTypeID,
				CounterTypeName,
				[Description],
				CounterGroupID,
				CounterUnitID
			FROM
				CounterTypes 
			WHERE 
				CounterTypeID = @Found
		END
	END
		
END
```
