## 226. proc_GPV_CountersReadings_SetIsUpdated

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_SetIsUpdated]
@IsUpdated BIT,
@ChangedGeneralRule BIT,
@UnchangedBrandList AS BrandsUDT READONLY,
@ChangedBrandList AS BrandsUDT READONLY,
@UnchangedPrinterModelsList AS PrintersModelsUDT READONLY,
@ChangedPrinterModelsList AS PrintersModelsUDT READONLY

AS

BEGIN
	
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 31/01/2017.
	-- Define o valor da coluna IsUpdated.
	-- @BrandsList deve conter os fabricantes que não devem ser atualizados, ou seja, os fabricantes que possuem refras que não foram alteradas.
	-- @UnchangedPrinterModelsList deve conter os fabricantes que não devem ser atualizados, ou seja, os fabricantes que possuem refras que não foram alteradas.
	-- @UnchangedPrinterModelsList deve conter o BrandName para que filtrar nos casos onde um mesmo nome de modelo é comum para mais de um fabricante.
	-- @ChangedPrinterModelsList é necessário no cenário onde, por exemplo: 
	--	* tenho uma regra o fabricante Lexmark e tenho uma regra para o modelo xyz da Lexmark
	--	* utilizo a interface para excluir/modificar a regra do modelo xyz da Lexmark, nesse momento a regra é marcada como modificada,
	--  * porém a regra a nível de fabricante não sofre alteração (unchanged) e o fabricante é inserido na @UnchangedPrinterModelsList.
	--  * o modelo xyz que deveria ser atualizado neste cenário ele não é, estão é necessário criar essa lista (@ChangedPrinterModelsList) com as exceções.
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	
	--Espero uma lista de fabricantes, e aqui no NPDB descubro o ID delas e então uso na hora de determinar quem deve ser atualizado.
	DECLARE @UnchangedBrands_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		BrandID INT,
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)

	DECLARE @ChangedBrands_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		BrandID INT,
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)
	
	--Espero uma lista de modelos de impressora que não sofreram alteração, e aqui no NPDB descubro o ID delas e então uso na hora de determinar quem deve ser atualizado.
	DECLARE @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		PrinterModelID INT,
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(100),
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)	

	--Espero uma lista de molodes de impressora que sofreream alteração;
	DECLARE @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		PrinterModelID INT,
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(100),
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)

	--Busco o BrandID das @UnchangedBrandList
	INSERT INTO @ChangedBrands_TMP (BrandName)
		SELECT 
			BrandName 
		FROM 
			@ChangedBrandList

	UPDATE @ChangedBrands_TMP 
	SET BrandID = B.BrandID 
	FROM Brands B
		INNER JOIN @ChangedBrandList BL ON B.BrandName = BL.BrandName
		
	--Busco o BrandID das @UnchangedBrandList
	INSERT INTO @UnchangedBrands_TMP (BrandName)
		SELECT 
			BrandName 
		FROM 
			@UnchangedBrandList

	UPDATE @UnchangedBrands_TMP 
	SET BrandID = B.BrandID 
	FROM Brands B
		INNER JOIN @UnchangedBrandList BL ON B.BrandName = BL.BrandName

	--Busco o PrinterModelID das @UnchangedPrinterModelsList
	INSERT INTO @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP (PrinterModelName, BrandName)
		SELECT 
			PML.PrinterModelName, PML.BrandName
		FROM 
			@UnchangedPrinterModelsList PML

	UPDATE @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP 
	SET PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	FROM PrintersModels PM
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		INNER JOIN @UnchangedPrinterModelsList PML ON PM.PrinterModelName = PML.PrinterModelName AND B.BrandName = PML.BrandName
		
	--Busco o PrinterModelID das @ChangedPrinterModelsList
	INSERT INTO @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP (PrinterModelName, BrandName)
		SELECT 
			PML.PrinterModelName, PML.BrandName
		FROM 
			@ChangedPrinterModelsList PML

	UPDATE @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP 
	SET PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	FROM PrintersModels PM
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		INNER JOIN @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP PML ON PM.PrinterModelName = PML.PrinterModelName AND B.BrandName = PML.BrandName
		
	IF (@ChangedGeneralRule = 1)
	BEGIN

		UPDATE 
			CountersReadings
		SET 
			IsUpdated = @IsUpdated
		FROM
			CountersReadings CR 
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		WHERE
			CR.IsUpdated <> @IsUpdated AND 
			(NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @UnchangedBrands_TMP _B WHERE _B.BrandID = PM.BrandID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP _UPM WHERE _UPM.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID))
	END

	UPDATE 
		CountersReadings
	SET 
		IsUpdated = @IsUpdated
	FROM
		CountersReadings CR 
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	WHERE
		CR.IsUpdated <> @IsUpdated AND
		((EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @ChangedBrands_TMP _CB WHERE _CB.BrandID = PM.BrandID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP _UPM WHERE _UPM.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID))
			OR EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP _CPM WHERE _CPM.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID))

END
```

## 229. proc_GPV_Counters_RetrieveSetFromInterval

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Counters_RetrieveSetFromInterval]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate DATETIME,
@FinishDate DATETIME,
@GetStarter BIT

AS
BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 16/11/2015
	-- Se @GetStarter = 1, busca o contador mais antigo da impressora específicada dentro do intervalo de tempo específicado (@StartDate, @FinishDate)
	-- Se @GetStarter = 0, busca o contador mais recente da impressora específicada dentro do intervalo de tempo específicado (@StartDate, @FinishDate)
	--*******************************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @CounterReadingID INT = 0;

	IF(@GetStarter = 1)
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			CR.CounterReadingID,
			CT.CounterTypeName,
			CR.DateTimeRead,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
 
		FROM 
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT TOP 1
					CounterReadingID,
					MIN(DateTimeRead) DateTimeRead
				FROM 
					CountersReadings
				WHERE
					PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
					AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDate AND @FinishDate
					AND Removed = 0		
				GROUP BY
					CounterReadingID
				ORDER BY
					DateTimeRead ASC
			) Aux ON CR.CounterReadingID = Aux.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
	END
	ELSE IF(@GetStarter = 0)
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			CR.CounterReadingID,
			CT.CounterTypeName,
			CR.DateTimeRead,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
 
		FROM 
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT TOP 1
					CounterReadingID,
					MAX(DateTimeRead) DateTimeRead
				FROM 
					CountersReadings
				WHERE
					PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
					AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDate AND @FinishDate	
					AND Removed = 0	
				GROUP BY
					CounterReadingID
				ORDER BY
					DateTimeRead DESC
			) Aux ON CR.CounterReadingID = Aux.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID

	END
END
```

## 230. proc_GPV_NSLReadings_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_NSLReadings_Insert]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME,
@CounterColor BIGINT,
@CounterTotal BIGINT

AS
BEGIN
	
	--***************************************************************************
	-- Insere uma leitura MANUAL de um contador nsl para uma impressora
	-- Diego, 16/08/2013
	-- Alterado para retornar o ID do NSLReadingInserido, retorna 0 caso nenhum seja inserido.
	-- Rafael Machado, 02/05/2017
	--***************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @NSLReadingID INT
	SET @NSLReadingID = 0
	
	--IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NSLReadings WHERE FileInputID = 0 AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND @DateTimeRead = DateTimeRead))
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NSLReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND @DateTimeRead = DateTimeRead)) --nao deixar inserir se ja existe um nslreading (manual ou nao) na mesma hora
	BEGIN
	
		INSERT INTO NSLReadings
		(
			FileInputID,
			PrinterDeviceID,			
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterColor,
			CounterTotal
		)
		VALUES
		(
			0,--FileInputID
			@PrinterDeviceID,
			@DateTimeRead,
			@CounterColor,
			@CounterTotal
		)

		SELECT @NSLReadingID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	END

	SELECT @NSLReadingID AS NSLReadingID

END
```

## 231. proc_GPV_NSLReadings_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_NSLReadings_Remove]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME

AS
BEGIN
	
	--***************************************************************************
	-- Remove uma leitura MANUAL de um contador nsl de uma impressora
	-- Diego, 16/08/2013
	--
	-- Deleta sempre: Robsonm 06/03/2017
	--
	-- Diego, 24/03/2017
	-- Se for leitura manual deleta
	-- Se for leitura de nsl atualiza os contadores para zero
	-- Diego, 28/04/2017
	-- Alterado para remover o SuppliesReferenceCounters do NSLReading que foi zerado
	--***************************************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @NSLReadingID INT = NULL
	DECLARE @FileInputID INT = NULL

	SELECT @NSLReadingID = NSLReadingID, @FileInputID = FileInputID FROM NSLReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND DateTimeRead = @DateTimeRead

	IF(@NSLReadingID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

		IF(@FileInputID = 0)
		BEGIN

			--Manual deleta
			DELETE FROM
				NSLReadings
			WHERE
				FileInputID = 0 AND
				PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
				@DateTimeRead = DateTimeRead

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN

			--NSL atualiza
			UPDATE
				NSLReadings
			SET
				CounterColor = 0,
				CounterTotal = 0
			FROM
				NSLReadings
			WHERE
				NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID

			DELETE FROM
				SuppliesReferenceCounters
			WHERE
				NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID

		END

	END

	SELECT 1

END
```

## 232. proc_GPV_NSLReadings_RetrieveCountersFromRange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_NSLReadings_RetrieveCountersFromRange]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateStart DATETIME,
@LatestDate DATETIME

AS
BEGIN

	--************************************************************************************
	--Retorna os contadores da impressora com leitura após a data passada por parâmetro.
	--************************************************************************************

	SELECT
		DateTimeRead,
		CounterColor,
		CounterTotal
	FROM
		NSLReadings
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN @DateStart AND @LatestDate
	ORDER BY
		DateTimeRead

END
```

## 234. proc_GPV_Parameters_Set

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Parameters_Set]
@ParameterName NVARCHAR(255),
@ParameterValue NVARCHAR(255)
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @Found SMALLINT

	SELECT @Found = COUNT(ParameterName) FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = @ParameterName

	IF( @Found <=0 )
		INSERT INTO Parameters (ParameterName, ParameterValue) VALUES (@ParameterName,@ParameterValue)
	ELSE
		UPDATE Parameters SET ParameterValue = @ParameterValue WHERE  ParameterName = @ParameterName

	
	--GP NAO MEXE NESSE PARAMETRO ENTAO NAO PRECISAMOS NOS PREOCUPAR COM ELE
	--IF(@ParameterName = 'Projects_RequiredProject')
	--	Update parameters SET parametervalue = parametervalue + 1 WHERE parametername = 'ProjectChangeID'

END
```

## 235. proc_GPV_PartnersData_RetrieveCountersRetrocomp

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PartnersData_RetrieveCountersRetrocomp] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME, 
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 30,
@GetJustProductionCounters BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

      --***********************************************************************************************************
      -- SP para o WS GetCountersData trazendo os dados de contadores de produção retrocompativeis (versão 5.5)
      -- Robson, 05/05/2016
      --***********************************************************************************************************

      -- Caso solicite somente as impressoras de contrato, buscará qualquer impressoras com contadores ou não
      DECLARE @OnlyPrintersWithCounters BIT
      SET @OnlyPrintersWithCounters = 1
      
      IF (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 1)
      BEGIN
            SET @OnlyPrintersWithCounters = 0
      END

      DECLARE @CountersOutput TABLE
            (
                  PrinterDeviceID INT, 
                  CounterTypeID INT,
                  AdjustType TINYINT,
                  ComplementType TINYINT,
                  ProductionIsLife BIT,
                  FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
                  LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
                  CounterTotalDif BIGINT, 
                  CounterBlackDif BIGINT,
                  CounterColorDif BIGINT,
                  CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, 
                  CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, 
                  CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT
            )



	--vou ter que pegar as impressoras antes para fazer o recalculo de cubos.
	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PDID INT)
	INSERT INTO 
		@Printers
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID
		FROM
			[dbo].[getPrintersAndCountersBehaviorsRetrocomp](null, null, null, @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters)
	
	DECLARE @PDID INT = NULL
	SELECT @PDID = PDID FROM @Printers 
	
	WHILE (@PDID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		DECLARE @exec NVARCHAR(MAX)
		SET @exec  = 'EXEC [proc_CountersCubesRetrocomp_RecalcPrinter] ''' + CAST(@StartDateTime AS NVARCHAR)  + ''','''+ CAST(@EndDateTime AS NVARCHAR) + ''',' + CAST(@PDID AS NVARCHAR) 
		
		--print @exec
		EXEC (@EXEC)

		DELETE FROM @PRINTERS WHERE PDID = @PDID
		SET @PDID = NULL
		SELECT @PDID = PDID FROM @Printers 
	
	END


      --CARREGA OS DADOS DOS CONTADORES DE PRODUÇÃO, BASEANDO-SE NO FILTRO SOLICITADO
      INSERT INTO 
            @CountersOutput
      SELECT 
            *
      FROM
            [dbo].[getPrintersCountersDataRetrocomp]
            (
                  @StartDateTime,
                  @EndDateTime,
                  NULL, --@PrinterDeviceID,
                  NULL, --@SiteID,
                  NULL, --@SiteDivisionID,
                  @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters,
                  @MaxLimitDaysEarlier,
                  1, --@GetLatestCounterNumbers (para este relatório preciso dos ultimos contadores)
                  @GetJustProductionCounters, --(se é pra trazer só so contadores de produção).
                  @OnlyPrintersWithCounters
            )

      SELECT
                  PD.PrinterDeviceID,
            REPLACE(dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID),';',',') AS PrinterDeviceName,
            ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '-') AS SerialNumber,
            dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS AddressName, 
            PMF.BrandName,
            PM.PrinterModelName,
            CASE
                  WHEN PD.EngagedStatus IN (0, 2) THEN 0
                  ELSE 1
            END AS Engaged,
            ISNULL(PD.Location, '-') AS Location,
            Sites.SiteName,
            ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
            CT.CounterTypeName,
            --Leituras
            CO.FirstDateTimeRead,
            CO.LastDateTimeRead,
            --Saldos
            CO.CounterTotalDif AS CounterTotal,
            CO.CounterBlackDif AS CounterMono,
            CO.CounterColorDif AS CounterColor,
            --Últimos
            CO.CounterTotalLatestNumber AS LatestCounterTotal,
            CO.CounterBlackLatestNumber AS LatestCounterMono,
            CO.CounterColorLatestNumber AS LatestCounterColor,
            --Primeiros
            CO.CounterTotalLatestNumber - CO.CounterTotalDif AS FirstCounterTotal,
            CO.CounterBlackLatestNumber - CO.CounterBlackDif AS FirstCounterMono,
            CO.CounterColorLatestNumber - CO.CounterColorDif AS FirstCounterColor
      FROM 
            @CountersOutput CO
            INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CO.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
            INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON CO.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
            INNER JOIN Sites ON PD.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
            LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
            INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
            INNER JOIN Brands PMF ON PMF.BrandID = PM.BrandID
      ORDER BY
            PrinterDeviceName ASC, 
            [Description] ASC,
            CT.CounterGroupID ASC
            
END
```

## 236. proc_GPV_PartnersData_RetrieveRawCounters

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PartnersData_RetrieveRawCounters] 
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 1

AS

BEGIN

       --***********************************************************************************************************
       -- Maicon 24/08/2015
       -- Retornar os contadores sem nenhum tratamento
       --***********************************************************************************************************

       SELECT
		   PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		   REPLACE(dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID),';',',') AS PrinterDeviceName,
		   ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '-') AS SerialNumber,
		   dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS AddressName, 
		   PMF.BrandName,
		   PM.PrinterModelName,
		   CASE WHEN PD.EngagedStatus IN (0, 2) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Engaged,
		   ISNULL(PD.Location, '-') AS Location,
		   S.SiteName,
		   ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
		   CT.CounterTypeName,
		   C.CounterTotal,
		   C.CounterMono,    
		   C.CounterColor,
		   CR.DateTimeRead as CounterDate
		FROM
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = CR.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
			INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
			LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands PMF ON PMF.BrandID = PM.BrandID
		WHERE
			((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 1 AND (PD.EngagedStatus = 1 OR PD.EngagedStatus = 3))) 
			AND CR.Removed = 0
			AND CR.DateTimeRead = (
										SELECT
											   MAX (CR2.DateTimeRead)
										FROM
											   CountersReadings CR2
										INNER JOIN 
												Counters C2 ON C2.CounterReadingID = CR2.CounterReadingID
										WHERE
											   CR2.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID AND
											   C2.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
										GROUP BY
											   CR2.PrinterDeviceID,
											   C2.CounterTypeID
									)
		ORDER BY
			   PrinterDeviceName ASC,
			   CounterDate DESC,
			   CT.CounterGroupID ASC
			   
           
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PolicyParameters_SetCaptureUSBPrinterCounters]
@LocalInventoryEnabled BIT,
@InventoryTimeUpdate INT

AS
BEGIN

	--****************************************************************
	-- Atualiza os parâmetros que configuram a captura de contadores de impressoras USB

	-- Rafael Machado, 10/08/2018

	--Atualiza o PolicyParameterID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
	BEGIN

	WHERE 
		ParameterName = 'LocalInventoryEnabled'
	
	UPDATE 
		PoliciesParameters 
	SET 
		ParameterValue = CAST(@InventoryTimeUpdate AS NVARCHAR) 
	WHERE 
		ParameterName = 'InventoryTimeUpdate'

END
```

## 240. proc_GPV_PrintCacheBilling_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintCacheBilling_Retrieve]
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate DATETIME = NULL,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN

	--******************************************************************************************************
	-- Retorna o cache de bilhetagem.
	-- Diego - 21/11/2017: Inserida instrução nolock nas consultas devido a problemas de DeadLock
	--******************************************************************************************************

	IF (@StartDate IS NULL)
	BEGIN

		--se não passou data pega dos últimos 31 dias
		SET @EndDate = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(GETDATE() AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)
		SET @StartDate = DATEADD(DAY,-31,@EndDate)

	END

	DECLARE @Data TABLE (CacheDate DATETIME, TotalPagesMono INT, TotalPagesColor INT)

	IF (@SiteID = -1)
	BEGIN

		--INSERT INTO @Data
		--    SELECT Data, SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPagesMono, SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS TotalPagesColor 
		--    FROM CUBECORE
		--    WHERE Data BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		--    GROUP BY Data

		INSERT INTO @Data
			SELECT 
				Data,
				SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPagesMono,
				SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS TotalPagesColor
			FROM
				CubePrinter WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE
				Data BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate 
				--Robson, 26-01-2015
				--Pegar imrpessoras com contadores e bilhetagem ativados.
				-- No cubo ja estao só as com bilhetagem
				AND PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PrintersDevices.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3))
			GROUP BY
				Data

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @Data
			SELECT
				Data,
				SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPagesMono,
				SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS TotalPagesColor
			FROM
				CubePrinter WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE
				Data BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
				AND SiteID = @SiteID    
				--Robson, 26-01-2015
				--Pegar imrpessoras com contadores e bilhetagem ativados.
				-- No cubo ja estao só as com bilhetagem
				AND PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PrintersDevices.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3))
			GROUP BY
				Data

	END
            
	--PREENCHE COM OS DIAS FALTANTES
	WHILE (@EndDate >= @StartDate)
	BEGIN
      
		IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @Data WHERE CacheDate = @StartDate))
		BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @Data VALUES (@StartDate,0,0)

		END
            
		SET @StartDate = DATEADD(DAY,1, @StartDate)
      
	END
      
	SELECT * FROM @Data ORDER BY CacheDate ASC

END
```

## 241. proc_GPV_PrintCacheCounters_RetrievePeriodVolume

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintCacheCounters_RetrievePeriodVolume]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Robson, 19/03/2016
	-- Serve para trazer os dados de contadores no mes de referencia tanto para a impressoras quanto para a empresa
	-- trazendo o mesmo valor que o relatório comparativo (ultimo menos o primeiro) substituindo o modo atual que
	-- soma os valores impressos por dia e que pode ter furos quando o ultimo do dia é menor que o primeiro.
	--** Diego 08/03/2017
	--** Caso o comando SUM estourar a variavel INT irá retornar o maior inteiro válido: 2147483647
	--***********************************************************************************************************
       

	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PDID INT)

	IF (@PrinterDeviceID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Printers VALUES (@PrinterDeviceID)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @Printers                    
			SELECT   
				PD.PrinterDeviceID
			FROM  
				PrintersDevices PD  
			WHERE  
				(PD.EnabledCounterStatus  IN (1, 3)) AND  
				(PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation)) 
	END


	DECLARE @LatestCounterReadings TABLE (		
	PrinterDeviceID INT,			
	DateTimeRead DATETIME,
	CounterReadingID INT,
	ReferenceMono INT,
	ReferenceColor INT,
	IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os últimos do período
	INSERT INTO @LatestCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings 					
				WHERE				
					PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @Printers) AND
					Removed = 0 AND
					DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime 
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC
			
	DECLARE @FirstCounterReadings TABLE (		
	PrinterDeviceID INT,		
	DateTimeRead DATETIME,
	CounterReadingID INT,
	ReferenceMono INT,
	ReferenceColor INT,
	IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os valores iniciais. Lembrando que agora são buscados os dados apenas do dia anterior à data inicial
	--somente das impressoras que tem registros do ultimo contador do periodo
	INSERT INTO @FirstCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,		
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings 					
				WHERE				
					PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					Removed = 0 AND
					DateTimeRead < @StartDateTime AND
					DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(d,-1,@StartDateTime)
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC
			

	DECLARE @IntervalCounterReadings TABLE (		
	PrinterDeviceID INT,		
	DateTimeRead DATETIME,
	CounterReadingID INT,
	ReferenceMono INT,
	ReferenceColor INT,
	IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
	INSERT INTO @IntervalCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,	
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings 					
				WHERE				
					PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					Removed = 0 AND
					DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @FullCounterReadings TABLE (
		PrinterDeviceID INT, 
		BrandName NVARCHAR(255),
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(255),
			
		--StartDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		StartCounterReadingID INT,
		StartReferenceMono INT,
		StartReferenceColor INT,
		StartIsUpdated BIT,
		--EndDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		EndCounterReadingID INT,
		EndReferenceMono INT,
		EndReferenceColor INT,
		EndIsUpdated BIT)

	INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
		SELECT
			LCR.PrinterDeviceID,
			BrandName,
			PrinterModelName,  			
		
			--ISNULL(SCR.DateTimeRead,ECR.DateTimeRead) AS StartDateTimeRead,
			ISNULL(FCR.CounterReadingID,ISNULL(ICR.CounterReadingID,LCR.CounterReadingID)) AS StartCounterReadingID,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS StartReferenceMono,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) StartReferenceColor,
			ISNULL(FCR.IsUpdated,ISNULL(ICR.IsUpdated,LCR.IsUpdated)) AS StartIsUpdated,

			--ECR.DateTimeRead AS EndDateTimeRead,
			LCR.CounterReadingID AS EndCounterReadingID,
			LCR.ReferenceMono AS EndReferenceMono,
			LCR.ReferenceColor EndReferenceColor,
			LCR.IsUpdated AS EndIsUpdated		
		FROM 
			@LatestCounterReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCounterReadings FCR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = FCR.PrinterDeviceID
			LEFT JOIN @IntervalCounterReadings ICR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = ICR.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID

			


	IF ( ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @FullCounterReadings WHERE StartCounterReadingID = 0) > 0 ) OR
			((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @FullCounterReadings WHERE EndIsUpdated = 0) > 0 ))
	BEGIN

		--PASSAR PARA ATUALZIAÇÃO NO COMPONENTE
		SELECT * FROM @FullCounterReadings

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		DECLARE @MaxIntValue INT = [dbo].[GetMaxIntValue]()
		--AGRUPAR PARA JÁ DEVOLVER PRONTO
		SELECT 
			CASE
				WHEN SUM(CAST(PagesMono AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
				ELSE SUM(CAST(PagesMono AS BIGINT))
			END AS PagesMono,
			CASE
				WHEN SUM(CAST(PagesColor AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
				ELSE SUM(CAST(PagesColor AS BIGINT))
			END AS PagesColor
		FROM
			(
			SELECT
				PrinterDeviceID,
				CASE WHEN StartReferenceMono > EndReferenceMono THEN 0 ELSE EndReferenceMono - StartReferenceMono END AS PagesMono,
				CASE WHEN StartReferenceColor > EndReferenceColor THEN 0 ELSE EndReferenceColor - StartReferenceColor END AS PagesColor
			FROM 
				@FullCounterReadings
			GROUP BY
				PrinterDeviceID,StartReferenceMono,EndReferenceMono,EndReferenceColor,StartReferenceColor
			) AS Resumed


	END

END
```

## 242. proc_GPV_PrintCache_RetrieveBillingFromPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintCache_RetrieveBillingFromPrinter]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Essa SP traz os totais mono e color impressos (bilhetagem) por dia
	-- Robson, 02-02-2017
	--***********************************************************************************************************


	--INICIO DADOS DE BILHETAGEM
	--#####################################################################################################
	
	--Tabela que contém os dados de bilhetagem	
	DECLARE @TBPrintCacheBilling TABLE
	(	
		CacheDate DATE,		
		PagesMono INT,
		PagesColor INT,
		TotalPages INT
	)
			  
	INSERT INTO 
		@TBPrintCacheBilling
		SELECT 
			CP.Data,
			SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS PagesMono,
			SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS PagesColor,
			SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN + CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS TotalPages
		FROM
			CubePrinter CP
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CP.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		WHERE
			Data BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
			AND CP.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus in (1,3)
		GROUP BY
			Data
		
	--Preenche com zero os dias restantes que não possuiam dados de bilhetagem	
	DECLARE @StartDateAux DATETIME
	SET @StartDateAux = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)	
	
	WHILE (@EndDate >= @StartDateAux)
	BEGIN
	
		IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT CacheDate FROM @TBPrintCacheBilling WHERE CacheDate = @StartDateAux))
			INSERT INTO @TBPrintCacheBilling VALUES (@StartDateAux,0,0,0)
		
		SET @StartDateAux = DATEADD(DAY,1, @StartDateAux)
	
	END	

	--Retorna os dados
	SELECT
		CacheDate,
		@PrinterDeviceID AS PrinterDeviceID,
		0 AS IsCounters,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		TotalPages
	FROM
		@TBPrintCacheBilling

		
END
```

## 243. proc_GPV_PrintCache_RetrieveFromPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintCache_RetrieveFromPrinter]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- SP Mantida VIVA exclusivamente para o Portal de serviços porque a partir da versão 5.9 essa SP
	-- não é mais usada pelo sistema MPS
	--
	-- Esta forçando zerar a data inicial e colocar 23:59:59 na final
	-- Praticamente cópia de proc_GPV_PrintCacheBilling_Retrieve + proc_GPV_CountersReadings_RetrieveReferencesFromPrinter
	-- Robson, 09-02-2017
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	IF (@StartDate IS NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		--Se não passou data pega dos últimos 31 dias
		SET @EndDate = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(GETDATE() AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)
		SET @StartDate = DATEADD(DAY,-31,@EndDate)
		
	END

	--zerar data:
	SET @StartDate = DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @StartDate)))
	SET @EndDate = DATEADD(s,-1,DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, dateadd(Day,1,@EndDate)))))


	--INICIO DADOS DE BILHETAGEM
	--#####################################################################################################
	
	--Tabela que contém os dados de bilhetagem	
	DECLARE @TBPrintCacheBilling TABLE
	(	
		CacheDate DATE,		
		PagesMono INT,
		PagesColor INT,
		TotalPages INT
	)
			  
	INSERT INTO 
		@TBPrintCacheBilling
		SELECT 
			CP.Data,
			SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS PagesMono,
			SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS PagesColor,
			SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN + CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS TotalPages
		FROM
			CubePrinter CP
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CP.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		WHERE
			Data BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
			AND CP.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus in (1,3)
		GROUP BY
			Data
		
	--Preenche com zero os dias restantes que não possuiam dados de bilhetagem	
	DECLARE @StartDateAux DATETIME
	SET @StartDateAux = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)	
	
	WHILE (@EndDate >= @StartDateAux)
	BEGIN
	
		IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT CacheDate FROM @TBPrintCacheBilling WHERE CacheDate = @StartDateAux))
			INSERT INTO @TBPrintCacheBilling VALUES (@StartDateAux,0,0,0)
		
		SET @StartDateAux = DATEADD(DAY,1, @StartDateAux)
	
	END
	
	--#####################################################################################################
	--FIM DADOS DE BILHETAGEM	

	--INICIO DADOS DE CONTADORES
	--#####################################################################################################
	
	DECLARE @CounterReadings TABLE (
		ID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1), 
		BrandName NVARCHAR(255),
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(255),
		CacheDate DATE, 
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
        ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
		)

	
	INSERT INTO @CounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			BrandName,
			PrinterModelName,   
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateTimeRead))),
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),DateTimeRead,112), PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings
				WHERE
					PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
					Removed = 0 AND
					DateTimeRead BETWEEN DATEADD(D,-1,@StartDate) AND @EndDate --pega o contador do dia anterior para pegar o ultimo do primeiro dia
			) Resumed
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON Resumed.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC

	
	DECLARE @MinDate DATE = NULL
	SELECT @MinDate = MIN (CacheDate) FROM @CounterReadings 

	IF (@MinDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
					
		--se eu nao tenho um cachedate do dia anterior ao startdate significa que nao tinha nenhuma leitura no dia anterior (uau)			
		IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @CounterReadings WHERE CacheDate = DATEADD(D,-1,@StartDate)))
		BEGIN 
			
			-- então vou buscar o primeiro dentro do primeiro dia que tem dados (que nao necessariamente é o startdate)
			--e eu sei que tem dados pelo teste do @MinDate ali em cima
			INSERT INTO @CounterReadings 	
				SELECT 
					BrandName,
					PrinterModelName,   
					DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DATEADD(d,-2,@StartDate)))), --coloco uma data louca qq pra ficar fora do ultimo select senao ia entrar 2 cachedates iguais
					DateTimeRead,
					CounterReadingID,
					ReferenceMono,
					ReferenceColor,
					IsUpdated	
				FROM 
					(  
						SELECT 
							*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),DateTimeRead,112), PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead ASC) Num
						FROM
							CountersReadings
						WHERE
							PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
							Removed = 0 AND
							DateTimeRead BETWEEN @MinDate AND DATEADD(D,1,@MinDate) --POSSO PEGAR O CONTADOR O DIA SEGUINTE (DIA + 1 ) PQ EU SEI QUE TEM UMA LEITURA ANTES DESSE HORARIO
					) Resumed
					INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON Resumed.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
					INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
					INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
				WHERE 
					Num = 1
			
		END

	END


	--AGRUPAR, MESMO QUE OS CONTADORES NÃO ESTEJAM ATUALIZADOS

	--Tabela que contém os dados de bilhetagem	
	DECLARE @TBPrintCacheCounters  TABLE
	(	
		CacheDate DATE,		
		PagesMono INT,
		PagesColor INT
	)
		
	INSERT INTO @TBPrintCacheCounters
	SELECT			
		ECR.CacheDate,
		ECR.ReferenceMono - ISNULL(SCR.ReferenceMono,ECR.ReferenceMono) AS PagesMono,
		ECR.ReferenceColor - ISNULL(SCR.ReferenceColor,ECR.ReferenceColor) AS PagesColor			
	FROM 
		@CounterReadings ECR
		LEFT JOIN @CounterReadings SCR ON ECR.ID = SCR.ID - 1
	WHERE 
		ECR.CacheDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate


	--Preenche com zero os dias restantes que não possuiam dados de bilhetagem	
	SET @StartDateAux = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)	

	
	WHILE (@EndDate >= @StartDateAux)
	BEGIN
	
		IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT CacheDate FROM @TBPrintCacheCounters WHERE CacheDate = @StartDateAux))
			INSERT INTO @TBPrintCacheCounters VALUES (@StartDateAux,0,0)
		
		SET @StartDateAux = DATEADD(DAY,1, @StartDateAux)
	
	END	

	--#####################################################################################################
	--FIM DADOS DE CONTADORES	
	
	DECLARE @MaxIntValue INT = [dbo].[GetMaxIntValue]()
	--Retorna os dados
	SELECT
		CacheDate,
		@PrinterDeviceID AS PrinterDeviceID,
		0 AS IsCounters,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		TotalPages
	FROM
		@TBPrintCacheBilling
	
	UNION
	
	--Retorna os dados
	select 
		CacheDate,			
		PrinterDeviceID,
		IsCounters,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		CASE
			WHEN CAST((PagesMono + PagesColor) AS BIGINT) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
			ELSE PagesMono + PagesColor
		END
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT
			CacheDate,			
			@PrinterDeviceID AS PrinterDeviceID,
			1 AS IsCounters,
			CASE WHEN PagesMono < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PagesMono END AS PagesMono,
			CASE WHEN PagesColor < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PagesColor END AS PagesColor
		FROM
			@TBPrintCacheCounters
	) as r
	

END
```

## 245. proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesContractInfo_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesContractInfo_Retrieve]
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS

BEGIN

	--*********************************************************************************
	--** Traz os dados de contrato de uma impresora
	--** Robson, 20/02/2013
	--*********************************************************************************	

	IF (EXISTS(SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevicesContractInfo WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)) --Existe configuração, retorna cmfe está na PrintersDevicesInfo
	BEGIN 
	
		SELECT 			
			ISNULL(CostFixed,-1) AS CostFixed
		FROM 
			PrintersDevicesContractInfo
		WHERE 
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			
	END 
	ELSE 
	BEGIN 
	
		SELECT 			
			-1 AS CostFixed
					
	END

END
```

## 246. proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesContractInfo_SetCostFixed

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesContractInfo_SetCostFixed]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@CostFixed [DECIMAL](19, 6)
AS
BEGIN

	--*********************************************************************************
	--** Atribui o valor do custo fixo a impressora, criando o registro se não existir.
	--** Robson, 20/02/2013
	--*********************************************************************************	

	DECLARE @EXISTS SMALLINT
	SELECT @EXISTS = COUNT(*) FROM PrintersDevicesContractInfo WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	IF(@EXISTS > 0) --Já existe, faz o update somente
	BEGIN 
		UPDATE 
			PrintersDevicesContractInfo 
		SET 
			CostFixed = @CostFixed
		WHERE 
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			
	END 
	ELSE 
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesContractInfo VALUES (@PrinterDeviceID, @CostFixed)

	END

END
```

## 247. proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesCounters_RetrieveAllForRegister

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesCounters_RetrieveAllForRegister]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@Day DATETIME = NULL,
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@LastDate DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Maicon, 21/08/2015
	-- Usado para trazer os contadores de uma impressora no MPS, para cadastros de contadores.
	-- Se Não for passado parâmetro irá pegar todos os do último dia que tem dados.
	-- Se for passado parâmetro @Day pega todos os do dia informado
	-- Se forem passados os parâmetros @StartDate e @LastDate pega o do intervalo, embora isso não esteja sendo usado (ainda)
	-- Roger 17/03/2017
	-- Foi adicionar para buscar na CountersReadings apenas os contadores que não estão removidos
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	IF (@StartDate IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		IF (@Day IS NULL)
		BEGIN       
			--PEGAR A DATA MAIS RECENTE QUE TEM DADOS
			SELECT @Day = MAX(DateTimeRead) FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND Removed=0
		END

		SELECT @StartDate = DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @Day)))
		SELECT @LastDate = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, @StartDate + 1)            
	END
	
	SELECT 
		C.CounterReadingID, 
		@PrinterDeviceID AS PrinterDeviceID,
		C.CounterTypeID,
		CR.DateTimeRead,
		C.CounterTotal as CounterNumber,
		C.CounterMono as CounterBlackNumber,
		C.CounterColor as CounterColorNumber,
		CT.CounterTypeName,
		CT.Description

	FROM Counters C
		INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR on C.CounterReadingID = CR.CounterReadingID
		INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT on c.CounterTypeID=ct.CounterTypeID
	WHERE 
		C.CounterReadingID in
		(
			SELECT  
				CounterReadingID 
			FROM 
				CountersReadings 
			WHERE 
				PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID 
				and DateTimeRead >= @StartDate AND DateTimeRead <= @LastDate    
		)
		AND CR.Removed = 0		
	ORDER BY DatetimeRead DESC
				            
END
```

## 248. proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesCounters_RetrieveAllMaxMinForRegister

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesCounters_RetrieveAllMaxMinForRegister]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	--Roger 06/11/2018 5.39 #31 Criado para buscar os contadores anterior e próximo a data informada
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	  DECLARE @StartDate DATETIME
	  DECLARE @LastDate DATETIME		
	   

	  SELECT TOP 1 @StartDate = DateTimeRead FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND Removed=0 AND DateTimeRead < @DateTimeRead ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC 
	  SELECT TOP 1 @LastDate = DateTimeRead FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND Removed=0 AND DateTimeRead > @DateTimeRead ORDER BY DateTimeRead ASC 
		
	  IF(@StartDate IS NULL)--Caso não tenha anterior
	  BEGIN
		 SET @StartDate = @DateTimeRead
	  END

	  IF(@LastDate IS NULL)--Caso não tenha próximo
	  BEGIN
		 SET @LastDate = @DateTimeRead
	  END
	
	
	SELECT 
		C.CounterReadingID, 
		@PrinterDeviceID AS PrinterDeviceID,
		C.CounterTypeID,
		CR.DateTimeRead,
		C.CounterTotal as CounterNumber,
		C.CounterMono as CounterBlackNumber,
		C.CounterColor as CounterColorNumber,
		CT.CounterTypeName,
		CT.Description

	FROM Counters C
		INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR on C.CounterReadingID = CR.CounterReadingID
		INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT on c.CounterTypeID=ct.CounterTypeID
	WHERE 
		CR.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND 
		CR.Removed = 0 AND
		CR.DateTimeRead >=@StartDate AND CR.DateTimeRead <=@LastDate AND CR.DateTimeRead <> @DateTimeRead
	ORDER BY DatetimeRead DESC
				            
END
```

## 249. proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesCounters_RetrieveContractPrintersWithoutCounters

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesCounters_RetrieveContractPrintersWithoutCounters]
@MinDays INT

AS

BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Robson, 30/12/2015
	-- Traz as impressoras de contrato que não mandam dados ha mais que x dias.
	-- Usada para gerar o evento de impressora sem contador
	-- Rafael Machado 28/06/2017
	-- Adicionado o filtro para retornar apenas impressoras monitoradas.
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	SELECT 
		CR.PrinterDeviceID, 
		PD.SiteID,
		MAX(CR.DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead
	FROM 
		CountersReadings CR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
	WHERE 
		PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3)
		AND PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) --Impressora deve estar monitorada.
	GROUP BY 
		CR.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.SiteID
	HAVING
		MAX(CR.DateTimeRead) < DATEADD(D, -1*@MinDays ,GETDATE())

END
```

```sql
       --***********************************************************************************************************
```

## 252. proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveAllFromRange

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveAllFromRange]
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT,
@SupplySubFunctionTypeID INT,
@DateStart DATETIME = NULL,
@LatestDate DATETIME = NULL,
@BringCountersRules BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	--******************************************************************************************************************************************************
	-- Robson, 13/05/2013
	-- Traz AS leituras de um determinado periodo mais 5 dias pra tras.
	-- Se não for passado data é trazido todas AS leituras
	-- Diego, 28/04/2017
	-- Alteração para buscar contadores de referencia de suprimento caso existam para o slot e tipo informados.
	-- Diego, 02/05/2017
	-- Alterado para retornar as colunas das regras de contadores de referencia.
	--******************************************************************************************************************************************************

	IF(@BringCountersRules = 0)
	BEGIN

		SELECT
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
			NR.DateTimeRead,
			NR.FileInputID, 
			PDSH.LoadStatus,
			ST.SupplyTypeName,
			SCC.SupplyColorName,
			SPN.SupplyPhysicalName,
			SC.SupplyCapacity,
			SPNU.PartNumber,
			SSN.SupplySerialNumber,
			SO.SupplyOIDName,

			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterColor,
				NR.CounterColor
			)
			AS CounterColor,
			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterTotal,
				NR.CounterTotal
			)
			AS CounterTotal,

			PDSH.TotalReadings,
			PDSH.SupplyChangeID,
			PDSH.Invalid,
			PDSH.ForceStart
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
			INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
			INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  PDSH.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  PDSH.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID
			
				LEFT JOIN SuppliesReferenceCounters SRC ON NR.NSLReadingID = SRC.NSLReadingID AND SRC.SupplySubFunctionTypeID = @SupplySubFunctionTypeID

			INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC ON PDSH.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
			INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON PDSH.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
			INNER JOIN SupplyOIDs SO ON PDSH.SupplyOIDID = SO.SupplyOIDID
		WHERE
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID AND
			((@DateStart IS NOT NULL AND NR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY,-5,@DateStart) AND @LatestDate )--pega AS leturas de 5 dias pra tras
			OR @DateStart IS NULL)
		ORDER BY
			NR.DateTimeRead DESC

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		SELECT
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
			NR.DateTimeRead,
			NR.FileInputID, 
			PDSH.LoadStatus,
			ST.SupplyTypeName,
			SCC.SupplyColorName,
			SPN.SupplyPhysicalName,
			SC.SupplyCapacity,
			SPNU.PartNumber,
			SSN.SupplySerialNumber,
			SO.SupplyOIDName,

			SRCRC.SupplyReferenceCounterRule AS CounterColorRule,
			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterColor,
				NR.CounterColor
			)
			AS CounterColor,

			SRCRT.SupplyReferenceCounterRule AS CounterTotalRule,
			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterTotal,
				NR.CounterTotal
			)
			AS CounterTotal,

			PDSH.TotalReadings,
			PDSH.SupplyChangeID,
			PDSH.Invalid,
			PDSH.ForceStart
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
			INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
			INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  PDSH.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  PDSH.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID
			
				LEFT JOIN SuppliesReferenceCounters SRC ON NR.NSLReadingID = SRC.NSLReadingID AND SRC.SupplySubFunctionTypeID = @SupplySubFunctionTypeID
				LEFT JOIN SupplyReferenceCountersRules SRCRC ON SRC.CounterColorRuleID = SRCRC.SupplyReferenceCounterRuleID
				LEFT JOIN SupplyReferenceCountersRules SRCRT ON SRC.CounterTotalRuleID = SRCRT.SupplyReferenceCounterRuleID

			INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC ON PDSH.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
			INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON PDSH.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
			INNER JOIN SupplyOIDs SO ON PDSH.SupplyOIDID = SO.SupplyOIDID
		WHERE
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID AND
			((@DateStart IS NOT NULL AND NR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY,-5,@DateStart) AND @LatestDate )--pega AS leturas de 5 dias pra tras
			OR @DateStart IS NULL)
		ORDER BY
			NR.DateTimeRead DESC

	END
						
END
```

## 253. proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_SetForceStart

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_SetForceStart]
@PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID INT,
@ForceStart BIT,
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@FullName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@Email NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@PartnerName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL

AS
BEGIN

	--******************************************************************************
	--Atualiza o campo ForceStart para indicar se é um inicio de suprimento ou não.
	--Diego 26/04/2013
	--******************************************************************************
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--Atualiza o campo ForceStart
	UPDATE
		PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
	SET
		ForceStart = @ForceStart
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID = @PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID	
	
	IF(@ForceStart = 1)
	BEGIN
	
		IF(NOT EXISTS(SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID = @PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID))
		BEGIN
		
			--Inserir registro de auditoria para indicar quem fez a alteração nos históricos do suprimento
			INSERT INTO
				PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings
					(
						PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
						AccountID,
						FullName,
						Email,
						PartnerName,
						[Date]
					)
				VALUES
					(
						@PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
						@AccountID,
						@FullName,
						@Email,
						@PartnerName,
						GETDATE()
					)
		
		END

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
		IF(EXISTS(SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID = @PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID))
		BEGIN
		
			--Remover registro de auditoria, pois o histórico não é mais o inicio de um novo suprimento
			DELETE FROM
				 PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings
			WHERE
				 PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID = @PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID

		END

	END
		
END
```

## 257. proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_InsertNewPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_InsertNewPrinter]
@PrinterDeviceName NVARCHAR(200),
@SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50),
@BrandName NVARCHAR(100),
@ModelName NVARCHAR(100)

AS

BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************************************
	--** 04/03/2013, robson
	--** Responsável por criar uma nova impressora pelo GP. Vai criar com quase tudo padrão.
	--** 18/03/2015, Héber Savedra - Portal 360, v5.3.2
	--** Alterado para inserir o TrustOrigin igual 1, que é o novo padrão
	--** 28/02/2020, Diego Antunes
	--** Inserido campo UpdatedDate
	--*******************************************************************************************************

	--Pegar o modelo. Copiado de [proc_PrE_PrintersModels_Retrieve]
	DECLARE @PrinterModelID INT
	SET @PrinterModelID = NULL
	
	SELECT
		@PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	FROM
		PrintersModels PM
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	WHERE
		PM.PrinterModelName = @ModelName
		AND B.BrandName = @BrandName

	IF (@PrinterModelID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @BrandID INT
		SET @BrandID = NULL
		
		SELECT
			@BrandID = BrandID
		FROM
			Brands 
		WHERE
			BrandName = @BrandName
			
		IF (@BrandID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				Brands (BrandName)
			VALUES
				(@BrandName)
				
			SET @BrandID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		END
		
		INSERT INTO
			PrintersModels (BrandID, PrinterModelName, CorrectName, PrintersModelsSlotProfileID, PrinterModelKnownID)
		VALUES
			(@BrandID, @ModelName, NULL, NULL, NULL)
			
		SET @PrinterModelID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()				
	END

	DECLARE @SiteID INT
	SELECT @SiteID = SiteID FROM Sites WHERE IsDefault = 1

	DECLARE @CostGroupID INT
	SELECT @CostGroupID  = CostGroupID  FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1

	--Criar a impressora
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceID INT

	INSERT INTO
		PrintersDevices
		(
			PrinterDeviceName,
			SerialNumber,
			AddressName,
			AddressPort,
			AddressMAC,
			PrinterModelID,
			IsLocal,
			IsUSBPort,
			SiteID,
			SiteDivisionID,
			Location,
			CostGroupID,
			CostAccountID,
			ForceColor,
			TrustOrigin,
			EnabledBillingStatus,
			EnabledCounterStatus,
			EngagedStatus,
			UpdatedDate
		)
	VALUES
		(
			@PrinterDeviceName,
			@SerialNumber,
			'unknown',--@AddressName,
			'unknown',--@AddressPort,
			'unknown',--@AddressMAC,
			@PrinterModelID,
			1,		--@IsLocal,
			0,		--@IsUSBPort,
			@SiteID,
			NULL,
			'',		--@Location,
			@CostGroupID,
			NULL,	--CostAccountID
			0,		--ForceColor
			1,		--TrustOrigin
			0,		--@EnabledBillingStatus,
			3,		--@EnabledCounterStatus,
			3,		--@EngagedStatus (coloco como se fosse forçado porque na verdade impressora esta sendo inserida na mao é pq é de contrato)
			GETUTCDATE() --UpdatedDate
		)
		
	SET @PrinterDeviceID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	--INSERIR Auditoria
	INSERT INTO 
		PrintersDevicesAuditings 
		(PrinterDeviceID,AuditingActionID,DateAction,AuditingSourceID,AuditingFieldID,Value)		
	VALUES
		(@PrinterDeviceID,1,GETUTCDATE(),5,1,@PrinterDeviceID)		
	
	SELECT @PrinterDeviceID
			
END
```

## 258. proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAddressNameChangeWarnings

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAddressNameChangeWarnings]
@UTCOneDayAgo DATETIME = NULL --criado para ajudar nos testes, para que seja possível 'forçar uma data'

AS
BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************************************
	--** Rafael Machado, 07/06/2017
	--** Obtém as impressoras que mudaram de IP a mais de um dia.
	--** SP utilizada para criação do evento de IP com troca de IP.
	--** Corrigido comportamento para buscar trocas de IP dentro de 24 horas.
	--** Rafael Machado, 20/06/2017
	--** Adicionado where para não retornas as impressoras removidas.
	--*******************************************************************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF(@UTCOneDayAgo IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @UTCOneDayAgo = DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETUTCDATE())
	END
	
	DECLARE @Printers TABLE 
	(
		PrinterDeviceID INT,
		SiteID INT,
		CurrentAddressName NVARCHAR(50),
		PreviousAddressNameAuditDate DATETIME
	)

	INSERT INTO @Printers (PrinterDeviceID, SiteID, CurrentAddressName, PreviousAddressNameAuditDate)
		SELECT 
			PD.PrinterDeviceID,
			PD.SiteID,
			PD.AddressName CurrentAddressName,
			PDA.DateAction PreviousAddressNameAuditDate
		FROM
			PrintersDevices PD
			INNER JOIN 
			(
				SELECT
					_PDA.PrinterDeviceID,
					MAX(_PDA.AuditingID) AuditingID
				FROM
					PrintersDevicesAuditings _PDA
				WHERE
					_PDA.AuditingFieldID = 4 --AddressName Field
					AND _PDA.DateAction >= @UTCOneDayAgo 
					AND _PDA.AuditingActionID = 2 -- Apenas ação do tipo 'update'
				GROUP BY
					_PDA.PrinterDeviceID
			) LastOneDayAgoAuditing ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = LastOneDayAgoAuditing.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevicesAuditings PDA ON LastOneDayAgoAuditing.AuditingID = PDA.AuditingID
		WHERE
			PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) AND
			NOT EXISTS 
			(
				--Não pode existir registro aqui nessa tabela, se existir ele é porque essa sp ja foi executada
				--E o evento ja foi criado.
				SELECT 
					* 
				FROM 
					PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges _PDANC 
				WHERE 
					_PDANC.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
					AND _PDANC.CurrentAddressName = PD.AddressName
					AND _PDANC.PreviousChangeDate = PDA.DateAction
			)

	-- atualiza o que existe usando inner join
	UPDATE 
		PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges
	SET
		CurrentAddressName = P.CurrentAddressName,
		PreviousChangeDate = P.PreviousAddressNameAuditDate
	FROM 
		PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges PDANC
		INNER JOIN @Printers P ON PDANC.PrinterDeviceID = P.PrinterDeviceID

	--insere o que é novo e não existe 
	INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges (PrinterDeviceID, CurrentAddressName, PreviousChangeDate)
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID, 
			CurrentAddressName, 
			PreviousAddressNameAuditDate 
		FROM 
			@Printers P
		WHERE 
			NOT EXISTS 
			(
				SELECT * FROM PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges _PDANC WHERE _PDANC.PrinterDeviceID = P.PrinterDeviceID
			)

	SELECT 
		PrinterDeviceID,
		SiteID,
		CurrentAddressName
	FROM 
		@Printers

END
```

## 259. proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAll]

AS
BEGIN

	--**************************************************************************************
	-- Diego, 05/06/2013
	-- Retorna todas AS impressoras da empresa, somente AS que tem algum tipo de monitoração
	-- E impressoras não consolidadas
	-- Rafael Machado, 17/07/2017
	-- O filtro que fazia com que impressoras com bilhetagem ou contadores habilitados fossem retornadas foi comentado porque
	-- agora precisamos tratar as impressoras que estão suspensas e esse é um estado que não está presente no NPDB,
	-- por isso preciso retornar todas as impressoras.
	-- Rafael Machado, 04/08/2017
	-- Adicionado coluna FirmwareVersion.
	--**************************************************************************************
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	SELECT 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.SiteID,
		S.SiteName,
		ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID,-1) AS SiteDivisionID,
		ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName,'') AS SiteDivisionName,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName AS PrinterName,
		RTRIM(LTRIM(PM.PrinterModelName)) AS ModelName,
		RTRIM(LTRIM(B.BrandName)) AS BrandName,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.AddressMAC,
		PD.IsLocal,
		PD.IsUSBPort,
		PD.Location,
		PD.FirmwareVersion,
		CASE WHEN PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN(0,2) THEN 0
			 WHEN PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN(1,3) THEN 1
			 END AS EnabledBilling,
			 
		CASE WHEN PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN(0,2) THEN 0
			 WHEN PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN(1,3) THEN 1
			 END AS EnabledCounters,
			 
		CASE WHEN PD.EngagedStatus IN(0,2) THEN 0
			 WHEN PD.EngagedStatus IN(1,3) THEN 1
			 END AS Engaged
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
		INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
		LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesConsolidation PDC ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PDC.PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
	WHERE
		(PDC.PrinterDeviceMainID IS NULL)

END
```

## 260. proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_RetrieveChangedIP

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_RetrieveChangedIP]
@BeginDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT

AS

BEGIN

	--************************************************************************************
	-- Robson, 26/08/2014
	-- SP para o relatório de trocas de IPs no MPS
	-- Versão 5.3
	--************************************************************************************

	SELECT 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressName,
		S.SiteName,
		PDA.DateAction, 
		PDA.Value
	FROM
		PrintersDevicesAuditings PDA 
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PDA.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID 
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID 
		INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
	WHERE 
		PDA.AuditingFieldID = 4 AND
		PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) AND
		PDA.DateAction BETWEEN @BeginDate AND @EndDate AND
		(@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 1 AND PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3) ))
	ORDER BY
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PDA.DateAction

END
```

```sql
AS
BEGIN


	--***************************************************************************************

	END
```
	
```sql
END
```

## 263. proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_SetEngagedStatus

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_SetEngagedStatus]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@Engaged BIT,
@ActionPerformedBySystem BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN


	--***************************************************************************************
	--** Define essa impressora como de contrato (pelo usuário).
	--** false = 2, true = 3. Então tem que somar '2' que valor que foi passado
	--** Robson, 21/02/2013
	--** Adicionado o parâmetro que indica se a ação foi originada do Sistema ou Usuário,
	--** esse parâmetro será usado para definir o @EngagedStatus.
	--** Rafael Machado, 25/09/2015
	--***************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @EngagedStatus TINYINT
	
	IF(@ActionPerformedBySystem = 1)
	BEGIN --O sistema que originou essa alteração não precisa alterar o @Enganged
		SET @EngagedStatus = @Engaged
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN --O usuário originou essa alteração adiciona + 2.
		SET @EngagedStatus = (@Engaged + 2)
	END	

	IF (EXISTS ( SELECT 1  FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND EngagedStatus <> (@EngagedStatus)))
	BEGIN
	
		UPDATE 
			PrintersDevices
		SET 
			EngagedStatus = (@EngagedStatus)
		WHERE 
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

		INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesAuditings 
			(
				PrinterDeviceID, 
				AuditingActionID, 
				DateAction, 
				AuditingSourceID, 
				AuditingFieldID, 
				Value
			)
		VALUES
			(
				@PrinterDeviceID,
				2,
				GETUTCDATE(),
				5,
				19,
				(@EngagedStatus)
			)

	END
	
END
```

## 268. proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_SetSite

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_PrintersDevices_SetSite]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@SiteID INT

AS
BEGIN


	--******************************************************************************************************
	--** Altera o site de uma impressora 
	--** Robson, 22/02/2013
	--******************************************************************************************************

	IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND SiteID <> @SiteID))
	BEGIN
	
		UPDATE
			PrintersDevices 
		SET 
			SiteID = @SiteID,
			SiteDivisionID = NULL
		WHERE
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

		INSERT INTO 
			PrintersDevicesAuditings 
			(PrinterDeviceID, AuditingActionID, DateAction, AuditingSourceID, AuditingFieldID, Value)
		VALUES
			(@PrinterDeviceID,2,GETUTCDATE(),5,10,@SiteID)

		INSERT INTO 
			PrintersDevicesAuditings 
			(PrinterDeviceID, AuditingActionID, DateAction, AuditingSourceID, AuditingFieldID, Value)
		VALUES
			(@PrinterDeviceID,2,GETUTCDATE(),5,11,'-1')
		
		
		--Avisa que tem uma fila para reprocessar
		
		--Só é possível ter uma fila de atualização para todos
		--menos a consolidação da impressora
		DELETE FROM
			ProcessQueues 
		WHERE 
			ProcessQueueType = 11 -- atualização de site 
			AND ObjectQueueID = @PrinterDeviceID
		

		DECLARE @Period CHAR
		SET @Period = dbo.GetProcessQueuePeriod(GETDATE(), 11, @PrinterDeviceID)

		IF (@Period <> 'n')
		BEGIN
		
			INSERT INTO
				ProcessQueues
				(
					ProcessQueueType, 
					ObjectQueueID, 
					ObjectQueueField,
					DateIncluded, 
					[Status], 
					ErrorDescription,
					LastDateUpdated,
					LastPeriodUpdated,
					Period
				)	
			VALUES 
				(
					11 , --site
					@PrinterDeviceID ,
					0, --ObjectQueueField (héber disse pra deixar 0)
					GETDATE(),
					1,
					'',
					GETDATE(),
					NULL,
					@Period
				)
		END
		
		SELECT 1
		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
		SELECT 0
	
	END
	
	/**
	DECLARE @PrinterData NVARCHAR(1000)	
	SELECT @PrinterData = PrinterDeviceName + ' - ' + AddressName FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = 1
	
	--insere a auditoria, já que o GP nao tava colocando, e já que o businessLite nao tem 
	INSERT INTO Auditings (PartnerName, PartnerAccount, AuditingActionID,AffectedDescription, ObjectID, ActionDate) VALUES
	(@PartnerName, @PartnerAccount, 15, @PrinterData, @PrinterDeviceID, GETDATE())
	**/


END
```

## 270. proc_GPV_ProcessQueues_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_ProcessQueues_Insert] 
@QueueType INT ,			
@ObjectQueueID INT
AS
BEGIN

	IF(@QueueType <> 7)
	BEGIN
		--Só é possível ter uma fila de atualização para todos
		--menos a consolidação da impressora
		DELETE FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueType = @QueueType AND ObjectQueueID = @ObjectQueueID

	END

	DECLARE @period CHAR
	SET @period = dbo.GetProcessQueuePeriod(GETDATE(),@QueueType,@ObjectQueueID)

	IF (@period <> 'n')
	BEGIN
	
		INSERT INTO
			ProcessQueues 
				(ProcessQueueType, 
				ObjectQueueID, 
				ObjectQueueField,
				DateIncluded, 
				Status, 
				ErrorDescription,
				LastDateUpdated,
				LastPeriodUpdated,
				Period
				)	
		VALUES 
				(@QueueType ,
				@ObjectQueueID ,
				0, --ObjectQueueField (héber disse pra deixar 0)
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				'',
				GETDATE(),
				NULL,
				@period)

	END
END
```

## 271. proc_GPV_Reports_CountersReadings_RetrievePrintersWithoutCounters

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_CountersReadings_RetrievePrintersWithoutCounters]
@SinceDate DATETIME = NULL,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1
AS

BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	--  Robson, 09/08/2015
	--  Relatório de Impressoras Monitoradas sem Contadores no MPS
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	SELECT
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
		ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '-') AS SerialNumber ,
		ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '-') AS AddressMAC,
		PD.AddressName
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
	WHERE 
		PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation)
		AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR PD.EngagedStatus IN (1, 3))
		AND PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN
			(
				SELECT DISTINCT 
					PrinterDeviceID 
				FROM
					CountersReadings
				WHERE
					(@SinceDate IS NULL OR DateTimeRead >= @SinceDate )
			)
		AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PD.SiteID = @SiteID) 
		AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID, 0) = @SiteDivisionID) 
	ORDER BY  
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) ASC, 
		PD.AddressName ASC

END
```

## 272. proc_GPV_Reports_CountersReadings_RetrieveReferenceCounters

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_CountersReadings_RetrieveReferenceCounters]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1, 
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 30,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Diego, 10/02/2017
	-- Stored Procedure usada para o Relatório de contadores (Referência)
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PrinterDeviceID INT)

	INSERT INTO @Printers                    
		SELECT   
			PD.PrinterDeviceID
		FROM  
			PrintersDevices PD  
		WHERE
			((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR (PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)) AND
			((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) AND
			((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND
			((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) AND
			(PD.EnabledCounterStatus  IN (1,3))

	DECLARE @FirstCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega o primeiro valor menor ou igual a data passada, até o limite de dias indicado para busca anterior.
	INSERT INTO @FirstCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,		
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @Printers) AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead <= @StartDateTime AND
					CR.DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1,@StartDateTime)
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	--PASSAR PARA ATUALIzAÇÃO NO COMPONENTE
	SELECT
		FCR.PrinterDeviceID,
		FCR.CounterReadingID,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		PD.AddressName AS MachineIP,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterFullName,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,

		FCR.DateTimeRead,
		FCR.ReferenceMono,
		FCR.ReferenceColor,
		FCR.IsUpdated
	FROM
		@FirstCounterReadings FCR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON FCR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	ORDER BY
		PrinterDeviceName

END
```

## 273. proc_GPV_Reports_CountersReadings_RetrieveReferenceValues

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_CountersReadings_RetrieveReferenceValues]  
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS
BEGIN
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Maicon Pereira 08-09-2015
	-- Stored Procedure usada para buscar os dados das leituras de referência
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	SELECT 
		@PrinterDeviceID PrinterDeviceID,
		CR.CounterReadingID,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		CR.DateTimeRead,
		CR.ReferenceMono, 
		CR.ReferenceColor,
		CR.IsUpdated
	FROM 
		CountersReadings CR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	WHERE 
		CR.DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime AND
		CR.DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND
		CR.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
		CR.Removed = 0
	ORDER BY DateTimeRead ASC

END
```

## 274. proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveAllCounters

```sql
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveAllCounters] 
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME = NULL,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1, 
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 30,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Maicon Pereira 04-09-2015
	--
	-- Stored Procedure usada para o Relatório de contadores (Consumo e Intervalo)
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	if(@EndDate is NULL)
	BEGIN

		DECLARE @LastCountersOnly TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT, DTR DATETIME)

		INSERT INTO @LastCountersOnly 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD1 ON PD1.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @StartDate and 
						DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,(@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1),@StartDate) AND
						CR.Removed = 0 AND 
						((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR PD1.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) AND 
						((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD1.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) AND
						((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD1.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND 
						((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD1.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD1.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) 
						AND PD1.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)						
					GROUP BY 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID  AND CR.Removed = 0

		SELECT
			PD.PrinterDeviceID,
			[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](PD.PrinterDeviceID) as PrinterDeviceName,
			PD.AddressName AS MachineIP,
			PD.SerialNumber, 
			C.CounterTypeID,  
			CT.CounterTypeName as CounterTypeName,
			CT.Description as CounterTypeDescription,
			LC.DTR as StartDateTimeRead,
			C.CounterMono as StartCounterMono,
			C.CounterColor as StartCounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal as StartCounterTotal
		FROM @LastCountersOnly LC
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD on PD.PrinterDeviceid = LC.PDID
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = LC.CTRID
		INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON CT.CounterTypeID = C.CounterTypeID
		ORDER BY [dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](PD.PrinterDeviceID) ASC 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		--Pega os ultimos contadores do periodo
		DECLARE @LastCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
		INSERT INTO @LastCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD1 ON PD1.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @EndDate and 
						DateTimeRead >= @StartDate AND
						CR.Removed = 0 AND 
						((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR PD1.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) AND 
						((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD1.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) AND
						((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD1.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND 
						((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD1.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD1.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) 
						AND PD1.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)
					GROUP BY 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID  AND CR.Removed = 0
		
		--Pega os primeiros contadores do periodo somente das impressoras que tem registros do ultimo contador do periodo
		DECLARE @FirstCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
				
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD1 ON PD1.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @StartDate and 
						DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,(@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1),@StartDate) AND
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters)  AND
						CR.Removed = 0 
					GROUP BY 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID  AND CR.Removed = 0

		--Pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
		DECLARE @IntervalCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CTRIDLC INT, DTR DATETIME)
		INSERT INTO @IntervalCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MIN(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD1 ON PD1.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @EndDate and 
						DateTimeRead >= @StartDate AND
						CR.Removed = 0 AND 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters) AND
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PDID FROM @FirstCounters)  
					GROUP BY 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID  AND CR.Removed = 0

		--Junto as duas tabelas de valores iniciais
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT * from @IntervalCounters 
			
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @IntervalCounters 		

		DECLARE @FirstCountersReadings TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT,DTR DATETIME, CTID INT, MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @FirstCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			FC.PDID,
			FC.CTRID,  
			FC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @FirstCounters FC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = FC.CTRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @FirstCounters
		
		DECLARE @LastCountersReadings TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT, DTR DATETIME,CTID INT ,MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @LastCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			LC.PDID,
			LC.CTRID,  
			LC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @LastCounters LC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = LC.CTRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @LastCounters
		
		SELECT 
		ISNULL(FCR.PDID,LCR.PDID) as PrinterDeviceID,
		[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](ISNULL(FCR.PDID,LCR.PDID)) as PrinterDeviceName,
		(SELECT AddressName FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = ISNULL(FCR.PDID,LCR.PDID)) AS MachineIP,
		(SELECT SerialNumber FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = ISNULL(FCR.PDID,LCR.PDID)) AS SerialNumber,
		ISNULL(FCR.CTID,LCR.CTID) as CounterTypeID,
		ISNULL((SELECT CounterTypeName FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = FCR.CTID),(SELECT CounterTypeName FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = LCR.CTID)) as CounterTypeName,
		ISNULL((SELECT Description FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = FCR.CTID),(SELECT Description FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = LCR.CTID)) as CounterTypeDescription,
		ISNULL(FCR.DTR,@StartDate) as StartDateTimeRead,
		FCR.MONO as StartCounterMono,
		FCR.COLOR as StartCounterColor,
		FCR.TOTAL as  StartCounterTotal,
		ISNULL(LCR.DTR,@EndDate ) as EndDateTimeRead,	
		LCR.MONO as EndCounterMono,
		LCR.COLOR as EndCounterColor,
		LCR.TOTAL as EndCounterTotal,
		LCR.MONO - FCR.MONO as CounterMonoDif,
		LCR.COLOR - FCR.COLOR as CounterColorDif,
		LCR.TOTAL - FCR.TOTAL as CounterTotalDif 
		FROM @LastCountersReadings LCR
		RIGHT OUTER JOIN @FirstCountersReadings FCR ON LCR.PDID = FCR.PDID AND LCR.CTID = FCR.CTID 
		ORDER BY [dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](ISNULL(FCR.PDID,LCR.PDID)) ASC  
	END
END
```
