## 275. proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveClosingNDDigital

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveClosingNDDigital]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME

AS
BEGIN

	--****************************************************************************************************************************
	--Robson, 22/09/16: SP para auxiliar na validação dos dados de contadores usados no fechamento ndd (DataResumeExport)
	-- Diego 08/02/2017:
	-- Alteração para buscar e retornar os dados de forma compativel com a mesma forma utilizada no relatório de comparativo.
	--** Diego 08/03/2017
	--** Caso o comando SUM estourar a variavel INT irá retornar o maior inteiro válido: 2147483647
	--****************************************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PrinterDeviceID INT)

	INSERT INTO @Printers                    
		SELECT   
			PD.PrinterDeviceID
		FROM  
			PrintersDevices PD  
		WHERE
			PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)
	
	--Pega os ultimos contadores do periodo
	DECLARE @LatestCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,			
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os últimos do período
	INSERT INTO @LatestCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @Printers) AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @FirstCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os valores iniciais. Lembrando que agora o padrão é de buscar os dados apenas do dia anterior à data inicial
	--somente das impressoras que tem registros do ultimo contador do periodo
	INSERT INTO @FirstCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,		
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead < @StartDateTime AND
					CR.DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,-30,@StartDateTime)
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC
                    
	DECLARE @IntervalCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
	INSERT INTO @IntervalCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,	
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @FullCounterReadings TABLE
	(
		PrinterDeviceID INT, 
			
		StartDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		StartReferenceMono INT,
		StartReferenceColor INT,
		StartReferenceTotal INT,
		StartIsUpdated BIT,

		EndDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		EndReferenceMono INT,
		EndReferenceColor INT,
		EndReferenceTotal INT,
		EndIsUpdated BIT,

		CounterTotalDiff BIGINT
	)

	DECLARE @MaxIntValue INT = [dbo].[GetMaxIntValue]()
	INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
		SELECT
			LCR.PrinterDeviceID,

			ISNULL(FCR.DateTimeRead,ISNULL(ICR.DateTimeRead,LCR.DateTimeRead)) AS StartDateTimeRead,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS StartReferenceMono,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) AS StartReferenceColor,

			CASE WHEN
			(
				CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS BIGINT)
				+
				CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) AS BIGINT)
			) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
			ELSE
			(
				CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS BIGINT)
				+
				CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) AS BIGINT)
			)
			END AS StartReferenceTotal,

			ISNULL(FCR.IsUpdated,ISNULL(ICR.IsUpdated,LCR.IsUpdated)) AS StartIsUpdated,
			LCR.DateTimeRead AS EndDateTimeRead,
			LCR.ReferenceMono AS EndReferenceMono,
			LCR.ReferenceColor EndReferenceColor,

			CASE WHEN
			(
				CAST (LCR.ReferenceMono AS BIGINT) + CAST(LCR.ReferenceColor AS BIGINT)
			) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
			ELSE
			(
				CAST (LCR.ReferenceMono AS BIGINT) + CAST(LCR.ReferenceColor AS BIGINT))
			END AS LastReferenceTotal,

			LCR.IsUpdated AS EndIsUpdated,

			CASE WHEN
			(
				ISNULL
				(
					(
						(CAST(LCR.ReferenceMono AS BIGINT) + CAST(LCR.ReferenceColor AS BIGINT))
						-
						(
							CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS BIGINT)
							+
							CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) AS BIGINT)
						)
					)
				, 0)
				
			) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
			ELSE
			(
				ISNULL
				(
					(
						(CAST(LCR.ReferenceMono AS BIGINT) + CAST(LCR.ReferenceColor AS BIGINT))
						-
						(
							CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS BIGINT)
							+
							CAST(ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) AS BIGINT)
						)
					)
				, 0)
			)
			END AS CounterTotalDiff
		FROM 
			@LatestCounterReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCounterReadings FCR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = FCR.PrinterDeviceID
			LEFT JOIN @IntervalCounterReadings ICR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = ICR.PrinterDeviceID

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		FCR.StartDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
		FCR.EndDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
		FCR.StartReferenceMono AS FirstReferenceMono,
		FCR.EndReferenceMono AS LastReferenceMono,
		(FCR.EndReferenceMono - FCR.StartReferenceMono) AS ReferenceMono,
		FCR.StartReferenceColor AS FirstReferenceColor,
		FCR.EndReferenceColor AS LastReferenceColor,
		(FCR.EndReferenceColor - FCR.StartReferenceColor) AS ReferenceColor,
		FCR.StartReferenceTotal AS FirstReferenceTotal,
		FCR.EndReferenceTotal AS LastReferenceTotal,
		FCR.CounterTotalDiff AS ReferenceTotal,
		CASE
			WHEN FCR.StartIsUpdated = 1 AND FCR.EndIsUpdated = 1 THEN 1
			ELSE 0
		END AS IsUpdated
	FROM
		@FullCounterReadings FCR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON FCR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID

END
```

## 276. proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveComparative

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveComparative]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@BringPrintersWithJobsButNoCounters BIT = 0,
@BringPrintersWithNoJobsAndNoCounters BIT = 0,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN

	--****************************************************************************************************************************************
	-- Stored Procedure usada para o Relatório Comparativo entre contadores e contabilização
	-- Diego 08/02/2017:
	-- Alteração para buscar e retornar os dados de forma compativel com o novo componente que efetua o calculo de contadores de referencia.
	--****************************************************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PrinterDeviceID INT)

	INSERT INTO @Printers                    
		SELECT   
			PD.PrinterDeviceID
		FROM  
			PrintersDevices PD  
		WHERE
			((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR (PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)) AND
			((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) AND
			((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND
			((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) AND
			(PD.EnabledCounterStatus  IN (1,3)) AND
			(PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation))

	DECLARE @LatestCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,			
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os últimos do período
	INSERT INTO @LatestCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @Printers) AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @FirstCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os valores iniciais. Lembrando que agora o padrão é de buscar os dados apenas do dia anterior à data inicial
	--somente das impressoras que tem registros do ultimo contador do periodo
	INSERT INTO @FirstCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,		
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead < @StartDateTime AND
					CR.DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1,@StartDateTime)
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @IntervalCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
	INSERT INTO @IntervalCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,	
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC


	DECLARE @FullCounterReadings TABLE
	(
		PrinterDeviceID INT, 
			
		StartDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		StartCounterReadingID INT,
		StartReferenceMono INT,
		StartReferenceColor INT,
		StartIsUpdated BIT,

		EndDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		EndCounterReadingID INT,
		EndReferenceMono INT,
		EndReferenceColor INT,
		EndIsUpdated BIT,

		CounterMonoTotalDiff BIGINT,
		CounterColorTotalDiff BIGINT,
		CounterTotalDiff BIGINT,
		TotalPages INT
	)

	INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
		SELECT
			LCR.PrinterDeviceID,

			ISNULL(FCR.DateTimeRead,ISNULL(ICR.DateTimeRead,LCR.DateTimeRead)) AS StartDateTimeRead,
			ISNULL(FCR.CounterReadingID,ISNULL(ICR.CounterReadingID,LCR.CounterReadingID)) AS StartCounterReadingID,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS StartReferenceMono,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) StartReferenceColor,
			ISNULL(FCR.IsUpdated,ISNULL(ICR.IsUpdated,LCR.IsUpdated)) AS StartIsUpdated,

			LCR.DateTimeRead AS EndDateTimeRead,
			LCR.CounterReadingID AS EndCounterReadingID,
			LCR.ReferenceMono AS EndReferenceMono,
			LCR.ReferenceColor EndReferenceColor,
			LCR.IsUpdated AS EndIsUpdated,

			0 AS CounterMonoTotalDiff,
			0 AS CounterColorTotalDiff,
			0 AS CounterTotalDiff,
			ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(ISNULL(FCR.DateTimeRead,ISNULL(ICR.DateTimeRead,LCR.DateTimeRead)), LCR.DateTimeRead, LCR.PrinterDeviceID), 0) AS TotalPages
		FROM 
			@LatestCounterReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCounterReadings FCR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = FCR.PrinterDeviceID
			LEFT JOIN @IntervalCounterReadings ICR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = ICR.PrinterDeviceID

	IF(@BringPrintersWithJobsButNoCounters = 1 OR @BringPrintersWithNoJobsAndNoCounters = 1)
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
			SELECT
				PD.PrinterDeviceID,

				@StartDateTime AS StartDateTimeRead,
				0 AS StartCounterReadingID,
				0 AS StartReferenceMono,
				0 AS StartReferenceColor,
				1 AS StartIsUpdated,

				@EndDateTime AS EndDateTimeRead,
				0 AS EndCounterReadingID,
				0 AS EndReferenceMono,
				0 AS EndReferenceColor,
				1 AS EndIsUpdated,

				0 AS CounterMonoTotalDiff,
				0 AS CounterColorTotalDiff,
				0 AS CounterTotalDiff,
				ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime, PD.PrinterDeviceID), 0)
			FROM
				PrintersDevices PD
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID from @FullCounterReadings) AND
				((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR (PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)) AND
				((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) AND
				((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND
				((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) AND
				(PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation)) AND
				EnabledBillingStatus IN (1,3) AND
				EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)

	END

	--PASSAR PARA ATUALZIAÇÃO NO COMPONENTE
	SELECT
		FCR.PrinterDeviceID,
        PD.PrinterDeviceName +' ('+ B.BrandName + ' ' + PM.PrinterModelName +') -SN: ' + PD.SerialNumber AS PrinterDeviceName,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
        PD.SerialNumber,
        PD.AddressName,
        dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS MachineIP,

		FCR.StartDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
		FCR.StartCounterReadingID,
		FCR.StartReferenceMono,
		FCR.StartReferenceColor,
		FCR.StartIsUpdated,

		FCR.EndDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
		FCR.EndCounterReadingID,
		FCR.EndReferenceMono,
		FCR.EndReferenceColor,
		FCR.EndIsUpdated,

		FCR.CounterMonoTotalDiff,
		FCR.CounterColorTotalDiff,
        FCR.CounterTotalDiff AS [Counter],
        FCR.TotalPages AS Monitored
	FROM
		@FullCounterReadings FCR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON FCR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	ORDER BY
		PrinterDeviceName

END
```

## 277. proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveConferenceVolume

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveConferenceVolume]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN

	--****************************************************************************************************************************************
	--Roger 05/02/2018: Relatório Conferência de volume, Query usada para geração do relatório de conferência de volume que serve para os clientes validarem no 
	--MPS os valores cobrados pela NDD.Ela traz os dados de contadores no período (igual ao relatório comparativo) e também os dados de bilhetagem no período mas apenas das impressoras que não apresentaram contadores.
	--****************************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PrinterDeviceID INT)

	INSERT INTO @Printers                    
		SELECT   
			PD.PrinterDeviceID
		FROM  
			PrintersDevices PD  
		WHERE
			((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR (PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)) AND			
			((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND
			((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) AND
			(PD.EnabledCounterStatus  IN (1,3)) AND
			(PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation))

	DECLARE @LatestCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,			
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os últimos do período
	INSERT INTO @LatestCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @Printers) AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @FirstCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os valores iniciais. Lembrando que agora o padrão é de buscar 30 dias antes
	--somente das impressoras que tem registros do ultimo contador do periodo
	INSERT INTO @FirstCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,		
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead < @StartDateTime AND
					CR.DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,-30,@StartDateTime)
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @IntervalCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
	INSERT INTO @IntervalCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,	
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC


	DECLARE @FullCounterReadings TABLE
	(
		PrinterDeviceID INT, 
			
		StartDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		StartCounterReadingID INT,
		StartReferenceMono INT,
		StartReferenceColor INT,
		StartIsUpdated BIT,

		EndDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		EndCounterReadingID INT,
		EndReferenceMono INT,
		EndReferenceColor INT,
		EndIsUpdated BIT,

		CounterMonoTotalDiff BIGINT,
		CounterColorTotalDiff BIGINT,
		CounterTotalDiff BIGINT,
		TotalPages INT
	)

	INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
		SELECT
			LCR.PrinterDeviceID,

			ISNULL(FCR.DateTimeRead,ISNULL(ICR.DateTimeRead,LCR.DateTimeRead)) AS StartDateTimeRead,
			ISNULL(FCR.CounterReadingID,ISNULL(ICR.CounterReadingID,LCR.CounterReadingID)) AS StartCounterReadingID,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS StartReferenceMono,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) StartReferenceColor,
			ISNULL(FCR.IsUpdated,ISNULL(ICR.IsUpdated,LCR.IsUpdated)) AS StartIsUpdated,

			LCR.DateTimeRead AS EndDateTimeRead,
			LCR.CounterReadingID AS EndCounterReadingID,
			LCR.ReferenceMono AS EndReferenceMono,
			LCR.ReferenceColor EndReferenceColor,
			LCR.IsUpdated AS EndIsUpdated,

			0 AS CounterMonoTotalDiff,
			0 AS CounterColorTotalDiff,
			0 AS CounterTotalDiff,
			0 AS TotalPages
		FROM 
			@LatestCounterReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCounterReadings FCR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = FCR.PrinterDeviceID
			LEFT JOIN @IntervalCounterReadings ICR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = ICR.PrinterDeviceID

		--Estou indo buscas os volumes das impressoras que não tem volume
		UPDATE 
			@FullCounterReadings		
		SET 
			TotalPages=ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(StartDateTimeRead,EndDateTimeRead, PrinterDeviceID), 0)  		
		WHERE 
			CounterTotalDiff=0

		--Impressoras que possuem contabilização, mais não possuem alteração de contadores no período		
		INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
			SELECT
				PD.PrinterDeviceID,

				@StartDateTime AS StartDateTimeRead,
				0 AS StartCounterReadingID,
				0 AS StartReferenceMono,
				0 AS StartReferenceColor,
				1 AS StartIsUpdated,

				@EndDateTime AS EndDateTimeRead,
				0 AS EndCounterReadingID,
				0 AS EndReferenceMono,
				0 AS EndReferenceColor,
				1 AS EndIsUpdated,

				0 AS CounterMonoTotalDiff,
				0 AS CounterColorTotalDiff,
				0 AS CounterTotalDiff,
				ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime, PD.PrinterDeviceID), 0)
			FROM
				PrintersDevices PD
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID from @FullCounterReadings) AND
				((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR (PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)) AND				
				((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND
				((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) AND
				(PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation)) AND
				EnabledBillingStatus IN (1,3) AND
				EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)



	--PASSAR PARA ATUALZIAÇÃO NO COMPONENTE
	SELECT
		FCR.PrinterDeviceID,
        PD.PrinterDeviceName +' ('+ B.BrandName + ' ' + PM.PrinterModelName +') -SN: ' + PD.SerialNumber AS PrinterDeviceName,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
        PD.SerialNumber,
        PD.AddressName,
        dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS MachineIP,

		FCR.StartDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
		FCR.StartCounterReadingID,
		FCR.StartReferenceMono,
		FCR.StartReferenceColor,
		FCR.StartIsUpdated,

		FCR.EndDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
		FCR.EndCounterReadingID,
		FCR.EndReferenceMono,
		FCR.EndReferenceColor,
		FCR.EndIsUpdated,

		FCR.CounterMonoTotalDiff,
		FCR.CounterColorTotalDiff,
        FCR.CounterTotalDiff AS [Counter],
        FCR.TotalPages AS Monitored
	FROM
		@FullCounterReadings FCR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON FCR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	ORDER BY
		PrinterDeviceName

END
```

## 278. proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveCountersFromPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveCountersFromPrinter]
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@CounterTypeID INT = NULL
AS

BEGIN

--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Maicon Pereira 04-09-2015
	--
	-- Stored Procedure usada para o Relatório de leituras contadores 
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	SELECT 
		CR.DateTimeRead,
		C.CounterTypeID,
		CT.CounterTypeName as CounterTypeName,
		CT.Description as CounterTypeDescription,
		C.CounterMono,
		C.CounterColor,
		C.CounterTotal
	FROM 
		Counters C
		INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR ON C.CounterReadingID = CR.CounterReadingID 
		INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
	WHERE 
		CR.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
		CR.DateTimeRead >= @StartDate AND 
		CR.DateTimeRead <= @EndDate AND
		CR.Removed = 0 AND 
		((@CounterTypeID IS NULL) OR (C.CounterTypeID = @CounterTypeID))
	ORDER BY 
		CR.DateTimeRead ASC, 
		C.CounterTypeID ASC
	
END
```

## 279. proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveCountersToExport

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveCountersToExport] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME, 
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 30,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	--- Robson Wiggers, 10/09/2015
	-- SP para exportação de contadores no MPS
	--- Versão Contratos
	-- Philipe Barros, 01/11/2017
	-- Alterado para trazer o nome do contador
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	--Pega os ultimos contadores dentro do periodo
	DECLARE @LastCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
	
	INSERT INTO @LastCounters 
		SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
		FROM CountersReadings CR
		RIGHT OUTER JOIN
			(
				SELECT 
					CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
					MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
				FROM 
					CountersReadings CR
					INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE 
					DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND
					DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime  AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND 					
					((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) AND
					((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND 
					((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) 
					AND PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)
				GROUP BY 
					CR.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS TableAux
			ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID AND CR.Removed = 0 
		
		
		--Pega os primeiros contadores do periodo somente das impressoras que tem registros dentro do limite maximo anterior
		DECLARE @FirstCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
				
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @StartDateTime and 
						DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,(@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1),@StartDateTime) AND
						PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters) AND
						CR.Removed = 0
					GROUP BY 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID  AND CR.Removed = 0 

		--Agora pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
		DECLARE @IntervalCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CTRIDLC INT, DTR DATETIME)
		INSERT INTO @IntervalCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MIN(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD1 ON PD1.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND 
						DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime AND
						CR.Removed = 0 AND 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters) AND
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PDID FROM @FirstCounters)  
					GROUP BY 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID  AND CR.Removed = 0 

		--Junto as duas tabelas de valores iniciais
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT * from @IntervalCounters 
			
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @IntervalCounters 		

		DECLARE @FirstCountersReadings TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT,DTR DATETIME, CTID INT, MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @FirstCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			FC.PDID,
			FC.CRID,  
			FC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @FirstCounters FC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = FC.CRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @FirstCounters
		
		DECLARE @LastCountersReadings TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT, DTR DATETIME,CTID INT ,MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @LastCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			LC.PDID,
			LC.CRID,  
			LC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @LastCounters LC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = LC.CRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @LastCounters
		
		SELECT 
			PD.PrinterDeviceID,
			[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](PD.PrinterDeviceID) as PrinterDeviceName,
			PD.SerialNumber, 
			PM.PrinterModelName,
			PD.AddressName AS MachineIP,
			S.SiteName,
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName,'') AS SiteDivisionName,
			ISNULL(FCR.CTID,LCR.CTID) AS CounterTypeID,
			ISNULL((SELECT CounterTypeName FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = FCR.CTID),(SELECT CounterTypeName FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = LCR.CTID)) as CounterTypeName,
			ISNULL((SELECT Description FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = FCR.CTID),(SELECT Description FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = LCR.CTID)) as CounterTypeDescription,
			(SELECT CounterGroupName from CounterTypeGroups Where CounterGroupID = ISNULL((SELECT CounterGroupID FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = FCR.CTID),(SELECT CounterGroupID FROM COUNTERTYPES WHERE COUNTERTYPEID = LCR.CTID)))as CounterTypeGroupName,
			FCR.DTR as StartDateTimeRead,
			LCR.DTR as EndDateTimeRead,	
			FCR.TOTAL as  StartCounterTotal,
			LCR.TOTAL as EndCounterTotal,
			FCR.MONO as StartCounterMono,
			LCR.MONO as EndCounterMono,
			FCR.COLOR as StartCounterColor,	
			LCR.COLOR as EndCounterColor
		FROM 
			@LastCountersReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCountersReadings FCR on LCR.PDID = FCR.PDID AND LCR.CTID = FCR.CTID 
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = LCR.PDID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
			LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID 
		ORDER BY 
			[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](PD.PrinterDeviceID) ASC 
END
```

## 280. proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveVolume

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_Counters_RetrieveVolume]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN

	--****************************************************************************************************************************************
	-- Roger 26/04/2017
	-- Stored Procedure usada para o Relatório Volume	  
	--****************************************************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PrinterDeviceID INT)

	INSERT INTO @Printers                    
		SELECT   
			PD.PrinterDeviceID
		FROM  
			PrintersDevices PD  
		WHERE
			((@PrinterDeviceID = -1) OR (PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)) AND
			((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) AND
			((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID )) AND
			((@SiteDivisionID = -1) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID) OR (@SiteDivisionID = 0 AND PD.SiteDivisionID IS NULL)) AND
			(PD.EnabledCounterStatus  IN (1,3)) AND
			(PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation))

	DECLARE @LatestCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,			
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os últimos do período
	INSERT INTO @LatestCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @Printers) AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @FirstCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os valores iniciais. Lembrando que agora o padrão é de buscar os dados apenas do dia anterior à data inicial
	--somente das impressoras que tem registros do ultimo contador do periodo
	INSERT INTO @FirstCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,		
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead < @StartDateTime AND
					CR.DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1,@StartDateTime)
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @IntervalCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		PrinterDeviceID INT,		
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		ReferenceMono INT,
		ReferenceColor INT,
		IsUpdated BIT
	)

	--Pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
	INSERT INTO @IntervalCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,	
			DateTimeRead,
			CounterReadingID,
			ReferenceMono,
			ReferenceColor,
			IsUpdated	
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT 
					*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead) Num
				FROM
					CountersReadings CR
				WHERE				
					CR.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @LatestCounterReadings) AND  --PEGA QUEM TEM CONTADORES LAST SÓ
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			) Resumed
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			PrinterDeviceID, DateTimeRead DESC


	DECLARE @FullCounterReadings TABLE
	(
		PrinterDeviceID INT, 
			
		StartDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		StartCounterReadingID INT,
		StartReferenceMono INT,
		StartReferenceColor INT,
		StartIsUpdated BIT,

		EndDateTimeRead DATETIME,
		EndCounterReadingID INT,
		EndReferenceMono INT,
		EndReferenceColor INT,
		EndIsUpdated BIT,

		CounterMonoTotalDiff BIGINT,
		CounterColorTotalDiff BIGINT,
		CounterTotalDiff BIGINT
		
	)

	INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
		SELECT
			LCR.PrinterDeviceID,

			ISNULL(FCR.DateTimeRead,ISNULL(ICR.DateTimeRead,LCR.DateTimeRead)) AS StartDateTimeRead,
			ISNULL(FCR.CounterReadingID,ISNULL(ICR.CounterReadingID,LCR.CounterReadingID)) AS StartCounterReadingID,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceMono,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceMono,LCR.ReferenceMono)) AS StartReferenceMono,
			ISNULL(FCR.ReferenceColor,ISNULL(ICR.ReferenceColor,LCR.ReferenceColor)) StartReferenceColor,
			ISNULL(FCR.IsUpdated,ISNULL(ICR.IsUpdated,LCR.IsUpdated)) AS StartIsUpdated,

			LCR.DateTimeRead AS EndDateTimeRead,
			LCR.CounterReadingID AS EndCounterReadingID,
			LCR.ReferenceMono AS EndReferenceMono,
			LCR.ReferenceColor EndReferenceColor,
			LCR.IsUpdated AS EndIsUpdated,

			0 AS CounterMonoTotalDiff,
			0 AS CounterColorTotalDiff,
			0 AS CounterTotalDiff			
		FROM 
			@LatestCounterReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCounterReadings FCR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = FCR.PrinterDeviceID
			LEFT JOIN @IntervalCounterReadings ICR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = ICR.PrinterDeviceID


	--PASSAR PARA ATUALZIAÇÃO NO COMPONENTE
	SELECT
		FCR.PrinterDeviceID,
        PD.PrinterDeviceName +' ('+ B.BrandName + ' ' + PM.PrinterModelName +') -SN: ' + PD.SerialNumber AS PrinterDeviceName,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
        PD.SerialNumber,
        PD.AddressName,
        dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS MachineIP,

		FCR.StartDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
		FCR.StartCounterReadingID,
		FCR.StartReferenceMono,
		FCR.StartReferenceColor,
		FCR.StartIsUpdated,

		FCR.EndDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
		FCR.EndCounterReadingID,
		FCR.EndReferenceMono,
		FCR.EndReferenceColor,
		FCR.EndIsUpdated,

		FCR.CounterMonoTotalDiff,
		FCR.CounterColorTotalDiff,
        FCR.CounterTotalDiff AS [Counter],       
		S.SiteID,
		S.SiteName
		
	FROM
		@FullCounterReadings FCR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON FCR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		LEFT JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID=PD.SiteID
		

	ORDER BY
		PrinterDeviceName

END
```

## 281. proc_GPV_Reports_PrintJobs_RetrieveFromPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_PrintJobs_RetrieveFromPrinter]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS
BEGIN
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Maicon Pereira 08-09-2015
	--
	-- Stored Procedure usada para listar os jobs de impressão que foram impressos no período.
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	SELECT
		P.PrintJobID,
		P.Title,
		P.DatePrinted,
		P.PagesMono,
		P.PagesColor,
		PA.PrintApplicationName,
		PS.PaperSizeName
	FROM 
		PrintJobs P
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA on P.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID 
		INNER JOIN PapersSize PS on P.PaperSizeID = PS.PaperSizeID
	WHERE 
		(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)AND
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
		P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3) AND
		P.JobDisabled = 0
	ORDER BY 
		P.DatePrinted ASC

END
```

## 282. proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingCosts

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingCosts]
AS
BEGIN

	--**********************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 18/06/2013
	--** Traz os custos (agora grupos) das impressoras para o relatório de fechamento
	--**********************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @C TINYINT
	SELECT @C = COUNT(*) FROM CostGroups
	
	IF (@C <= 20) --20 é o limite do excel
	BEGIN
		
		SELECT 
			pc.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName, 
			pc.CostMono AS MonoCost,
			pc.CostColor AS ColorCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexMono AS DuplexMonoCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexColor AS DuplexColorCost,
			pc.CostMono AS CopiesMonoCost, 
			pc.CostColor AS CopiesColorCost, 
			ISNULL(pcps.CostMono, pc.CostMono) AS A3MonoCost,
			ISNULL(pcps.CostColor, pc.CostColor) AS A3ColorCost,
			pc.CostScan AS ScanCost,
			pc.CostSentFax AS FaxCost
		FROM
			CostGroups pc  
			LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize pcps ON pcps.CostGroupID = pc.CostGroupID AND pcps.PaperSizeID = 8
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		--Se tem mais que 20 custos pega só os 20 primeiros que estiverem em uso
		SELECT 
			pc.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName, 
			pc.CostMono AS MonoCost,
			pc.CostColor AS ColorCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexMono AS DuplexMonoCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexColor AS DuplexColorCost,
			pc.CostMono AS CopiesMonoCost, 
			pc.CostColor AS CopiesColorCost, 
			ISNULL(pcps.CostMono, pc.CostMono) AS A3MonoCost,
			ISNULL(pcps.CostColor, pc.CostColor) AS A3ColorCost,
			pc.CostScan AS ScanCost,
			pc.CostSentFax AS FaxCost
		FROM
			CostGroups pc  
			LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize pcps ON pcps.CostGroupID = pc.CostGroupID AND pcps.PaperSizeID = 8
		WHERE
			pc.CostGroupID IN (SELECT DISTINCT TOP 20 CostGroupID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE EnabledCounterStatus in (1,3))

	END

END
```

## 283. proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingData]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters bit,
@ShowBillingData bit = 1

AS
BEGIN


                --**********************************************************************************************
                --** Robson, 18/06/2013
                --** Traz os dados de impressão para o relatório de fechamento
                --UPDATE: Ramiro Pedrozo (17/09/2012),foi alterado para atender requesito ""REQ 4.12.0.004""
                --do cenario ""CEN022308_GP_Gestão"", no mesmo foi descrito uma alteração de filtro por 
                --impressoras de contrato, e para isso foi preciso adiciopnar um parametro novo ""@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters""
                --UPDATE: Hugo Longo (05/02/2013),foi alterado para atender o ID ""46964""
                --Buscar dados de contabilização das impressoras  (padrão marcado), e para isso foi preciso adicionar um novo parâmetro ""@ShowBillingData""
                --**********************************************************************************************
                
                DECLARE @ClosingDataList TABLE
                (
                               PrinterDeviceName NVARCHAR(200),
                               Model NVARCHAR(255),
                               SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50),
                               MachineIP NVARCHAR(52),
                               [Type] bit,
                               SiteName NVARCHAR(255),
                               FirstCounter int,
                               FirstCounterDate datetime,
                               LastCounter int,
                               LastCounterDate datetime,
                               Total int,
                               TotalMono int,
                               TotalColor int,
                               TotalCopies int,
                               TotalCopiesMono int,
                               TotalCopiesColor int,
                               TotalfaxReceived int,
                               TotalfaxSent int,
                               TotalScan int,
                               TotalDuplex int,
                               TotalDuplexMono int,
                               TotalDuplexColor int,
                               TotalA3 int,
                               TotalA3Mono int,
                               TotalA3Color int,
                               PrintCostName NVARCHAR(255),
                               Engaged int,
                               Monitored int,
                               CostFixed decimal (19,6),
                               CostExtra decimal (19,6),
                               Location NVARCHAR(255),
                               Productivity int,
                               EngagedVolume int,
                               Department NVARCHAR(100),
                               CounterBlackNumber int,
                               CounterColorNumber int,                          
                               PrinterDeviceID int)
                               
                
                DECLARE @CountersOutput TABLE
                (
                               PrinterDeviceID INT, 
                               CounterTypeID INT,
                               AdjustType TINYINT,
                               ComplementType TINYINT,
                               ProductionIsLife BIT,
                               FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
                               LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
                               CounterTotalDif BIGINT, 
                               CounterBlackDif BIGINT,
                               CounterColorDif BIGINT,
                               CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, 
                               CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, 
                               CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT
                )
                
                --CARREGA OS DADOS DOS CONTADORES DE PRODUÇÃO, BASEANDO-SE NO FILTRO SOLICITADO
                --UPDATE: Ramiro Pedrozo (17/09/2012),foi alterado para atender requesito ""REQ 4.12.0.004""
                --do cenario ""CEN022308_GP_Gestão"", no mesmo foi descrito uma alteração de filtro por 
                --impressoras de contrato 
                
                INSERT INTO 
                               @CountersOutput
                               SELECT 
                                               *
                               FROM
                                               [dbo].[getPrintersCountersData]
                                               (
                                                               @StartDateTime,
                                                               @EndDateTime,
                                                               NULL, --@PrinterDeviceID,
                                                               NULL, --@SiteID,
                                                               NULL, --@SiteDivisionID,
                                                               @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters,
                                                               30,--@MaxLimitDaysEarlier,
                                                               1, --@GetLatestCounterNumbers (para este relatório é preciso os ultimos contadores)
                                                               1, --@GetJustProductionCounters (se é pra trazer só so contadores de produção)
                                                               1)--@OnlyPrintersWithCounters)
                
                DECLARE @CountersCube TABLE 
                (PDID INT, FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, TotalPages INT, CNDif Bigint, CCNDif Bigint,
                CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT)
                
                INSERT INTO 
                               @CountersCube
                               SELECT 
                                               PrinterDeviceID, 
                                               FirstDateTimeRead, 
                                               LastDateTimeRead, 
                                               0, 
                                               CounterTotalDif,
                                               CounterColorDif,
                                               CounterTotalLatestNumber, 
                                               CounterBlackLatestNumber, 
                                               CounterColorLatestNumber
                               FROM
                                               @CountersOutput
                
                --INSERIR IMPRESSORAS DE CONTRATO QUE NÃO ESTÃO AQUI.
                INSERT INTO 
                               @CountersCube
                               SELECT 
                                               PrinterDeviceID, 
                                               @StartDateTime, 
                                               @EndDateTime, 
                                               0, 
                                               0,
                                               0,
                                               0, 
                                               0, 
                                               0
                               FROM 
                                               PrintersDevices 
                               WHERE 
                                               EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
                                               EngagedStatus IN (1,3) AND 
                                               PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @CountersOutput)
                
                --VERIFICA SE PRECISA ADICIONAR A CONTABILIZAÇÃO NO RELATÓRIO
                IF(@ShowBillingData = 1)
                BEGIN
                               --COLOCA O TOTAL DE PÁGINAS NAS IMPRESSORAS     
                               UPDATE @CountersCube SET TotalPages = ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(FirstDateTimeRead, LastDateTimeRead, PDID), 0)
                END
                ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                --- AGORA AQUI VAMOS CALCULAR OS VALORES DOS DEMAIS CONTADORES (CÓPIA, FAX, ETC)
                ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

                --ARMAZENA NA TABELA TEMPORÁRIA AS IMPRESSORAS, OS PRIMEIROS E ÚLTIMOS CONTADORES DELAS NO PERÍODO E A DIFERENÇA ENTRE ELES
                DECLARE @OthersCountersCube TABLE 
                               (PDID2 INT, 
                               CTID INT,
                               CNDif   BIGINT,
                               CCNDif  BIGINT)
                
                
                INSERT INTO @OthersCountersCube
                               SELECT PDID2, CTID, SUM(CNDif), SUM(CCNDif) FROM
                               (
                                               SELECT 
                                                               CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayTotal) ELSE SUM(FullTotal) END AS CNDif,
                                                               CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayColor) ELSE SUM(FullColor) END AS CCNDif,
                                                               CC.PrinterDeviceID AS PDID2,
                                                               CC.CounterTypeID AS CTID
                                               FROM 
                                                               CubeCounter CC
                                                               INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CC.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
                                               WHERE 
                                                               (CC.CubeDate BETWEEN @StartDateTime  AND @EndDateTime) AND --DENTRO DO PERÍODO INFORMADO
                                                               PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
                                                               PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation) AND
                                                               CC.CounterTypeID <> 1 AND CC.CounterTypeID <> 2 --TIRA FORA O GERAL E O DE IMPRESSÃO

                                               GROUP BY CC.PrinterDeviceID, CC.CounterTypeID, BeforeDate
                               ) AS TABLE1
                               GROUP BY PDID2, CTID


                DELETE FROM @OthersCountersCube WHERE CNDif = 0


                DECLARE @Complementares TABLE 
                               (PDID INT, 
                               TotalCopies INT,
                               TotalCopiesColor INT,
                               TotalfaxReceived INT,
                               TotalfaxSent INT,
                               TotalScan INT,
                               TotalDuplex INT,
                               TotalDuplexColor INT,
                               TotalA3 INT,
                               TotalA3Color INT)

                
                INSERT INTO @Complementares 
                               SELECT distinct PDID2,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 

                -- cópias 1
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalCopies = CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copies') and PDID = PDID2

                --cópias 2
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalCopies = TotalCopies  + CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = TotalCopiesColor  + CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copy') and PDID = PDID2
                               
                --fax recebido 1
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalfaxReceived = CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Fax') and PDID = PDID2

                --fax recebido 2
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalfaxReceived = TotalfaxReceived + CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxReceived') and PDID = PDID2

                --fax enviado
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalfaxSent = CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxSent') and PDID = PDID2

                --fax enviado
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalScan = CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Scan') and PDID = PDID2

                -- duplex
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalDuplex = CNDif, TotalDuplexColor = CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Duplex') and PDID = PDID2

                -- a3 1
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalA3 = CNDif, TotalA3Color = CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3AndBiggerSizes') and PDID = PDID2

                -- a3 2
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalA3 = TotalA3 + CNDif, TotalA3Color = TotalA3Color + CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3') and PDID = PDID2

                INSERT INTO @ClosingDataList
                               SELECT     
                                               PD.PrinterDeviceName AS PrinterDeviceName,
                                               PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
                                               PD.SerialNumber,
                                               '[' + PD.AddressName  + ']' AS MachineIP, 
                                               PD.IsLocal AS [Type],
                                               Sites.SiteName,
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber - C.CNDif,0) AS FirstCounter,                      
                                               C.FirstDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber,0) AS LastCounter,
                                               C.LastDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
                                               C.CNDif AS Total,                            
                                               (C.CNDif - C.CCNDif )AS TotalMono,
                                               C.CCNDif AS TotalColor,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) AS TotalCopies,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesMono,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesColor,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalfaxReceived,0) AS TotalfaxReceived,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalfaxSent,0) AS TotalfaxSent,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalScan,0) AS TotalScan,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) AS TotalDuplex,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexMono,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexColor,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) AS TotalA3,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Mono,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Color,
                                               PC.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName,
                                               CASE PD.EngagedStatus WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Engaged,
                                               C.TotalPages AS Monitored,
                                               0  AS CostFixed, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do nddPrintMaster
                                               0  AS CostExtra, --Não tem mais
                                               PD.Location,
                                               0 AS Productivity, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do KB
                                               0 AS EngagedVolume, --Não tem mais
                                               ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName,'Sem departamento') AS Department,
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterBlackLatestNumber,0) AS CounterBlackNumber,                                                                                                     
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterColorLatestNumber,0) AS CounterColorNumber,                                     
                                               PD.PrinterDeviceID 
                               FROM 
                                               PrintersDevices PD
                                               INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
                                               INNER JOIN @CountersCube C ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = C.PDID
                                               INNER JOIN Sites ON PD.SiteID = Sites.SiteID
                                               LEFT OUTER JOIN @Complementares O ON C.PDID = O.PDID
                                               INNER JOIN CostGroups PC ON PD.CostGroupID = PC.CostGroupID
                                               LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID

                SELECT * FROM @ClosingDataList
                               
END
```

## 284. proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingDataRetrocomp

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingDataRetrocomp]
@StartDateTime DATE,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters bit,
@ShowBillingData bit = 1

AS
BEGIN


	--**********************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 03/05/2016
	--** gera relatório retrocompativel com contadores de produção para a versão 5.5
	--** Robson, 31/07/2017
	--** Alterado porque o order parou de funcionar e o recalculo nao começava do começo então 
	--** impressoras ficavam de fora 
	--**********************************************************************************************

	set nocount on 
	
	DECLARE @ClosingDataList TABLE
		(PrinterDeviceName NVARCHAR(200),
		Model NVARCHAR(255),
		SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50),
		MachineIP NVARCHAR(52),
		[Type] bit,
		SiteName NVARCHAR(255),
		FirstCounter int,
		FirstCounterDate datetime,
		LastCounter int,
		LastCounterDate datetime,
		Total int,
		TotalMono int,
		TotalColor int,
		TotalCopies int,
		TotalCopiesMono int,
		TotalCopiesColor int,
		TotalfaxReceived int,
		TotalfaxSent int,
		TotalScan int,
		TotalDuplex int,
		TotalDuplexMono int,
		TotalDuplexColor int,
		TotalA3 int,
		TotalA3Mono int,
		TotalA3Color int,
		PrintCostName NVARCHAR(255),
		Engaged int,
		Monitored int,
		CostFixed decimal (19,6),
		CostExtra decimal (19,6),
		Location NVARCHAR(255),
		Productivity int,
		EngagedVolume int,
		Department NVARCHAR(100),
		CounterBlackNumber int,
		CounterColorNumber int,
		PrinterDeviceID int)


	DECLARE @CountersOutput TABLE
		(PrinterDeviceID INT, 
		CounterTypeID INT,
		AdjustType TINYINT,
		ComplementType TINYINT,
		ProductionIsLife BIT,
		FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
		LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
		CounterTotalDif BIGINT, 
		CounterBlackDif BIGINT,
		CounterColorDif BIGINT,
		CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, 
		CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, 
		CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT)


	--vou ter que pegar as impressoras antes para fazer o recalculo de cubos.
	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PDID INT)
	INSERT INTO 
		@Printers
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID
		FROM
			[dbo].[getPrintersAndCountersBehaviorsRetrocomp](null, null, null, @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters)
		
	
	DECLARE @PDID INT = NULL
	SELECT TOP 1 @PDID = PDID FROM @Printers ORDER BY PDID
	
	WHILE (@PDID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		DECLARE @CurrentPDID INT = @PDID

		DECLARE @exec NVARCHAR(MAX)
		SET @exec  = 'EXEC [proc_CountersCubesRetrocomp_RecalcPrinter] ''' + CAST(@StartDateTime AS NVARCHAR)  + ''','''+ CAST(@EndDateTime AS NVARCHAR) + ''','  + CAST(@PDID AS NVARCHAR) 
		
		print @exec
		EXEC (@EXEC)

		--DELETE FROM @PRINTERS WHERE PDID = @PDID
		SET @PDID = NULL
		SELECT TOP 1 @PDID = PDID FROM @Printers WHERE PDID > @CurrentPDID  ORDER BY PDID
	
	END
                
	--CARREGA OS DADOS DOS CONTADORES DE PRODUÇÃO, BASEANDO-SE NO FILTRO SOLICITADO
	INSERT INTO 
		@CountersOutput
		SELECT 
			*
		FROM
			[dbo].[getPrintersCountersDataRetrocomp]
			(
			@StartDateTime,
			@EndDateTime,
			null, --@PrinterDeviceID,
			NULL, --@SiteID,
			NULL, --@SiteDivisionID,
			@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters,
			30,--@MaxLimitDaysEarlier,
			1, --@GetLatestCounterNumbers (para este relatório é preciso os ultimos contadores)
			1, --@GetJustProductionCounters (se é pra trazer só so contadores de produção)
			1)--@OnlyPrintersWithCounters)
               
	DECLARE @CountersCube TABLE 
	(PDID INT, FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, TotalPages INT, CNDif Bigint, CCNDif Bigint,
	CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT)

	INSERT INTO 
		@CountersCube
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID, 
			FirstDateTimeRead, 
			LastDateTimeRead, 
			0, 
			CounterTotalDif,
			CounterColorDif,
			CounterTotalLatestNumber, 
			CounterBlackLatestNumber, 
			CounterColorLatestNumber
		FROM
			@CountersOutput

	--INSERIR IMPRESSORAS DE CONTRATO QUE NÃO ESTÃO AQUI.
	INSERT INTO 
		@CountersCube
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID, 
			@StartDateTime, 
			@EndDateTime, 
			0, 
			0,
			0,
			0, 
			0, 
			0
		FROM 
			PrintersDevices 
		WHERE 
			EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
			EngagedStatus IN (1,3) AND 
			PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @CountersOutput)
                
	--VERIFICA SE PRECISA ADICIONAR A CONTABILIZAÇÃO NO RELATÓRIO
	IF(@ShowBillingData = 1)
	BEGIN
		--COLOCA O TOTAL DE PÁGINAS NAS IMPRESSORAS     
		UPDATE @CountersCube SET TotalPages = ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(FirstDateTimeRead, LastDateTimeRead, PDID), 0)
	END
	
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--- AGORA AQUI VAMOS CALCULAR OS VALORES DOS DEMAIS CONTADORES (CÓPIA, FAX, ETC)
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	--ARMAZENA NA TABELA TEMPORÁRIA AS IMPRESSORAS, OS PRIMEIROS E ÚLTIMOS CONTADORES DELAS NO PERÍODO E A DIFERENÇA ENTRE ELES
	DECLARE @OthersCountersCube TABLE 
		(PDID2 INT, 
		CTID INT,
		CNDif   BIGINT,
		CCNDif  BIGINT)
                
	INSERT INTO @OthersCountersCube
		SELECT PDID2, CTID, SUM(CNDif), SUM(CCNDif) FROM
		(
			SELECT 
				CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayTotal) ELSE SUM(FullTotal) END AS CNDif,
				CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayColor) ELSE SUM(FullColor) END AS CCNDif,
				CC.PrinterDeviceID AS PDID2,
				CC.CounterTypeID AS CTID
			FROM 
				CubeCounterRetrocomp CC
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CC.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
			WHERE 
				(CC.CubeDate BETWEEN @StartDateTime  AND @EndDateTime) AND --DENTRO DO PERÍODO INFORMADO
				PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
				PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation) AND
				CC.CounterTypeID <> 1 AND CC.CounterTypeID <> 2 --TIRA FORA O GERAL E O DE IMPRESSÃO
			GROUP BY CC.PrinterDeviceID, CC.CounterTypeID, BeforeDate
		) AS TABLE1
		GROUP BY PDID2, CTID

	DELETE FROM @OthersCountersCube WHERE CNDif = 0

	DECLARE @Complementares TABLE 
		(PDID INT, 
		TotalCopies INT,
		TotalCopiesColor INT,
		TotalfaxReceived INT,
		TotalfaxSent INT,
		TotalScan INT,
		TotalDuplex INT,
		TotalDuplexColor INT,
		TotalA3 INT,
		TotalA3Color INT)

                
	INSERT INTO @Complementares 
		SELECT distinct PDID2,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 

	-- cópias 1
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalCopies = CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copies') and PDID = PDID2

	--cópias 2
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalCopies = TotalCopies  + CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = TotalCopiesColor  + CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copy') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax recebido 1
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalfaxReceived = CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Fax') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax recebido 2
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalfaxReceived = TotalfaxReceived + CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxReceived') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax enviado
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalfaxSent = CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxSent') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax enviado
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalScan = CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Scan') and PDID = PDID2

	-- duplex
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalDuplex = CNDif, TotalDuplexColor = CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Duplex') and PDID = PDID2

	-- a3 1
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalA3 = CNDif, TotalA3Color = CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3AndBiggerSizes') and PDID = PDID2

	-- a3 2
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalA3 = TotalA3 + CNDif, TotalA3Color = TotalA3Color + CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3') and PDID = PDID2


	INSERT INTO @ClosingDataList
		SELECT     
			PD.PrinterDeviceName AS PrinterDeviceName,
			PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
			PD.SerialNumber,
			'[' + PD.AddressName  + ']' AS MachineIP, 
			PD.IsLocal AS [Type],
			Sites.SiteName,
			ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber - C.CNDif,0) AS FirstCounter,                      
			C.FirstDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
			ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber,0) AS LastCounter,
			C.LastDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
			C.CNDif AS Total,                            
			(C.CNDif - C.CCNDif )AS TotalMono,
			C.CCNDif AS TotalColor,
			ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) AS TotalCopies,
			ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesMono,
			ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesColor,
			ISNULL(O.TotalfaxReceived,0) AS TotalfaxReceived,
			ISNULL(O.TotalfaxSent,0) AS TotalfaxSent,
			ISNULL(O.TotalScan,0) AS TotalScan,
			ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) AS TotalDuplex,
			ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexMono,
			ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexColor,
			ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) AS TotalA3,
			ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Mono,
			ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Color,
			PC.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName,
			CASE PD.EngagedStatus WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Engaged,
			C.TotalPages AS Monitored,
			0  AS CostFixed, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do nddPrintMaster
			0  AS CostExtra, --Não tem mais
			PD.Location,
			0 AS Productivity, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do KB
			0 AS EngagedVolume, --Não tem mais
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName,'Sem departamento') AS Department,
			ISNULL(C.CounterBlackLatestNumber,0) AS CounterBlackNumber,                                                                                                     
			ISNULL(C.CounterColorLatestNumber,0) AS CounterColorNumber,                                     
			PD.PrinterDeviceID 
		FROM 
			PrintersDevices PD
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN @CountersCube C ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = C.PDID
			INNER JOIN Sites ON PD.SiteID = Sites.SiteID
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @Complementares O ON C.PDID = O.PDID
			INNER JOIN CostGroups PC ON PD.CostGroupID = PC.CostGroupID
			LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID

	SELECT * FROM @ClosingDataList

END
```

## 285. proc_GPV_Reports_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter]
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN
	
	--***********************************************************************************
	-- Roger,21/03/2017
	-- Busco as ultimas leituras das impressoras dos consumíveis
	-- Roger 05/04/2017
	-- Adicionado separado os dados da impressora para exportar CSV
	-- 22/01/2019, Diego Antunes #Sprint 35 v5.43
	-- Inserido parametro SiteID que não estava sendo considerado pela SP.
	--***********************************************************************************

	SELECT 
		SU.PrinterDeviceID,        
		NR.DateTimeRead,
		NR.CounterColor,
		SU.LoadStatus,
		NR.CounterTotal,
		SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
		SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
		SPNU.PartNumber,
		SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
		SCC.SupplyColorName,
		ST.SupplyTypeName,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(SU.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterFullName,
		B.BrandName,
		P.PrinterDeviceName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		P.SerialNumber AS PrinterSerialNumber,
		P.AddressName,
		P.[Location]
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			NSLReadingID
		FROM
		(
			SELECT
				NSL.NSLReadingID,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SU.PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) N
			FROM
				NSLReadings NSL
				INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON SU.NSLReadingID = NSL.NSLReadingID
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE
				NSL.DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND
				PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) AND --SÓ AS IMPRESSORAS COM CONTADORES ATIVOS
				((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID))
		) AS F
		WHERE N = 1
	) AS BASE 
	INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU	ON BASE.NSLReadingID = SU.NSLReadingID
	INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN	ON SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
	INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN	ON SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
	INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU	ON SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
	INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC		ON SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
	INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR			ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID
	INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC			ON SU.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
	INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST			ON SU.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
	INNER JOIN PrintersDevices AS P		ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = P.PrinterDeviceID
	INNER JOIN PrintersModels AS PM		ON P.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	LEFT JOIN Brands AS B				ON B.BrandID=PM.BrandID
	ORDER BY
		SU.PrinterDeviceID

END
```

## 289. proc_GPV_Sites_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Sites_Insert]
@SiteName NVARCHAR(255)
AS

BEGIN

                --*************************************************************************************************
                --** Cria o site no banco nbdb, pelo GP
                --** Retorna o id e se é o default
                --** Robson, 19/02/2013 
                --*************************************************************************************************

                DECLARE @SiteID INT
                DECLARE @HasDefault BIT
                SET @HasDefault = 0

                SELECT @SiteID = SiteID, @HasDefault = IsDefault FROM Sites WHERE (SiteName = @SiteName)
                
                IF (@SiteID IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                
                               SELECT @HasDefault = 1 FROM Sites WHERE IsDefault = 1
                               
                               IF (@HasDefault = 1)
                                               SET @HasDefault = 0
                               ELSE
                                               SET @HasDefault = 1
                               
                               INSERT INTO
                                               Sites
                                                               (
                                                                              SiteName,
                                                                              IsDefault
                                                               )
                                               VALUES
                                                               (
                                                                              @SiteName,
                                                                              @HasDefault
                                                               ) 

                               SELECT @SiteID = CONVERT(INT, @@identity)

                END       

                SELECT @SiteID AS SiteID, @HasDefault AS IsDefault

END
```

## 290. proc_GPV_Sites_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Sites_Remove]
@SiteID INT
AS
BEGIN


	--*******************************************************************
	--** Remove um site (que interface ja garantiu que nao tem subredes e nao é o padrao)
	--** Precisa passar todas AS impressoras para o site padrão.
	--** Robson, 20/02/2013
	--*******************************************************************

	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PrinterDeviceID INT)
	
	INSERT INTO @Printers 
		SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE SiteID = @SiteID

	DECLARE @SiteDefaultID INT
	SELECT @SiteDefaultID = SiteID FROM Sites WHERE IsDefault = 1

	--passar todas AS impressoras para o site padrão
	UPDATE 
		PrintersDevices
	SET 
		SiteID = @SiteDefaultID,
		SiteDivisionID = NULL
	WHERE 
		SiteID = @SiteID

	--passar todos os machines para o site default
	UPDATE 
		Machines 
	SET 
		SiteID = @SiteDefaultID
	WHERE 
		SiteID = @SiteID
	
	--passar todAS AS SUBREDES PARA O SITE PADRÃO.
	UPDATE 
		SubNetworks 
	SET 
		SiteID = @SiteDefaultID
	WHERE 
		SiteID = @SiteID
	
	--criar uma fila para cada impressora
	DECLARE @PDID INT 
	SET @PDID = NULL
	
	SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @Printers
	
	WHILE (@PDID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		--Só é possível ter uma fila de atualização para todos
		--menos a consolidação da impressora
		DELETE FROM
			ProcessQueues 
		WHERE 
			ProcessQueueType = 11 --site 
			AND ObjectQueueID = @PDID

		DECLARE @Period CHAR
		SET @Period = dbo.GetProcessQueuePeriod(GETDATE(), 11, @PDID)

		IF (@Period = 'n')
		BEGIN
			RETURN 0
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				ProcessQueues
				(
					ProcessQueueType, 
					ObjectQueueID, 
					ObjectQueueField,
					DateIncluded, 
					[Status], 
					ErrorDescription,
					LastDateUpdated,
					LastPeriodUpdated,
					Period
				)	
			VALUES 
				(
					11 , --site 
					@PDID ,
					0, --ObjectQueueField (héber disse pra deixar 0)
					GETDATE(),
					1,
					'',
					GETDATE(),
					NULL,
					@Period
				)
		END
		
		DELETE FROM @Printers WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PDID 
		SET @PDID = NULL
		SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @Printers
		
	
	END
	
	DELETE FROM Sites WHERE SiteID = @SiteID
		
 
END
```

## 296. proc_GPV_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll]
@SiteID INT = 0,
@IgnoreSiteID BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
 
 	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Traz todos os subnetworks, ou só os de um site, só teodos menos de um site
	-- Robson, 19/02/2013
	--*******************************************************************************************************************


	IF (@IgnoreSiteID = 0)
	BEGIN

	    IF (@SiteID <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID = @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
				ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID <> @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
	END
END
```
