## 297. proc_GPV_SubNetworks_Set

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SubNetworks_Set] 
@SubNetworkAddress NVARCHAR(15),
@LowerIP NVARCHAR(15),
@HigherIP NVARCHAR(15)
AS
BEGIN

  	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Pega o ID ou cria a subrede
	-- Robson, 20/02/2013
	--*******************************************************************************************************************


	DECLARE @SubnetworkID INT
	SET @SubnetworkID = NULL
	
	SELECT @SubnetworkID = SubnetworkID FROM SubNetworks WHERE SubNetworkAddress = @SubNetworkAddress
	
	IF (@SubnetworkID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		-- Não existe, precisa criar.
		DECLARE @SiteID INT
		SELECT @SiteID = SiteID FROM Sites WHERE IsDefault = 1 --não existe cenario onde o site default ja nao tenha sido criado (pelo menos nao antes de chamar essa sp)

		INSERT INTO SubNetworks
					(SiteID, 
					SubNetworkAddress,
					LowerIP, 
					HigherIP)
		VALUES					
			(@SiteID, 
			@SubNetworkAddress,
			@LowerIP, 
			@HigherIP)
		
		SELECT @SubnetworkID = CONVERT(INT, @@identity)
	
	END
	
	SELECT @SubnetworkID
	
 
END
```

## 298. proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAll]
@PrinterDeviceID INT 

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Robson, 10/05/2013
	-- Retorna todos os unmonitoreds de uma impressora desde sempre
	--###############################################################################

	SELECT 
		NR.NSLReadingID,
		NR.DateTimeRead,
		NR.CounterColor,
		SU.LoadStatus,
		NR.CounterTotal,
		SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
		SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
		SPNU.PartNumber,
		SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
		SCC.SupplyColorName,
		ST.SupplyTypeName,
		SO.SupplyOIDName
	FROM
		SuppliesUnmonitored SU
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
		INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
		INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 
		INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC ON SU.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
		INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON SU.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
		INNER JOIN SupplyOIDs SO ON SU.SupplyOIDID = SO.SupplyOIDID
	WHERE
		SU.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) --SÓ AS IMPRESSORAS COM CONTADORES ATIVOS
	ORDER BY
		NR.DateTimeRead DESC


END
```

## 299. proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter]  
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************
	--Roger,20/03/2017
	--Busco as ultimas leituras das impressoras dos consumíveis
	--***********************************************************************************
       SELECT 
             SU.PrinterDeviceID,        
             NR.DateTimeRead,
             NR.CounterColor,
             SU.LoadStatus,
             NR.CounterTotal,
             SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
             SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
             SPNU.PartNumber,
             SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
             SCC.SupplyColorName,
             ST.SupplyTypeName
       FROM
             (
                    SELECT 
                           NSLReadingID  
                    FROM 
                           (
                                  SELECT 
                                        NSL.NSLReadingID, 
                                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SU.PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) N
                                  FROM
                                        NSLReadings NSL
                                        INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON SU.NSLReadingID = NSL.NSLReadingID  
                                        INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
                                  WHERE 
                                        (@PrinterDeviceID = 0 OR SU.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) AND
                                        PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) --SÓ AS IMPRESSORAS COM CONTADORES ATIVOS
                           ) AS F 
                    WHERE N = 1
             ) AS BASE 
             INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON base.nslreadingid = SU.nslreadingid              
             INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
             INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
             INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
             INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
             INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 
             INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC ON SU.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
             INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON SU.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
END
```

## 300. proc_IVT_CounterTypes_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_CounterTypes_Retrieve]
@CounterTypeID INT = -1, 
@CounterTypeName NVARCHAR (255) = '',
@CounterUnitID INT = 1

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@CounterTypeID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			CounterTypeID,
			CounterTypeName,
			[Description],
			CounterGroupID,
			CounterUnitID
		FROM
			CounterTypes 
		WHERE
			CounterTypeID = @CounterTypeID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Found INT
		SET @Found = -1
		
		SELECT
			@Found = CounterTypeID
		FROM 
			CounterTypes 
		WHERE 
			CounterTypeName = @CounterTypeName
			AND CounterUnitID = @CounterUnitID
		
		IF (@Found = -1)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @LastID INT
			SELECT @LastID = Max(CounterTypeID) FROM CounterTypes
			
			DECLARE @NewID INT
			DECLARE @CounterGroupID INT
			
			SET @NewID = @LastID + 1
			SET @CounterGroupID = 6 -- Other
			
			INSERT INTO
				CounterTypes (CounterTypeID, CounterTypeName, [Description], CounterGroupID, CounterUnitID)
			VALUES
				(@NewID, @CounterTypeName, @CounterTypeName, @CounterGroupID, @CounterUnitID)

			SELECT
				@NewID AS CounterTypeID,
				@CounterTypeName AS CounterTypeName, 
				@CounterTypeName AS [Description],
				@CounterGroupID AS CounterGroupID,
				@CounterUnitID AS CounterUnitID
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				CounterTypeID,
				CounterTypeName,
				[Description],
				CounterGroupID,
				CounterUnitID
			FROM
				CounterTypes 
			WHERE 
				CounterTypeID = @Found
		END
	END
		
END
```

## 301. proc_IVT_NSLReadings_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_NSLReadings_Insert]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME,
@CounterColor BIGINT,
@CounterTotal BIGINT,
@FileInputID BIGINT

AS
BEGIN
	
	--***************************************************************************
	--Insere a leitura de um contador do arquivo nsl para uma impressora
	--***************************************************************************
	
	IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NSLReadings WHERE FileInputID = @FileInputID AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND @DateTimeRead = DateTimeRead))
	BEGIN
	
		SELECT 0
	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
		INSERT INTO
			NSLReadings(
				FileInputID,
				PrinterDeviceID,			
				DateTimeRead,
				CounterColor,
				CounterTotal
				)
			VALUES(
				@FileInputID,
				@PrinterDeviceID,
				@DateTimeRead,
				@CounterColor,
				@CounterTotal
				)
				
		SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY()			
	
	END

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_NSLReadings_RetrieveCountersFromPrinter]

AS
BEGIN

	--*********************************************************************************************
	-- Diego, 21/03/2017
	-- Retorna todos os contadores da impressora
	-- Diego, 28/04/2017
	-- Alteração para buscar contadores de referencia de suprimento caso existam para o slot e tipo informados.

	SELECT

		COALESCE
```

## 304. proc_IVT_NSLReadings_RetrieveIDsFromPrinterDevice

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_NSLReadings_RetrieveIDsFromPrinterDevice]

AS
BEGIN

	--*********************************************************************************************
	-- Robson, 19/09/2013
	-- Traz os IDS de NSL (para processamento dos unmonitored) mas só apartir da data que tem unmonitored
	-- Diego, 13/06/2017
	-- Alterado para não trazer os NSLReadingIDs de forma repetida.

	SELECT
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PartnersConfigurations_RetrieveObjectsLevel6]

AS

BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 27-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Traz dados das impressoras para aplicar AS regra de limpreza do SuppliesUnmonitored
	--###############################################################################
	SELECT 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID, 				
		ISNULL(PM.CorrectName,PM.PrinterModelName) AS ModelName	, --é o correctname porque AS regras são criadas nos modelos conhecidos sem mains
		B.BrandName,
		ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID,-1) AS  SiteDivisionID,
		PD.SiteID,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS Value,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Processed
		 
	FROM

		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	WHERE 
		dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0
		--AND PD.Monitored IN(1,3)
	

END
```

## 308. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_Insert]
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT,
@NSLReadingID INT,
@SupplyTypeID tinyint,
@SupplyPhysicalNameID SMALLINT,
@SupplySerialNumberID INT,
@LoadStatus SMALLINT,
@SupplyCapacityID SMALLINT,
@SupplyColorID tinyint,
@PartNumberID SMALLINT,
@SupplyOIDID SMALLINT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME --Espera esse Date (que é o mesmo que o do nslreadingID) só pra não ter que busca-lo novamente.

AS
BEGIN

	--****************************************************************************
	-- ROBSON , 2013-03-07, nBilling 5.0
	-- Insere os dados de histórico dos Slots de uma impressora
	-- 
	-- DEVE MANTER:
	--		- O PRIMEIRO HISTÓRICO DO DIA 
	--		- O ANTERIOR, SE ESTE NOVO TEM ALGUM CAMPO DIFERENTE DO ANTERIOR
	--		- CASO CONTRÁRIO ATUALIZA O ANTERIOR COM OS NOVOS DADOS.
	-- 
	--		PODE OCORRER DE TER CASOS QUE DEVIA TER ATUALIZADO E NÃO ATUALIZOU, 
	--		MAS POSSIVELMENTE É PORQUE O ANTERIOR FOI INSERIDO DEPOIS DO POSTERIOR
	-- DIEGO, 2013-05-17
	-- Atualizada para inserir os dados do Agent

	-- Robson
	-- 04/04/2017
	-- Super revolução: Vai manter apenas o primeiro diferente dos demais. A partir do segundo 
	-- já fica atualizado sempre não importa a data
	-- 17/05/2017 -Robson: desrevolução - Vai fazer isso citado anteriormente, mas mantendo um registro por dia também

	-- 14/06/2017 -Robson: Agora não é testado se tem um no futuro. De 2 selects de consulta passamos para 1. Os possíveis impactos
	-- são que ao inserir uma leitura no meio (que não é muito comum) a próxima leitura (que estava certa) vai parecer errada. Mas só isso aparentemente.
	
	--11/01/2018 -Rafael Machado: foi realizado uma análise e nessa análise foi alterado a busca do último histórico.
	-- Originalmente apenas um select era feito, agora essa busca foi alterada e quebrada em dois selects porque na análise foi identificado que desas forma
	-- o desempenho é superior a um select.

	--****************************************************************************

	DECLARE @OldPrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID INT = NULL
	DECLARE @OldSupplyTypeID TINYINT
	DECLARE @OldSupplyPhysicalNameID SMALLINT
	DECLARE @OldSupplySerialNumberID INT
	DECLARE @OldLoadStatus SMALLINT
	DECLARE @OldSupplyCapacityID SMALLINT
	DECLARE @OldSupplyColorID TINYINT
	DECLARE @OldPartNumberID SMALLINT
	DECLARE @OldTotalReadings TINYINT
	DECLARE @OldDateTimeRead DATETIME 

	DECLARE @OldInvalid BIT
	DECLARE @OldForceStart BIT

    -- Aqui busca apenas o id do histórico
    SELECT TOP 1
	   @OldPrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID = PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID
    FROM
	   PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
	   INNER JOIN PrintersDevicesSlots pds on PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = pds.PrinterDeviceSlotID 
	   INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID
    WHERE
	   PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID AND
	   NR.DateTimeRead <=  @DateTimeRead  AND 
	   NR.PrinterDeviceID = PDS.PrinterDeviceID 
    ORDER BY 
	   NR.DateTimeRead DESC

    --Aqui busca as demais informações que são necessárias.
	SELECT 
	   @OldSupplyTypeID = SupplyTypeID,
	   @OldSupplyPhysicalNameID = SupplyPhysicalNameID ,
	   @OldSupplySerialNumberID  = SupplySerialNumberID, 
	   @OldLoadStatus = LoadStatus, 
	   @OldSupplyCapacityID  = SupplyCapacityID,
	   @OldSupplyColorID = SupplyColorID, 
	   @OldPartNumberID = PartNumberID,
	   @OldTotalReadings = TotalReadings,
	   @OldInvalid = Invalid,
	   @OldForceStart = ForceStart,
	   @OldDateTimeRead = DateTimeRead
    FROM
	   PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
	   INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID
    WHERE
	   PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID  = @OldPrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID
	
	DECLARE @Insert TINYINT = 0
	
	--Compara com o que chegou
	IF (@OldPrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		--nao achou ninguem antes desse, tem que fazer um insert. Isso só vai acontecer com a primeira leitura ever	
		SET @Insert = 1
		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
		--Se datas forem iguais, quer dizer que esse histórico já tinha sido inserido por algum motivo. Não insere
		IF (@DateTimeRead = @OldDateTimeRead)
		BEGIN

			RETURN
			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN			
			

			--Se o anterior foi invalidado ou forçado troca vou gerar um novo também, sem um motivo específico.
			IF (@OldInvalid = 1 OR @OldForceStart = 1)
			BEGIN

				SET @Insert = 1

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
			
				----Tem um anterior. Tenho que testar se tem um pra frente
				--IF (EXISTS( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON 
				--			PDSH.NSLReadingID=NR.NSLReadingID WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID AND
				--			NR.DateTimeRead > @DateTimeRead))
				--BEGIN

				--	--SE EXISTE QQ REGISTRO PRA FRENTE EU NAO VOU ME PREOCUPAR EM ATUALIZAR. PODE DAR PROBLEMA NO CONTADOR, ENFIM. E TAMBÉM É MAIS RESTRITO QUE ISSO POSSA ACONTECER
				--	SET @Insert = 1
				--END
				--ELSE
				--BEGIN

					--AGORA VOU TESTAR SE O REGISTRO ANTERIOR É IGUAL A ESSE
					IF (@OldSupplyTypeID  = @SupplyTypeID AND
						@OldSupplyPhysicalNameID  = @SupplyPhysicalNameID AND
						@OldSupplySerialNumberID = @SupplySerialNumberID AND
						@OldLoadStatus = @LoadStatus AND
						@OldSupplyCapacityID = @SupplyCapacityID AND
						@OldSupplyColorID = @SupplyColorID AND
						@OldPartNumberID = @PartNumberID)
					BEGIN

						--Era igual, vou ver se são do mesmo dia
						IF(CAST(@DateTimeRead AS DATE) = CAST(@OldDateTimeRead AS DATE))
						BEGIN

							--são do mesmo dia. Aplico a regra normal
							--VOU VER SE O ANTERIOR É O PRIMEIRO
							IF (@OldTotalReadings = 1)
							BEGIN
								--O ANTERIOR ERA O PRIMEIRO E NÃO MEXO NELE. INSIRO OUTRO, MAS JA COM 2 LEITURAS.
								SET @Insert = 2
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								--O ANTERIOR ERA UM VALOR QQ. ATUALIZO-O
								SET @Insert = @OldTotalReadings
								IF (@Insert <> 255)
									SET @Insert = @OldTotalReadings + 1
							END

						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN

							--São dias diferentes, insiro como 2 (porque ele não é o primeiro original)
							SET @Insert = 2

						END

					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN

						--O ANTERIOR É DIFERENTE EM ALGUMA FORMA. INSERE
						SET @Insert = 1
					
					END		

				--END
			END
		END
		
	END


	IF(@Insert IN (1,2))
	BEGIN 	
	
		INSERT INTO
				PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric 
				(
					PrinterDeviceSlotID,
					NSLReadingID,
					SupplyTypeID,
					SupplyPhysicalNameID,
					SupplySerialNumberID,
					LoadStatus,
					SupplyCapacityID,
					SupplyColorID,
					PartNumberID,
					SupplyOIDID,
					TotalReadings,
					SupplyChangeID,
					ForceStart,					
					Invalid
				)
			VALUES
				(
					@PrinterDeviceSlotID,
					@NSLReadingID,
					@SupplyTypeID,
					@SupplyPhysicalNameID,
					@SupplySerialNumberID,
					@LoadStatus,
					@SupplyCapacityID,
					@SupplyColorID,
					@PartNumberID,
					@SupplyOIDID,
					@Insert,--TotalReadings
					NULL,--SupplyChangeID
					0,--ForceStart					
					0--Invalid
				)

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		UPDATE 
			PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
		SET
			NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID,
			TotalReadings = @Insert,
			SupplyChangeID = NULL -- passa pra NULL pra poder ser processado pelo SuppliesSVC.
		WHERE
			PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID = @OldPrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID

	END
	
END
```

## 309. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveAllForProcessing

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveAllForProcessing]
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT,
@SupplySubFunctionTypeID INT,
@SupplyChangeID INT = 0,
@DateStart DATETIME = NULL

AS
BEGIN

	--**********************************************************************************************************
	-- Diego, 27/04/2017
	-- Alteração para buscar contadores de referencia de suprimento caso existam para o slot e tipo informados.
	--**********************************************************************************************************

	IF (@SupplyChangeID = 0)
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
			NR.DateTimeRead,

			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterColor,
				NR.CounterColor
			)
			AS CounterColor,
			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterTotal,
				NR.CounterTotal
			)
			AS CounterTotal,

			SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
			SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
			PDSH.LoadStatus,
			PDSH.LoadStatus AS LoadRealStatus,
			SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
			SPNU.PartNumber,
			PDSH.TotalReadings,			
			PDSH.SupplyChangeID,
			PDSH.ForceStart,
			-1 AS InternalSupplyChangeID
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
			INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
			INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  PDSH.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  PDSH.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 

				LEFT JOIN SuppliesReferenceCounters SRC ON NR.NSLReadingID = SRC.NSLReadingID AND SRC.SupplySubFunctionTypeID = @SupplySubFunctionTypeID
		WHERE
			(PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID --ID do Slot
			AND PDSH.Invalid = 0 --Somente os válidos
			AND (NR.DateTimeRead >= @DateStart OR @DateStart IS NULL)) --Apartir da data passada ou todos
		ORDER BY
			NR.DateTimeRead ASC --Ordem crescente de data
		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
			NR.DateTimeRead,

			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterColor,
				NR.CounterColor
			)
			AS CounterColor,
			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterTotal,
				NR.CounterTotal
			)
			AS CounterTotal,

			SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
			SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
			PDSH.LoadStatus,
			PDSH.LoadStatus AS LoadRealStatus,
			SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
			SPNU.PartNumber,
			PDSH.TotalReadings,			
			PDSH.SupplyChangeID,
			PDSH.ForceStart,		
			-1 AS InternalSupplyChangeID
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
			INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
			INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  PDSH.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  PDSH.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 

				LEFT JOIN SuppliesReferenceCounters SRC ON NR.NSLReadingID = SRC.NSLReadingID AND SRC.SupplySubFunctionTypeID = @SupplySubFunctionTypeID
		WHERE
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID --ID do Slot
			AND SupplyChangeID = @SupplyChangeID --ID do suprimento
			AND PDSH.Invalid = 0 --Somente os válidos
		ORDER BY
			NR.DateTimeRead ASC
	
	END
		
END
```

## 310. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveMissingSlots

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveMissingSlots] 
@NSLReadingID INT = 0

AS

BEGIN


	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 25-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Traz todos Slots do PrintersDevicesSlots de um determinado NSLReading que não tem históricos de Slot
	--###############################################################################

	SELECT 
		PDS.SupplySlotID,
		PDS.PrinterDeviceSlotID
	FROM 
		NSLReadings NR
		LEFT join PrintersDevicesSlots PDS	on NR.PrinterDeviceID = PDS.PrinterDeviceID
		LEFT join PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH ON PDS.PrinterDeviceSlotID = PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID AND PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID
	WHERE 
		(NR.NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID) AND
		( PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IS NULL)
		
END
```

## 314. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_Remove] 
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT = 0

AS

BEGIN


	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 25-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Remove o PrinterDeviceSlotID e joga os históricos para a Unmonitored
	--###############################################################################


		--Insere para a Unmonitored 
		INSERT INTO 
			SuppliesUnmonitored 
			([PrinterDeviceID]
           ,[NSLReadingID]
           ,[SupplyTypeID]
           ,[SupplyPhysicalNameID]
           ,[SupplySerialNumberID]
           ,LoadStatus
           ,[SupplyCapacityID]
           ,[SupplyColorID]
           ,[PartNumberID])
				SELECT 
				PDS.PrinterDeviceID, 
				PDSH.NSLReadingID, 
				PDSH.SupplyTypeID, 
				PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID, 
				PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID, 
				PDSH.LoadStatus, 
				PDSH.SupplyCapacityID, 
				PDSH.SupplyColorID, 
				PDSH.PartNumberID 
				FROM
				PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevicesSlots PDS ON PDS.PrinterDeviceSlotID = PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID
				WHERE
				PDS.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID
			
			
			--Deleta da PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
			DELETE FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID
			
			--Deleta da PrintersDevicesSlots
			DELETE FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID
				

END
```

## 315. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_RetrieveAll

```sql

AS

	--###############################################################################
	-- Retorna todos os slots da impressora
	--###############################################################################

	WHERE
```

## 316. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_Set

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_Set]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@SupplySlotID SMALLINT

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Robson, 09-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Cria o slot na impressora caso não tenha 
	--###############################################################################

	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceSlotID INT 
	SET @PrinterDeviceSlotID = NULL
	SELECT @PrinterDeviceSlotID = PrinterDeviceSlotID FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceID =  @PrinterDeviceID AND SupplySlotID = @SupplySlotID

	IF (@PrinterDeviceSlotID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		INSERT INTO 
			PrintersDevicesSlots (PrinterDeviceID, SupplySlotID)
		VALUES
			(@PrinterDeviceID, @SupplySlotID)
	
		SET @PrinterDeviceSlotID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
	END
	
	SELECT @PrinterDeviceSlotID	
	
	
END
```

## 317. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_SetSupplySlotID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_SetSupplySlotID]

@SupplySlotID SMALLINT

AS
BEGIN


	--************************************************************************************************
	-- Diego, 20/11/2018 Sprint 32 v5.40
	-- Atualiza o SupplySlotID do um PrinterDeviceSlot existente.
	-- Deve ser utilizado somente pelo NSLImporter no momento da sincronização dos slots da empresa.
	--************************************************************************************************

	UPDATE
		PrintersDevicesSlots
	SET
		SupplySlotID = @SupplySlotID
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID

END
```

## 318. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl_GetSlotProfileID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl_GetSlotProfileID]
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Robson, 09-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Pega o ID do SlotProfile da impressora do banco
	--###############################################################################
	
	DECLARE @PrintersModelsSlotProfileID INT
	SET @PrintersModelsSlotProfileID = 0 

	SELECT 
		@PrintersModelsSlotProfileID = ISNULL(PrintersModelsSlotProfileID,0) 
	FROM

	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	SELECT @PrintersModelsSlotProfileID	
	
END
```

## 319. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl_SetReceivedSupplyData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl_SetReceivedSupplyData]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@ReadingTime DATETIME

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Robson, 09-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Atualiza a data da última leitura (mais recente) de dados de suprimentos  
	--###############################################################################

	IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID))
	BEGIN

		UPDATE 
			PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl 
		SET 
			LastDateReceivedSupplies = @ReadingTime
		WHERE 
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
		INSERT INTO 
			PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl (PrinterDeviceID, LastDateReceivedSupplies)
		VALUES
			(@PrinterDeviceID, @ReadingTime)
	
	END
	
END
```

## 320. proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl_SetSlotProfileID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl_SetSlotProfileID]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@SupplySlotProfileID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Robson, 09-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Atualiza o SlotProfileId da impressora no banco (depois de ter criado os slots dela)
	-- Diego, 26/11/2018 - Sprint 32 v5.40
	-- Alterado tipo do parametro @SupplySlotProfileID para INT
	--###############################################################################

	UPDATE 
		PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl 
	SET 
		PrintersModelsSlotProfileID = @SupplySlotProfileID
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	IF (@@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO 
			PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl (PrinterDeviceID, PrintersModelsSlotProfileID)
		VALUES
			(@PrinterDeviceID, @SupplySlotProfileID)
	END
		
END
```

## 321. proc_IVT_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromModel

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromModel]
@PrinterModelID INT,
@PrintersModelsSlotProfileID INT = 0

AS
BEGIN


	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 25-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Traz todas AS impressoras de um determinado modelo e o seu SlotProfileID
	-- Diego, 13/06/2017
	-- Alterado para permitir retornar somente as impressoras que estejam com o SlotProfileID diferente do passado
	--###############################################################################

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		ISNULL(PDS.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID, 0) AS 'PrintersModelsSlotProfileID'
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl PDS ON PDS.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
	WHERE
		PD.PrinterModelID = @PrinterModelID AND
		dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0 AND
		(ISNULL(PDS.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID, 0) <> @PrintersModelsSlotProfileID OR @PrintersModelsSlotProfileID = 0)

END
```

## 322. proc_IVT_Printers_Devices_Counters_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_Printers_Devices_Counters_Insert]
@FileInputID INT = NULL,
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME,
@CounterInputTypeID INT,
@ReferenceMono INT,
@ReferenceColor INT,
--Os tipos User-Defnied Table Types tem uma peculiaridade, quando esse parâmetor for passado, é necessário verificar se a ordem das colunas
--criadas no datatable que está sendo passado coresponde com a ordem das colunas estabelecidas no tipo dbo.PlainCounters.
--É necessário tomar esse cuidado por que o nome das colunas não é levado em consideração, apenas a ordem e a quantidade.
@CountersList AS dbo.PlainCounters READONLY,
@IgnoreCountersValidation BIT = NULL

AS

BEGIN
	
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 18/08/2015
	-- Procedure utilizada no NSLImporter, para a inserção de contadores.
	-- Rafael Machado, 11/01/2018
	-- Foi realizado uma análise e essa análise acabou gerando algumas alterações nessa sp:
	-- - Essa sp deixou de buscar o parâmetro 'IgnoreCountersValidations' da tabela parameters.
	-- - Deixou de utilizar a função [GetCounterReadingBeforeFirst] porque essa sp não precisa mais de todos os parâmetros
	--     que essa função retorna. Também notamos que essa SP era o único local no NPDB onde está função era utilizado, então 
	--     vamos deletar essa função.
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	
	--Intervalo mínimo de tempo que vamos utilizar para controlar se devemos ou não inserir uma leitura.
	--Na parameters existe uma parâmetro que desabilita este controle, é o IgnoreCountersValidation.
	DECLARE @MinimumIntervalBetweenReadingsInMinutes TINYINT
	SET @MinimumIntervalBetweenReadingsInMinutes = 119; 
	
	DECLARE @LastCounterReadingDateTimeRead DATETIME = NULL 
	DECLARE @LastReferenceMono INT = 0
	DECLARE @LastReferenceColor INT = 0
	
	
	DECLARE @DiffBetweenLastCounterReadingAndCurrentCounterReading INT
	SET @DiffBetweenLastCounterReadingAndCurrentCounterReading = NULL
	
	DECLARE @CounterReadingID INT
	SET @CounterReadingID = 0
	
	DECLARE @DateInclude DATETIME
	SET @DateInclude = GETUTCDATE()

	--Pega a data da última leitura da impressora.
	SELECT TOP 1 
		@LastCounterReadingDateTimeRead = DateTimeRead
	FROM 
		CountersReadings
	WHERE 
		DateTimeRead <= @DateTimeRead AND --pego menor igual porque se for igual pula a inclusão desses contadores
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
		Removed = 0
	ORDER BY  
		DateTimeRead DESC
 
	--se já existir outra leitura no mesmo horário (CountersReadings), mesmo que os contadores dessas leituras estejam diferentes.
	IF (@LastCounterReadingDateTimeRead = @DateTimeRead)
		RETURN;
		
     IF (@IgnoreCountersValidation IS NULL)
	BEGIN	
		--Busca da Parameters, se é para ignorar a validação de contadores.
		SELECT @IgnoreCountersValidation = ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'IgnoreCountersValidations'
		
		--Se não tinha valor na parameters defino 0 como o valor padrão.
		IF(@IgnoreCountersValidation IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @IgnoreCountersValidation = 0
		END
	END

	IF (@LastCounterReadingDateTimeRead IS NULL) OR (@IgnoreCountersValidation = 1)
	BEGIN
		--Continua a inserção pq é a primeira leitura ou o parâmetro para ignorar as validações está ativo.
		
		--Reference mono e color serão obtidos dps de uma função
		INSERT INTO CountersReadings 
			(
				FileInputID, 
				PrinterDeviceID, 
				DateTimeRead, 
				CounterInputTypeID, 
				ReferenceMono, 
				ReferenceColor,
				DateInclude,
				Removed
			)
		VALUES 
			(
				@FileInputID, 
				@PrinterDeviceID, 
				@DateTimeRead, 
				@CounterInputTypeID, 
				@ReferenceMono,  
				@ReferenceColor,  
				@DateInclude,
				0 /*removed = 0*/
			)
				
		SELECT @CounterReadingID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()				 
				
		INSERT INTO Counters
		(
			CounterReadingID, 
			CounterTypeID, 
			CounterMono, 
			CounterColor, 
			CounterTotal
		)
			SELECT 
				@CounterReadingID,
				CounterTypeID, 
				CounterMono, 
				CounterColor, 
				CounterTotal 
			FROM 
				@CountersList

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		SELECT @DiffBetweenLastCounterReadingAndCurrentCounterReading = DATEDIFF(MINUTE, @LastCounterReadingDateTimeRead, @DateTimeRead)
	
		IF (@DiffBetweenLastCounterReadingAndCurrentCounterReading > @MinimumIntervalBetweenReadingsInMinutes) --Intervalo maior/igual a duas horas insere.
		BEGIN
		
			--Reference mono e color serão obtidos dps de uma função
			INSERT INTO CountersReadings 
				(
					FileInputID, 
					PrinterDeviceID, 
					DateTimeRead, 
					CounterInputTypeID, 
					ReferenceMono, 
					ReferenceColor,
					DateInclude,
					Removed
				)
			VALUES 
				(
					@FileInputID, 
					@PrinterDeviceID, 
					@DateTimeRead, 
					@CounterInputTypeID, 
					@ReferenceMono,	 
					@ReferenceColor,  
					@DateInclude,
					0 /*removed = 0*/
				)
					
			SELECT @CounterReadingID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()				 
					
			INSERT INTO Counters 
			(
				CounterReadingID, 
				CounterTypeID, 
				CounterMono, 
				CounterColor, 
				CounterTotal
			)
				SELECT 
					@CounterReadingID,
					CounterTypeID, 
					CounterMono, 
					CounterColor, 
					CounterTotal 
				FROM 
					@CountersList
				
		END
	END

	SELECT @CounterReadingID AS CounterReadingID
	
END
```

## 323. proc_IVT_Printers_Devices_Counters_Plotters_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_Printers_Devices_Counters_Plotters_Insert]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@CounterTypeID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME,
@CounterValue DECIMAL(18,6),
@DateInclude DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Found SMALLINT
	SELECT
		@Found = COUNT(PrinterDeviceCounterPlotterID)
	FROM
		PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND CounterTypeID = @CounterTypeID
		AND DateTimeRead = @DateTimeRead

	IF (@Found = 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter
			(PrinterDeviceID, CounterTypeID, DateTimeRead, CounterValue, DateInclude)
		VALUES
			(@PrinterDeviceID, @CounterTypeID, @DateTimeRead, @CounterValue, @DateInclude)

		SELECT Scope_Identity()
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT -1
		RETURN
	END

END
```

## 326. proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_MoveHistoricToSlot

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_MoveHistoricToSlot]
@SupplyUnmonitoredID INT,
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--************************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 19/09/2013
	--** Mode a leitura do supplyUnmonitored para o slot que agora é conhecido
	--************************************************************************************************

	INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
		(
			PrinterDeviceSlotID,
			NSLReadingID,
			SupplyTypeID,
			SupplyPhysicalNameID,
			SupplySerialNumberID,
			LoadStatus,
			SupplyCapacityID,
			SupplyColorID,
			PartNumberID,
			SupplyOIDID,
			TotalReadings,
			SupplyChangeID,
			ForceStart,
			Invalid)
		SELECT
			@PrinterDeviceSlotID,
			NSLReadingID,
			SupplyTypeID,
			SupplyPhysicalNameID,
			SupplySerialNumberID,
			LoadStatus,
			SupplyCapacityID,
			SupplyColorID,
			PartNumberID,
			SupplyOIDID,
			1,--TotalReadings,
			NULL,--SupplyChangeID,
			0,--ForceStart,
			0--Invalid
		FROM
			SuppliesUnmonitored
		WHERE
			SupplyUnmonitoredID = @SupplyUnmonitoredID
		
		
	DELETE FROM SuppliesUnmonitored WHERE SupplyUnmonitoredID = @SupplyUnmonitoredID
		
		
END
```

## 327. proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_Remove]
@SupplyUnmonitoredID INT = 0,
@PrinterDevicesIDs AS IntTable READONLY,
@LimitDays DATETIME = '2001-01-01 00:00:00'

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 26/09/12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Remove o SuppliesUnmonitored com base no SupplyUnmonitoredID
	-- Diego, 29/06/2018
	-- Alteração para utilizar uma tabela de IDs ao invés de uma string.
	--###############################################################################

	IF(@SupplyUnmonitoredID = 0)
	BEGIN

		DELETE
			SU
		FROM
			SuppliesUnmonitored AS SU
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings ON NSLReadings.NSLReadingID = SU.NSLReadingID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl ON PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl.PrinterDeviceID = SU.PrinterDeviceID
		WHERE
			NSLReadings.DateTimeRead < @LimitDays AND
			SU.PrinterDeviceID IN  (SELECT INTID FROM @PrinterDevicesIDs) AND
			(PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID IS NOT NULL AND PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID <> 0)

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		DELETE FROM
			SuppliesUnmonitored
		WHERE
			SupplyUnmonitoredID = @SupplyUnmonitoredID

	END

END
```

---

## 328. proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveSuppliesFromNSL

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveSuppliesFromNSL]
@NSLReadingID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--************************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 19/09/2013
	--** Traz os SuppliesUnmonitored de uma leitura nsl que nao se encaixaram em nenhum slot.
	--** Como está chamando apenas quando ainda não havia slots antes, vai trazer todos pois nenhum se encaixou
	--************************************************************************************************

	SELECT 
		SC.SupplyCapacity,
		SPNU.PartNumber,
		SPN.SupplyPhysicalName,
		SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
		SCo.SupplyColorName,
		ST.SupplyTypeName,
		SU.LoadStatus,
		SU.SupplyUnmonitoredID
	FROM
		NSLReadings NR		
		INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 
		INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
		INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID		
		INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCo ON SU.SupplyColorID = Sco.SupplyColorID
		INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON SU.SupplyTypeID = St.SupplyTypeID
	WHERE
		NR.NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID
		
END
```

## 345. proc_Machines_Find

```sql
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_Find] 
@IP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@MachineName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@Mask NVARCHAR(15) =NULL,
@StrongName NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@ProductID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@StrongName <> '')
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			M.MachineID 
		FROM 
			Machines M 
		WHERE 
			M.StrongName = @StrongName
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@MachineName IS NULL )
		BEGIN
			IF (@ProductID <> -1)
			BEGIN
				SELECT
					M.MachineID 
				FROM 
					Machines M 
					INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
				WHERE 
					MNA.IP = @IP
					AND IPR.ProductID = @ProductID
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN			
				SELECT
					M.MachineID 
				FROM 
					Machines M 
					INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
				WHERE 
					MNA.IP = @IP
					AND MNA.Mask = @Mask
			END
		END
		ELSE
			IF (@ProductID <> -1)
			BEGIN	
				SELECT
					M.MachineID 
				FROM 
					Machines M 
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
				WHERE 
					M.MachineName = @MachineName
					AND IPR.ProductID = @ProductID
			END
			ELSE
				IF(@IP IS NOT NULL AND @Mask IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 
						M.MachineID 
					FROM 
						Machines M 
						INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
					WHERE 
						MNA.IP = @IP
						AND MNA.Mask = @Mask
						AND M.MachineName = @MachineName
				END	
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT
						M.MachineID 
					FROM 
						Machines M 
					WHERE 
						M.MachineName = @MachineName
				END
	END
END
```

## 346. proc_Machines_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_Insert]
@SubNetworkID INT,
@SiteID INT,
@OperationSystemID INT,
@MachineName NVARCHAR(50),
@StrongName NVARCHAR(36) = ''

AS

BEGIN

	--Atualiza o MachineID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 7	--MachineID
	END

	INSERT INTO
		Machines
		(
			SubNetworkID,
			SiteID,
			OperationSystemID,
			MachineName,
			StrongName,
			Removed,
			SiteForcedByUser
		)	
	VALUES
		(
			@SubNetworkID,
			@SiteID,
			@OperationSystemID,
			@MachineName,
			@StrongName,
			0,
			0
		)

	SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY()

END
```

## 349. proc_Machines_NetWorkAddress_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_NetWorkAddress_Update] 
@MachineID INT,
@IP NVARCHAR(15),
@MacAddress NVARCHAR(50),
@Mask NVARCHAR(15)

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Found INT
	SET @Found = 0
	
	SELECT @Found = COUNT(1) FROM MachinesNetworkAddress WHERE MachineID = @MachineID AND IP = @IP

	UPDATE
		MachinesNetworkAddress 
	SET 
		MacAddress = '' 
	WHERE 
		MACAddress = @MacAddress

	IF (@Found <> 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO 
			MachinesNetworkAddress (MachineID, IP, Mask, MacAddress) 
		VALUES
			(@MachineID, @IP, @Mask, @MacAddress)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			MachinesNetworkAddress
		SET
			MacAddress = @MacAddress, 
			Mask = @Mask
		WHERE 
			MachineID = @MachineID AND IP = @IP
	END
	
	--Atualiza o MachineID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 7	--MachineID
	END

END
```

## 352. proc_Machines_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_RetrieveAll] 
@SiteID INT = 0,
@Removed BIT = 0

AS
BEGIN

	SELECT 
		DISTINCT M.*, 
		OperationSystems.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,
		Sites.SiteName
	FROM
		Machines M
		LEFT JOIN Sites ON M.SiteID = Sites.siteID		
		INNER JOIN OperationSystems ON OperationSystems.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
	WHERE
		(M.SiteID = @SiteID OR @SiteID = 0) AND
		(M.Removed = 0 OR M.Removed = @Removed) 
	ORDER BY M.MachineName ASC
END
```

## 355. proc_Machines_RetrievePAAgent

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_RetrievePAAgent] 
@MachineID INT = 0,
@Days INT = -3

AS
BEGIN
                
                SELECT 
                               * 
                FROM
                
                               (SELECT DISTINCT
                                               M.*, 
                                               OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem, 
                                               CASE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                                               MF.LastDateAccess,
                                               MF.ProductVersion,
                                               0 AS Actived, 
                                               1 AS UnActived  
                               FROM 
                                               Machines M
                                               LEFT JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
                                               LEFT JOIN InstalledProducts MF ON M.MachineID = MF.MachineID
                                               INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                               WHERE 
                                               MF.ProductID in (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products) AND 
                                               MF.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) AND
                                               M.MachineID = @MachineID
                               
                               UNION

                                               SELECT DISTINCT 
                                                               M.*, 
                                                               OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,  
                                                               CASE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                                                               MF.LastDateAccess,
                                                               MF.ProductVersion,
                                                               1 AS Actived,
                                                               0 AS UnActived  
                                               FROM 
                                                               Machines M
                                                               LEFT JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
                                                               LEFT JOIN InstalledProducts MF ON M.MachineID = MF.MachineID
                                                               INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                                               WHERE 
                                                               MF.ProductID in (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products) AND 
                                                               MF.LastDateAccess > DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) AND
                                                               M.MachineID = @MachineID
                                               ) AS PaGeneral
END
```

## 357. proc_Machines_SetRemoved_WithoutData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_SetRemoved_WithoutData]
@NumberOfDays INT

AS

BEGIN

	UPDATE
		Machines
	SET 
		Removed = 1
	WHERE 
		MachineID IN
		(
			SELECT
				MachineID
			FROM 
				InstalledProducts
			WHERE 
				PrinterDeviceID IS NULL
				AND DATEDIFF(dd, LastDateAccess, GETDATE()) >= @NumberOfDays
				AND MachineID NOT IN
					(
						SELECT DISTINCT 
							MachineID  
						FROM 
							InstalledProducts
						WHERE
							PrinterDeviceID IS NULL
							AND DATEDIFF(dd, LastDateAccess, GETDATE()) < @NumberOfDays
					)
		)
	
	--Atualiza o MachineID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 7	--MachineID
	END

END
```

## 358. proc_Machines_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_Update]
@MachineID INT,
@SubNetworkID INT,
@SiteID INT,
@OperationSystemID INT,
@MachineName NVARCHAR(50),
@StrongName NVARCHAR(36) = ''

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @OldSiteID INT
	SELECT @OldSiteID = SiteID FROM Machines WHERE MachineID = @MachineID

	IF (@OldSiteID = @SiteID)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			Machines 
		SET      
			SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID,
			OperationSystemID = @OperationSystemID,
			MachineName = @MachineName,
			StrongName = @StrongName,
			Removed = 0
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			Machines 
		SET      
			SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID,
			SiteID = @SiteID,
			OperationSystemID = @OperationSystemID,
			MachineName = @MachineName,
			StrongName = @StrongName,
			Removed = 0,
			SiteForcedByUser = 1
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID
	END
	
	--Atualiza o MachineID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 7	--MachineID
	END

END
```

## 359. proc_Module_Production

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_Production]
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		*
	FROM (
		SELECT
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PB.PolicyBehaviorID IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Permission,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PB.PolicyBehaviorID IN (6,7,10,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2, 0) AS [Security],
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PB.PolicyBehaviorID IN (8,9,12,13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2, 0) AS Converter,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN p.[Enabled] = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2, 0) AS [Enabled]
		FROM Policies P INNER JOIN PoliciesBehaviorsParameters PB ON PB.PolicyID = P.PolicyID
		) AS Q1,
		(
		SELECT QuotaParameterValue AS QuotasType FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 1
		) AS Q2,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalUsers FROM Accounts
		) AS Q3,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalPrinters FROM PrintersDevices
		) AS Q4,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(AccountID)) AS UsersHasJobs, COUNT(DISTINCT(PrinterDeviceID)) AS PrintersHasJobs FROM PrintJobs WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q5,
		(
		SELECT ISNULL(MIN(PrintJobID), 0) AS MinPrintJobID, ISNULL(MAX(PrintJobID), 0) AS MaxPrintJobID FROM PrintJobs WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q6,
		(
		SELECT 0 AS TotalPrintersReleaser, COUNT(DISTINCT(PrinterDeviceID)) AS PrintersReleaserHasJobs FROM PrintJobsReleaser PJR INNER JOIN PrintJobs PJ ON PJ.PrintJobID = PJR.PrintJobID WHERE DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q7,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalAccounts FROM CostAccounts
		) AS Q8,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(CostAccountID)) AS TotalAccountsSelectable FROM CostAccountsSelectable
		) AS Q9,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalMachines, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Removed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalMachinesRemoved FROM Machines
		) AS Q10,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS NPL, ISNULL(SUM(RowsCount), 0) AS NPLRows FROM FilePrintJob WHERE DateBeginProcess BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q11,
		(
		SELECT 0 AS FileInputLastID
		) AS Q12,
		(
		SELECT 
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 0 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledByUser,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 1 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledBySystem,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN (PagesMono) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN (PagesColor) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledColor,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 0 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledByUser,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 1 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledBySystem,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN (PagesMono) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN (PagesColor) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledColor		
		FROM PrintJobsCanceled PJC WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q13,
		(
		SELECT ISNULL(MIN(PrintJobID), 0) AS MinPrintJobCanceledID, ISNULL(MAX(PrintJobID), 0) AS MaxPrintJobCanceledID FROM PrintJobsCanceled WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q14

END
```

## 360. proc_Module_ProductionData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_ProductionData]
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME,
@GroupByPrinter BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@GroupByPrinter = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			PJ.PrinterDeviceID AS ID,
			B.BrandName + ' ' + PM.PrinterModelName AS PrinterName,
			COALESCE(PD.SerialNumber, '-') AS SerialNumber,
			PD.EnabledBillingStatus AS [Enabled],
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))) AS DateInclude,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, PJ.DatePrinted))) AS DatePrinted,
			COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesMono), 0) AS TotalMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesColor), 0) AS TotalColor,
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CAST(CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsReleaser
		FROM 
			PrintJobs PJ
			LEFT JOIN PrintJobsReleaser PJR ON PJR.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		WHERE 
			DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
			B.BrandName,
			PM.PrinterModelName,
			PD.SerialNumber,
			PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted))),
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		ORDER BY
			PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted)))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, PJ.DateInclude))) AS DateInclude,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, PJ.DatePrinted))) AS DatePrinted,
			COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesMono), 0) AS TotalMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesColor), 0) AS TotalColor,
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CAST(CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsReleaser
		FROM 
			PrintJobs PJ
			LEFT JOIN PrintJobsReleaser PJR ON PJR.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
		WHERE 
			DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted))),
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		ORDER BY
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted)))
	END

END
```

## 361. proc_Module_ProductionReleaserPrinters

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_ProductionReleaserPrinters]
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	-- *****************************************************************************************
	-- Héber Savedra, 2020-09-03
	-- Busca o total de impressora do Releaser pelo novo método
	-- *****************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @StartDateZero DATETIME
	SET @StartDateZero = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @StartDate), 0)
	
	DECLARE @EndDateZero DATETIME
	SET @EndDateZero = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @EndDate)), -1)

	SELECT 
		YearCollected, 
		MonthCollected,
		SUM(Amount) AS Amount
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			YEAR(DateCollected) AS YearCollected, 
			MONTH(DateCollected) AS MonthCollected, 
			MAX(Amount) AS Amount
		FROM 
			PrintJobsReleaserPrinters
		WHERE 
			DateCollected BETWEEN @StartDateZero AND @EndDateZero
			AND (LEN(StrongName) > 0)
		GROUP BY
			YEAR(DateCollected), 
			MONTH(DateCollected),
			ServerName,
			StrongName,
			HostID		
		) AS TB 
	GROUP BY
		YearCollected, 
		MonthCollected

END
```

## 365. proc_Module_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_Update]
@Module NVARCHAR(47),
@Value NVARCHAR(max)

AS

BEGIN

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysinfo WHERE Identification = @Module)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE 
			sysinfo 
		SET 
			[Value] = @Value 
		WHERE 
			Identification = @Module

		--Atualiza o AccountsID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
		IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
			   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PoliciesControls
			SET
				PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
			WHERE
				PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountID
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO 
			sysinfo (Identification, [Value]) 
		VALUES 
			(@Module, @Value)
	END
	
END
```

## 366. proc_Module_UpdateData

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_UpdateData]
@Key UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
@Name NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@CreatedAt DATETIME = NULL,
@Count INT = NULL,
@Manual BIT = NULL,
@Hash NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@Binary VARBINARY(MAX) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@Name IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sysdata WHERE [Key] = @Key AND UpdateAt IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE 
				sysdata
			SET 
				UpdateAt = GETDATE() 
			WHERE 
				[Key] = @Key

			SELECT 
				CreatedAt 
			FROM 
				sysdata
			WHERE 
				[Key] = @Key
				AND UpdateAt IS NOT NULL
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT NULL AS CreatedAt
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO 
			sysdata ([Key], Name, CreatedAt, [Count], [Manual], [Hash], [Binary]) 
		VALUES 
			(@Key, @Name, @CreatedAt, @Count, @Manual, @Hash, @Binary)	
	END
	
END
```

## 367. proc_Paging_RetrieveRows

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Paging_RetrieveRows]
@Table NVARCHAR(70),
@WhereClause NVARCHAR(max) = NULL,
@Sort NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@PrimaryKey NVARCHAR(50),
@ActualPage INT = 1,
@PageSize INT = 30

AS

BEGIN


	/*DECLARE VARIABLES*/
	DECLARE @BuildWhereClause NVARCHAR(max)
	DECLARE @BuildWhereClauseSimple NVARCHAR(max)
	DECLARE @SortIsPrimaryKey BIT

	DECLARE @strPageSize NVARCHAR(7) 
	DECLARE @strStartRow NVARCHAR(7) 	

	DECLARE @prec INT

	/*DEFAULT SORTING*/
	IF @Sort IS NULL OR @Sort = ''
		SET @Sort = @PrimaryKey
		
	/*SET IF SORTING COLUMN IS PK*/
	IF CHARINDEX(@PrimaryKey,@Sort)>0
		SET @SortIsPrimaryKey = 1
	ELSE
		SET @SortIsPrimaryKey = 0

	/*ACTUAL PAGE*/
	IF @ActualPage < 1
		SET @ActualPage = 1

	/*SET WHERE CLAUSE */
	IF @WhereClause IS NOT NULL AND @WhereClause != ''
	BEGIN
		SET @BuildWhereClause = ' WHERE ' + @WhereClause + ' '
		SET @BuildWhereClauseSIMPLE = ' AND ' + @WhereClause + ' '
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @BuildWhereClause = ''
		SET @BuildWhereClauseSimple = ''
	END

	/*CONVERT PAGESIZE FOR STRING*/
	SET @strPageSize = CAST(@PageSize AS NVARCHAR(50))

	/*EXECUTE DYNAMIC QUERY DEPEND STATE*/
	IF @SortIsPrimaryKey = 1 --ROWSCOUNT
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @SortColumn NVARCHAR(200)
		DECLARE @SortOperator CHAR(4)
		DECLARE @SortColumnType NVARCHAR(30)


		/*SET SORTING VARIABLES*/	
		IF CHARINDEX('DESC',@Sort)>0
		BEGIN
			SET @SortColumn = REPLACE(@Sort, 'DESC', '')
			SET @SortOperator = ' <= '
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF CHARINDEX('ASC', @Sort) > 0
				SET @SortColumn = REPLACE(@Sort, 'ASC', '')
			
			SET @SortOperator = ' >= '
		END

		/*FIND TYPE SORTCOLUMN*/
		SELECT
			@SortColumnType = t.name,
			@prec = c.prec
		FROM 
			sysobjects o 
			JOIN syscolumns c on o.id = c.id
			JOIN systypes t on c.xusertype = t.xusertype
		WHERE 
			o.name = @Table 
			AND c.name = @SortColumn
		
		IF CHARINDEX('CHAR', @SortColumnType) > 0
			SET @SortColumnType = @SortColumnType + '(' + CAST(@prec AS NVARCHAR) + ')'

		/*CACL START ROW*/
		SET @strStartRow = CAST(((@ActualPage - 1) * @PageSize + 1) AS NVARCHAR(50))

		Exec(
		'
			DECLARE @DQSortColumn ' + @SortColumnType + '
			SET ROWCOUNT ' + @strStartRow + '
			SELECT @DQSortColumn = ' + @SortColumn + ' FROM ' + @Table + @BuildWhereClause + ' ORDER BY ' + @Sort + '
			SET ROWCOUNT ' + @strPageSize + '	
			SELECT * FROM ' + @Table + ' WHERE ' + @SortColumn + @SortOperator + ' @DQSortColumn ' + @BuildWhereClauseSimple + ' ORDER BY ' + @Sort + '
		'
		)
	END
	ELSE IF @ActualPage = 1 AND @SortIsPrimaryKey = 0 --SUBQUERY
	BEGIN
		EXEC ('SELECT TOP ' + @strPageSize + ' * FROM ' + @Table + @BuildWhereClause + ' ORDER BY ' + @Sort + ',' + @PrimaryKey)
	END
	ELSE IF @ActualPage > 1 AND @SortIsPrimaryKey = 0 --CURSOR
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @PrimaryKeyType NVARCHAR(30)

		/*FIND TYPE SORTCOLUMN*/
		SELECT
			@PrimaryKeyType = t.name,
			@prec = c.prec
		FROM 
			sysobjects o 
			JOIN syscolumns c on o.id = c.id
			JOIN systypes t on c.xusertype = t.xusertype
		WHERE 
			o.name = @Table 
			AND c.name = @PrimaryKey
		
		IF CHARINDEX('CHAR',  @PrimaryKeyType) > 0
			SET @PrimaryKeyType = @PrimaryKeyType + '(' + CAST(@prec AS NVARCHAR) + ')'

		/*CALC START ROW*/
		SET @strStartRow = CAST(((@ActualPage - 1) * @PageSize + 1) AS NVARCHAR(50))

		EXEC(
		'
			DECLARE @PageSize INT
			SET @PageSize = ' + @strPageSize + '

			DECLARE @PK ' + @PrimaryKeyType + '
			DECLARE @tblPK TABLE (PK  ' + @PrimaryKeyType + ' NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

			DECLARE PagingCursor CURSOR DYNAMIC READ_ONLY FOR
			SELECT '  + @PrimaryKey + ' FROM ' + @Table + @BuildWhereClause + ' ORDER BY ' + @Sort + ' , ' + @PrimaryKey + '
			
			OPEN PagingCursor
			FETCH RELATIVE ' + @strStartRow + ' FROM PagingCursor INTO @PK
			
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			
			WHILE @PageSize > 0 AND @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
			
				IF ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tblPK WHERE PK = @Pk))
				BEGIN
							INSERT @tblPK (PK)  VALUES (@PK)
							SET @PageSize = @PageSize - 1
				END

						FETCH NEXT FROM PagingCursor INTO @PK
			           
			END
			
			CLOSE       PagingCursor
			DEALLOCATE  PagingCursor
			
			SELECT * FROM ' + @Table + ' JOIN @tblPK tblPK ON ' + @PrimaryKey + ' = tblPK.PK ' + @BuildWhereClause + ' ORDER BY ' + @Sort + ' , ' + @PrimaryKey
		)
	END

END
```

```sql
		FROM

		WHERE
```

```sql
	ELSE
	BEGIN
```

```sql
		BEGIN
```
```sql
			SELECT
				COUNT(1)
			FROM

			WHERE
				(AccountID = @AccountID OR AccountID = 0)
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				PermissionAccessID
			FROM 
				AccountsPermissions
			WHERE
				AccountID = @AccountID
		END
	END
			
END
```

## 378. proc_Permissions_SetPermission

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Permissions_SetPermission]
@AccountID INT,
@PermissionControlID SMALLINT,
@PermissionAccessID SMALLINT

AS

BEGIN

	-- Se vai negar acesso, então deleta o registro caso não seja permissão de login (CanLogin = 3).
	IF (@PermissionAccessID = 0 AND @PermissionControlID <> 3)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM
			AccountsPermissions
		WHERE
			AccountID = @AccountID
			AND PermissionControlID = @PermissionControlID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Found SMALLINT

		--Caso o registro já exista, então não o cadastra novamente
		SELECT @Found = COUNT(AccountID) FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE ((AccountID = @AccountID) AND (PermissionControlID = @PermissionControlID))

		IF (@Found < 1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				AccountsPermissions
				(
					AccountID,
					 PermissionControlID,
					 PermissionAccessID
				 )
			VALUES
				(
					@AccountID, 
					 @PermissionControlID,
					 @PermissionAccessID
				)
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				AccountsPermissions
			SET
				PermissionControlID = @PermissionControlID,
				PermissionAccessID = @PermissionAccessID
			WHERE
				AccountID = @AccountID
				AND PermissionControlID = @PermissionControlID
		END
	END

END
```

## 383. proc_PoliciesControls_AccountsDomains

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_AccountsDomains]
@JustDomains BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN
 
	IF (@JustDomains = 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @IsCostAccountSelectable NVARCHAR(1)
		SET @IsCostAccountSelectable = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')
		
		SELECT
			AC.AccountID,
			AC.LogonName,
			ISNULL(AC.FullName, '') AS FullName,
			ISNULL(AC.Email, '') AS Email,
			CASE 
				WHEN @IsCostAccountSelectable = 3 THEN ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) 
				ELSE -1
			END  AS CostAccountID,
			dbo.AccountHasAliases(AC.AccountID) AS HasAliases,
			ISNULL(AI.ReleaserStorageQuota, -1) AS ReleaserStorageQuota,
			/*ReleaseStorageQuota: Quando o retorno é -2 a quotas está desabilitada para o usuário
			quando o retorno é -1 a cota está habilitada e usa a cota padrão.*/
			AC.DomainID,
			D.DomainName,
			D.DomainTypeID,
			'' AS DomainIP
			--ISNULL(DA.[Address],'') AS DomainIP
		FROM
			Accounts AC
			LEFT JOIN AccountsInfo AI ON AI.AccountID = AC.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			--LEFT JOIN DomainsAddresses DA ON DA.DomainID = D.DomainID			
		WHERE
			Removed = 0
			AND	AC.AccountID IN
			(
				SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
			) 
	
		SELECT 
			AccountGroupID, 
			AccountID
		FROM 
			AccountsGroupsObjects
	END
	ELSE
	IF (@JustDomains = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT
			D.DomainID,
			D.DomainName,
			D.DomainTypeID,
			'' AS DomainIP
			--ISNULL(DA.[Address], '') AS DomainIP
		FROM
			Accounts AC
			LEFT JOIN AccountsInfo AI ON AC.AccountID = AI.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			--LEFT JOIN DomainsAddresses DA ON DA.DomainID = D.DomainID			
		WHERE
			Removed = 0
			AND	AC.AccountID IN
			(
				SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
			)
	END
	
END
```

## 384. proc_PoliciesControls_CostAccountsSelectable

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_CostAccountsSelectable]

AS

BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Edit date: 17/10/2013
	-- Edit author:	Rafael Machado
	-- Description: Foi encontrado um problema relacionado aos CostAccountsSelectables
	--				onde um usuário poderia referenciar um CostAccountId que não seria retornado na chamada desta procedure,
	--				e então um erro seria gerado, para contornar este problema foi adicionado um select adicional buscando
	--				os CostAccountsIds que são referenciados pelos usuários.
	--
	-- Edit date: 12/09/2019
	-- Edit author: Anderson Tabaldi
	-- Description: Alterado para buscar as contas selecionáveis da tabela CostAcountsSelectable e CostAccountsSelectableObject
	--
	-- Edit date: 03/12/2019
	-- Edit author: Rodrigo Scopel
	-- Description: Aplicado DISTINCT para remover duplicidades do JOIN

	DECLARE @IsCostAccountSelectable NVARCHAR(1)
	SET @IsCostAccountSelectable = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')

	SELECT DISTINCT
		-2 AS DomainID,
		'-' AS DomainName,
		-2 AS AccountID,
		'-' AS LogonName,
		CA.CostAccountID,
		CA.CostAccountName,
		CA.CostAccountCode
	FROM
		CostAccountsSelectable CAS
		INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.CostAccountSelectableID = CAS.CostAccountSelectableID
		INNER JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = CAS.CostAccountID
	WHERE
		CASO.IsAllSelectable = 1
		
	UNION ALL
		
	SELECT DISTINCT
		D.DomainID,
		D.DomainName,
		AC.AccountID,
		AC.LogonName,
		CA.CostAccountID,
		CA.CostAccountName,
		CA.CostAccountCode
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.DomainID,
				CAS.CostAccountID
			FROM
				Accounts AC
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.AccountID = AC.AccountID AND CASO.ObjectAllowedType = 1
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectable CAS ON CAS.CostAccountSelectableID = CASO.CostAccountSelectableID
			WHERE
				AC.Removed = 0
				
			UNION ALL

			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.DomainID,
				CAS.CostAccountID
			FROM
				CostAccountsSelectable CAS
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.CostAccountSelectableID = CAS.CostAccountSelectableID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.CostAccountID = CASO.CostAccountID AND CASO.ObjectAllowedType = 2 AND CASO.FilterByChildren = 0
			WHERE
				AC.Removed = 0
				
			UNION ALL

			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.DomainID,
				CAS.CostAccountID
			FROM
				CostAccountsSelectable CAS
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.CostAccountSelectableID = CAS.CostAccountSelectableID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT * FROM dbo.getCostAccountChildrenTable(CASO.CostAccountID)) AND CASO.ObjectAllowedType = 2 AND CASO.FilterByChildren = 1
			WHERE
				AC.Removed = 0	
							
		) AS TB
			 INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = TB.AccountID
			 INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			 LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = TB.CostAccountID
	
	UNION ALL
	
	--Workaround--
	-- Os '-3' e '-' foram adicionados apenas para que fosse possível executar um union com os demais selects,
	-- as informações relevantes para esse select abaixo são apenas: CostAccountID, CostAccountName, CostAccountCode
	SELECT DISTINCT
		-3 AS DomainID,
		'-' AS DomainName,
		-3 AS AccountID,
		'-' AS LogonName,
	
	CASE 
		WHEN @IsCostAccountSelectable = 3 THEN ISNULL(AC.CostAccountID, -1) 
		ELSE -1
		END  AS CostAccountID,
		CA.CostAccountName,
		CA.CostAccountCode
	FROM
		Accounts AC 
		INNER JOIN CostAccounts CA ON AC.CostAccountID = CA.CostAccountID
	WHERE	
		AC.Removed = 0
		AND	AC.AccountID IN
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
		)
	ORDER BY
		AccountID 
END
```

```sql
@IsAccountsGroups BIT = 0

			PDGPS.CostMono,

		FROM

			)
	END
	
END
```

## 386. proc_PoliciesControls_Machines

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_Machines]

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @TBMachines TABLE
		(
			MachineID INT,
			StrongName NVARCHAR(32),
			MachineName NVARCHAR(50),
			IP1 NVARCHAR(55),
			IP2 NVARCHAR(55),
			ID INT IDENTITY
		)
		
	DECLARE @TBMachinesTemp TABLE
		(	
			MachineID INT,
			StrongName NVARCHAR(36),
			MachineName NVARCHAR(50),
			IP1 NVARCHAR(55),
			IP2 NVARCHAR(55)
		)
		
	DECLARE @MachineID INT
	DECLARE @IP1 NVARCHAR(55)
	DECLARE @IP2 NVARCHAR(55)

	INSERT INTO
		@TBMachines
	SELECT DISTINCT
		M.MachineID,
		M.StrongName,
		M.MachineName,
		MNA.IP AS IP1,
		'' AS IP2
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON MNA.MachineID = M.MachineID
	WHERE
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND PD.CostGroupID <> (SELECT CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1)
		OR PD.PrinterDeviceID IN 
		(
			SELECT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesMembers(2)
		)

	INSERT INTO
		@TBMachinesTemp
	SELECT 
		M.MachineID,
		M.StrongName,
		M.MachineName,
		MNA.IP AS IP1,
		'' AS IP2
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON MNA.MachineID = M.MachineID
	WHERE
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND PD.CostGroupID <> (SELECT CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1)
		OR PD.PrinterDeviceID IN 
		(
			SELECT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesMembers(2)
		)

	WHILE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @TBMachinesTemp) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @IP1 = ''
		SET @IP2 = ''
		
		SELECT TOP(1) @MachineID = MachineID, @IP1 = IP1 FROM @TBMachinesTemp

		SELECT 
			TOP(1) @IP2 = IP
		FROM
			MachinesNetworkAddress
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID AND IP <> @IP1

		UPDATE 
			@TBMachines
		SET
			IP2 = @IP2
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID 
			AND IP1 = @IP1
		
		DELETE FROM
			@TBMachinesTemp
		WHERE 
			MachineID = @MachineID
			AND IP1 = @IP1
	END

	DELETE
		TB1 
	FROM
		@TBMachines TB1 
	WHERE
		TB1.ID NOT IN (SELECT MIN(ID) FROM @TBMachines TB2 WHERE TB2.MachineID = TB1.MachineID)

	SELECT
		MachineID,
		StrongName,
		MachineName,
		IP1,
		IP2
	FROM 
		@TBMachines
		
END
```

## 391. proc_PoliciesControls_PoliciesMessages

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_PoliciesMessages]

AS

BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Edit date: 15/10/2013
	-- Edit author:	Rafael Machado
	-- Description: Alterando a clausula Inner Join pelo Left Join e também adicionado o Distinct, para não
	--				haver redundâncias de registros contendo -1.

	SELECT DISTINCT
		ISNULL(PM.PolicyMessageID, -1) AS PolicyMessageID,
		CASE 
			WHEN PM.UseDefaultMessage = 1 THEN ''
			WHEN PM.UseDefaultMessage = 0 THEN PM.MessageText
		END AS MessageText
	FROM
		Policies P
		LEFT JOIN PoliciesMessages PM ON PM.PolicyMessageID = P.PolicyMessageID
		
END
```

## 395. proc_PoliciesControls_PrintersDevices

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_PrintersDevices]

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressMAC,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.AddressPort,
		IsLocal,
		IsUSBPort,
		PD.CostGroupID,
		ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
		CASE EnabledBillingStatus
			WHEN 0 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)
			WHEN 2 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)
			ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT)

	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
	WHERE
		PD.CostGroupID <> (SELECT CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1) 
		OR PD.PrinterDeviceID IN 
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesMembers(2)
		)
		OR PD.ForceColor <> 0
		OR EnabledBillingStatus IN (0, 2)

END
```

## 401. proc_PoliciesControls_RetrieveUpdatedAccounts

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_RetrieveUpdatedAccounts]
@PolicyControlAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN
  
 	--########################################################################
	-- Data: 03-06-2014;		
	-- Autor: Rafael Borges Machado;
	-- Task: #716;
	-- Descrição: retorna duas tabelas, 
	-- a primeira tabela retorna os usuários 'ATUALIZADOS'.
	-- a segunda, retorna os groups ids dos usuários que estão na primeira tabela. 
	--########################################################################


	--########################################################################
	-- Usuários atualizados.
	--########################################################################
	DECLARE @IsCostAccountSelectable NVARCHAR(1)
	SET @IsCostAccountSelectable = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')

	SELECT
		AC.AccountID,
		AC.LogonName,
		ISNULL(AC.FullName, '') AS FullName,
		ISNULL(AC.Email, '') AS Email,
		CASE 
			WHEN @IsCostAccountSelectable = 3 THEN ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) 
			ELSE -1
		END  AS CostAccountID,
		dbo.AccountHasAliases(AC.AccountID) AS HasAliases,
		ISNULL(AI.ReleaserStorageQuota, -1) AS ReleaserStorageQuota,
		/*ReleaseStorageQuota: Quando o retorno é -2 as quotas estão desabilitadas para o usuário
		quando o retorno é -1 a cota está habilitada e usa a cota padrão.*/
		AC.DomainID,
		D.DomainName,
		D.DomainTypeID,
		ISNULL(DA.[Address],'') AS DomainIP
	FROM
		Accounts AC
		LEFT JOIN AccountsInfo AI ON AI.AccountID = AC.AccountID
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		LEFT JOIN DomainsAddresses DA ON DA.DomainID = D.DomainID			
	WHERE
		Removed = 0
		AND	AC.AccountID IN
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
		)
		AND AC.AccountID IN (SELECT 
									DISTINCT PCA.AccountID
								FROM 
									PoliciesControlsAccounts PCA
								WHERE 
									IsRemoved = 0 
									AND PolicyControlAccountID > @PolicyControlAccountID
									AND IsRegularCache = 1) 
		
	SELECT 
		AccountGroupID, 
		AccountID
	FROM 
		AccountsGroupsObjects
	WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT 
							DISTINCT PCA.AccountID
						FROM 
							PoliciesControlsAccounts PCA
						WHERE 
							IsRemoved = 0 
							AND PolicyControlAccountID > @PolicyControlAccountID
							AND IsRegularCache = 1)	
			
END
```

## 403. proc_Policies_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_Insert]
@PolicyName NVARCHAR(50),
@JobTypeID INT,
@PolicyType TINYINT,
@PolicyMessageText NVARCHAR(2000) = NULL,
@Enabled BIT,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @PolicyMessageID INT
			
	IF (@PolicyMessageText IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Atualiza o PolicyMessageID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
		IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
			   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PoliciesControls
			SET
				PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
			WHERE
				PolicyControlID = 15 --PolicyMessageID
		END	
	
		INSERT INTO
			PoliciesMessages (MessageText, UseDefaultMessage)
		VALUES
			(@PolicyMessageText, 0)
			
		SET @PolicyMessageID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @PolicyMessageID = NULL
	END	
	
	INSERT INTO
		Policies (PolicyName, JobTypeID, PolicyType, PolicyMessageID, [Enabled], AccountIDOwner)
	VALUES
		(@PolicyName, @JobTypeID, @PolicyType, @PolicyMessageID, @Enabled, @AccountIDOwner)
		
	--Atualiza o PolicyID e PolicyBehaviorParameterID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 12 --PolicyID
			OR PolicyControlID = 16	--PolicyBehaviorParameterID
	END	
		
	SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY()

END
```

## 404. proc_Policies_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_Remove]
@PolicyID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @PolicyMessageID INT = NULL
	DECLARE @PolicyBehaviorParameterID INT = NULL
	
	DELETE FROM
		PoliciesFeaturesParameters
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
		
	DELETE FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
		
	SELECT 
		@PolicyMessageID = PolicyMessageID
	FROM 
		Policies
	WHERE 
		PolicyID = @PolicyID 
	
	DELETE FROM
		Policies
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	
	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMessages
	WHERE
		PolicyMessageID = @PolicyMessageID
		
	--Atualiza o PolicyID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 12 --PolicyID
			OR PolicyControlID = 16	--PolicyBehaviorParameterID
	END	
	
END
```

## 405. proc_Policies_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_Retrieve]
@PolicyID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT 
		P.PolicyID,
		P.PolicyName,
		P.JobTypeID,
		P.PolicyType,
		P.[Enabled],
		P.AccountIDOwner,
		ISNULL(P.PolicyMessageID, -1) AS PolicyMessageID,
		ISNULL(PMS.MessageText, '') AS MessageText,
		ISNULL(PMS.UseDefaultMessage, 1) AS UseDefaultMessage
	FROM 
		Policies P
		LEFT JOIN PoliciesMessages PMS ON PMS.PolicyMessageID = P.PolicyMessageID
	WHERE 
		P.PolicyID = @PolicyID
		
	SELECT
		PBP.PolicyBehaviorParameterID,
		PBP.PolicyID,
		PBP.PolicyBehaviorID,
		ISNULL(PBP.PolicyBehaviorValue, -1) AS PolicyBehaviorValue 
	FROM
		PoliciesBehaviorsParameters PBP
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	ORDER BY
		PBP.PolicyBehaviorID
		
	SELECT
		PFP.PolicyFeatureParameterID,
		PFP.PolicyID,
		PFP.PolicyFeatureID,
		PFP.PolicyCompareTypeID,
		ISNULL(PFP.Value, '') AS Value,
		ISNULL(PFP.OperatorType, 0) AS OperatorType,
		PFP.[Order]
	FROM
		PoliciesFeaturesParameters PFP
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	ORDER BY
		PFP.[Order]
		
	SELECT
		PM.PolicyMemberID,
		PM.PolicyID,
		PM.ObjectID,
		ISNULL(PM.PrinterDeviceID, -1) AS PrinterDeviceID,
		PM.PolicyMemberType
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers PM
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID

END
```
