	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Insere todos os Jobs que não estão vinculados AS informações SAP, Bureau, cotas, auditoria, codigo de rastreio e releaser
	INSERT INTO
		PrintJobs
			(	PrinterQueueID, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, CostAccountID, SiteID,
			    JobOriginID, JobTypeID, PrintApplicationID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID, SpoolSize, PrintWayID,
			    Title, DatePrinted, DateInclude, PagesMono, PagesColor, CostMono, CostColor,
			    WasLastPageColor, JobDisabled, PrintStationID, IsCorporative
			)
	SELECT 
		CASE WHEN PrinterQueueID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE PrinterQueueID END, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, CASE WHEN CostAccountID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE CostAccountID END, SiteID,
		JobOriginID, JobTypeID, PrintApplicationID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID, SpoolSize, PrintWayID,
		Title, DatePrinted, GETDATE(), PagesMono, PagesColor, ISNULL(CostMono, 0), ISNULL(CostColor, 0),
		WasLastPageColor, 0, CASE WHEN PrintStationID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE PrintStationID END, IsCorporative
	FROM 
		@Temp 
	WHERE 
		QuotaDebitID = '' AND StampLogonID = '' AND IsReleaserOrigin = 0
			
	IF (@@Error <> 0)
	BEGIN
		ROLLBACK
		RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs - 2', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END	

	-- Processa apenas os Jobs com informações Bureau, neste caso ele irá buscar os registros, um a um, por causa do campo PK ser uma IDENTITY.
	SELECT @PrimaryKey = NULL, @PrimaryKeyPrevious = 0	
	
	SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF
	FROM @Temp
	WHERE QuotaDebitID = ''
	ORDER BY IDF

	WHILE (@PrimaryKey IS NOT NULL AND @PrimaryKey > @PrimaryKeyPrevious)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			PrintJobs
				(	PrinterQueueID, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, CostAccountID, SiteID,
					JobOriginID, JobTypeID, PrintApplicationID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID, SpoolSize, PrintWayID,
					Title, DatePrinted, DateInclude, PagesMono, PagesColor, CostMono, CostColor,
					WasLastPageColor, JobDisabled, PrintStationID, IsCorporative
				)
		SELECT 
			CASE WHEN PrinterQueueID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE PrinterQueueID END, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, CASE WHEN CostAccountID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE CostAccountID END, SiteID,
			JobOriginID, JobTypeID, PrintApplicationID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID, SpoolSize, PrintWayID,
			Title, DatePrinted, GETDATE(), PagesMono, PagesColor, ISNULL(CostMono, 0), ISNULL(CostColor, 0),
			WasLastPageColor, 0, CASE WHEN PrintStationID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE PrintStationID END, IsCorporative
		FROM 
			@Temp 
		WHERE 
			IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END	

		SELECT @PrintJobID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		SELECT @IsReleaserOrigin = IsReleaserOrigin FROM @Temp WHERE IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@IsReleaserOrigin = 1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				PrintJobsReleaser (PrintJobID)
			VALUES
				(@PrintJobID)
		END	

		--alterado em 30/01/2007
		SELECT @Services = [Services], @AdditionalInfo = AdditionalInfo, @Notes = Notes
		FROM @Temp
		WHERE IDF = @PrimaryKey
		
		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END	

		SET @PrimaryKeyPrevious = @PrimaryKey		
		
		SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
		FROM @Temp
		WHERE QuotaDebitID = '' AND IDF > @PrimaryKey
		ORDER BY IDF
	END

	-- Processa os jobs que tem cotas
	SELECT @PrimaryKey = NULL, @PrimaryKeyPrevious = 0	
	
	SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
	FROM @Temp
	WHERE QuotaDebitID <> ''
	ORDER BY IDF

	WHILE (@PrimaryKey IS NOT NULL AND @PrimaryKey > @PrimaryKeyPrevious)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			PrintJobs
				(	PrinterQueueID, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, CostAccountID, SiteID,
					JobOriginID, JobTypeID, PrintApplicationID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID, SpoolSize, PrintWayID,
					Title, DatePrinted, DateInclude, PagesMono, PagesColor, CostMono, CostColor,
					WasLastPageColor, JobDisabled, PrintStationID, IsCorporative
				)
		SELECT 
			CASE WHEN PrinterQueueID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE PrinterQueueID END, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, CASE WHEN CostAccountID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE CostAccountID END, SiteID,
			JobOriginID, JobTypeID, PrintApplicationID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID, SpoolSize, PrintWayID,
			Title, DatePrinted, GETDATE(), PagesMono, PagesColor, ISNULL(CostMono, 0), ISNULL(CostColor, 0),
			WasLastPageColor, 0, CASE WHEN PrintStationID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE PrintStationID END, IsCorporative
		FROM
			@Temp
		WHERE
			IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END	

		SELECT @PrintJobID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		SELECT @StampLogonID = StampLogonID, @IsReleaserOrigin = IsReleaserOrigin FROM @Temp WHERE IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@IsReleaserOrigin = 1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				PrintJobsReleaser (PrintJobID)
			VALUES
				(@PrintJobID)
		END		

		IF (@StampLogonID <> '')
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				StampLogonJobs (StampLogonID, PrintJobID)
			VALUES
				(@StampLogonID, @PrintJobID)
		END	

		SELECT @QuotaDebitID = QuotaDebitID, @PrinterDeviceID = PrinterDeviceID FROM @Temp WHERE IDF = @PrimaryKey

		DECLARE @QuotasObjectType INT = 0
		SELECT @QuotasObjectType = QuotaParameterValue FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 35 -- QuotasObjectType (Users = 1, Shared = 2, Printers = 4)

		IF (@QuotasObjectType IN (1, 2))
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasDebits WHERE QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID)
			BEGIN
				--Atualiza o débito de cotas com o ID desse job
				UPDATE
					QuotasDebits
				SET
					PrintJobID = @PrintJobID,
					PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE
					QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--Cria na tabela de relação job x débito
				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintJobs WHERE QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO
						QuotasPrintJobs (PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, QuotaDebitHostID)
					VALUES
						(@PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @QuotaDebitID)
				END
			END
		END
		ELSE IF (@QuotasObjectType = 4)
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintersDebits WHERE QuotaPrinterDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID)
			BEGIN
				--Atualiza o débito de cotas com o ID desse job
				UPDATE
					QuotasPrintersDebits
				SET
					PrintJobID = @PrintJobID,
					PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE
					QuotaPrinterDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--Cria na tabela de relação job x débito
				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintersPrintJobs WHERE QuotaPrinterDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO
						QuotasPrintersPrintJobs (PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, QuotaPrinterDebitHostID)
					VALUES
						(@PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @QuotaDebitID)
				END
			END
		END

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasDebits WHERE QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID)
		BEGIN
			--Atualiza o débito de cotas com o ID desse job
			UPDATE
				QuotasDebits
			SET
				PrintJobID = @PrintJobID,
				PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE
				QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Cria na tabela de relação job x débito
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasPrintJobs WHERE QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitID)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO
					QuotasPrintJobs (PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, QuotaDebitHostID)
				VALUES
					(@PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @QuotaDebitID)
			END
		END
		
		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END	

		SET @PrimaryKeyPrevious = @PrimaryKey		
		
		SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
		FROM @Temp
		WHERE QuotaDebitID <> '' AND IDF > @PrimaryKey
		ORDER BY IDF
	END	

	-- Processa os jobs que só possuem informações de auditing
	SELECT @PrimaryKey = NULL, @PrimaryKeyPrevious = 0	
	
	SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
	FROM @Temp
	WHERE QuotaDebitID = ''
	ORDER BY IDF

	WHILE (@PrimaryKey IS NOT NULL AND @PrimaryKey > @PrimaryKeyPrevious)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			PrintJobs (PrinterQueueID,	PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID,
					   JobOriginID, PrintApplicationID, PrintWayID, PagesColor, PagesMono,
					   SpoolSize, 	Title,	CostMono, CostColor, DatePrinted, DateInclude,	CostAccountID, 
					   JobTypeID, SiteID, JobDisabled, WasLastPageColor, PrintStationID, IsCorporative)
			SELECT
				CASE WHEN PrinterQueueID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE PrinterQueueID END, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID,
				JobOriginID, PrintApplicationID, PrintWayID, PagesColor, PagesMono,
				SpoolSize, Title, ISNULL(CostMono,0), ISNULL(CostColor,0), DatePrinted, GETDATE(), 
				CASE WHEN CostAccountID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE CostAccountID END,
				JobTypeID, SiteID, 0, WasLastPageColor,	CASE WHEN PrintStationID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE PrintStationID END, IsCorporative
			FROM
				@Temp
			WHERE
				IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END	

		SELECT @PrintJobID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		SELECT @IsReleaserOrigin = IsReleaserOrigin FROM @Temp WHERE IDF = @PrimaryKey
	
		IF (@IsReleaserOrigin = 1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				PrintJobsReleaser (PrintJobID)
			VALUES
				(@PrintJobID)
		END	

		SET @PrimaryKeyPrevious = @PrimaryKey		
		
		SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
		FROM @Temp
		WHERE QuotaDebitID = '' AND IDF > @PrimaryKey--+1 Diego Removemos o +1 pois estava pulando os indices pares
		ORDER BY IDF ASC
	END				

	-- Processa os jobs que só possuem informações de codigo de rastreio
	SELECT @PrimaryKey = NULL, @PrimaryKeyPrevious = 0	
	
	SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
	FROM @Temp
	WHERE QuotaDebitID = '' AND (StampLogonID <> '' OR IsReleaserOrigin = 1)
	ORDER BY IDF

	WHILE (@PrimaryKey IS NOT NULL AND @PrimaryKey > @PrimaryKeyPrevious)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			PrintJobs (PrinterQueueID,	PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID,
					   JobOriginID, PrintApplicationID, PrintWayID, PagesColor, PagesMono,
					   SpoolSize, 	Title,	CostMono, CostColor, DatePrinted, DateInclude,	CostAccountID, 
					   JobTypeID, SiteID, JobDisabled, WasLastPageColor, PrintStationID, IsCorporative)
			SELECT
				CASE WHEN PrinterQueueID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE PrinterQueueID END, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID,
				JobOriginID, PrintApplicationID, PrintWayID, PagesColor, PagesMono,
				SpoolSize, Title, ISNULL(CostMono,0), ISNULL(CostColor,0), DatePrinted, GETDATE(), 
				CASE WHEN CostAccountID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE CostAccountID END,
				JobTypeID, SiteID, 0, WasLastPageColor,	CASE WHEN PrintStationID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE PrintStationID END, IsCorporative
			FROM
				@Temp
			WHERE
				IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END	

		SELECT @PrintJobID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		SELECT @StampLogonID = StampLogonID, @IsReleaserOrigin = IsReleaserOrigin FROM @Temp WHERE IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@StampLogonID <> '')
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				StampLogonJobs (StampLogonID, PrintJobID)
			VALUES
				(@StampLogonID, @PrintJobID)
		END	
		
		IF (@IsReleaserOrigin = 1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				PrintJobsReleaser (PrintJobID)
			VALUES
				(@PrintJobID)
		END		

		SET @PrimaryKeyPrevious = @PrimaryKey		
		
		SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
		FROM @Temp
		WHERE QuotaDebitID = '' AND (StampLogonID <> '' OR IsReleaserOrigin = 1) AND IDF > @PrimaryKey
		ORDER BY IDF ASC
	END				

	-- Processa os jobs que possuem informações da porcentagem do EcoToner
	SELECT @PrimaryKey = NULL, @PrimaryKeyPrevious = 0	
	
	SELECT TOP 1 @PrimaryKey = IDF	
	FROM @Temp
	WHERE QuotaDebitID = '' AND StampLogonID = '' AND IsReleaserOrigin = 0
	ORDER BY IDF

	WHILE (@PrimaryKey IS NOT NULL AND @PrimaryKey > @PrimaryKeyPrevious)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			PrintJobs (PrinterQueueID,	PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID,
					   JobOriginID, PrintApplicationID, PrintWayID, PagesColor, PagesMono,
					   SpoolSize, 	Title,	CostMono, CostColor, DatePrinted, DateInclude,	CostAccountID, 
					   JobTypeID, SiteID, JobDisabled, WasLastPageColor, PrintStationID, IsCorporative)
			SELECT
				CASE WHEN PrinterQueueID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE PrinterQueueID END, PrinterDeviceID, AccountID, PaperSizeID, PrintQualityID,
				JobOriginID, PrintApplicationID, PrintWayID, PagesColor, PagesMono,
				SpoolSize, Title, ISNULL(CostMono,0), ISNULL(CostColor,0), DatePrinted, GETDATE(), 
				CASE WHEN CostAccountID = -1 THEN NULL ELSE CostAccountID END,
				JobTypeID, SiteID, 0, WasLastPageColor,	CASE WHEN PrintStationID = 0 THEN NULL ELSE PrintStationID END, IsCorporative
			FROM
				@Temp
			WHERE
				IDF = @PrimaryKey

		IF (@@Error <> 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK
			RAISERROR('Erro ao inserir o lote de PrintJobs', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END	

		SELECT @PrintJobID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		SET @PrimaryKeyPrevious = @PrimaryKey

		CubeUserAccountWeek.EN = CubeUserAccountWeek.EN + C.EN, CubeUserAccountWeek.EV = CubeUserAccountWeek.EV + C.EV
	FROM (
			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, AccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
					SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
					SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV,

					SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
					SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
					SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, dia
			FROM (
				SELECT	Data, AccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
							SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
							SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
							SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
							SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
							SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
							SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
							SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV,
							CASE WHEN DAY(Data) < 8 THEN 1 
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 15 AND DAY(Data) > 7 THEN 8
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 22 AND DAY(Data) > 14 THEN 15
								 WHEN DAY(Data) > 21 THEN 22 END AS dia
				FROM @User 
				GROUP BY Data, AccountID) AS Te
			GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , AccountID
			UNION ALL
			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, AccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
						SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
						SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
						SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
						SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
						SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
						SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
						SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, dia
			FROM (
					SELECT	Data, AccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
							SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
							SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV,

							SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
							SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
							SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, 28 AS dia
					FROM @User 
					GROUP BY Data, AccountID) AS Te
			GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , AccountID) AS C
	WHERE
		CubeUserAccountWeek.yearw = C.Ano  AND  
		CubeUserAccountWeek.monthw = C.Mes AND 
		CubeUserAccountWeek.dayw = C.Dia  AND
		CubeUserAccountWeek.AccountID = C.AccountID

			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, PrinterQueueID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
						SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
						SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
						SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
						SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
						SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
						SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
						SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, dia
			FROM (
					SELECT	Data, PrinterQueueID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
							SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
							SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
							SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
							SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
							SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
							SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
							SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, 
							CASE WHEN DAY(Data) < 8 THEN 1 
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 15 AND DAY(Data) > 7 THEN 8
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 22 AND DAY(Data) > 14 THEN 15
								 WHEN DAY(Data) > 21 THEN 22 END AS dia
					FROM @Queue
					GROUP BY Data, PrinterQueueID) AS Te
			GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , PrinterQueueID
			UNION ALL
			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, PrinterQueueID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
						SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
						SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
						SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
						SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
						SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
						SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
						SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, dia
			FROM (
					SELECT	Data, PrinterQueueID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
							SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
							SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
							SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
							SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
							SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
							SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
							SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, 28 AS dia
					FROM @Queue
					GROUP BY Data, PrinterQueueID) AS Te
	GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , PrinterQueueID) AS C
	WHERE	CubeQueuePrinterWeek.yearw = C.Ano  AND  
			CubeQueuePrinterWeek.monthw = C.Mes AND 
			CubeQueuePrinterWeek.dayw = C.Dia  AND
			CubeQueuePrinterWeek.PrinterQueueID = C.PrinterQueueID
	
	IF(@@Error <> 0 )

		RETURN
	END	

	UPDATE CubeMachineIDWeek
	SET CubeMachineIDWeek.CDFN = CubeMachineIDWeek.CDFN + C.CDFN, CubeMachineIDWeek.CDFV = CubeMachineIDWeek.CDFV + C.CDFV, CubeMachineIDWeek.CDCN = CubeMachineIDWeek.CDCN + C.CDCN,
		CubeMachineIDWeek.CDCV = CubeMachineIDWeek.CDCV + C.CDCV, CubeMachineIDWeek.CDIN = CubeMachineIDWeek.CDIN + C.CDIN,	CubeMachineIDWeek.CDIV = CubeMachineIDWeek.CDIV + C.CDIV,
		CubeMachineIDWeek.CSFN = CubeMachineIDWeek.CSFN + C.CSFN, CubeMachineIDWeek.CSFV = CubeMachineIDWeek.CSFV + C.CSFV,	CubeMachineIDWeek.CSCN = CubeMachineIDWeek.CSCN + C.CSCN,
		CubeMachineIDWeek.CSCV = CubeMachineIDWeek.CSCV + C.CSCV, CubeMachineIDWeek.CSIN = CubeMachineIDWeek.CSIN + C.CSIN, CubeMachineIDWeek.CSIV = CubeMachineIDWeek.CSIV + C.CSIV,

		CubeMachineIDWeek.PSFN = CubeMachineIDWeek.PSFN + C.PSFN, CubeMachineIDWeek.PSFV = CubeMachineIDWeek.PSFV + C.PSFV,	CubeMachineIDWeek.PSCN = CubeMachineIDWeek.PSCN + C.PSCN,

		CubeMachineIDWeek.EN = CubeMachineIDWeek.EN + C.EN, CubeMachineIDWeek.EV = CubeMachineIDWeek.EV + C.EV
	FROM (
			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, MachineID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
					SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
					SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
					SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
					SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
					SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
					SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,

					SELECT	Data, MachineID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
							SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
							SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
							SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
							SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
							SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
							SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
							SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV,
							CASE WHEN DAY(Data) < 8 THEN 1 
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 15 AND DAY(Data) > 7 THEN 8
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 22 AND DAY(Data) > 14 THEN 15
								 WHEN DAY(Data) > 21 THEN 22 END AS dia
					FROM @Machine
					GROUP BY Data, MachineID) AS Te
			GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , MachineID
			UNION ALL
			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, MachineID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
						SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
						SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
						SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
						SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
						SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
						SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
						SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV,	dia
			FROM (
					SELECT	Data, MachineID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
								SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
								SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
								SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
								SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV,

								SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
								SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, 28 AS dia
						FROM @Machine
						GROUP BY Data, MachineID) AS Te
	GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , MachineID) AS C
	WHERE	CubeMachineIDWeek.yearw = C.Ano  AND

	UPDATE CubeCostAccountIDWeek

		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CDCV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CDCV + C.CDCV, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CDIN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CDIN + C.CDIN,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CDIV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CDIV + C.CDIV,
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSFN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSFN + C.CSFN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSFV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSFV + C.CSFV,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSCN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSCN + C.CSCN,
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSCV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSCV + C.CSCV,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSIN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSIN + C.CSIN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSIV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CSIV + C.CSIV, 
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDFN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDFN + C.PDFN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDFV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDFV + C.PDFV, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDCN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDCN + C.PDCN, 
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDCV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDCV + C.PDCV, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIN + C.PDIN,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIV + C.PDIV,
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFN + C.PSFN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFV + C.PSFV,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCN + C.PSCN, 
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCV + C.PSCV,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIN + C.PSIN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIV + C.PSIV,
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.TotJobs = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.TotJobs + C.TotJobs,
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SN + C.SN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SV + C.SV,
		CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EN + C.EN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EV + C.EV
	FROM (
			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, CostAccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
					SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
					SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
					SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
					SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
					SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
					SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
					SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, dia
			FROM (
					SELECT	Data, CostAccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
							SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
							SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
							SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
							SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
							SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
							SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
							SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, 
							CASE WHEN DAY(Data) < 8 THEN 1 
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 15 AND DAY(Data) > 7 THEN 8
								 WHEN DAY(Data) < 22 AND DAY(Data) > 14 THEN 15
								 WHEN DAY(Data) > 21 THEN 22 END AS dia
					FROM @CostAccount
					GROUP BY Data, CostAccountID) AS Te
			GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , CostAccountID
			UNION ALL
			SELECT	YEAR(Data) AS ano, MONTH(data) AS mes, CostAccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
						SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
						SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
						SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN, 
						SUM (PSFV) AS PSFV, SUM (PSCN) AS PSCN, SUM (PSCV) AS PSCV, SUM (PSIN) AS PSIN, SUM (PSIV) AS PSIV, 
						SUM (TotJobs) AS TotJobs,
						SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
						SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, dia
			FROM (
					SELECT	Data, CostAccountID, SUM (CDFN) AS CDFN,  SUM (CDFV) AS CDFV, SUM (CDCN) AS CDCN, SUM (CDCV) AS CDCV, 
							SUM (CDIN) AS CDIN, SUM (CDIV) AS CDIV, SUM (CSFN) AS CSFN, SUM (CSFV) AS CSFV, SUM (CSCN) AS CSCN, 
							SUM (CSCV) AS CSCV, SUM (CSIN) AS CSIN, SUM (CSIV) AS CSIV, SUM (PDFN) AS PDFN,  SUM (PDFV) AS PDFV, 
							SUM (PDCN) AS PDCN, SUM (PDCV) AS PDCV, SUM (PDIN) AS PDIN, SUM (PDIV) AS PDIV, SUM (PSFN) AS PSFN,

							SUM (SN) AS SN, SUM (SV) AS SV,
							SUM (EN) AS EN, SUM (EV) AS EV, 28 AS dia
					FROM @CostAccount
					GROUP BY Data, CostAccountID) AS Te
	GROUP BY YEAR(Data), MONTH(data), dia , CostAccountID) AS C
	WHERE   CubeCostAccountIDWeek.yearw = C.Ano  AND

			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.dayw = C.Dia  AND

	IF (@@Error <> 0)
	BEGIN
		ROLLBACK

	-- Finaliza o processamento de um arquivo de Jobs ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	INSERT INTO

## 462. proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveBureau

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveBureau] 
@PrintJobID INT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		SUM(PPJ.PagesMono +  PPJ.PagesColor) AS Pages, 
		CASE PagesMono WHEN 0 THEN 'Color' ELSE 'Mono' END AS Color,
		SUM(PPJ.CostMono + PPJ.CostColor) AS Cost,
		PrintWays.PrintWayName,
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName,  
		PrintQualities.PrintQualityName, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName, 
		--CostCenters.CostCenterName, 
		[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](PPJ.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
		PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName, 
		PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName, 
		Accounts.LogonName,
		Domains.DomainName,
		BureauResources.BureauResourceName,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Cost AS CostBureau,
		PPJ.DatePrinted AS [Date],
		BureauJobs.AdditionalInformation,
		BureauJobs.Notes,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Quantity
	FROM
		PrintJobs PPJ
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON (PPJ.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID)  
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON (PPJ.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID)
		INNER JOIN PrintQualities ON (PPJ.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID)
		INNER JOIN PapersSize ON (PPJ.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID)
		INNER JOIN Accounts ON (PPJ.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID)
		--LEFT JOIN CostCenters ON (PPJ.CostCenterID = CostCenters.CostCenterID)
		INNER JOIN PrintWays ON (PPJ.PrintWayID = PrintWays.PrintWayID)
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON (PPJ.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID)  
		LEFT JOIN Machines ON (PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID) 
		INNER JOIN Domains ON (Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID)
		LEFT JOIN BureauJobs ON (PPJ.PrintJobID = BureauJobs.PrintJobID)
		INNER JOIN BureauResourcesJobs ON (PPJ.PrintJobID = BureauResourcesJobs.PrintJobID)
		INNER JOIN BureauResources ON (BureauResourcesJobs.BureauResourceID = BureauResources.BureauResourceID)
	WHERE
		PPJ.PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
	GROUP BY
		PPJ.PagesMono, 
		PPJ.CostMono, 
		PPJ.CostAccountID,
		PrintWays.PrintWayName, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintQualities.PrintQualityName,
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName, 
		--CostCenters.CostCenterName, 
		PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName,
		PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName,
		Accounts.LogonName,
		Domains.DomainName,
		PPJ.DatePrinted,
		BureauResources.BureauResourceName,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Cost,
		BureauJobs.AdditionalInformation,
		BureauJobs.Notes,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Quantity

END
```

## 463. proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveToWebService

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveToWebService]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@Summarize BIT = 0,
@FilterDateType BIT = 0 --0 = Por data da impressão 1 = Por data de inclusão

AS

BEGIN

	--#######################################################
	-- 02-06-2014 - Rafael,
	--	Procedure utilizada pelo WebService nJWS_5
	--
	-- 2021-04-01, Héber Savedra
	-- Removido o agrupamento incorreto do campo PagesMono
	--#######################################################

	--#######################################################
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--#######################################################

	DECLARE @AccountID INT
	SET @AccountID = -1
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT
	SET @CostAccountID = -1

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--#######################################################
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	--########################################################

	DECLARE @strWhereDate NVARCHAR (200)	
	DECLARE @strEndDateTime NVARCHAR (100) 
	DECLARE @strStartDateTime NVARCHAR (100) 

	SET @strStartDateTime = CAST(DATEPART(yyyy, @StartDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mm, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(dd, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ' ' +
							CAST(DATEPART(hh, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mi, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(ss, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) 

	SET @strEndDateTime   = CAST(DATEPART(yyyy, @EndDateTime)	AS CHAR(4)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mm, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(dd, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ' ' +
							CAST(DATEPART(hh, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mi, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(ss, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) 

	IF @FilterDateType = 0
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DatePrinted  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END
	ELSE IF @FilterDateType = 1
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DateInclude  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END

	IF @Summarize = 1
	BEGIN
		EXEC ('	
			DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT)
	
			IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](' +@CostAccountID+ ')
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 2)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
						SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](' + @AccountIDOwner + ')
				END
			END

			SELECT
				* 
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT  
						Accounts.LogonName AS LogonName,
						Accounts.FullName AS FullName,
						[Domains].DomainName AS DomainName,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountName , dbo.GetString(1) )AS CostAccount,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountCode , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS CostAccountCode,
						ISNULL(Machines.MachineName,''-'') AS Machine, 
						ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(Machines.MachineID) , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS MachineIP, 
						REPLACE(PrintersDevices.PrinterDevicename,'';'','','') AS PrinterName,
						--PrintersDevices.AddressPort AS Porta_da_Impressora, 
						PrintersDevices.AddressName AS PrinterAddress,
						ISNULL(SerialNumber, ''-'') AS SerialNumber,
						CASE         
							WHEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) > 0  THEN 1 -- Mono
							ELSE 0 -- Color
						END AS IsColor,
						CASE         
							WHEN PrintJobs.PrintWayID = 0  THEN 0 --Simplex
							ELSE 1 --Duplex
						END AS IsDuplex,
						PrintQualities.PrintQualityName AS PrintQuality,
						PapersSize.PaperSizeName AS PaperSize,
						JobOrigins.OriginName AS JobOrigim, 
						JobTypes.TypeName AS JobType,
						SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
						SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
						SUM(PrintJobs.CostMono) AS CostMono,
						SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor) AS CostColor
					FROM
						PrintJobs 
						INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
						INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID  
						INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
						INNER JOIN PapersSize ON PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersModels ON PrintersModels.PrinterModelID = PrintersDevices.PrinterModelID
						LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
						LEFT JOIN Machines ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID 
						INNER JOIN Sites ON PrintJobs.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
						LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions ON PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionID 
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts ON printjobs.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
						LEFT JOIN JobOrigins ON PrintJobs.JobOriginID = JobOrigins.JobOriginID 
						LEFT JOIN JobTypes ON PrintJobs.JobTypeID = JobTypes.JobTypeID 
						LEFT JOIN PrintQualities ON PrintJobs.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID 
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND ' + @strWhereDate + '  
						(('+@UseORMethod+'= 0 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')AND 
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))OR
						('+@UseORMethod+'= 1 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')OR
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))))
					GROUP BY 
						Accounts.LogonName,
						Accounts.FullName,
						Domains.DomainName,
						CostAccounts.CostAccountName,
						CostAccounts.CostAccountCode,
						Machines.MachineName,
						Machines.MachineID, 
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName,
						PrintersDevices.AddressName,
						PrintersDevices.SerialNumber,
						PrintJobs.PrintWayID,
						PrintQualities.PrintQualityName,    
						PapersSize.PaperSizeName,
						JobOrigins.OriginName,
						JobTypes.TypeName) AS Details
					ORDER BY
						Details.FullName ASC
		');
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		EXEC ('	
			DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT)

			IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](' +@CostAccountID+ ')
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 2)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
						SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](' + @AccountIDOwner + ')
				END
			END
	
			SELECT
				* 
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT  
						Accounts.LogonName AS LogonName,
						Accounts.FullName AS FullName,
						[Domains].DomainName AS DomainName,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountName , dbo.GetString(1) )AS CostAccount,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountCode , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS CostAccountCode,
						ISNULL(Machines.MachineName,''-'') AS Machine, 
						ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(Machines.MachineID) , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS MachineIP, 
						REPLACE(PrintersDevices.PrinterDevicename,'';'','','') AS Printer,
						PrintersDevices.AddressPort AS PrinterPort, 
						Brands.BrandName AS PrinterBrand,
						REPLACE(PrintersModels.PrinterModelName,'';'','','') AS PrinterModel,
						PrintersDevices.AddressName AS PrinterAddress,
						CASE WHEN PrintersDevices.IsLocal = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS PrinterType,
						ISNULL(SerialNumber, ''-'') AS SerialNumber,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName,''-'') AS PrinterQueue,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.Port,''-'') AS PrinterQueuePort,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.ShareName,dbo.GetString(1)) AS SharedQueue,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.Driver,''-'') AS Driver,
						Sites.SiteName AS [Site],
						ISNULL(SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionName, ''-'') AS Department, 
						CASE         
							WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN 1 -- Mono
							ELSE 0 -- Color
						END AS IsColor,	
						CASE         
							WHEN PrintJobs.PrintWayID = 0  THEN 0 --Simplex
							ELSE 1 --Duplex
						END AS IsDuplex,
						CASE
							WHEN PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID IS NULL THEN 0
							ELSE 1 
						END AS IsLogicalTrust,
						PrintQualities.PrintQualityName AS PrintQuality,
						PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName AS PrintApplication, 
						PrintJobs.SpoolSize AS SpoolSize,
						PapersSize.PaperSizeName AS PaperSize,
						JobOrigins.OriginName AS JobOrigin, 
						JobTypes.TypeName AS JobType,
						PrintJobs.DatePrinted AS DatePrinted,
						PrintJobs.DateInclude AS DateIncluded, 
						PrintJobs.PagesColor  AS PagesColor,
						PrintJobs.PagesMono AS PagesMono,
						PrintJobs.CostMono AS CostMono,
						PrintJobs.CostColor AS CostColor,
						PrintJobs.Title AS Title
					FROM
						PrintJobs 
						INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
						INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID  
						INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
						INNER JOIN PapersSize ON PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersModels ON PrintersModels.PrinterModelID = PrintersDevices.PrinterModelID
						INNER JOIN Brands ON PrintersModels.BrandID = Brands.BrandID
						LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
						LEFT JOIN Machines ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID 
						INNER JOIN Sites ON PrintJobs.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
						LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions ON PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionID 
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts ON printjobs.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
						LEFT JOIN JobOrigins ON PrintJobs.JobOriginID = JobOrigins.JobOriginID 
						LEFT JOIN JobTypes ON PrintJobs.JobTypeID = JobTypes.JobTypeID 
						LEFT JOIN PrintQualities ON PrintJobs.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID 
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND ' + @strWhereDate + '  
    					(('+@UseORMethod+'= 0 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')AND 
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))OR
						('+@UseORMethod+'= 1 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')OR
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))))
				) AS Details
			ORDER BY Details.FullName ASC
	');
	END

END
```

## 464. proc_PrintJobs_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintJobs_Update]
@PrintJobID bigint,
@PrinterQueueID int = null,
@PrinterDeviceID int = null,
@AccountID int = null,
@PaperSizeID int = null,
@PrintQualityID int = null,
@JobOriginID smallint= null,
@PrintApplicationID int = null,
@PrintWayID int = null,
@PagesColor int = null,
@PagesMono int = null,
@SpoolSize float = null,
@Title NVARCHAR(150) = null,
@DatePrinted datetime = null,
@Cost money = null,
@ProjectID int = null,
@WasLastPageColor bit = 0

AS

BEGIN
	IF @ProjectID = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @ProjectID = null
	END

	IF( @AccountID is null )
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PrintJobs
		SET
			PrinterQueueID = @PrinterQueueID,
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID,
			PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID,
			PrintQualityID = @PrintQualityID,
			JobOriginID = @JobOriginID,
			PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID,
			PrintWayID = @PrintWayID,
			PagesColor = @PagesColor,
			PagesMono = @PagesMono,
			SpoolSize = @SpoolSize, 
			CostMono  = ISNULL(dbo.TotalCostCalcMono (@PrinterDeviceID, @PrintWayID, @PaperSizeID, @PagesColor, @PagesMono, @WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID), 0),
			CostColor = ISNULL(dbo.TotalCostCalcColor(@PrinterDeviceID, @PrintWayID, @PaperSizeID, @PagesColor, @PagesMono, @WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID), 0),
			DatePrinted = @DatePrinted,
			DateInclude = GETDATE(),
			CostAccountID = dbo.GetCostAccountIDWithPeriod(@AccountID, 0, '2001-1-1')
		WHERE
			PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PrintJobs
		SET
			AccountID = @AccountID,
			Title = @Title
		WHERE
			PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
	END
	
	--DELETE FROM
	--	SAPPrintJobs
	--WHERE
	--	PrintJobID = @PrintJobID

END
```

## 465. proc_PrintQualities_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintQualities_Insert] 
@PrintQualityID INT,
@PrintQualityName NVARCHAR(255)

AS

BEGIN

	INSERT INTO
		PrintQualities (PrintQualityID, PrintQualityName)
	VALUES
		(@PrintQualityID, @PrintQualityName)

	--Atualiza o PrintQualityID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 11 --PrintQualityID
	END
	
END
```

## 468. proc_PrintersDevicesBillingRules_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevicesBillingRules_Insert] 
@BillingRule NVARCHAR(255),
@Description NVARCHAR(255),
@BillingRuleTypeID TINYINT

AS

BEGIN

	--Atualiza o PortID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 9 --PortID
	END
	
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevicesBillingRules WHERE BillingRule = @BillingRule))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE 
			PrintersDevicesBillingRules 
		SET 
			[Description] = @Description,
			BillingRuleTypeID = @BillingRuleTypeID
		WHERE 
			BillingRule = @BillingRule

		SELECT
			BillingRuleID
		FROM 
			PrintersDevicesBillingRules 
		WHERE 
			BillingRule = @BillingRule
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			PrintersDevicesBillingRules(BillingRule, [Description], BillingRuleTypeID) 
		VALUES
			(@BillingRule, @Description, @BillingRuleTypeID)
		
		SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	
END
```

## 473. proc_PrintersDevicesConsolidation_RetrieveAll_Grid

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevicesConsolidation_RetrieveAll_Grid]
@IsRetrievePrintersMain BIT

AS

BEGIN

      SELECT DISTINCT
            PD.PrinterDeviceID, 
            PD.PrinterDeviceName, 
            ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber, 
            PD.AddressName, 
            PD.AddressPort, 
            PC.CostGroupName,
            B.BrandName,
            PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
            S.SiteID,
            S.SiteName,
            SD.SiteDivisionID,
            ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '') AS SiteDivisionName, 
            ISNULL(PD.Location, '') AS Location,
            PD.IsLocal,
            dbo.[GetPrinterDeviceConsolidationBillingStatus](PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS EnabledBillingStatus
      FROM         
            PrintersDevices PD
            INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
            INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
            INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
            INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID 
            LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID
      WHERE
            (
                  (@IsRetrievePrintersMain = 1 AND PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceMainID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation))
                  OR 
                  (@IsRetrievePrintersMain = 0 AND PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation))
            )
END
```

## 474. proc_PrintersDevicesCountersConfig_Set

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevicesCountersConfig_Set]
@IsLifeCounter BIT = NULL,
@BrandID INT = NULL,
@PrinterModelID INT = NULL,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@ProductionIsLife BIT = NULL,
@ComplementType INT = NULL,
@AdjustType INT = NULL

AS
BEGIN

	IF (@IsLifeCounter IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--PARTE DE HELP
		SET NOCOUNT ON

		print '*********************************************************************************************************************'
		print 'Help da Procedure'
		print '*********************************************************************************************************************'
		print ''
		print '**** Listar Configuração atual e ver HELP ***************************************************************************'
		print ''
		print 'exec [proc_PrintersDevicesCountersConfig_Set]'
		print ''
		print '*********************************************************************************************************************'
		print ''
		print '**** Configurar o contador de produção ******************************************************************************'
		print ''
		print 'exec [proc_PrintersDevicesCountersConfig_Set] 0, @ID_DO_FABRICANTE, @ID_DO_MODELO, @ID_DA_IMPRESSORA, @ORIGEM_DOS_DADOS, @TIPO_DO_COMPLEMENTO, @TIPO_DE_AJUSTE,'
		print ''
		print 'Onde:'
		print '		Substituir @ID_DO_FABRICANTE pelo ID correspondente caso a regra seja por fabricante.'
		print '			Caso a regra não seja por fabricante passar NULL.'
		print '			Para descobrir o id do fabricante: SELECT * FROM Brands WHERE BrandName = ''MEUFABRICANTE'''
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @ID_DO_MODELO pelo ID correspondente caso a regra seja por modelo.'
		print '			Caso a regra não seja por modelo passar NULL. Não precisa passar o ID do fabricante quando esta passando o modelo.'
		print '			Para descobrir o id do fabricante: SELECT * FROM PrintersModels PM INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID WHERE BrandName = ''MEUFABRICANTE'' AND PrinterModelName = ''MEUMODELO'''
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @ID_DA_IMPRESSORA pelo ID correspondente caso a regra seja por impressora.'
		print '			Caso a regra não seja por impressora passar NULL. Não precisa passar o ID do fabricante nem do modelo quando esta passando a impressora.'
		print '			Para descobrir o id da impressora : SELECT * FROM PrintersDevices WHERE (filtro à sua escolha)'
		print ''
		print '		Ou seja, se a regra for geral, todos os três parâmetros anteriores terão valor NULL'
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @ORIGEM_DOS_DADOS pelo valor correspondente:'
		print '			 0 - Indica que será usado a SOMA DOS CONTADORES DE IMPRESSÃO para obter o contador de produção'
		print '			 1 - Indica que será usado O CONTADOR DE VIDA para obter o contador de produção'		
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @TIPO_DO_COMPLEMENTO pelo valor correspondente: (APENAS QUANDO A ORIGEM DOS DADOS FOR DO CONTADOR DE VIDA, CASO CONTRÁRIO PASSAR NULL)'
		print '			 0 - Sem complemento. Usa o valor original obtido'
		print '			 1 - Usar soma de impressão em mono e color se ambos os valores encontrados foi 0'
		print '			 2 - Usar soma de impressão em mono e color sempre'
		print '			 3 - Usar soma de impressão em color se o valor encontrado foi 0'
		print '			 4 - Usar soma de impressão em color sempre'
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @TIPO_DE_AJUSTE pelo valor correspondente:'
		print '			 0 - Não irá ajustar valores. Será utilizado o valor original (exceto para os contadores de referência onde será usada a configuração de ajuste 1).'
		print '			 1 - Ajusta o contador Mono para ser igual ao contador Total subtraido do contador Color.'
		print '			 2 - Ajusta o contador Total para ser igual ao contador Mono adicionado do contador Color (exceto para os contadores de referência onde será usada a configuração de ajuste 1).'
		print '*********************************************************************************************************************'
		print ''
		print '**** Configurar o contador de vida ******************************************************************************'
		print ''
		print 'exec [proc_PrintersDevicesCountersConfig_Set] 1, @ID_DO_FABRICANTE, @ID_DO_MODELO, @ID_DA_IMPRESSORA, NULL, @TIPO_DO_COMPLEMENTO, @TIPO_DE_AJUSTE,'
		print ''
		print 'Onde:'
		print '		Substituir @ID_DO_FABRICANTE pelo ID correspondente caso a regra seja por fabricante.'
		print '			Caso a regra não seja por fabricante passar NULL.'
		print '			Para descobrir o id do fabricante: SELECT * FROM Brands WHERE BrandName = ''MEUFABRICANTE'''
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @ID_DO_MODELO pelo ID correspondente caso a regra seja por modelo.'
		print '			Caso a regra não seja por modelo passar NULL. Não precisa passar o ID do fabricante quando esta passando o modelo.'
		print '			Para descobrir o id do fabricante: SELECT * FROM PrintersModels PM INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID WHERE BrandName = ''MEUFABRICANTE'' AND PrinterModelName = ''MEUMODELO'''
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @ID_DA_IMPRESSORA pelo ID correspondente caso a regra seja por impressora.'
		print '			Caso a regra não seja por impressora passar NULL. Não precisa passar o ID do fabricante nem do modelo quando esta passando a impressora.'
		print '			Para descobrir o id da impressora : SELECT * FROM PrintersDevices WHERE (filtro à sua escolha)'
		print ''
		print '		Ou seja, se a regra for geral, todos os três parâmetros anteriores terão valor NULL'
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @TIPO_DO_COMPLEMENTO pelo valor correspondente:'
		print '			 0 - Sem complemento. Usa o valor original obtido'
		print '			 1 - Usar soma de impressão em mono e color se ambos os valores encontrados foi 0'
		print '			 2 - Usar soma de impressão em mono e color sempre'
		print '			 3 - Usar soma de impressão em color se o valor encontrado foi 0'
		print '			 4 - Usar soma de impressão em color sempre'
		print ''
		print '		Substituir @TIPO_DE_AJUSTE pelo valor correspondente:'
		print '			 0 - Não irá ajustar valores. Será utilizado o valor original.'
		print '			 1 - Ajusta o contador Mono para ser igual ao contador Total subtraído do contador Color.'
		print '			 2 - Ajusta o contador Total para ser igual ao contador Mono adicionado do contador Color.'
		print '*********************************************************************************************************************'
		

		SELECT 
			CASE IsLifeCounter WHEN 1 THEN 'Regra do contador de vida' ELSE 'Regra do contador de produção' END AS Tipo, 		
			CASE ISNULL(PDCC.PrinterBrandID,0) WHEN 0 THEN '-' ELSE 'Fabricante ' + b1.BrandName END AS Fabricante,
			CASE ISNULL(PDCC.ModelID,0) WHEN 0 THEN '-' ELSE 'Modelo ' + b2.BrandName +  ' ' + pm.PrinterModelName END AS Modelo,	
			CASE ISNULL(PDCC.printerdeviceid,0) WHEN 0 THEN '-' ELSE 'Impressora ' + pd.PrinterDeviceName +  ' ' + pd.SerialNumber + ' '  + pd.AddressName END AS impressora,	
			CASE AdjustType WHEN 0 THEN 'Sem ajuste' WHEN 1 THEN 'Mono = Total - Color' ELSE 'Total = Mono + Color' END AS Ajuste, 		
			CASE ISNULL(ComplementType,0) WHEN 0 THEN 'Sem complemento/não se aplica' 
				WHEN 1 THEN 'Usar soma de impressão em mono e color se ambos forem 0'
				WHEN 2 THEN 'Usar soma de impressão em mono e color sempre'
				WHEN 3 THEN 'Usar soma de impressão em color se for 0'		
				ELSE 'Usar soma de impressão em color sempre' END AS Complemento, 		
			CASE ISNULL(cast(ProductionIsLife AS int),2) WHEN 2 THEN '-' WHEN 1 THEN 'Usar contador de vida' ELSE 'Usar soma dos contadores de impressão' END AS ContadorDeProdução	
		FROM 
			PrintersDevicesCountersConfig PDCC
			LEFT JOIN Brands B1 ON PDCC.PrinterBrandID = B1.BRANDID
			LEFT JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PDCC.ModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
			LEFT JOIN Brands B2 ON PM.BrandID = B2.BrandID
			LEFT JOIN PrintersDevices pd on pdcc.PrinterDeviceID = pd.PrinterDeviceID


		RETURN 
	END

	DECLARE @message NVARCHAR(100)

	IF (@IsLifeCounter IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN


			--CONFIRGURAR O CONTADOR 

			IF(@BrandID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @PrinterModelID = NULL
				SET @PrinterDeviceID = NULL
			END
			ELSE IF(@PrinterModelID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @BrandID = NULL
				SET @PrinterDeviceID = NULL
			END
			ELSE IF (@PrinterDeviceID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @BrandID = NULL
				SET @PrinterModelID = NULL
			END

			IF (@IsLifeCounter = 1)
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'ORIGEM DE DADOS FORÇADA PARA NULL'
				SET @ProductionIsLife = NULL --nao tem origem de dados para o contador de vida. Já o de vida.
				
				IF ((@ComplementType IS NULL) OR (@ComplementType > 4)) --PRECISA PASSAR UM COMPLEMENTO VÁLIDO
				BEGIN
					SET @message = 'TIPO DE COMPLEMENTO INVÁLIDO'
					RAISERROR( @message ,0,1) WITH NOWAIT 
					RETURN
				END
				
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				IF (@ProductionIsLife IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					--PRECISA PASSAR VALOR ENTAO RETORNA ERRO			
					SET @message = 'É PRECISO INFORMAR A @ORIGEM_DOS_DADOS PARA O CONTADOR DE PRODUÇÃO'
					RAISERROR( @message ,0,1) WITH NOWAIT 
					RETURN
				END

				IF (@ProductionIsLife = 0)
				BEGIN 
					PRINT 'COMPLEMENTO FORÇADO PARA NULL'
					SET @ComplementType = NULL --A PRODUÇÃO JÁ É O DE IMPRESSOA NAO TEM ONDE COMPLEMENTAR
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF ((@ComplementType IS NULL) OR (@ComplementType > 4))
					BEGIN
						SET @message = 'TIPO DE COMPLEMENTO INVÁLIDO'
						RAISERROR( @message ,0,1) WITH NOWAIT 
						RETURN
					END
				END


			END
		
			IF ((@AdjustType IS NULL) OR (@AdjustType > 2))
			BEGIN
				SET @message = 'TIPO DE AJUSTE INVÁLIDO'
				RAISERROR( @message ,0,1) WITH NOWAIT 
				RETURN
			END

		
			IF (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevicesCountersConfig WHERE IsLifeCounter = @IsLifeCounter AND 
						((@BrandID IS NULL AND PrinterBrandID IS NULL) OR (@BrandID IS NOT NULL AND PrinterBrandID = @BrandID)) AND
						((@PrinterModelID  IS NULL AND ModelID IS NULL) OR (@PrinterModelID IS NOT NULL AND ModelID = @PrinterModelID)) AND
						((@PrinterDeviceID  IS NULL AND PrinterDeviceID IS NULL) OR (@PrinterDeviceID IS NOT NULL AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID))))
			BEGIN

				PRINT '--ATUALIZAR'
				UPDATE 
					PrintersDevicesCountersConfig
				SET
					AdjustType = @AdjustType,
					ComplementType = @ComplementType,
					ProductionIsLife = @ProductionIsLife
				WHERE 
					IsLifeCounter = @IsLifeCounter AND 
					((@BrandID IS NULL AND PrinterBrandID IS NULL) OR (@BrandID IS NOT NULL AND PrinterBrandID = @BrandID)) AND
					((@PrinterModelID  IS NULL AND ModelID IS NULL) OR (@PrinterModelID IS NOT NULL AND ModelID = @PrinterModelID)) AND
					((@PrinterDeviceID  IS NULL AND PrinterDeviceID IS NULL) OR (@PrinterDeviceID IS NOT NULL AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID))
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				PRINT '--INSERIR'
				INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesCountersConfig VALUES (@IsLifeCounter,@BrandID,@PrinterModelID,@PrinterDeviceID,@AdjustType,@ComplementType,@ProductionIsLife) 

			END
			
			--pegar o comportamento do contador de referencia
			DECLARE @ReferenceCounterType BIT = 0
			SELECT @ReferenceCounterType = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName  = 'UseProductionAsReferenceCounter'
	
			IF (@ReferenceCounterType = 1)
			BEGIN	
				--RECALCULAR OS CONTADORES DE REFERENCIA.
				exec [proc_CountersReadings_RecalcX] NULL, NULL, @PrinterDeviceID, @PrinterModelID, @BrandID 
			END


		END

END
```

## 475. proc_PrintersDevicesCountersPlotters_Insert

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevicesCountersPlotters_Insert]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@CounterTypeID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME,
@CounterValue DECIMAL(18,6),
@DateInclude DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Found SMALLINT
	SELECT
		@Found = COUNT(PrinterDeviceCounterPlotterID)
	FROM
		PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND CounterTypeID = @CounterTypeID
		AND DateTimeRead = @DateTimeRead

	IF (@Found = 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter
			(PrinterDeviceID, CounterTypeID, DateTimeRead, CounterValue, DateInclude)
		VALUES
			(@PrinterDeviceID, @CounterTypeID, @DateTimeRead, @CounterValue, @DateInclude)

		SELECT Scope_Identity()
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT -1
		RETURN
	END

END

## 479. proc_PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize_Update] 
@CostGroupID INT,
@PaperSizeID INT,
@CostMono DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostColor DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostDuplexMono DECIMAL(19,6),
@CostDuplexColor DECIMAL(19,6)

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Found SMALLINT

    SELECT 
		@Found = COUNT(PaperSizeID)
	FROM 
		PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize
    WHERE 
		CostGroupID = @CostGroupID
		AND PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID

    IF (@Found <= 0)
    BEGIN
		INSERT INTO 
			PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize (CostGroupID, PaperSizeID, CostMono, CostColor, CostDuplexMono, CostDuplexColor)
		VALUES 
			(@CostGroupID, @PaperSizeID, @CostMono, @CostColor, @CostDuplexMono, @CostDuplexColor)
	END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        UPDATE 
			PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize             
        SET  
			CostMono = @CostMono,
			CostColor = @CostColor,
			CostDuplexColor = @CostDuplexMono,
			CostDuplexMono = @CostDuplexColor
        WHERE 
			CostGroupID = @CostGroupID
			AND PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID
	END
	
	--Atualiza o CostGroupID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 8 --CostGroupID
	END
	
END
```

## 485. proc_PrintersDevices_ConsolidatePrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_ConsolidatePrinter] 
@PrinterDeviceMainID INT,
@PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID INT
AS
BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 01/03/2013
	--** Revisto para a versão 5.0
	--*******************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @IDMain INT

	IF (@PrinterDeviceMainID = @PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID)
	BEGIN
		--Não existe consolidação pra ela mesma. Entao se por acaso é isso que esta tentando fazer na verdade remove a referencia.
		DELETE FROM
			PrintersDevicesConsolidation
		WHERE 
			PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-- Pega se a impressora que estou colocando como main na verdade já não é slave de alguém. 
		-- Se for, usa o principal dela como principal dessa
		SET @IDMain = @PrinterDeviceMainID		
		SELECT @IDMain = PrinterDeviceMainID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation WHERE PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceMainID --se não tem registro vai permanecer com esse id, se não vai mudar

		--se ja existe atualiza
		IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation WHERE PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE 
				PrintersDevicesConsolidation 
			SET 
				PrinterDeviceMainID = @IDMain 
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- Não tem, cria
			INSERT INTO
				PrintersDevicesConsolidation (PrinterDeviceMainID, PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID) 
			VALUES 
				(@IDMain, @PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID)
			
			-- e já altera os possíveis que estavam com essa impressora como main só que agora ela é slave de alguem então o main dela passa a ser a main das que ela era main
			UPDATE 
				PrintersDevicesConsolidation 
			SET 
				PrinterDeviceMainID = @IDMain 
			WHERE 
				PrinterDeviceMainID = @PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
		END	
		
		--Pega todas as impressoras consolidadas para a impressora principal e cria o registo no auditings
		INSERT INTO
			PrintersDevicesAuditings 
		SELECT
			PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID,
			2,
			GETUTCDATE(),
			4,
			20,
			PrinterDeviceMainID
		FROM 
			PrintersDevicesConsolidation 
		WHERE
			PrinterDeviceMainID = @IDMain
		
	END
	
	--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 5	--PrinterDeviceID
	END
	
	--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceConsolidationID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 19 --PrinterDeviceConsolidationID
	END
	
END
```

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_GroupsRules_Insert]
@GroupRule NVARCHAR(100),
@CostGroupID INT

AS

BEGIN

	IF(NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM PrintersDevicesGroupsRules WHERE GroupRule = @GroupRule))
	BEGIN

		DECLARE @Priority INT

		SELECT
			@Priority = ISNULL(MAX(Priority),0) + 1
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesGroupsRules

		INSERT INTO
			PrintersDevicesGroupsRules
		VALUES
			(@GroupRule, @CostGroupID, @Priority)

		SELECT @@IDENTITY
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_GroupsRules_RetrieveDevices]
@GroupRule NVARCHAR(100),
@PrintersDefaultGroup BIT

AS

BEGIN



	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
	WHERE
		((PM.PrinterModelName LIKE '%' + @GroupRule + '%') OR (PM.CorrectName <> '' AND PM.CorrectName LIKE '%' + @GroupRule + '%'))
		AND
		(

			OR
			(@PrintersDefaultGroup = 0)
		)

## 493. proc_PrintersDevices_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_Insert]
@PrinterDeviceName NVARCHAR(200),
@SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50),
@AddressName NVARCHAR(50),
@AddressPort NVARCHAR(100),
@AddressMAC NVARCHAR(50),
@PrinterModelID INT,
@IsLocal BIT,
@IsUSBPort BIT,
@SiteID INT,
@CostGroupID INT,
@EnabledBillingStatus TINYINT,
@EnabledCounterStatus TINYINT,
@EngagedStatus TINYINT,
@Model NVARCHAR(255)

AS

BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************************************
	--** 28/02/2020, Diego Antunes
	--** Inserido campo UpdatedDate
	--*******************************************************************************************************

	IF (@SerialNumber IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 0))
	BEGIN
		SET @SerialNumber = ''
	END

	IF (@AddressMAC IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 1))
	BEGIN
		SET @AddressMAC = ''
	END
	
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceIDFound INT

	SELECT @PrinterDeviceIDFound = [dbo].[GetPrinterDeviceID](-1, @AddressName, @AddressPort, @Model, @SerialNumber, @AddressMAC)

	IF(@PrinterDeviceIDFound = 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			PrintersDevices
			(
				PrinterDeviceName,
				SerialNumber,
				AddressName,
				AddressPort,
				AddressMAC,
				PrinterModelID,
				IsLocal,
				IsUSBPort,
				SiteID,
				Location,
				CostGroupID,
				CostAccountID,
				ForceColor,
				EnabledBillingStatus,
				EnabledCounterStatus,
				EngagedStatus,
				UpdatedDate
			)
		VALUES
			(
				@PrinterDeviceName,
				@SerialNumber,
				@AddressName,
				@AddressPort,
				@AddressMAC,
				@PrinterModelID,
				@IsLocal,
				@IsUSBPort,
				@SiteID,
				'', -- Location,
				@CostGroupID,
				NULL, -- CostAccountID
				0, -- ForceColor
				@EnabledBillingStatus,
				@EnabledCounterStatus,
				@EngagedStatus,
				GETUTCDATE() 	--UpdatedDate
			)
			
		SET @PrinterDeviceIDFound = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END

	--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 5	--PrinterDeviceID
	END
	
	--Retorna o ID que o foi inserido
	SELECT @PrinterDeviceIDFound

END
```

## 495. proc_PrintersDevices_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_Remove] 
@PrinterDeviceID INT 

AS

BEGIN

	-- =========================================================================================
	-- Maicon Pereira 28/05/2014
	-- Description:	Remover do banco a impressora e todos os dados relacionados à ela. 	
	-- Douglas Macedo 18/04/2019 #41 5.49
	-- Description:	Acrescentada remoção dos dados da tabela PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges. 
	-- =========================================================================================

	
	--Apaga os dados de auditoria relacionados à impressoras e que sejam da impressora a ser deletada do sistema
	DELETE FROM 
		Auditings 
	WHERE 
		AuditingActionID in(13,14,15,47,48) 
		AND ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os produtos instalados ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		InstalledProducts 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados de alteração de endereço ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados de politicas ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMembers 
	WHERE 
		ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND PolicyMemberType = 3

	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMembers 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND PolicyMemberType = 5
				
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da PrintJObs e da tabela BureauJobs
	
	--Cria tabela auxiliar para guardar os PrintJobIDs 
	DECLARE @PrintJobIDList TABLE (PrintJobID INT)
	--Cria variavel para verificação no laço de repetição
	DECLARE @CountPrintJobIDs INTEGER 
	
	
	--Pega os 100 primeiros printjobids da impressora e armazena nessa tabela 			
	INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobs where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	--Pega o total de itens na tabela
	SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	
	--Enquanto houver itens na tabela entra nesse laço de repetição
	WHILE(@CountPrintJobIDs > 0)
	BEGIN
	
		--Apaga os dados da BureauJobs
		DELETE FROM 
			BureauJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)

		--Apaga os dados da QuotasPrintJobs
		DELETE FROM 
			QuotasPrintJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)			
			
		--Apaga os dados da StampLogonJobs
		DELETE FROM 
			StampLogonJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)			

		--Apaga os dados da PrintJobs	
		DELETE FROM 
			PrintJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)
				
		--Limpa a tabela de PrintJobIDs				
		DELETE FROM @PrintJobIDList
		
		--Pega os dados dos próximos PrintJobIDs a serem excluidos
		INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobs where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

		--Atualiza o valor da variavel do laço de repetição
		SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	END
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintJobsCanceled
		
	--Pega os 100 primeiros printjobids da impressora e armazena nessa tabela 			
	INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobsCanceled where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	--Pega o total de itens na tabela
	SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	
	--Enquanto houver itens na tabela entra nesse laço de repetição
	WHILE(@CountPrintJobIDs > 0)
	BEGIN
	
		--Apaga os dados da PrintJobs	
		DELETE FROM 
			PrintJobsCanceled 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)
				
		--Limpa a tabela de PrintJobIDs				
		DELETE FROM @PrintJobIDList
		
		--Pega os dados dos próximos PrintJobIDs a serem excluidos
		INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobsCanceled where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

		--Atualiza o valor da variavel do laço de repetição
		SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	END
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga as filas de processamento ligadas a impressora
	
	--ProccessQueuesTypes
	--PrinterConsolidation = 7,
	--PrinterDeviceSetDisable = 9,
	--PrinterDeviceSetEnable = 10,
	--PrinterDeviceSite = 11,
        
	DELETE FROM 
		ProcessQueues 
	WHERE 
		ProcessQueueType IN (7,9,10,11) 
		AND ObjectQueueID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga as filas ligadas a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersQueues 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os debitos de quotas ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		QuotasDebits 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os suprimentos não monitorados ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		SuppliesUnmonitored 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	---------------------IMPRESSORAS-----------------------------------------------------
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesAuditings
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesAuditings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID	

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesConsolidation
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesConsolidation 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceMainID = @PrinterDeviceID	
		OR PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesContractInfo
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesContractInfo 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID		
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela Counters
	DELETE FROM
		Counters
	WHERE
		CounterReadingID in (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID)
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela CountersAuditing
	DELETE FROM 
		CountersAuditing 
	WHERE 
		CounterReadingID IN (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela CountersReadings
	
	DELETE FROM 
		CountersReadings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	--Cria tabelas auxiliares para armazenar IDs			
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList TABLE (PrinterDeviceSlotID INT)
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList TABLE (PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID INT)
		
	--Insere os IDs dos slots relacionados a impressora 	
	INSERT INTO @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList 
		SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotID FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			
	--Insere os IDs históricos dos slots relacionados a impressora 				
	INSERT INTO @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList 
		SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList)
			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList)
		
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList)
		
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlots
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlots 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList)
		
	--Limpa tabelas
	DELETE FROM 
		@PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList
		
	DELETE FROM 
		@PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados de leitura de NSL ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		NSLReadings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevices
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevices 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
END
```

## 496. proc_PrintersDevices_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_Retrieve]
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@AddressName NVARCHAR(50)= NULL,
@AddressPort NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@Model NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@AddressMAC NVARCHAR(20) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	--Força os parâmetros para ''
	IF (@AddressName IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @AddressName = ''
	END
	
	IF (@AddressPort IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @AddressPort = ''
	END
	
	IF (@Model IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @Model = ''
	END
	
	IF (@SerialNumber IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @SerialNumber = ''
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@SerialNumber IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 0))
		BEGIN
			SET @SerialNumber = ''
		END
	END
	
	IF (@AddressMAC IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @AddressMAC = ''
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@AddressMAC IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 1))
		BEGIN
			SET @AddressMAC = ''
		END
	END
	
	--Força o parâmetro para -1
	IF (@PrinterDeviceID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @PrinterDeviceID = -1
	END
	
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceIDFound INT

	SELECT @PrinterDeviceIDFound = [dbo].[GetPrinterDeviceID](@PrinterDeviceID, @AddressName, @AddressPort, @Model, @SerialNumber, @AddressMAC)


	SELECT 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.AddressPort,
		ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
		PM.PrinterModelID,
		B.BrandName AS Brand,
		PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
		PD.IsLocal,
		PD.IsUSBPort,
		PD.SiteID,
		ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID, -1) AS SiteDivisionID,
		PD.Location,
		PD.CostGroupID,
		ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
		PD.ForceColor,
		PD.TrustOrigin,
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
		PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
		PD.EngagedStatus,		
		ISNULL(PDC.PrinterDeviceMainID, -1) AS PrinterDeviceMainID,
		CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1
			THEN '@@Local' 
			ELSE '@@Network' 
		END AS DeviceTypeDescription
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesConsolidation PDC ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PDC.PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	WHERE 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceIDFound	

END
```
