## 551. proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceConsolidation

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceConsolidation]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS
BEGIN

      --*******************************************************************************************************
      --** Robson, 01/03/2013
      --** Revisto para a versão 5.0
	  --** Rafael Machado 10/09/2015
	  --** Removendo os trechos onde registros eram removidos das finadas tabelas CubeCounterGeneral e CubeCounter.
      --** Diego Antunes, 01/02/2016
      --** Alterado para na consolidação somente desabilitar os históricos e não remover slots e outros dados,
      --** pois ao desconsolidar a impressora e reabilitar sua monitoração estava duplicando os slots.
	  --** Diego Antunes, 30/03/2017
	  --** Correção para remover os CountersAuditing caso existam para permitir a remoção dos CountersReadings.
      --*******************************************************************************************************

      DECLARE @PrinterDeviceMainID INT  = -1   
      DECLARE @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID INT 

      --Busca o ID da impressora principal
      SELECT 
            @PrinterDeviceMainID = PrinterDeviceMainID
      FROM
            PrintersDevicesConsolidation
      WHERE
            PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceID

      --Busca o site da impressora principal
      SELECT @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID = SiteID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID =  @PrinterDeviceMainID

      IF (@PrinterDeviceMainID <> -1)
      BEGIN
            IF (@StartDate IS NULL) --os contadores e suprimentos atualiza só na primeira rodada
            BEGIN

					DELETE FROM
						Counters
					WHERE
						CounterReadingID in (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID)

					DELETE FROM
						CountersAuditing
					WHERE
						CounterReadingID in (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID)
		
					DELETE FROM 
						CountersReadings 
					WHERE 
						PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --****************************************************************************************************************************
                  --""suprimentos""
                  --Diego Antunes 01/02/2016 - Alterado para na consolidação somente desabilitar os históricos e não remover slots e outros dados,
                  --pois ao desconsolidar a impressora e reabilitar sua monitoração estava duplicando os slots.
                  --****************************************************************************************************************************
                  
                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
                  UPDATE
                        PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
                  SET
                        Invalid = 1             
                  WHERE
                        PrinterDeviceSlotID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotID FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
                  
                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    PrintersDevicesSlots
                  --WHERE
                  --    PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    SuppliesUnmonitored
                  --WHERE
                  --    PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl
                  --WHERE
                  --    PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --****************************************************************************************************************************
                  
                  --Troca para o grupo padrão a impressora escrava e  Tira a impressora do contrato, forçando como se fosse o usuário
                  DECLARE @PrinterGroupID INT
                  SELECT @PrinterGroupID = CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1

                  UPDATE
                        PrintersDevices
                  SET 
                        CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID,
                        EngagedStatus = 2 --false do usuário
                  WHERE 
                        PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID --? IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidateDID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation)
                        -- ? AND PrintCostID <> @PrintCostID                 
            END
      
            --prevendo alterações forçadas de banco, caso o registro não exista mais já cai fora
            UPDATE 
                  PrintJobs 
            SET 
                  PrinterdeviceID = @PrinterDeviceMainID,
                  CostMono  = dbo.TotalCostCalcMono (@PrinterDeviceMainID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, PagesColor, PagesMono, WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID),
                  CostColor = dbo.TotalCostCalcColor(@PrinterDeviceMainID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, PagesColor, PagesMono, WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID),
                  SiteID = @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID
            WHERE
                  PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
                  AND JobOriginID <> 7
                  AND (((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate)) 
                  OR  (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate))
                  OR    ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

            UPDATE 
                  PrintJobs 
            SET 
                  PrinterdeviceID = @PrinterDeviceMainID,
                  SiteID = @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID
            WHERE
                  PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND JobOriginID = 7 AND
                  (( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
                  ( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
                  ( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

      END

      IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
      BEGIN
            UPDATE
                  ProcessQueues 
            SET
                  Status = 2,
                  LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
                  LastPeriodUpdated = ISNULL(@EndDate,'2005-12-31')
            WHERE
                  ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
      END

END
```

## 553. proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceEnabled

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceEnabled]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@Enabled BIT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN


	--se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
		RETURN 

	UPDATE
		PrintJobs
	SET
		JobDisabled = @Enabled
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND JobDisabled <> @Enabled
		AND	(((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate))
			OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate))
			OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
	
	UPDATE
		PrintJobsCanceled
	SET
		JobDisabled = @Enabled
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND JobDisabled <> @Enabled
		AND	(((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate))
			OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate))
			OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
			
	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			Status = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
```

## 554. proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceForcedColor

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceForcedColor]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
		RETURN 

	DECLARE @ForcedColorID INT

	SELECT
		@ForcedColorID = ISNULL(ForceColor,-1)
	FROM
		PrintersDevices
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID


	IF (@ForcedColorID <> -1)
	BEGIN

		IF (@ForcedColorID = 1)
		BEGIN

			UPDATE 
				PrintJobs 
			SET 
				PagesMono  = (PagesMono + PagesColor),
				PagesColor = 0,	
				CostMono   = dbo.TotalCostCalcMono(@PrinterDeviceID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, 0, (PagesMono + PagesColor), 0, JobTypeID),
				CostColor  = 0
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID  = @PrinterDeviceID AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
		END
		ELSE IF (@ForcedColorID = 2)
		BEGIN
	 
			UPDATE 
				PrintJobs 
			SET 
				PagesColor = (PagesMono + PagesColor),
				PagesMono  = 0,	
				CostColor  = dbo.TotalCostCalcColor(@PrinterDeviceID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, (PagesMono + PagesColor), 0, 1, JobTypeID),
				CostMono   = 0
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID  = @PrinterDeviceID AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
		END

	END

	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			Status = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
```

## 557. proc_ProcessQueues_UpdateUserChangedDate

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_UpdateUserChangedDate]
@ProcessQueueID INT,
@PolicyID INT
AS
BEGIN

	--Se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
	BEGIN
		RETURN 
	END

	UPDATE
		Accounts
	SET 
		ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
	WHERE
		AccountID IN 
		(SELECT 
			ObjectId
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID 
		AND
			(PolicyMemberType = 1
		OR
			PolicyMemberType = 5))
			
	DELETE FROM
		ProcessQueues
	WHERE
		ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
END
```

## 558. proc_Products_InstalledProductsFromObject

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Products_InstalledProductsFromObject] 
@MachineID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT 
		MachineID,
		PrinterDeviceID,
		ProductID,
		ISNULL(LastDateAccess, '') AS LastDateAccess,
		ISNULL(ExpirePermission, '') AS ExpirePermission,
		ISNULL(ProductVersion , '') AS ProductVersion

	WHERE

		AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR @PrinterDeviceID = PrinterDeviceID)
	ORDER BY
		PrinterDeviceID,

		ProductID

END
```

## 561. proc_Products_RetrieveAllInactiveClients

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Products_RetrieveAllInactiveClients] 
@SiteID INT = 0,
@OnlyDPS BIT = 0,
@UnActived BIT = 0,
@Date DATETIME  = '1-1-1',
@Days INT = 3,
@OrderBy INT = 1

AS

BEGIN

	IF(@OnlyDPS = 0)
    BEGIN
		IF (@UnActived =1)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				* 
			FROM 
				(SELECT DISTINCT
					M.*, 
					OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,  
					CASE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
					IPR.LastDateAccess,
					IPR.ProductVersion, 
					0 AS Actived, 
					1 AS UnActived 
				FROM
					Machines M
					INNER JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
					INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
				WHERE 
					M.Removed = 0
					AND IPR.ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products)
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess > @Date 
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE())
					AND	(@SiteID = 0 OR S.SiteID = @SiteID)
				) AS Details
            ORDER BY
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 ) THEN Details.MachineName END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 ) THEN Details.IP END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 ) THEN Details.LastDateAccess END ASC
		END
        ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				* 
			FROM
	            (SELECT DISTINCT 
					M.*,
					OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem, 
                    CASE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                    IPR.LastDateAccess,
					IPR.ProductVersion,
					0 AS Actived, 
					1 AS UnActived  
				FROM 
					Machines M
					INNER JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
					INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                WHERE 
					M.Removed = 0 
					AND IPR.ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products)
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
					AND (@SiteID = 0 OR S.SiteID = @SiteID)

                UNION

                SELECT DISTINCT 
					M.*, 
					OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,  
					CASE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                    IPR.LastDateAccess,
					IPR.ProductVersion,
					1 AS Actived, 
					0 AS UnActived  
				FROM 
					Machines M
					INNER JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
					INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                WHERE 
					M.Removed = 0
					AND IPR.ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products)
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess > DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE())
					AND (@SiteID = 0 OR S.Siteid = @SiteID)        
				) AS PaGeneral
			ORDER BY
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 ) THEN PaGeneral.MachineName END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 ) THEN PaGeneral.IP END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 ) THEN PaGeneral.LastDateAccess END ASC
		END
	END
	
END
```

## 562. proc_Products_RetrieveID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Products_RetrieveID]
@ProductName NVARCHAR(100)

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Found SMALLINT
	
	SET @Found = -1;
	
	SELECT
		@Found = ProductID
	FROM
		Products 
	WHERE
		LOWER(ProductName) = LOWER(@ProductName)
	
	IF (@Found <> -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Found
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ProductID INT

		SELECT @ProductID = (MAX(ProductID) + 1) FROM Products

		INSERT INTO
			Products
		VALUES
			(@ProductID, @ProductName)

		SELECT @ProductID
	END
END
```

## 564. proc_Products_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Products_Update] 
@MachineID INT = NULL,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@ProductID INT,
@LastDateAccess DATETIME,
@ProductVersion NVARCHAR(20)

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Found INT;
	SET @Found = 0
	
	SELECT
		@Found = COUNT(1)
	FROM 
		InstalledProducts 
	WHERE 
		((@MachineID = MachineID OR @MachineID IS NULL) AND (@PrinterDeviceID = PrinterDeviceID OR @PrinterDeviceID IS NULL))
		AND ProductID = @ProductID

	IF (@Found = 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			InstalledProducts
			(
				MachineID,
				PrinterDeviceID,
				ProductID,
				LastDateAccess,
				[ProductVersion]
			)
		VALUES
			(
				@MachineID,
				@PrinterDeviceID,
				@ProductID,
				@LastDateAccess,
				@ProductVersion
			)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			InstalledProducts
		SET 	
			LastDateAccess = @LastDateAccess,
			[ProductVersion] = @ProductVersion
		WHERE
			((@MachineID = MachineID OR @MachineID IS NULL) AND (@PrinterDeviceID = PrinterDeviceID OR @PrinterDeviceID IS NULL))
			AND ProductID = @ProductID
	END	
	
END
```

## 565. proc_QuotasAccounts_DebitQuota

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_DebitQuota]
@AccountID INT,
@UsedDateTime DATETIME,
@QuotaDebitHostID BIGINT,
@TotalPages INT = 0,
@PagesMono INT = 0,
@PagesColor INT = 0,
@MoneyValue DECIMAL(19,6) = 0,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@IsCorporative BIT = 1,
@DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID INT = -1,
@PrintJobID BIGINT = NULL,
@ForceDebitQuota BIT = 0,
@Description NVARCHAR(100) = NULL

AS

BEGIN
	
	--Verificamos se esse débito já foi inserido, caso sim inserimos os valores em uma tabela de log, para futuras consultas.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasDebits WHERE QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitHostID AND UsedDateTime = @UsedDateTime AND QuotaDebitHostID <> 0 AND @DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID = -1)
	BEGIN	
		RETURN
	END

	--Verifica se o usuário está usando cotas
	DECLARE @UnlimitedQuotas INT
	SELECT @UnlimitedQuotas = 1 FROM QuotasUnlimited WHERE AccountID = @AccountID

	IF (@UnlimitedQuotas IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT -2 --usuário que nao usa cotas não vai fazer essa chamada.
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @Shared BIT
	SELECT @Shared = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS BIT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 3 --SharedQuotas

	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT 

	--Se estiver utilizando cotas compartilhadas, vai descontar da conta do usuário
	IF (@Shared = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @CostAccountID = ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
	END

	--0 = Desabilitado, 2 = Bloqueante, 3 = Não Bloqueante com aviso, 4 = Não bloqueante
	DECLARE @IsBlocked INT
	SELECT @IsBlocked = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 2 --QuotasState

	DECLARE @Type INT
	SELECT @Type = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 1 --QuotasType

	--Variáveis da tabela de créditos
	DECLARE @OrderID INT, @QuotaCreditID INT
	DECLARE @BCTotalPages INT, @BCPagesMono INT, @BCPagesColor INT, @BCMoneyValue DECIMAL(19, 6)
	
	DECLARE @TBCredits TABLE
		(
			OrderID INT IDENTITY(1, 1),
			QuotaCreditID INT,
			BCTotalPages INT,
			BCPagesMono INT,
			BCPagesColor INT,
			BCMoneyValue DECIMAL(19, 6),
			Updated BIT
		)
	
	BEGIN TRAN --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	--Retorna o ID do débito
	DECLARE @QuotaDebitID BIGINT

	--Verifica se esse débito já possui um PrintJobID
	SELECT
		@PrintJobID = QPJ.PrintJobID,
		@PrinterDeviceID = QPJ.PrinterDeviceID
	FROM
		QuotasPrintJobs QPJ
	WHERE
		QPJ.QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitHostID
		
	--Caso tenha remove ele da tabela de PrintJobs que chegaram antes do débito
	IF (@PrintJobID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM
			QuotasPrintJobs
		WHERE
			PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
			AND PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			AND QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitHostID
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
	END
			
	--Quando for para balancear os créditos negativos, deve primeiro remover os débitos desse crédito negativo
	IF (@DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM
			QuotasDebits
		WHERE
			QuotaCreditID = @DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		DELETE FROM 
			QuotasPercentageAlertsCredits
		WHERE 
			QuotaCreditID = @DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID
								
		DELETE FROM
			QuotasCredits
		WHERE
			QuotaCreditID = @DebitBalanceQuotaCreditID
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
	END
	
	--Por total de páginas
	IF (@Type = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@TBCredits
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
			0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		WHERE
			QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
			AND ((@Shared = 1 AND QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID) OR (@Shared = 0 AND QC.AccountID = @AccountID))
			AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QC.FinishDate,
			CASE WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QP.NextDate

		--Executa o desconto dos créditos
		WHILE (@TotalPages > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCTotalPages = BCTotalPages
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID
					
			--Quando o total de páginas for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCTotalPages >= @TotalPages)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseTotalPages = ExpenseTotalPages + @TotalPages WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, @TotalPages, 0, 0, 0)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				SET @TotalPages = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseTotalPages = ExpenseTotalPages + @BCTotalPages WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, @BCTotalPages, 0, 0, 0)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
				
				SET @TotalPages = @TotalPages - @BCTotalPages
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE QuotasCredits SET [Enabled] = 0, DisabledDate = GETDATE()  WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) = 0
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso falte créditos para esse débito (pode ser por alguma falha no host ou por estar do tipo 'Ignore')
		IF (@TotalPages > 0)
		BEGIN
			--Adiciona um crédito negativo para ficar registrado esse débito
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasCredits
					(
						QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
						ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
						FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled], DisabledDate
					)
			VALUES
				(
					NULL, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, GETDATE(), 0, 0, 0, 0, --Totais
					@TotalPages, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					NULL, @IsCorporative, 1, 1, NULL --OperatorID, [Enabled] e DisabledDate
				)
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			SET @QuotaCreditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
			--Insere o débito			
			INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, @TotalPages, 0, 0, 0)

			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
			END
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
	END
	
	--Por cor
	IF (@Type = 2)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @TBDebitsMonoColor TABLE
			(
				QuotaCreditID INT,
				PagesMono INT,
				PagesColor INT
			)
	
		INSERT INTO
			@TBCredits
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			0,
			QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono,
			QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor,
			0, 0
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		WHERE
			QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
			AND QC.AccountID = @AccountID
			AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QC.FinishDate,
			CASE WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QP.NextDate
			
		--Executa o desconto dos créditos mono
		WHILE (@PagesMono > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCPagesMono = BCPagesMono
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID
			
			--Quando o total de páginas for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCPagesMono >= @PagesMono AND @PagesMono > 0)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesMono = ExpensePagesMono + @PagesMono WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
				INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor(QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
				VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, @PagesMono, 0)
				
				SET @PagesMono = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (@BCPagesMono > 0)
				BEGIN
					--Executa o desconto
					UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesMono = ExpensePagesMono + @BCPagesMono WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
					
					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
					
					--Insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
					INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor(QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
					VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, @BCPagesMono, 0)
					
					SET @PagesMono = @PagesMono - @BCPagesMono
					
				END
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE
				QuotasCredits
			SET
				[Enabled] = 0,
				DisabledDate = GETDATE()
			WHERE 
				QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID 
				AND (PagesMono  - ExpensePagesMono)  = 0
				AND (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) = 0
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Reinicia a tabela dos créditos para descontar as páginas color
		UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 0 
		
		--Executa o desconto dos créditos color
		WHILE (@PagesColor > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCPagesColor = BCPagesColor
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID

			--Quando o total de páginas for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCPagesColor >= @PagesColor AND @PagesColor > 0)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesColor = ExpensePagesColor + @PagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Verifica se já existe um registro ou insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBDebitsMonoColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE @TBDebitsMonoColor SET PagesColor = @PagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor (QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
					VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, 0, @PagesColor)
				END
				
				SET @PagesColor = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (@BCPagesColor > 0)
				BEGIN
					--Executa o desconto
					UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpensePagesColor = ExpensePagesColor + @BCPagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID

					IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 0
						ROLLBACK TRAN
						RETURN
					END	
					
					--Verifica se já existe um registro ou insere na tabela que contém os descontos que serão executados posteriormente
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBDebitsMonoColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID)
					BEGIN
						UPDATE @TBDebitsMonoColor SET PagesColor = @BCPagesColor WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @TBDebitsMonoColor (QuotaCreditID, PagesMono, PagesColor)
						VALUES (@QuotaCreditID, 0, @BCPagesColor)
					END
					
					SET @PagesColor = @PagesColor - @BCPagesColor
				END
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE
				QuotasCredits
			SET
				[Enabled] = 0,
				DisabledDate = GETDATE()
			WHERE 
				QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID 
				AND (PagesMono  - ExpensePagesMono)  = 0
				AND (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) = 0
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso não tenha uma descrição, insere os débitos normalmente
		IF (@Description IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			--Insere os débitos, baseado na tabela de débitos preenchida anteriormente
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			SELECT
				@QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, PagesMono, PagesColor, 0
			FROM
				@TBDebitsMonoColor
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Caso tenha uma descrição, guarda todos os débitos inseridos na tabela temporária e depois insere na tabela de descrições
			DECLARE @IDs TABLE (ID INT)
			
			--Insere os débitos, baseado na tabela de débitos preenchida anteriormente
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			OUTPUT 
				Inserted.IdentityCol INTO @IDs
			SELECT
				@QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, PagesMono, PagesColor, 0
			FROM
				@TBDebitsMonoColor
			
			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
			SELECT
				ID, @Description
			FROM
				@IDs
		END
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Caso falte créditos para esse débito (pode ser por alguma falha no host ou por estar do tipo 'Ignore')
		IF (@PagesMono > 0 OR @PagesColor > 0)
		BEGIN
			--Adiciona um crédito negativo para ficar registrado esse débito
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasCredits
					(
						QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
						ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
						FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled], DisabledDate
					)
			VALUES
				(
					NULL, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, GETDATE(), 0, 0, 0, 0, --Totais
					0, @PagesMono, @PagesColor, 0, --Expenses
					NULL, @IsCorporative, 1, 1, NULL --OperatorID, [Enabled] e DisabledDate
				)
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
				
			SET @QuotaCreditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
			--Insere o débito
			INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, @PagesMono, @PagesColor, 0)

			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
			END
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
	END
	
	--Por valor
	IF (@Type = 3)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@TBCredits
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			0, 0, 0,
			QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
			0
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		WHERE
			QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
			AND QC.AccountID = @AccountID
			AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QC.FinishDate,
			CASE WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
			QP.NextDate

		--Executa o desconto dos créditos
		WHILE (@MoneyValue > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBCredits WHERE Updated = 0))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@OrderID = OrderID,
				@QuotaCreditID = QuotaCreditID,
				@BCMoneyValue = BCMoneyValue
			FROM
				@TBCredits
			WHERE
				Updated = 0
			ORDER BY
				OrderID
			
			--Quando o valor for menor que o balanço, executa o desconto simples
			IF (@BCMoneyValue >= @MoneyValue)
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseMoneyValue = ExpenseMoneyValue + @MoneyValue WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, 0, 0, @MoneyValue)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
			
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				SET @MoneyValue = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--Executa o desconto
				UPDATE QuotasCredits SET ExpenseMoneyValue = ExpenseMoneyValue + @BCMoneyValue WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				--Insere o débito
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, 0, 0, @BCMoneyValue)
				
				--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
				IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
				
					INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
					VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
				END
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
				
				UPDATE @TBCredits SET Updated = 1 WHERE OrderID = @OrderID
				
				SET @MoneyValue = @MoneyValue - @BCMoneyValue
			END
			
			--Caso tenha acabado os créditos, desabilita esse crédito
			UPDATE QuotasCredits SET [Enabled] = 0, DisabledDate = GETDATE() WHERE QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditID AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) = 0
		
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso falte créditos para esse débito (pode ser por alguma falha no host ou por estar do tipo 'Ignore')
		IF (@MoneyValue > 0)
		BEGIN
			--Adiciona um crédito negativo para ficar registrado esse débito
			INSERT INTO
				QuotasCredits
					(
						QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
						ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
						FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled], DisabledDate
					)
			VALUES
				(
					NULL, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, GETDATE(), 0, 0, 0, 0, --Totais
					0, 0, 0, @MoneyValue, --Expenses
					NULL, @IsCorporative, 1, 1, NULL --OperatorID, [Enabled] e DisabledDate
				)
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			SET @QuotaCreditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			--Insere o débito			
			INSERT INTO QuotasDebits (QuotaDebitHostID, QuotaCreditID, AccountID, CostAccountID, PrintJobID, PrinterDeviceID, UsedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue)
			VALUES (@QuotaDebitHostID, @QuotaCreditID, @AccountID, @CostAccountID, @PrintJobID, @PrinterDeviceID, @UsedDateTime, 0, 0, 0, @MoneyValue)

			--Quando for informada uma descrição, adicionar ela na tabela de descricoes de debitos
			IF (@Description IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @QuotaDebitID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			
				INSERT INTO QuotasDebitsDescriptions (QuotaDebitID, Description)
				VALUES (@QuotaDebitID, @Description)
			END
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
	END
	
	COMMIT TRAN -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	SELECT 1
	
END
```

## 566. proc_QuotasAccounts_HasPositiveCredit

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_HasPositiveCredit]
@AccountID INT,
@IsCorporative BIT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		COUNT(1)
	FROM
		QuotasCredits QC
	WHERE
		QC.OperatorID <> 1
		AND [Enabled] = 1
		AND IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
		AND AccountID = @AccountID
		AND (
				((TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0 )
				OR ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
				OR ((MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0)
			)
	
END
```

## 567. proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveAllBalances

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveAllBalances]

AS

BEGIN

		-- =============================================
		-- Edit date: 07/11/2013
		-- Edit author:	Rafael Machado
		-- Description: CostAccountType Users = 1,PrintersDevices = 2, SelectableCostAccount = 3
		--	Foi adicionado um case no select dos balanços, quando o tipo da conta for selecionavél(tipo 3),
		--	será verificado se o costAccountID é nulo, se o mesmo for nulo será informado -1 do contrário 
		--	o CostAccountID informado será o que está atribuido.
		--	Se o tipo da conta for 1 ou 2, o CostAccountID informado será -1.
		-- Edit date: 28/11/2013
		--		Adicionando um where no último select para não retornar os usuários que foram deletados
		-- Edit date: 23/05/2014
		--	Adicionando duas clausulas no where do último select, para filtrar as cotas.
		--	Se as cotas privadas não estiverem habilitadas retornará apenas as cotas corporativas.
		--	Se as cotas privadas estiverem habilitadas retornará tanto as cotas corporativas como também as privadas.
		
					
	DECLARE @TBBalances TABLE
		(
			AccountID INT,
			CostAccountID INT,
			TotalPages INT,
			PagesMono INT,
			PagesColor INT,
			MoneyValue DECIMAL (19, 6),
			UnlimitedQuotas BIT,
			IsCorporative BIT
		)
	
	INSERT INTO
		@TBBalances
	SELECT
		AccountID,
		CostAccountID, -- TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,		
		SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
		SUM(PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
		SUM(PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
		SUM(MoneyValue) AS MoneyValue,
		UnlimitedQuotas, 
		IsCorporative 
	FROM 
		dbo.[GetQuotasAccounts_RetrieveAllBalances]()
	GROUP BY
		AccountID,
		IsCorporative,
		CostAccountID,
		UnlimitedQuotas

	--Verifica se as cotas estão compartilhadas
	DECLARE @Shared BIT
	SELECT @Shared = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS BIT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 3 --SharedQuotas
 
	-------------------------------
	-- CostAccountType
	-- Users = 1,
	-- PrintersDevices = 2,
	-- SelectableCostAccount = 3
	--------------------------------
	DECLARE @CostAccountType NVARCHAR(1)
	SET @CostAccountType = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')

	--Se estiver utilizando cotas compartilhadas
	IF (@Shared = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			TB.CostAccountID,
			CA.CostAccountName,
			SUM(TB.TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
			SUM(TB.PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
			SUM(TB.PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
			SUM(TB.MoneyValue) AS MoneyValue,
			TB.IsCorporative
		FROM
			@TBBalances TB
			INNER JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = TB.CostAccountID
		WHERE TB.IsCorporative = '1'
		GROUP BY 
			TB.CostAccountID,
			CA.CostAccountName,
			TB.IsCorporative
		ORDER BY
			CostAccountID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		DECLARE @BillingPrivateEnabled INT
		SELECT @BillingPrivateEnabled = ParameterValue FROM PoliciesParameters where ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled'
	
		--Retorna os balanços
		SELECT
			D.DomainID,
			D.DomainName,
			TB.AccountID,
			AC.LogonName,
			ISNULL(AC.Email, '-') AS Email,
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserNameDefault,
			CASE 
				WHEN @CostAccountType = 3 THEN ISNULL(TB.CostAccountID, -1) 
				ELSE -1
			END  AS CostAccountID,
			dbo.GetCostAccountName(CA.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TB.UnlimitedQuotas,
			TB.TotalPages,
			TB.PagesMono,
			TB.PagesColor,
			TB.MoneyValue,
			TB.IsCorporative
		FROM
			@TBBalances TB
			INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = TB.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = AC.CostAccountID
		WHERE
			AC.Removed = 0
			AND (
			(@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND IsCorporative = 1) OR /*Cotas privadas desabilitadas -> busca apenas cotas corporativas*/
			(@BillingPrivateEnabled  = 1 AND IsCorporative IN (0,1)) /*Cotas privadas habilitadas -> busca os dois tipos de cotas*/
			)
		ORDER BY
			UserNameDefault
	END	
	
END
```

## 568. proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveBalance

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveBalance]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	--Caso não tenha o crédito padrão adiciona
	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT, @TotalPages INT, @PagesMono INT, @PagesColor INT, @MoneyValue DECIMAL (19, 6), @IsCorporative INT, @OperatorID INT
	
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	
	SELECT
		@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID,
		@TotalPages = TotalPages,
		@PagesMono  = PagesMono,
		@PagesColor = PagesColor,
		@MoneyValue = MoneyValue,
		@IsCorporative = IsCorporative,
		@OperatorID = OperatorID
	FROM 
		QuotasRules
	WHERE 
		IsDefaultQuota = 1
		AND [Enabled]  = 1
	
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR AccountID = @AccountID) AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)))
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
		SELECT
				@QuotaRuleID,
				@AccountID,
				@CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				NULL,
				@IsCorporative,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
	END
		
	DECLARE @TBAccountsGroups TABLE (AccountGroupID INT)
	
	INSERT INTO
		@TBAccountsGroups
	SELECT
		AccountGroupID
	FROM 
		AccountsGroupsObjects 
	WHERE
		AccountID = @AccountID
	
	--Verifica se existe alguma regra dos grupos que o usuário pertence
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @TBAccountsGroups)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasRules WHERE AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM @TBAccountsGroups) AND [Enabled] = 1)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @TBRulesGroups TABLE (QuotaRuleID INT)
			SET @QuotaRuleID = -1
				
			--Busca as regras (de crédito) desse grupo
			INSERT INTO
				@TBRulesGroups
			SELECT
				QuotaRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasRules
			WHERE
				[Enabled] = 1
				AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
				AND AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM @TBAccountsGroups)
				
			--Remove pelo ID da regra, os créditos que o usuário já recebeu
			DELETE FROM
				@TBRulesGroups
			WHERE
				QuotaRuleID IN (SELECT QuotaRuleID FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID IN (SELECT QuotaRuleID FROM @TBRulesGroups) AND AccountID = @AccountID)
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBRulesGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID
				FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
					
				--Insere o crédito
				INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
				SELECT
					@QuotaRuleID,
					@AccountID,
					NULL, --CostAccountID,
					GETDATE(),
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					FinishDate,
					IsCorporative,
					OperatorID,
					1 --[Enabled]
				FROM
					QuotasRules
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			END
		END
	END
		
	--Busca o balanço
	SELECT 
		(SUM(TotalPages) - SUM(ExpenseTotalPages)) AS TotalPages,
		(SUM(PagesMono)  - SUM(ExpensePagesMono))  AS PagesMono,
		(SUM(PagesColor) - SUM(ExpensePagesColor)) AS PagesColor,
		(SUM(MoneyValue) - SUM(ExpenseMoneyValue)) AS MoneyValue,
		IsCorporative
	FROM
		QuotasCredits
	WHERE 
		(@AccountID IS NULL OR AccountID = @AccountID)
		AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND [Enabled] = 1
	GROUP BY
		IsCorporative
	
END
```

## 569. proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveDebitBalance

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveDebitBalance]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	--Busca os créditos negativos
	SELECT
		QC.QuotaCreditID,
		ISNULL(QC.AccountID, -1) AS AccountID,
		ISNULL(QC.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
		QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
		QC.ExpensePagesMono,
		QC.ExpensePagesColor,
		QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		QC.IsCorporative,
		QC.OperatorID,
		
		QD.QuotaHostID,
		QD.QuotaDebitHostID,
		ISNULL(QD.PrintJobID, -1) AS PrintJobID,
		ISNULL(QD.PrinterDeviceID, -1) AS PrinterDeviceID,
		QD.UsedDateTime		
	FROM
		QuotasCredits QC
		INNER JOIN QuotasDebits QD ON QD.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
	WHERE
		QC.OperatorID = 1
		AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
		AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR QC.AccountID = @AccountID)
		AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND QC.AccountID IN (
			SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0
		)

END
```

## 570. proc_QuotasDebits_Retrieve

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasDebits_Retrieve]
@QuotaDebitHostID BIGINT

AS
BEGIN

	SELECT
		QD.QuotaDebitHostID,
		QD.AccountID,
		QD.CostAccountID,
		QD.PrintJobID,
		QD.PrinterDeviceID,
		QD.UsedDateTime,
		SUM(QD.TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
		SUM(QD.PagesMono)  AS PagesMono,
		SUM(QD.PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
		SUM(QD.MoneyValue) AS MoneyValue,
		QC.IsCorporative
	FROM 
		QuotasDebits QD
		INNER JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QC.QuotaCreditID = QD.QuotaCreditID
	WHERE
		QD.QuotaDebitHostID = @QuotaDebitHostID
	GROUP BY
		QD.QuotaDebitHostID,
		QD.AccountID,
		QD.CostAccountID,
		QD.PrintJobID,
		QD.PrinterDeviceID,
		QD.UsedDateTime,
		QC.IsCorporative

END
```

## 571. proc_QuotasHosts_SetQuotaHostID

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasHosts_SetQuotaHostID]
@StrongName NVARCHAR(32) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @QuotaHostID INT = -1

	SELECT @QuotaHostID = QuotaHostID FROM QuotasHosts WHERE StrongName = @StrongName

	IF(@QuotaHostID = -1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @LastID INT = NULL, @NewID INT = NULL

		SELECT TOP 1 @LastID = QuotaHostID FROM QuotasHosts ORDER BY QuotaHostID DESC

		IF(@LastID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @NewID = 1
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @NewID = @LastID + 1
		END

		INSERT INTO 
			QuotasHosts (QuotaHostID, StrongName) 
		VALUES 
			(@NewID, @StrongName)

		SET @QuotaHostID = @NewID
	END

	SELECT @QuotaHostID

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasPayments_Retrieve]
@QuotaPaymentID INT = NULL,
@ReferenceCode UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
@TransactionCode UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		[QuotaPaymentID],
		[AccountID],
		[Email],
		[GrossAmount],
		[NetAmount],
		[FeeAmount],
		[ReferenceCode],
		[ReferenceDate],
		[LinkCode],
		[LinkCodeDate],
		ISNULL([ERROR], '') AS ERROR,
		[TransactionCode],
		[TransactionStatus],
		[PaymentMethodType],
		[PaymentMethodCode],
		[QuotaCreditID],
		[Removed]
	FROM 
		QuotasPayments QP
	WHERE
		(@QuotaPaymentID IS NOT NULL AND QP.QuotaPaymentID = @QuotaPaymentID)
		OR (@ReferenceCode IS NOT NULL AND QP.ReferenceCode = @ReferenceCode)
		OR (@TransactionCode IS NOT NULL AND QP.TransactionCode = @TransactionCode)

END
```

## 592. proc_QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes_ValidateCardCode

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes_ValidateCardCode]
@CardCode NVARCHAR(12)

AS

BEGIN
	
	-- ***************************************************************************************
	-- Marco, 2013-08-28
	-- Valida se o código do cartão é valido (se o mesmo existe),se o cartão não venceu 
	-- ou já foi utilizado, retornando o seguinte status da validação: 
	--  0 - Válido 
	--	1 - Inválido
	--  2 - Expirado 
	--  3 - Utilizado
	-- ***************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @ValidationStatus TINYINT
	DECLARE @CardCodeID INT
	DECLARE @ExpirationDate DATETIME
	DECLARE @QuotaCreditID INT
	
	-- Por padrão seta como inválido.
	SET @ValidationStatus = 1
	
	SELECT 
		@CardCodeID = QPCC.CardCodeID,
		@ExpirationDate = QPCB.ExpirationDate,
		@QuotaCreditID = QPCC.QuotaCreditID
	FROM
		QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes QPCC
		INNER JOIN QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches QPCB ON QPCC.BatchID = QPCB.BatchID
	WHERE
		QPCC.CardCode = @CardCode 
	
	-- Se encontrou o código, valida o código	
	IF (@CardCodeID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- Se tem crédito atribuido, então o código de cartão ja foi utilizado.
		IF (@QuotaCreditID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			-- Seta como utilizado.
			SET @ValidationStatus = 3
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- Se não expirou a data, é valido.
			IF (@ExpirationDate > GETDATE())
			BEGIN
				-- Seta como válido
				SET @ValidationStatus = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- Seta  como expirado
				SET @ValidationStatus = 2
			END
		END
	END
	
	SELECT @ValidationStatus
	
END
```

## 593. proc_QuotasRules_GetDefaultQuota

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_GetDefaultQuota]

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		QR.QuotaRuleID,
		QR.TotalPages,
		QR.PagesMono,
		QR.PagesColor,
		QR.MoneyValue,
		QR.IsCorporative,
		QP.QuotaPeriodID,
		QP.PeriodType,
		QP.PeriodQuantity,
		QP.StartDate,
		QP.StartDay,
		QP.StartMonth,
		QP.IsExpire,
		QR.IsDefaultQuota	
	FROM
		QuotasRules QR
		LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
	WHERE
		[Enabled] = 1
		AND IsDefaultQuota = 1

END
```

## 594. proc_QuotasRules_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_Insert] 
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
@AccountGroupID INT = NULL,
@TotalPages INT,
@PagesMono INT,
@PagesColor INT,
@MoneyValue DECIMAL (19,6),
@IsCorporative BIT,
@FinishDate DATETIME = NULL,
--QuotasPeriods
@PeriodType INT = NULL,
@PeriodQuantity INT = NULL,
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@StartDay INT = NULL,
@StartMonth INT = NULL,
@RepeatTimes INT = 0,
@IsExpire BIT = NULL,
@InstantCredit BIT = 0,
--QuotasOperators
@OperatorID INT,
--PrepaidCards
@CardCode NVARCHAR(12) = NULL,
--QuotasPayments
@QuotaPaymentID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	DECLARE @QuotaCreditOrRuleID INT
	DECLARE @QuotaPeriodID INT
	SET @QuotaPeriodID = NULL

	-- Caso tenha recorrência, primeiro cria o registro na tabela de recorrências
	IF (@PeriodType IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPeriods
				(
					PeriodType,
					PeriodQuantity,
					StartDate,
					StartDay,
					StartMonth,
					NextDate,
					RepeatTimes,
					RepeatedTimes,
					IsExpire,
					LastDateRepeated,
					InstantCredit)
		VALUES
			(
				@PeriodType,
				@PeriodQuantity,
				@StartDate,
				@StartDay,
				@StartMonth,
				ISNULL(@StartDate, dbo.GetQuotasFirstNextDate(@PeriodType, @StartDay)),
				@RepeatTimes,
				0, --RepeatedTimes
				@IsExpire,
				NULL, --LastDateRepeated,
				@InstantCredit
			)
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
			
		SELECT @QuotaPeriodID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	
	-- Caso não tenha recorrência e o crédito não seja para um grupo, adicionar apenas o crédito
	IF (@QuotaPeriodID IS NULL AND @AccountGroupID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- Se possui o código de cartão pré-pago, então obtém o valor do cartão.
		IF (@CardCode IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				@MoneyValue = QPCB.MoneyValue
			FROM
				QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes QPCC
				INNER JOIN QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches QPCB ON QPCC.BatchID = QPCB.BatchID
			WHERE
				QPCC.CardCode = @CardCode 
				AND QPCC.QuotaCreditID IS NULL
		END
		
		--Insere o crédito
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasCredits
				(
					QuotaRuleID,
					AccountID,
					CostAccountID,
					CreatedDateTime,
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					ExpenseTotalPages,
					ExpensePagesMono,
					ExpensePagesColor,
					ExpenseMoneyValue,
					FinishDate,
					IsCorporative,
					OperatorID,
					[Enabled]
				)
		VALUES
			(
				NULL,
				@AccountID,
				@CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				@FinishDate,
				@IsCorporative,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
			)
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		SET @QuotaCreditOrRuleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
		
		-- Se possui o código do cartão e chegou aqui e conseguiu inserir o crédito,
		-- então aqui atribui o crédito inserido ao código do cartão.
		IF (@CardCode IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes
			SET
				QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditOrRuleID
			WHERE
				CardCode = @CardCode
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		-- Se possui o ID da compra e chegou aqui e conseguiu inserir o crédito,
		-- então aqui atribui o crédito inserido a compra.
		IF (@QuotaPaymentID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				QuotasPayments
			SET
				QuotaCreditID = @QuotaCreditOrRuleID
			WHERE
				QuotaPaymentID = @QuotaPaymentID
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--Insere a regra de cota
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasRules
				(
					AccountID,
					CostAccountID,
					AccountGroupID,
					CreatedDateTime,
					TotalPages,
 					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					IsCorporative,
					QuotaPeriodID,
					FinishDate,
					OperatorID,
					IsDefaultQuota,
					[Enabled]
				) 
		VALUES
			(
				@AccountID,
				@CostAccountID,
				@AccountGroupID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				@IsCorporative,
				@QuotaPeriodID,
				@FinishDate,
				@OperatorID,
				0, --IsDefaultQuota,
				1  --Enabled
			)
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		SET @QuotaCreditOrRuleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
		
		--Caso seja apenas um crédito para o grupo, já adiciona esses créditos
		IF (@QuotaPeriodID IS NULL AND @AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN			
			--Insere o crédito
			INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
			SELECT
				@QuotaCreditOrRuleID,
				AGO.AccountID,
				NULL, --CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				@FinishDate,
				@IsCorporative,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
			FROM
				AccountsGroupsObjects AGO
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = AGO.AccountID
			WHERE
				AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END
		END		

	END
	
	SELECT @QuotaCreditOrRuleID

	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END
```

## 595. proc_QuotasRules_ProcessCredits

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_ProcessCredits]
@DateProcess DATETIME
--@AccountID INT = NULL,
--@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
--@AccountGroupID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @TBQuotasRules TABLE
		(
			QuotaRuleID INT,
			QuotaPeriodID INT,
			RepeatTimes INT,
			RepeatedTimes INT,
			IsExpire BIT,
			Updated BIT
		)
	
	--Busca todas as regras habilitadas, com o último processamento e próxima adição dos créditos igual a data indicada
	INSERT INTO
		@TBQuotasRules
	SELECT
		QR.QuotaRuleID,
		QP.QuotaPeriodID,
		QP.RepeatTimes,
		QP.RepeatedTimes,
		QP.IsExpire,
		0 --Updated
	FROM
		QuotasRules QR
		INNER JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
	WHERE
		[Enabled] = 1
		AND (QP.LastDateRepeated IS NULL OR QP.LastDateRepeated < @DateProcess)
		AND (QP.NextDate = @DateProcess)
		--AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR QR.AccountID = @AccountID)
		--AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR QR.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		--AND (@AccountGroupID IS NULL OR QR.AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID)
	
	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT, @QuotaPeriodID INT, @RepeatTimes INT, @RepeatedTimes INT, @IsExpire BIT
	
	--Processa cada regra
	WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @TBQuotasRules WHERE Updated = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1
			@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID,
			@QuotaPeriodID = QuotaPeriodID,
			@RepeatTimes = RepeatTimes,
			@RepeatedTimes = RepeatedTimes,
			@IsExpire = IsExpire
		FROM 
	
		@TBQuotasRules 
		WHERE
			Updated = 0
		
		--Se for com expiração dos créditos, desabilita todos os créditos recebidos por essa regra
		IF (@IsExpire = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
			INSERT INTO
	
			QuotasExpires
				(
					QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
				)
			SELECT
					QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
					QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
					QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
			FROM
				QuotasCredits QC
			WHERE
				QC.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN	
				RETURN
			END	
			
			--Desabilita todos os créditos dessa regra, pois já foi criado as expirações necessárias
			UPDATE QuotasCredits SET [Enabled] = 0,	DisabledDate = GETDATE() WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
			
	RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso tenha repetido as vezes necessárias e a regra era para expirar, somente vai desabilitar essa regra
		IF (@RepeatTimes > 0 AND @RepeatTimes <= @RepeatedTimes AND @IsExpire = 1)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE QuotasRules SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE QuotasPeriods SET NextDate = NULL WHERE QuotaPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0			
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE @TBQuotasRules SET Updated = 1 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		
			CONTINUE
		END
		
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
		
		--Insere os créditos para as regras que não são de grupo e não é a padrão
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasCredits
			(
				QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
	
			ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT
			QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasRules
		WHERE
			QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND AccountGroupID IS NULL
			AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
			
		--Insere os créditos para a regra padrão
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasCredits
			(
				QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
				ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT DISTINCT
			QR.QuotaRuleID, QC.AccountID, QR.CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			QR.TotalPages, QR.PagesMono, QR.PagesColor, QR.MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			QR.FinishDate, QR.IsCorporative, QR.OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			INNER JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QR.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NOT NULL
			AND QR.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.IsDefaultQuota = 1
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Insere os créditos para as regras que são de grupo
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasCredits
			(
				QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
				ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT
			QuotaRuleID, AGO.AccountID, CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroups AG ON AG.AccountGroupID = QR.AccountGroupID
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroupsObjects AGO ON AGO.AccountGroupID = AG.AccountGroupID
		WHERE
			QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Atualiza a data do próximo crédito e número de repetições
		UPDATE
			QuotasPeriods
		SET		
			LastDateRepeated = NextDate,
			NextDate = dbo.GetQuotasNextDate(PeriodType, PeriodQuantity, StartDay, NextDate),
			RepeatedTimes = RepeatedTimes + 1
		WHERE
			QuotaPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN

			RETURN
		END	
			
		--Caso tenha repetido AS vezes necessárias e a regra era para manter os créditos, somente vai desabilitar essa regra
		IF (@RepeatTimes > 0 AND @RepeatTimes <= @RepeatedTimes + 1 AND @IsExpire = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE QuotasRules SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE QuotasPeriods SET NextDate = NULL WHERE QuotaPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		UPDATE @TBQuotasRules SET Updated = 1 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
	END
	
	--Processa os créditos expirados dos usuários
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasCredits WHERE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(FinishDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME) <= @DateProcess AND [Enabled] = 1 AND QuotaRuleID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasExpires
			(
				QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
				QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
				QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
				QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.QuotaRuleID IS NULL
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita todos os créditos que tenham data de expiração anterior a data indicada
		UPDATE
			QuotasCredits
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0,
			DisabledDate = GETDATE()
		WHERE
			FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND QuotaRuleID IS NULL
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Processa os créditos expirados dos grupos
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasRules WHERE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(FinishDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME) <= @DateProcess AND [Enabled] = 1 AND AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasExpires
			(
				QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
				QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
				QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
				QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			INNER JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess

			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita todos os créditos que tenham data de expiração anterior a data indicada
		UPDATE
			QC
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0,
			DisabledDate = GETDATE()
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			INNER JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL
					
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita a regra também, já que ela expirou
		UPDATE
			QuotasRules
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		WHERE
			FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL
			AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
		
	
	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
	END

	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	SELECT 1

END
```

## 596. proc_QuotasRules_Remove

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_Remove] 
@QuotaRuleID INT

AS

BEGIN

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	UPDATE
		QuotasCredits
	SET
		[Enabled] = 0,
		DisabledDate = GETDATE()
	WHERE
		QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
		
	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
		
	--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
	INSERT INTO
		QuotasExpires
		(
			QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
		)
	SELECT
		QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
		QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
		QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
	FROM
		QuotasCredits QC
	WHERE
		QC.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
		AND QC.QuotaCreditID NOT IN (SELECT QuotaCreditID FROM QuotasExpires WHERE QuotaCreditID IN (SELECT QuotaCreditID FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID))

	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
	
	UPDATE
		QuotasRules 
	SET
		[Enabled] = 0
	WHERE
		QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID

	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
	
	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END
```

## 598. proc_QuotasRules_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_RetrieveAll]
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountGroupID INT = -1,
@JustQuotasRules BIT,
@Enabled BIT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @BillingPrivateEnabled BIT
	SELECT @BillingPrivateEnabled = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM PoliciesParameters WHERE ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled'

	IF (@AccountGroupID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			QR.QuotaRuleID,
			QR.AccountID,
			QR.CostAccountID,
			QR.TotalPages,
			QR.PagesMono,
			QR.PagesColor,
			QR.MoneyValue,
			QR.IsCorporative,
			QR.FinishDate,
			QP.PeriodType,
			QP.PeriodQuantity,
			QP.NextDate,
			CASE QP.RepeatTimes -- Aqui trata quando tem ou não recorrencia
				WHEN 0 THEN '-'
				ELSE CAST(QP.RepeatedTimes AS NVARCHAR) + '/'+ CAST(QP.RepeatTimes AS NVARCHAR) 
			END AS Recurrences,
			QP.IsExpire,
			QO.OperatorName,
			ISNull(QIC.QuotaIdentifyCodeID,-1) AS QuotaIdentifyCodeID,
			ISNull(QIC.IdentifyCode,'-') AS IdentifyCode
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QR.OperatorID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QR.AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
			AND [Enabled] = @Enabled
			AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
			AND ((@JustQuotasRules = 0 AND QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NULL) OR (@JustQuotasRules = 1 AND QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NOT NULL))
			AND ((@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND QR.IsCorporative = 1) OR (@BillingPrivateEnabled = 1))
		ORDER BY 
			CreatedDateTime DESC
		
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@JustQuotasRules = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			QR.QuotaRuleID,
			QR.AccountID,
			QR.CostAccountID,
			QR.TotalPages,
			QR.PagesMono,
			QR.PagesColor,
			QR.MoneyValue,
			QR.IsCorporative,
			QP.PeriodType,
			QP.PeriodQuantity,
			QP.NextDate,
			CASE QP.RepeatTimes -- Aqui trata quando tem ou não recorrencia
				WHEN 0 THEN '-'
				ELSE CAST(QP.RepeatedTimes AS NVARCHAR) + '/'+ CAST(QP.RepeatTimes AS NVARCHAR) 
			END AS Recurrences,
			QP.IsExpire,
			QO.OperatorName,
			ISNull(QIC.QuotaIdentifyCodeID,-1) AS QuotaIdentifyCodeID,
			ISNull(QIC.IdentifyCode,'-') AS IdentifyCode
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QR.OperatorID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			(@AccountID = -1 OR QR.AccountID = @AccountID)
			AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR QR.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
			AND [Enabled] = @Enabled
			AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
			AND ((@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND QR.IsCorporative = 1) OR (@BillingPrivateEnabled = 1))
		ORDER BY 
			CreatedDateTime DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			QC.AccountID,
			QC.CostAccountID,
			QC.TotalPages,
			QC.PagesMono,
			QC.PagesColor,
			QC.MoneyValue,
			CASE
				WHEN QE.CreatedDateTime IS NOT NULL THEN QE.CreatedDateTime
				WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NOT NULL THEN QC.FinishDate
				WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN NULL
				ELSE dbo.GetQuotasNextDate(QP.PeriodType, QP.PeriodQuantity, QP.StartDay, QC.CreatedDateTime)
			END AS FinishDate,
			--COALESCE(QC.FinishDate, dbo.GetQuotasNextDate(0, 1, 0, QC.CreatedDateTime), QP.NextDate) AS FinishDate,
			--QC.FinishDate,
			ISNULL(QR.IsDefaultQuota, 0) AS IsDefaultQuota,
			QC.IsCorporative,
			QO.OperatorName,
			ISNULL(QIC.QuotaIdentifyCodeID,-1) AS QuotaIdentifyCodeID,
			ISNULL(QIC.IdentifyCode,'-') AS IdentifyCode
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID AND QP.IsExpire = 1
			LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QC.OperatorID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON (QIC.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID OR QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID)
			LEFT JOIN QuotasExpires QE ON QE.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
		WHERE
			(@AccountID = -1 OR QC.AccountID = @AccountID)
			AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
			AND QC.[Enabled] = @Enabled
			AND QC.OperatorID <> 1 --Não exibe os créditos quando o usuário fica negativo
			AND ((@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND QC.IsCorporative = 1) OR (@BillingPrivateEnabled = 1))
		ORDER BY 
			QC.CreatedDateTime DESC
	END
	
END
```

## 599. proc_QuotasRules_SetDefaultQuota

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_SetDefaultQuota]
@TotalPages INT,
@PagesMono INT,
@PagesColor INT,
@MoneyValue DECIMAL (19,6),
@IsCorporative BIT,
@OperatorID INT,
--QuotasPeriods
@PeriodType INT = NULL,
@PeriodQuantity INT = NULL,
@StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
@StartDay INT = NULL,
@StartMonth INT = NULL,
@IsExpire BIT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()

	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT
	SELECT @QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID FROM QuotasRules WHERE IsDefaultQuota = 1 AND [Enabled] = 1
	
	DECLARE @QuotaPeriodID INT
	SET @QuotaPeriodID = NULL

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	-- Caso tenha recorrência, primeiro cria o registro na tabela de recorrências
	IF (@PeriodType IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasPeriods
			(
				PeriodType,
				PeriodQuantity,
				StartDate,
				StartDay,
				StartMonth,
				NextDate,
				RepeatTimes,
				RepeatedTimes,
				IsExpire,		
				LastDateRepeated,
				InstantCredit
			)
		VALUES
			(
				@PeriodType,
				@PeriodQuantity,
				@StartDate,
				@StartDay,
				@StartMonth,
				ISNULL(@StartDate, dbo.GetQuotasFirstNextDate(@PeriodType, @StartDay)),
				0, --RepeatTimes,
				0, --RepeatedTimes
				@IsExpire,
				NULL, --LastDateRepeated,
				0  --InstantCredit
			)
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
			
		SELECT @QuotaPeriodID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	
	--Quando não tiver uma cota padrão, não precisa realizar esses passos
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasExpires
			(
				QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID, @DateTimeNow,
			QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
			QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
		WHERE
			QC.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		UPDATE
			QuotasCredits
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0,
			DisabledDate = GETDATE()
		WHERE
			QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)

		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
				
		UPDATE
			QuotasRules 
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		WHERE
			QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
	END
	
	--Insere a regra padrão

	INSERT INTO
		QuotasRules
		(
			AccountID,
			CostAccountID,
			CreatedDateTime,
			TotalPages,
			PagesMono,
			PagesColor,
			MoneyValue,
			IsCorporative,
			QuotaPeriodID,
			FinishDate,
			OperatorID,
			IsDefaultQuota,
			[Enabled]	
		) 
	VALUES
		(
			NULL, --AccountID,
			NULL, --CostAccountID,
			@DateTimeNow,
			@TotalPages,
			@PagesMono,
			@PagesColor,
			@MoneyValue,
			@IsCorporative,
			@QuotaPeriodID,
			NULL, --FinishDate,
			@OperatorID,
			1, --IsDefaultQuota,
			1 --Enabled
		)
		
	-- Atualiza o saldo dos usuários com a nova regra padrão caso já existia uma regra padrão configurada
	IF(@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Accounts TABLE (AccountID INT)
		INSERT INTO @Accounts SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits WHERE AccountID IS NOT NULL

		WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Accounts)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @AccountID INT = (SELECT TOP(1) AccountID FROM @Accounts)

			DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(100) = 'proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveBalance ' + CAST(@AccountID AS NVARCHAR)
			EXEC(@SQL)

			DELETE @Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AccountID
		END
	END
		
	SELECT @QuotaRuleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
	--Adiciona a regra padrão aos usuários que já tinha débitos
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL AND @QuotaPeriodID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
		SELECT DISTINCT
				@QuotaRuleID,
				QD.AccountID,
				QD.CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				NULL, --FinishDate
				@IsCorporative,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasDebits QD
			INNER JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QC.QuotaCreditID = QD.QuotaCreditID
		WHERE
			QC.QuotaRuleID <> @QuotaRuleID
				
	END

	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	SELECT 1
	
END
```

## 601. proc_QuotasRules_SetOperator

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_SetOperator]
@AccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN
	--********************************************************************************
	-- Marco,2013-04-26
	-- Esta sp é responsável por inseror um novo QuotaOperator ou atualizar um existente
	-- e retornar o seu respectivo ID. 
	--********************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @OperatorID INT
	DECLARE @OperatorName NVARCHAR(610)
	
	IF (@AccountID > 0)
	BEGIN
		-- Primeiro de Tudo, obtém o OperatorName Atualizado
		SELECT 
			@OperatorName = D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName
		FROM
			Accounts A
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = A.DomainID
		WHERE
			A.AccountID = @AccountID
	END
	ELSE IF (@AccountID = -2) --Cria o usuário utilizado na importação de cotas
	BEGIN
		SET @OperatorName = '-'
	END
	
	-- Verifica se já não existe um Operator relacionado com o AccountID parâmetrizado.
	SELECT 
		@OperatorID = OperatorID 
	FROM 
		QuotasOperators 
	WHERE 
		AccountID = @AccountID
		
	-- Se Existe, apenas atualiza o nome, se não existe, insere.	
	IF( @OperatorID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		IF (@AccountID > 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE 
				QuotasOperators
			SET
				OperatorName = @OperatorName
			WHERE
				OperatorID = @OperatorID
				AND OperatorName <> @OperatorName
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasOperators
				(
					OperatorName,
					AccountID
				)
		VALUES
				(
					@OperatorName,
					@AccountID
				)
		
		SET @OperatorID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
	
	SELECT @OperatorID
	
END
```
