															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubeMachineIDWeek C 
												WHERE	dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y AND 
														(@MachineID = -1	OR	C.MachineID		= @MachineID) 

									END
								-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

								SELECT	ISNULL(A.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,
									ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
									ISNULL(dbo.GetOperationSystem(A.MachineID),'Unknown') AS OperationSystem,
									ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(A.MachineID),'-') AS IP,
									A.MonoPages, 
									A.ColorPages, 
									A.TotalPages, 
									0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
									A.TotalCost,  
									A.TotalJobs, 
									1 AS Counter 
									FROM (SELECT	MachineID, 
													SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
													SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
													SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
													SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
													SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
											FROM (		SELECT	MachineID, 
																		SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
																		SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
																		SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
																		SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
																		SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
															FROM @temp 
															GROUP BY MachineID
													UNION All	
														SELECT 	ISNULL(PQ.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID, COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
																			CASE @PrintColorID 
																				WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																				WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																				WHEN 2 THEN -1
																			END AS MonoPages,
																			CASE @PrintColorID 
																				WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																				WHEN 1 THEN -1
																				WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																			END AS ColorPages,
																			CASE @PrintColorID
																				WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																				WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																				WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																			 END AS TotalPages,
																			CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono + P.CostColor)
																								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
																			 END AS TotalCost
															FROM PrintJobs P
																LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON P.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID
															WHERE	((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) OR 
																	(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND
																	(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
																	(@Color =-1			OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
																	(@Mono =-1			OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
																	(@PrintWayID =-1	OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
																	((@JobTypeID =-1	AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3))	OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
																	(@MachineID =-1 OR  PQ.MachineID= @MachineID) 
															GROUP BY PQ.MachineID				
													) AS B 
											GROUP BY MachineID ) AS A
											  LEFT JOIN Machines M ON A.MachineID	= M.MachineID
								WHERE A.TotalPages > 0
									ORDER BY		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (M.MachineName) END ASC,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (M.MachineName) END DESC,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
							END
					ELSE
						BEGIN

								--SELECT @EndDateTimE = @EndDateTimE + 1, @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime - 1

						
									SELECT	ISNULL(A.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,
										ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
										ISNULL(dbo.GetOperationSystem(A.MachineID),'Unknown') AS OperationSystem,
										ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(A.MachineID),'-') AS IP,
										A.MonoPages, 
										A.ColorPages, 
										A.TotalPages, 
										0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
										A.TotalCost,  
										A.TotalJobs, 
										1 AS Counter 
											FROM (SELECT	ISNULL(MachineID,-1) AS MachineID, 
															SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
															SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
															SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
															SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
															SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
													FROM ( SELECT	C.MachineID, 
																	SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																				THEN  -1
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN 
																	END) AS MonoPages,
																	SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																				THEN  -1
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  CDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN 
																		END) AS ColorPages, 
																SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + PDCN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN
																	END) AS TotalPages, 
																	SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
																SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + PDCV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV 
																	END )AS TotalCost
															FROM CubeMachineID C 
															WHERE	(c.Data				>= @StartDateTime		AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)	AND 
																	(@MachineID = -1	OR	C.MachineID		= @MachineID)  
															GROUP BY C.MachineID	
										UNION All
											SELECT 	ISNULL(PQ.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,
																CASE @PrintColorID 
																	WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																	WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																	WHEN 2 THEN -1
																END AS MonoPages,
																CASE @PrintColorID 
																	WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																	WHEN 1 THEN -1
																	WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																END AS ColorPages,
																CASE @PrintColorID 
																	WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																	WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																	WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																 END AS TotalPages, COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono + P.CostColor)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
																 END AS TotalCost
												FROM PrintJobs P
													LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ	ON P.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID 

												WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
														(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
														((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
														(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
														(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
														(@Color =-1			OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
														(@Mono =-1			OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
														(@PrintWayID =-1	OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
														((@JobTypeID =-1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
														(@MachineID =-1 OR  PQ.MachineID= @MachineID) 
												GROUP BY PQ.MachineID		
										) AS B 
										GROUP BY MachineID ) AS A 
										 LEFT  JOIN Machines M ON A.MachineID	= M.MachineID
								WHERE A.TotalPages > 0
								ORDER BY
		  						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (M.MachineName) END ASC,
								CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (M.MachineName) END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
						END
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
					SELECT	ISNULL(A.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,
						ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
						ISNULL(dbo.GetOperationSystem(A.MachineID),'Unknown') AS OperationSystem,
						ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(A.MachineID),'-') AS IP,
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						A.TotalPages, 
						0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
						A.TotalCost,  
						A.TotalJobs, 
						1 AS Counter 
						 FROM (SELECT	ISNULL(MachineID,-1) AS MachineID, 
										SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
										SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
										SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
									FROM ( SELECT	C.MachineID, 
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
												END) AS MonoPages,
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN 
													END) AS ColorPages, 
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + PDCN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN 
												END) AS TotalPages, 
												SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + PDCV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV
												END )AS TotalCost
										FROM CubeMachine C 
										WHERE	(c.Data						>= @StartDateTime			AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)		AND 
											(@MachineID = -1			OR		C.MachineID				= @MachineID)			AND 
											(@PaperSizeID = -1			OR		C.PaperSizeID			= @PaperSizeID)			AND
											(@PrintApplicationID = -1	OR		C.PrintApplicationID	= @PrintApplicationID)	AND
											(@JobOriginID = -1			OR      C.JobOriginID				= @JobOriginID)			AND
											(@SiteID = -1				OR		C.SiteID= @SiteID)								AND
											--//alteração [4.2]
											--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
											(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))

										GROUP BY C.MachineID
							UNION All
								SELECT	ISNULL(PQ.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,	
														CASE @PrintColorID 
															WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 2 THEN -1
														END AS MonoPages,
														CASE @PrintColorID 
															WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
															WHEN 1 THEN -1
															WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
														END AS ColorPages,
														CASE @PrintColorID
															WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor )
														END AS TotalPages,COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
			 											CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono + P.CostColor)
																			WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
														 END AS TotalCost
									FROM PrintJobs P 
										LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues	PQ	ON P.PrinterQueueID		= PQ.PrinterQueueID 
										LEFT  JOIN Machines			M	ON PQ.MachineID			= M.MachineID 
								WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
										(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
										((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
										(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
										(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
										(@Color =-1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
										(@Mono =-1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
										(@PaperSizeID =-1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
										(@MachineID =-1 OR PQ.MachineID = @MachineID) AND 
										(@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
										(@PrintWayID =-1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
										(@JobOriginID=-1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
										((@JobTypeID =-1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
										(@SiteID =-1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
										--//alteração [4.2]
										--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
										(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
 								GROUP BY PQ.MachineID 	
						) AS B 
						GROUP BY MachineID ) AS A
						LEFT JOIN Machines M ON A.MachineID = M.MachineID		


					WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

					ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (M.MachineName) END ASC,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (M.MachineName) END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
				END

			END -- Fim do tratamento HH:MM
		ELSE

			BEGIN
				IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @CCIDList))
					BEGIN
						--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

						SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

						While (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
							BEGIN
								IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
									BEGIN
										Insert into @dias 
											Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

						While (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
							BEGIN
								
								IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
									BEGIN
										SET @ini = 1
										SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
									END
								
								IF( DAY(@dia) in (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
									BEGIN
										Insert into @Semanas Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								ELSE
									BEGIN
										Break
									END	

								SET @dia = @dia +1

								While (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22))
									BEGIN				
										SET @dia = @dia + 1
									END

								IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
									BEGIN
										DELETE FROM @Semanas 
											WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia in (1, 8, 15, 22) 
							
										Insert into @Semanas
											Values (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	

										SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
									END
							END

						while(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
							BEGIN
								Insert into @dias 
									Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

        				-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
						
						SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

						IF (@total > 0)
							BEGIN

								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

								While(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
											FROM @dias
										DELETE FROM @dias 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										Insert into @temp
											SELECT	C.MachineID, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END AS ColorPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + PDCN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN
														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubeMachineID C 
												WHERE	DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y AND 
														(@MachineID = -1	OR	C.MachineID		= @MachineID) 
									END

								-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

								While(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
											FROM @semanas
										DELETE FROM @semanas 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										Insert into @temp
											SELECT	C.MachineID, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END AS ColorPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + PDCN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN
														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubeMachineIDWeek C 
												WHERE	dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y AND 
														(@MachineID = -1	OR	C.MachineID		= @MachineID) 

									END
								-- Fim processamento ponteiros.
								SELECT	ISNULL(A.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,
									ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
									ISNULL(dbo.GetOperationSystem(A.MachineID),'Unknown') AS OperationSystem,
									ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(A.MachineID),'-') AS IP,
									A.MonoPages, 
									A.ColorPages, 
									A.TotalPages, 
									0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
									A.TotalCost,  
									A.TotalJobs, 
									1 AS Counter 
									FROM (SELECT	ISNULL(MachineID,-1) AS MachineID, 
													SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
													SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
													SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
													SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
													SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
											FROM @temp 
											GROUP BY MachineID) AS A
									LEFT JOIN Machines M ON A.MachineID	= M.MachineID
									WHERE A.TotalPages > 0
									ORDER BY		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (M.MachineName) END ASC,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (M.MachineName) END DESC,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
							END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
								SET @EndDateTimE = @EndDateTimE + 1
								SELECT	ISNULL(A.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,
									ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
									ISNULL(dbo.GetOperationSystem(A.MachineID),'Unknown') AS OperationSystem,
									ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(A.MachineID),'-') AS IP,
									A.MonoPages, 
									A.ColorPages, 
									A.TotalPages, 
									0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
									A.TotalCost,  
									A.TotalJobs, 
									1 AS Counter 
										FROM (SELECT	C.MachineID, 
													SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END) AS MonoPages,
													SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END) AS ColorPages, 
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + PDCN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN
													END) AS TotalPages, 
													SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
													END )AS TotalCost
											FROM CubeMachineID C 
											WHERE	(c.Data				>= @StartDateTime		AND C.Data < @EndDateTimE)	AND 
													(@MachineID = -1	 OR	C.MachineID		= @MachineID)  
											GROUP BY C.MachineID	
									) AS  A 
									 LEFT JOIN Machines M ON A.MachineID	= M.MachineID
									WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

								ORDER BY
								CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (M.MachineName) END ASC,
								CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (M.MachineName) END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
						END
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
					SELECT	ISNULL(A.MachineID,-1) AS MachineID,
						ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
						ISNULL(dbo.GetOperationSystem(A.MachineID),'Unknown') AS OperationSystem,
						ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(A.MachineID),'-') AS IP,
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
						A.TotalCost,  
						A.TotalJobs, 
						1 AS Counter 
						 FROM (SELECT	C.MachineID, 
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
													THEN  -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN 
										END) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
													THEN  -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN 
											END) AS ColorPages, 
									SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN + PSCN
