```sql
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + PDCN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN + PSIN 											
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN
										END) AS TotalPages, 
										SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
									SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + PDCV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV
										END )AS TotalCost
								FROM CubeMachine C 
								WHERE	(c.Data						>= @StartDateTime			AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)		AND 
									(@MachineID = -1			OR		C.MachineID				= @MachineID)			AND 
									(@PaperSizeID = -1			OR		C.PaperSizeID			= @PaperSizeID)			AND
									(@PrintApplicationID = -1	OR		C.PrintApplicationID	= @PrintApplicationID)	AND
									(@JobOriginID = -1			OR      C.JobOriginID				= @JobOriginID)			AND
									(@SiteID = -1				OR		C.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//aqui só pode testar o CC
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))


								GROUP BY C.MachineID	
						) AS  A
					  LEFT JOIN Machines M ON A.MachineID	= M.MachineID
					WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

					ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (M.MachineName) END ASC,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (M.MachineName) END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
				END
		END
	END

END
```

## 613. proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@ProjectID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID,@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @HasCostAccountID BIT --0: Não Passou Centro de Custo; 1: Passou Centro de Custo
	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	IF (@CostAccountID = -1)
	BEGIN
		--nesse caso sempre tem que ter o CC. Então se não tem é pq quer os jobs sem CC
		SET @HasCostAccountID = 0
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SET @HasCostAccountID = 1		
	END
	
	print @CostAccountID
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
		SET @Mono = 1
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
		SET @Color = 1

	SELECT 
		Details.PrintJobID,
		Details.JobOriginID,
		Details.GroupName, 
		Details.Title , 
		Details.DatePrinted , 
		Details.PagesColor,
		Details.PagesMono,
		Details.Pages,  
		Details.PrintCost, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName , 
		Details.PrintColorName,
		Details.PrintWayID, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName ,
		1 AS Counter,
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			PrintJobs.PrintJobID,
			PrintJobs.JobOriginID,
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID) AS GroupName, 
			--PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName AS GroupName, 
			PrintJobs.AccountID,
			PrintJobs.Title , 
			PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID , 
			PrintJobs.PaperSizeID, 
			PrintJobs.DatePrinted,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
				WHEN 1 THEN -1
				WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
			END AS PagesColor,
			CASE @PrintColorID 
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
				WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
				WHEN 2 THEN -1
			END AS PagesMono,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono
	     		WHEN 1 THEN  PrintJobs.PagesMono
		      	WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor 
			END AS Pages,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono
	     			WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.CostMono
		      		WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor
			END AS PrintCost,
			CASE  
				WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
				ELSE 'Mono'
			END AS PrintColorName,
			PrintJobs.PrintWayID
		FROM         
			PrintJobs 
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
		WHERE
			(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND
			(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
			AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
			AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
			AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
			AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
			AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
			AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
			AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) )OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
			AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
			AND (@PrinterDeviceID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) 
			AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				((
					@UseORMethod= 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)
						AND 
						(
							(@HasCostAccountID = 0 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL) 
							OR 
							(@HasCostAccountID =1 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
						)
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod= 1 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			
						OR
						(
							(@HasCostAccountID = 0 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL) 
								OR 
							(@HasCostAccountID =1 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
						)
					)

				))
		 ) AS Details
			INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
			INNER JOIN PapersSize ON Details.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
	ORDER BY
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC, 
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC
		
END
```

## 614. proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountPrintDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountPrintDetails]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = 1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1, 
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren BIT = 1

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início
	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE (AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters (AccountID, CostAccountID, UseORMethod, BuildListType)
	SELECT
		AccountID, CostAccountID, UseORMethod, BuildListType
	FROM
		[dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT
		@AccountID = AccountID,
		@CostAccountID = CostAccountID,
		@UseORMethod = UseORMethod,
		@buildListType = BuildListType
	FROM 
		@Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		--Verifica se é marcado a o~pção pra trazer os filhos do centro de custo na filtragem 
		IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Se sim continua como era antes
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList 
			SELECT 
				CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se não insere apenas o centro de custo pesquisado na tabela 
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList
			VALUES
				(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList 
			SELECT
				DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END

	SELECT 
		CostAccountID,
		ISNULL(CostAccountName, '@@UsersWithoutACostAccount') AS CostAccountName, 
		AccountID,
		GroupName,
		PrintJobID,
		JobOriginID,	
		Title,
		DatePrinted, 
		PagesColor, 
		PagesMono,
		Pages,  
		PrintCost, 
		PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintColorName,
		PrintWayID, 
		PaperSizeName,
		1 AS [Counter],
		PrintApplicationResource
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT
				ISNULL(PJ.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
				dbo.GetCostAccountName(CA.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
				PJ.AccountID,
				dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS GroupName,
				PJ.PrintJobID,
				PJ.JobOriginID,
				PJ.Title , 
				PJ.DatePrinted , 
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
					WHEN  1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
					WHEN  2 THEN -1
				END AS PagesMono,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor
					WHEN  1 THEN -1
					WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor
				END AS PagesColor,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono
	     			WHEN  1 THEN  PJ.PagesMono
		      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor 
				END AS Pages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono
	     			WHEN  1 THEN PJ.CostMono
		      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.CostColor
				END AS PrintCost,
				CASE  
     				WHEN PJ.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
					ELSE 'Mono'
				END AS PrintColorName,
				PJ.PrintWayID,
				PA.PrintApplicationName,
				PS.PaperSizeName,
				PA.PrintApplicationResource
			FROM         
				PrintJobs PJ
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
				LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = PJ.CostAccountID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJ.AccountID
				INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
				INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON PJ.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID
				INNER JOIN PapersSize PS ON PJ.PaperSizeID = PS.PaperSizeID 
			WHERE
				(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
				AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0 ) AND	(@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0 ) 
				AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
				AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
				AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
				AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  PJ.SiteID = @SiteID) 
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				(
					(
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
				)
		) AS Details
			 
	ORDER BY
		Details.CostAccountName,
		Details.GroupName,
		Details.DatePrinted
		/*CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END desc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC, 
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END desc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END desc*/

END
```

## 615. proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountWithoutDetails

```sql
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountWithoutDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeId  SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](-1,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID FROM @Parameters --*****************

--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
		DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

		SET @Mono = - 1
		SET @Color =  -1

		 IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
			SET @Mono = 1
		ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
 			SET @Color = 1


	IF((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType') = 2)
	BEGIN
	
			 SELECT *
				
				 FROM  ( 
				
					SELECT     
						0 AS CostAccountID, 	
						'@@PrintersWithoutACostAccount' AS CostAccountName,
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID,
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName + ' (' + PrintersDevices.AddressName + ':'+  PrintersDevices.AddressPort +')' AS PrinterDeviceName,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter 
					FROM         
						PrintJobs
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND 
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND		
						(@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) AND
						(@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) AND
						(@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND
						(@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
						(@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
						(@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
						((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
						(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL ) AND 
						(@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							(
								(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
								(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL)
							)


					GROUP BY 
 						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName,PrintersDevices.AddressName,PrintersDevices.AddressPort, PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS CostAccountsSummary 
			  
				ORDER BY
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
END
ELSE
BEGIN 
						 SELECT *
				
				 FROM  ( 
				
					SELECT     
						0 AS CostAccountID, 	
						'@@UsersWithoutACostAccount' AS CostAccountName,
						Accounts.AccountID,
						Accounts.FullName +'  (' + Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName +')'  AS AccountName,
						--SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) AS PagesColor, 
						--SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter 
					FROM         
						PrintJobs
						INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID
						INNER JOIN Domains ON Domains.DomainID = Accounts.DomainID
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND 
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND		
						(@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) AND
						(@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) AND
						(@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND
						(@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
						(@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
						(@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
						((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
						(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL ) AND 
						(@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							(
								(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
								(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL)
							)


					GROUP BY 
 						Domains.DomainName, Accounts.AccountID, Accounts.FullName, Accounts.LogonName--, CostAccounts.CostAccountID, CostAccounts.CostAccountName 
			) AS CostAccountsSummary 
			  
				ORDER BY
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
		
END

END
```

## 616. proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountsSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountsSummary] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren BIT = 1

AS

BEGIN --BEGIN DA SP

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE (AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters (AccountID, CostAccountID, UseORMethod, BuildListType)
	SELECT
		AccountID, CostAccountID, UseORMethod, BuildListType
	FROM
		[dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT
		@AccountID = AccountID,
		@CostAccountID = CostAccountID,
		@UseORMethod = UseORMethod,
		@buildListType = BuildListType
	FROM 
		@Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		--Verifica se é marcado a o~pção pra trazer os filhos do centro de custo na filtragem 
		IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Se sim continua como era antes
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList 
			SELECT 
				CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se não insere apenas o centro de custo pesquisado na tabela 
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList
			VALUES
				(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList 
			SELECT
				DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	--Verifica qual string vai utilizar no retorno da SP
	DECLARE @ResourceWithoutCostAccount NVARCHAR(30)
	
	IF((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType') = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @ResourceWithoutCostAccount = '@@PrintersWithoutACostAccount'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @ResourceWithoutCostAccount = '@@UsersWithoutACostAccount'
	END

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT ,  @Mono SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Dia DATETIME, @Mes SMALLINT
	DECLARE @Ini BIT, @Total INT, @d SMALLINT, @m SMALLINT, @y SMALLINT
	DECLARE @Temp		TABLE (CostAccountID INT, MonoPages INT, ColorPages INT, TotalPages INT, TotalJobs INT,  TotalCost MONEY)
	DECLARE @Dias		TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
	DECLARE @Semanas	TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME


	DECLARE @ReportCostAccounts TABLE
		(
			 CostAccountParentID INT,
			 CostAccountID INT,
			 CostAccountName NVARCHAR(255),
			 CostAccountCode NVARCHAR(100),
			 MonoPages INT,
			 ColorPages INT,
			 TotalPages INT,
			 TotalCost DECIMAL(19, 6),
			 TotalJobs INT,
			 [Counter] INT,
			 TotalPagesAux INT,
			 MonoPagesAux INT,
			 ColorPagesAux INT,
			 TotalCostAux DECIMAL(19, 6),
			 ShowOrder TINYINT
		)

	DECLARE @ReportCostAccountsAux TABLE
		(
			 CostAccountParentID INT,
			 CostAccountID INT,
			 CostAccountName NVARCHAR(255),
			 CostAccountCode NVARCHAR(100),
			 MonoPages INT,
			 ColorPages INT,
			 TotalPages INT,
			 TotalCost DECIMAL(19, 6),
			 TotalJobs INT,
			 [Counter] INT,
			 TotalPagesAux INT,
			 MonoPagesAux INT,
			 ColorPagesAux INT,
			 TotalCostAux DECIMAL(19, 6),
			 ShowOrder TINYINT
		) 
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountsMissing TABLE
		(
			CostAccountParentID INT
		)


	SELECT @Mono = - 1, @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END 
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END

	--alteração 4.2 [pega se tem que pegar os dados do usuário, então tem que ser da printJobs]
	IF @AccountID <> -1
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@ReportCostAccounts
		SELECT
			CC.CostAccountParentID,
			ISNULL(A.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
			ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, @ResourceWithoutCostAccount) AS CostAccountName, 
			ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
			A.MonoPages, 
			A.ColorPages, 
			A.TotalPages, 
			A.TotalCost,  
			A.TotalJobs, 1 AS [Counter],
			0 AS TotalPagesAux,
			0 AS TotalCostAux,
			0 AS MonoPagesAux,
			0 AS ColorPagesAux,
			1 AS ShowOrder
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PJ.CostAccountID,
					CASE @PrintColorID
						WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
						WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
						WHEN  2 THEN -1
					END AS MonoPages,
					CASE @PrintColorID
						WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
						WHEN  1 THEN -1
						WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
					END AS ColorPages,
					CASE @PrintColorID
						WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono)
						WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
						WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
					END AS TotalPages,
					COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
					CASE @PrintColorID
						WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono)
						WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono)
						WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor)
					END AS TotalCost
				FROM
					PrintJobs PJ
				WHERE
					(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
					AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
					AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0)
					AND (@Mono =  -1 OR PJ.PagesMono  > 0)
					AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID)
					AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
					AND
					(
						(
							@UseORMethod = 0 
							AND
							(
								(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
								AND 
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							)
						)
						OR
						(
							@UseORMethod = 1
							AND
							(
								(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
								OR
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							)
						)
					)
				GROUP BY
					PJ.CostAccountID
			)
			AS A
			LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON A.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			A.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END ASC,
			 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END DESC,
			 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
			 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
			 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
			 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

		SELECT @StartDateTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) +
						 RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) +
						 RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME),
			   @EndDateTime	= CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) +
						 RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) +
						 RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME) 
				
		IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
		BEGIN
			SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' +
								CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' +
								CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
		END

		IF(@StartDateTime > @EndDateTime)
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data de Inicio de relatório é maior que data de Fim!', 16,1)
			RETURN	
		END

		-- Serão realizadas duas Consultas Se existe ou não a necessidade de ir nos Cubos + Produção, ou apenas Cubos.
		IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0
			OR (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
		BEGIN -- BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE VAI PEGAR DA PRINTJOBS
			IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime) + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
			END

			IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
			END

			IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1)
			BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO ONDE NÃO HOUVE FILTROS
				SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

				WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
				BEGIN
					IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @dias VALUES (YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

				SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

				WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
				BEGIN
					IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ini = 1
						SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
					END
						
					IF(DAY(@dia) IN (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES (YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						BREAK
					END	

					SET @dia = @dia +1

					WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22))
					BEGIN				
						SET @dia = @dia + 1
					END

					IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
					BEGIN
						DELETE FROM @Semanas WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia IN (1, 8, 15, 22) 
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES  (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	
						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
					END
				END

				WHILE (@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @dias VALUES (YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

      			-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
				SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @semanas)

				IF (@total > 0)
				BEGIN --BEGIN DE ONDE VAI PEGAR DADOS DOS CUBOS SEMANAIS
					PRINT 'CUBO SEMANAL + PRINTJOBS, SEM FILTROS'
					SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @dias)

					WHILE(@total > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @total = @total - 1 
						SELECT TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia FROM @dias
						DELETE FROM @dias WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
						INSERT INTO
							@Temp
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID, 
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
							END AS MonoPages,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
							END AS ColorPages,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN
							END AS TotalPages,
							TotJobs,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
									WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
									WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV 
								END AS TotalCost
						FROM
							CubeCostAccountID C
						WHERE
							DAY(c.data) = @d
							AND MONTH(c.data) = @m
							AND YEAR(c.data) = @y
							AND  --//alteração [4.2] aqui só pode testar os CCs
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					END

					-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
					SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @semanas)

					WHILE(@total > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @total = @total - 1
						SELECT TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia FROM @semanas
						DELETE FROM @semanas WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
						INSERT INTO
							@Temp
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							CASE	
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
							END AS MonoPages,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
							END AS ColorPages,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
							END AS TotalPages,
							TotJobs,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV 
							END AS TotalCost
						FROM 
							CubeCostAccountIDWeek C
						WHERE
							dayw = @d
							AND monthw = @m
							AND yearw = @y
							AND --//alteração [4.2] //aqui só pode testar os CCs
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					END
					-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

					INSERT INTO
						@ReportCostAccounts
					SELECT
						CC.CostAccountParentID,
						ISNULL(A.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID, 
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, @ResourceWithoutCostAccount) AS CostAccountName,
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.TotalCost,  
						A.TotalJobs,
						1 AS [Counter],
						0 AS TotalPagesAux,
						0 AS TotalCostAux,
						0 AS MonoPagesAux,
						0 AS ColorPagesAux,
						1 AS ShowOrder
					FROM
						(
							SELECT	
								CostAccountID, 
								SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
								SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
								SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
								SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
								SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
							FROM
								(
									SELECT	
										CostAccountID,
										SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
										SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
										SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
									FROM
										@Temp 
									GROUP BY
										CostAccountID

									UNION ALL	

									SELECT 	
										PJ.CostAccountID,
										COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
										CASE @PrintColorID
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
											WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
											WHEN  2 THEN -1
										END AS MonoPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
											WHEN  1 THEN -1
											WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
										END AS ColorPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID 
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono)
											WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono) 
											WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
										END AS TotalPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor)
											WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono)
											WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor)
										END AS TotalCost
									FROM
										PrintJobs PJ
									WHERE
										((PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) OR
										(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND
										(PJ.JobDisabled = 0) AND
										(@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0) AND 
										(@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0)	AND 
										(@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
										((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND 
										--//alteração [4.2]
										--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
										(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
									GROUP BY 
										PJ.CostAccountID
								) AS B 
							GROUP BY 
								CostAccountID
						)
						AS A
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = A.CostAccountID
					WHERE 
						A.TotalPages > 0
					ORDER BY
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
				END --END DE ONDE VAI PEGAR DADOS DOS CUBOS SEMANAIS
				ELSE
				BEGIN -- BEGIN DE ONDE VAI PEGAR OS DADOS DOS CUBOS NORMAIS SEM FILTROS
					PRINT 'CUBOS SECUNDÁRIOS + PRINTJOBS, SEM FILTROS'	

					--SELECT @EndDateTimE = @EndDateTimE + 1--,-@StartDateTime = @StartDateTime - 1
					INSERT INTO
						@ReportCostAccounts
					SELECT	
						CC.CostAccountParentID,
						ISNULL(A.CostAccountID,-1) AS CostAccountID, 
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, @ResourceWithoutCostAccount) AS CostAccountName, 
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.TotalCost,  
						A.TotalJobs, 1 AS [Counter],
						0 AS TotalPagesAux,
						0 AS TotalCostAux,
						0 AS MonoPagesAux,
						0 AS ColorPagesAux,
						1 AS ShowOrder
					FROM
						(
							SELECT	
								CostAccountID,
								SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
								SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
								SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
								SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
								SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
							FROM
								(
									SELECT
										C.Costaccountid,
										SUM(CASE
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
											END) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(CASE
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
											END) AS ColorPages, 	
										SUM(CASE
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
										END) AS TotalPages, 
										SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
										SUM(CASE	
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV 
											END )AS TotalCost
									FROM
										CubeCostAccountID C 
									WHERE
										(C.Data	>= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
										AND --//alteração [4.2] //aqui só pode testar os CCs
										(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
									GROUP BY
										C.CostAccountID
		
									UNION ALL

									SELECT
										PJ.CostAccountID,
										CASE @PrintColorID
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono) 
											WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono) 
											WHEN 2 THEN -1 
										END AS MonoPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor) 
											WHEN 1 THEN -1
											WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
										END AS ColorPages, 
										CASE @PrintColorID
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono)
											WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono) 
											WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor) 
										END AS TotalPages,
										COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
										CASE @PrintColorID 
											WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor)
											WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono)
											WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor)
										END AS TotalCost
									FROM
										PrintJobs PJ
									WHERE
										(((PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
										(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
										((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
										(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
										(PJ.JobDisabled = 0)	AND 
										(@Color = -1			OR PJ.PagesColor > 0) AND 
										(@Mono = -1			OR PJ.PagesMono > 0)	AND 
										(@PrintWayID = -1	OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
										((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND 
										--//alteração [4.2]
										--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
										(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
									GROUP BY
										PJ.CostAccountID
								) AS B 
							GROUP BY
								CostAccountID
						)
						AS A
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = A.CostAccountID
					WHERE
						A.TotalPages > 0
					ORDER BY
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
				END -- END DE ONDE VAI PEGAR OS DADOS DOS CUBOS NORMAIS SEM FILTROS
			END  --END DO BLOCO ONDE NÃO HOUVE FILTROS
			ELSE
			BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO COM FILTROS
				PRINT 'CUBOS PRIMÁRIOS + PRINTJOBS, COM FILTROS'
				
				INSERT INTO
					@ReportCostAccounts
				SELECT
					CC.CostAccountParentID,
					ISNULL(A.CostAccountID,-1) AS CostAccountID, 
					ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, @ResourceWithoutCostAccount) AS CostAccountName, 
					ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
					A.MonoPages, 
					A.ColorPages, 
					A.TotalPages, 
					A.TotalCost,  
					A.TotalJobs, 1 AS [Counter],
					0 AS TotalPagesAux,
					0 AS TotalCostAux,
					0 AS MonoPagesAux,
			        0 AS ColorPagesAux,
					1 AS ShowOrder
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							CostAccountID,
							SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
							SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
							SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
							SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
							SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
						FROM
							(
								SELECT
									C.CostAccountID,
									SUM(CASE
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN   
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
										END) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(CASE
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
											END) AS ColorPages, 	
										SUM(CASE
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
```
