```sql
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
											END) AS TotalPages, 
											SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
											SUM(CASE
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV 
												END )AS TotalCost
								FROM
									CubeCostAccount C
								WHERE
									(C.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime) AND
									(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND
									(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
									(@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
									(@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								GROUP BY
									C.CostAccountID
									
								UNION ALL
								
								SELECT
									PJ.CostAccountID,
									CASE @PrintColorID
										WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono) 
										WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono) 
										WHEN 2 THEN -1
									END AS MonoPages,
									CASE @PrintColorID
										WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
										WHEN 1 THEN -1
										WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
									END AS ColorPages,
									CASE @PrintColorID
										WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono)
										WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
										WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
									END AS TotalPages,
									COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
									CASE @PrintColorID
										WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor)
										WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono)
										WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor)
									END AS TotalCost
								FROM
									PrintJobs PJ
								WHERE
									(((PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
									(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
									((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
									(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
									(PJ.JobDisabled = 0)	AND 
									(@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0) AND 
									(@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0)	AND 
									(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
									(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
									(@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
									(@JobOriginID= -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
									((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
									(@SiteID = -1 OR  PJ.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
 								GROUP BY
 									PJ.CostAccountID
							) AS B 
						GROUP BY
							CostAccountID
					)
					AS A
					LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = A.CostACCOUNTID
				WHERE
					A.TotalPages > 0
				ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END ASC,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END DESC,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
			END
		END -- BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE VAI PEGAR DA PRINTJOBS 
		ELSE
		BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE SÓ VAI PEGAR DOS CUBOS
			IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1)
			BEGIN -- BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS SEM FILTROS
				SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

				WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
				BEGIN
					IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @dias VALUES (YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

				SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

				WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
				BEGIN
					IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ini = 1
						SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
					END
				
					IF( DAY(@dia) IN (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES (YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						BREAK
					END	

					SET @dia = @dia +1
					WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22))
					BEGIN				
						SET @dia = @dia + 1
					END

					IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
					BEGIN
						DELETE FROM @Semanas WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia IN (1, 8, 15, 22) 
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES  (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	
						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
					END
				END

				WHILE(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @dias VALUES (YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

   				-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
				SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @semanas)

				IF (@total > 0)
				BEGIN --BEGIN SÓ DO CUBOS SEM FILTROS SEMANAIS
					PRINT 'pega só dos cubos,  semanais, sem filtros '

					SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @dias)

					WHILE(@total > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @total = @total - 1 
						
						SELECT TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
						FROM @dias
						
						DELETE FROM @dias 
						WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
						
						INSERT INTO
							@Temp
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
							END AS MonoPages,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
							END AS ColorPages,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
							END AS TotalPages,
							totJobs,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV END AS TotalCost
						FROM
							CubeCostAccountID C
						WHERE
							DAY(C.Data) = @d AND MONTH(C.Data) = @m AND YEAR(C.Data) = @y
							AND --//alteração [4.2] //aqui só pode testar os CCs
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					END

					-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
					SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @semanas)

					WHILE(@total > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @total = @total - 1 
						
						SELECT TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
						FROM @semanas
						
						DELETE FROM @semanas
						WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
					
						INSERT INTO
							@Temp
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
							END AS MonoPages,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
							END AS ColorPages, 
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
							END AS TotalPages,
							totJobs,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV 
							END AS TotalCost
						FROM
							CubeCostAccountIDWeek C 
						WHERE
							dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y
							AND --//alteração [4.2] //aqui só pode testar os CCs
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					END
						-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

					INSERT INTO
						@ReportCostAccounts
					SELECT
						CC.CostAccountParentID,
						ISNULL(A.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID, 
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, @ResourceWithoutCostAccount) AS CostAccountName, 
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.TotalCost,  
						A.TotalJobs, 1 AS [Counter],
						0 AS TotalPagesAux,
						0 AS TotalCostAux,
						0 AS MonoPagesAux,
						0 AS ColorPagesAux,
						1 AS ShowOrder
					FROM
						(
							SELECT
								CostAccountID, 
								SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
								SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
								SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
								SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
								SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
							FROM
								@Temp
							GROUP BY
								CostAccountID
						)
						AS A
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = A.CostAccountID
					WHERE
						A.TotalPages > 0
					ORDER BY
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
				END --END SÓ DO CUBOS SEM FILTROS SEMANAIS
				ELSE
				BEGIN --BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS 2 SEM FILTROS
					PRINT 'pega só dos cubos, dos secundários -  sem filtros'
					
					SET @EndDateTimE = @EndDateTimE + 1
					
					INSERT INTO
						@ReportCostAccounts
					SELECT
						CC.CostAccountParentID,
						ISNULL(A.CostAccountID,-1) AS CostAccountID, 
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, @ResourceWithoutCostAccount) AS CostAccountName, 
						ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.TotalCost,  
						A.TotalJobs, 1 AS [Counter],
						0 AS TotalPagesAux,
						0 AS TotalCostAux,
						0 AS MonoPagesAux,
						0 AS ColorPagesAux,
						1 AS ShowOrder
					FROM
						(
							SELECT
								C.CostAccountID,
								SUM(CASE
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN  PDCN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN  PSFN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN  PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN  PDIN 
								END) AS MonoPages,
								SUM(CASE
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
								END) AS ColorPages,
								SUM(CASE
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
								END) AS TotalPages,
								SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs,
								SUM(CASE
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV 
								END )AS TotalCost
							FROM 
								CubeCostAccountID C
							WHERE
								(C.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data < @EndDateTime)
								AND --//alteração [4.2] //aqui só pode testar os CCs
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							GROUP BY
								C.CostAccountID
						)
						AS A 
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = A.CostAccountID
					WHERE 
						A.TotalPages > 0
					ORDER BY
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
				END -- END SÓ DOS CUBOS 2 SEM FILTROS
			END -- END SÓ DOS CUBOS SEM FILTROS
			ELSE
			BEGIN -- BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS COM FILTROS 

			PRINT 'PEGA SÓ DOS CUBOS, DOS PRIMÁRIOS, COM FILTROS'

			INSERT INTO
				@ReportCostAccounts
			SELECT
				CC.CostAccountParentID,
				ISNULL(A.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID, 
				ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, @ResourceWithoutCostAccount) AS CostAccountName, 
				ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
				A.MonoPages, 
				A.ColorPages, 
				A.TotalPages, 
				A.TotalCost,  
				A.TotalJobs, 1 AS [Counter],
				0 AS TotalPagesAux,
				0 AS TotalCostAux,
				0 AS MonoPagesAux,
				0 AS ColorPagesAux,
				1 AS ShowOrder
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT
						C.CostAccountID,
						SUM(CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
						END) AS MonoPages,
						SUM(CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1 THEN -1
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN   
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN 
								WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
						END) AS ColorPages,
						SUM(CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN + PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN + PDCN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + CSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN + PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN + PDFN  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN + PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIN
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN + PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIN 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIN 
						END) AS TotalPages,
						SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs,
						SUM(CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 THEN CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV + PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PSCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CSCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV + PDCV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN PDCV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 THEN CDCV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + CSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV + PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PSFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CSFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV + PDFV  
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN PDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 THEN CDFV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV + PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PSIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CSIV
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV + PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN PDIV 
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1 THEN CDIV 
						END )AS TotalCost
					FROM
						CubeCostAccount C 
					WHERE
						(C.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime) AND 
						(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND
						(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
						(@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
						(@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
						--//alteração [4.2]
						--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					GROUP BY
						C.CostAccountID
				)
				AS  A
				LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = A.CostAccountID
			WHERE
				A.TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CC.CostAccountName) END DESC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC

			END  -- END  SÓ DOS CUBOS COM FILTROS 

		END -- END DE ONDE SÓ PEGA DADOS DOS CUBOS
	END
	
	INSERT INTO
		@ReportCostAccountsAux
	SELECT
		CostAccountParentID,
		CostAccountID, 
		CostAccountName,
		CostAccountCode,
		SUM(MonoPages)  AS MonoPages,
		SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
		SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
		SUM(TotalCost)  AS TotalCost,
		SUM(TotalJobs)  AS TotalJobs,
		[Counter],
		TotalPagesAux,
		MonoPagesAux,
		ColorPagesAux,
		TotalCostAux,
		1 AS ShowOrder
	FROM
		@ReportCostAccounts
	GROUP BY
		CostAccountParentID,
		CostAccountID,
		CostAccountName,
		CostAccountCode,
		[Counter],
		TotalPagesAux, 
		MonoPagesAux, 
		ColorPagesAux,
		TotalCostAux 

	UPDATE
		@ReportCostAccountsAux
	SET
		CostAccountID = NULL
	WHERE
		CostAccountID = -1
	
	INSERT INTO
		@CostAccountsMissing 
	SELECT
		DISTINCT (CostAccountParentID)
	FROM 
		@ReportCostAccountsAux
	WHERE
		CostAccountParentID NOT IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @ReportCostAccountsAux WHERE CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)
		AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID)

	DECLARE @Top1 INT
	SELECT @Top1 = CostAccountParentID FROM @CostAccountsMissing

	IF (@Top1 IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		WHILE ((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @CostAccountsMissing) <>  0)
		BEGIN 
			INSERT INTO
				@ReportCostAccountsAux
			SELECT
				CostAccountParentID,
				CostAccountID,
				CostAccountName,
				ISNULL(CostAccountCode, '-') AS CostAccountCode,
				CASE @PrintColorID WHEN 2 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS MonoPages, 
				CASE @PrintColorID WHEN 1 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS ColorPages, 
				0 AS TotalPages, 
				0 AS TotalCost, 
				0 AS TotalJobs, 
				1 AS [Counter],
				0 AS TotalPagesAux, 
				CASE @PrintColorID WHEN 2 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS MonoPagesAux, 
				CASE @PrintColorID WHEN 1 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS ColorPagesAux, 
				0 AS TotalCostAux,
				1 AS ShowOrder
			FROM
				CostAccounts
			WHERE
				CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountParentID FROM @CostAccountsMissing) 

			DELETE FROM @CostAccountsMissing
			
			INSERT INTO
				@CostAccountsMissing 
			SELECT DISTINCT
				(CostAccountParentID)
			FROM 
				@ReportCostAccountsAux
			WHERE
				CostAccountParentID NOT IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @ReportCostAccountsAux WHERE CostAccountID IS NOT NULL)
				AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID)
				AND CostAccountParentID IS NOT NULL
		END 
	END

	IF (@CostAccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			@ReportCostAccountsAux 
		SET 
			CostAccountParentID = NULL 
		WHERE 
			CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
	END
	
	UPDATE
		@ReportCostAccountsAux
	SET 
		CostAccountName = [dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CostAccountID)
	WHERE 
		CostAccountID <> -1

    -- Resource vai primeiro na ordenação 
	UPDATE
		@ReportCostAccountsAux
	SET
		ShowOrder = 0
	WHERE
		CostAccountName = @ResourceWithoutCostAccount

	SELECT
		*
	FROM 
		@ReportCostAccountsAux RCA
	ORDER BY 
		ShowOrder,
		CostAccountParentID,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN CostAccountName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN CostAccountName END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC

END
```

## 617. proc_Reports_RetrieveCubeBureau

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCubeBureau] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](-1,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario
	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2


	SELECT 
		ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CB.CostAccountID), 'No Account Cost') AS CostAccountName,
		BR.BureauResourceName,
		DATEPART(YEAR,  DatePrinted) AS [YEAR],
		DATEPART(MONTH, DatePrinted) AS [MONTH],
		D.DomainName,
		AC.LogonName,
		S.SiteName AS [Site],
		ISNULL(M.MachineName,'No Machine') AS MachineName, 
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName, 
		ISNULL(PQ.PrinterQueueName,'No Printer Queue') AS PrinterQueueName,
		CB.Quantity,
		CAST(CB.Cost AS NUMERIC(16,2)) AS Cost,
		ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, 'No Departament') AS SiteDivision
	FROM
		(
			SELECT 
				BRJ.BureauResourceID,
				SUM(BRJ.Cost) AS Cost,
				SUM(BRJ.Quantity) AS Quantity,
				PJ.CostAccountID, 
				PJ.AccountID,
				PJ.DatePrinted,
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				PJ.PrinterQueueID
			FROM 
				BureauResourcesJobs BRJ
				INNER JOIN PrintJobs PJ ON BRJ.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
			WHERE
				PJ.JobOriginID = 7
				AND PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
				AND PJ.JobDisabled = 0
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				((
					@UseORMethod= 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						AND
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod= 1 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				))
			GROUP BY
				BRJ.BureauResourceID,			
				PJ.CostAccountID, 
				PJ.AccountID,
				PJ.DatePrinted,
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				PJ.PrinterQueueID
		)
	AS  CB
		INNER JOIN BureauResources BR ON BR.BureauResourceID = CB.BureauResourceID
		INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = CB.AccountID
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = CB.PrinterDeviceID
		LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues  PQ ON PQ.PrinterQueueID = CB.PrinterQueueID
		LEFT  JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
		LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
	ORDER BY 
		CostAccountName, 
		BureauResourceName, 
		[YEAR], 
		[MONTH], 
		DomainName, 
		LogonName, 
		[Site], 
		SD.SiteDivisionName,
		MachineName, 
		PrinterDeviceName, 
		PrinterQueueName

END
```

## 618. proc_Reports_RetrieveCubePrinting

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCubePrinting] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](-1, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario
	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @GetCosts BIT
	
	--primeiro verifica se o usuário é admin
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AccountIDOwner AND PermissionControlID = 1 AND PermissionAccessID = 9))
	BEGIN	
		-- Significa que o usuário pode ver todos os CCs e os custos dos jobs
		SET @GetCosts = 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN	
		-- Significa que o usuário só pode ver os seus dados e/ou seus CCs
		-- Verifica se ele é gerente de algum CC
		IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = @AccountIDOwner)>0)
		BEGIN
			-- o usuário é gerente. Ve se gerentes podem ver custo
			DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToManagers BIT
			SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToManagers = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToManagers'

			IF(@ShowCostsReportsToManagers = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 1
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--não é admion nem gerente. ve se usuários podem ver custos.
			DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts BIT
			SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToAccounts'

			IF(@ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 1
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT     
		D.DomainName,
		AC.FullName,
		S.SiteName,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName, 
		DATEPART(YEAR,    [Date]) AS DateYear,
		DATEPART(MONTH,   [Date]) AS DateMonth,
		DATEPART(DAY,     [Date]) AS DateDay,
		DATEPART(QUARTER, [Date]) AS DateQuarter,
		CASE CB.PrintWayID WHEN 0 THEN 'Simplex' ELSE 'Duplex' END AS Duplex, 
		PA.PrintApplicationName,
		PQL.PrintQualityName,
		PS.PaperSizeName,
		CASE CB.JobOriginID 
			WHEN 1 THEN 'IMPRESSÃO DIRETA'  
			WHEN 2 THEN 'DPS'
			WHEN 3 THEN 'FORMS'
			WHEN 4 THEN 'Cópia Lexmark'
			WHEN 5 THEN 'Fax Lexmark'
			WHEN 6 THEN 'Xerox MF'
			WHEN 7 THEN 'BUREAU' END AS JobOrigin,
		CASE Color WHEN 0 THEN 'Mono' ELSE 'Color' END AS Color,
		CASE CB.CostAccountID  WHEN -1 THEN 'No Account Cost' ELSE CC.CostAccountName END AS CostAccountName,
		ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '') AS CostAccountCode,
		CASE CB.PrinterQueueID WHEN -1 THEN 'No Print Server' ELSE M.MachineName END AS PrintServerName, 
		PD.SerialNumber,
		CASE CB.PrinterQueueID WHEN -1 THEN 'No Printer Queue' ELSE PQ.PrinterQueueName END AS PrinterQueueName, 
		CASE CB.JobTypeID WHEN 1 THEN 'Printing' WHEN 2 THEN 'Copy' WHEN 3 THEN 'FaxReceived' WHEN 4 THEN 'Scan' WHEN 5 THEN 'FaxSent' END AS JobType,
		ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, 'No Department') AS SiteDivisionName,
		Pages, 
		CASE @GetCosts WHEN 1 THEN Cost ELSE 0 END AS Cost
	FROM       
		CubeCube CB
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = CB.PrinterDeviceID 
		LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID 
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON PA.PrintApplicationID = CB.PrintApplicationID 
		INNER JOIN PrintQualities PQL ON PQL.PrintQualityID = CB.PrintQualityID 
		INNER JOIN PapersSize PS ON PS.PaperSizeID = CB.PaperSizeID 
		INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = CB.AccountID 
		LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterQueueID = CB.PrinterQueueID 
		LEFT  JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID 
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = CB.SiteID
		LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = CB.CostAccountID
	WHERE
		(CB.[Date] BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
		AND Pages > 0
		AND
		--//alteração [4.2]
		--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
		((
			@UseORMethod= 0 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR CB.AccountID = @AccountID)
				AND
				(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CB.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		)
		OR
		(
			@UseORMethod= 1 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR CB.AccountID = @AccountID)
				OR
				(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CB.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		))

END
```

## 619. proc_Reports_RetrieveDevicesDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveDevicesDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@Duplex SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID  SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1 ,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1, --0:Todos sem CC da impressora informada e -1:Todos sem CC independente da impressora
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@OnlyCostAccountParent BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	------
	-- Alessandra Santos, 24-03-2018
	-- Correção para buscar os trabalhos corretos dos gerentes
    ------
    -- Wesley Lemos, 04/03/2020
    -- Correção para buscar os trabalhos sem conta para admin quando agrupados por conta 
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)
		
	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters--*************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		IF (@OnlyCostAccountParent = 0)
		BEGIN
		
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList (CostAccountID) VALUES(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			IF (@OnlyCostAccountParent = 0)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList (CostAccountID) VALUES(@CostAccountID)
			END
		END
	END
	
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Mono  SMALLINT
	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT	

	SET @Mono  = -1
	SET @Color = -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
 		SET @Color = 1
 	END

	SELECT 	
		PrintJobID,
		JobOriginID,
		GroupName, 
		Title, 
		DatePrinted,
		PagesColor,
		PagesMono,
		Pages, 
		PrintCost, 
		PA.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintColorName,
		PrintWayID,
		PS.PaperSizeName,
		1 AS Counter,
		PA.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 			
			PJ.PrintJobID,
			PJ.JobOriginID,
			AC.FullName +' (' + D.DomainName + '\' + AC.LogonName +')' AS GroupName, 
			PJ.Title , 
			PJ.DatePrinted,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor
				WHEN  1 THEN -1
				WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor
			END AS PagesColor,
			CASE @PrintColorID 
				WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
				WHEN  1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
				WHEN  2 THEN -1
			END AS PagesMono,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono
     			WHEN  1 THEN  PJ.PagesMono
	      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor 
			END AS Pages,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono
     			WHEN  1 THEN PJ.CostMono
	      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.CostColor
			END AS PrintCost,
			CASE  
     			WHEN PJ.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
				ELSE 'Mono'
			END AS PrintColorName,
			PJ.PrintWayID,
			PrintApplicationID,
			PaperSizeID 
		FROM         
			PrintJobs PJ
			INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON PJ.AccountID = AC.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID  
		WHERE
			(PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
			AND (PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
			AND	(@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0)
			AND (@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0)
			AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
			AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
			AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
			AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID in (1,2,3))OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
			AND (@PrinterDeviceID= -1 OR PJ.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
			AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR  PJ.PrintWayID= @PrintWayID)
			AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  PJ.SiteID= @SiteID)
			AND
			--//alteração [4.2]
			--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
			((
				@UseORMethod = 0 
				AND
				(
					(@AccountID = -1 OR	PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
					AND ((@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					OR ((@CostAccountID = 0 AND PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))
					OR ((@CostAccountID = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList) AND PJ.CostAccountID IS NULL)))
				)
			)
			OR
			(
				@UseORMethod = 1 
				AND
				(
					(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
					OR ((@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					OR ((@CostAccountID = 0 AND PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))
					OR ((@CostAccountID = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList) AND PJ.CostAccountID IS NULL)))
				)
			))

		) AS Details
			 INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID 
			 INNER JOIN PapersSize PS ON Details.PaperSizeID = PS.PaperSizeID 
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC

END
```
