## 620. proc_Reports_RetrieveDevicesSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveDevicesSummary]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,  
@EndDateTime DATETIME, 
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1, 
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,  
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1, 
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,  
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1, 
@Classify SMALLINT = -1, 
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1, 
@SiteID INT = -1, 
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT, 
@CostAccountID INT = -1, 
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@GroupByCostAccount BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	-- A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	
	--/// INICIO

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT
		@AccountID = AccountID,
		@CostAccountID = CostAccountID,
		@UseORMethod = UseORMethod,
		@buildListType = buildListType
	FROM 
		@Parameters 
	--*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// FIM DAS ALTERAÇÕES 4.2


	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT
	
	IF (@GroupByCostAccount = 1)
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'AGRUPAR POR CENTRO DE CUSTOS' --***********************

		SET @Mono = -1
		SET @Color = -1

		IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET @Mono = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
		BEGIN
 			SET @Color = 1
		END
		
		SELECT 
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID, 
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceName,
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceType,
			DevicesSummary.TotalPeriodPages,
			DevicesSummary.Model AS DriverName,
			TotalJobs,
			MonoPages, 
			ColorPages, 
			TotalPages, 
			TotalCost,
			[Counter],
			DevicesSummary.SiteID,
			S.SiteName,
			DevicesSummary.SiteDivisionID,
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
			ISNULL(DevicesSummary.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
			ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](DevicesSummary.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName
		FROM 
		(	
			SELECT     
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PJ.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PJ.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceType,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
					WHEN 1  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
					WHEN 2  THEN -1
				END AS MonoPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
					WHEN 1  THEN -1
					WHEN 2  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
				END AS ColorPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
      				WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono)
	      			WHEN 1  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
	      			WHEN 2  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
		   		END AS TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
	      				WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono)
	      				WHEN 1  THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono)
		      			WHEN 2  THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor)
		   		END AS TotalCost,
				COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
				1 AS [Counter],
				PD.SiteID,
				PD.SiteDivisionID,
				PJ.CostAccountID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs PJ
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PJ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
				INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				(PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
				AND (PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0 )
				AND (@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0 )
				AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
				AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
				AND (@JobOriginID = -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
				AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJ.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
				AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3) )
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				(
					(
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
				)
			GROUP BY 
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				PD.PrinterDeviceName,
				PM.PrinterModelName,
				PD.SiteID,
				PD.SiteDivisionID,
				PJ.CostAccountID
		) AS DevicesSummary
			 INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = DevicesSummary.SiteID
			 LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = DevicesSummary.SiteDivisionID
			 LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = DevicesSummary.CostAccountID
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
			
		RETURN
	END

	--alteração 4.2 [pega se tem que pegar os dados do usuário, então tem que ser da printJobs]
	IF (@AccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'PESQUISOU POR USUÁRIO' --***********************

		SET @Mono = -1
		SET @Color = -1

		IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET @Mono = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
		BEGIN
 			SET @Color = 1
		END
		
		SELECT 
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID, 
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceName,
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceType,
			DevicesSummary.TotalPeriodPages,
			DevicesSummary.Model AS DriverName,
			TotalJobs,
			MonoPages, 
			ColorPages, 
			TotalPages, 
			TotalCost,
			[Counter],
			DevicesSummary.SiteID,
			S.SiteName,
			DevicesSummary.SiteDivisionID,
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
			-1 AS CostAccountID,
			'' AS CostAccountName
		FROM 
		(	
			SELECT     
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PJ.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PJ.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceType,
				--PD.Model,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
					WHEN 1  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
					WHEN 2  THEN -1
				END AS MonoPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
					WHEN 1  THEN -1
					WHEN 2  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
				END AS ColorPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
      				WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono)
	      			WHEN 1  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
	      			WHEN 2  THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
		   		END AS TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
	      				WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono)
	      				WHEN 1  THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono)
		      			WHEN 2  THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor)
		   		END AS TotalCost,
				COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
				1 AS [Counter],
				PD.SiteID,
				PD.SiteDivisionID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs PJ
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PJ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
				INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				(PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
				AND (PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0 )
				AND (@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0 )
				AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
				AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
				AND (@JobOriginID = -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
				AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJ.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
				AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3))
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				(
					(
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
				)
			GROUP BY 
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				PD.PrinterDeviceName,
				--PD.Model,
				PM.PrinterModelName,
				PD.SiteID,
				PD.SiteDivisionID
		) AS DevicesSummary
			 INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = DevicesSummary.SiteID
			 LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = DevicesSummary.SiteDivisionID
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
			
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'NÃO PESQUISOU POR USUÁRIO' --***********************
		
		SET NOCOUNT ON

		DECLARE @Dia DATETIME, @Mes SMALLINT
		DECLARE @Ini BIT, @Total INT, @d SMALLINT, @m SMALLINT, @y SMALLINT
		DECLARE @temp	 TABLE (PrinterDeviceID INT, MonoPages INT, ColorPages INT, TotalPages INT, TotalJobs INT,  TotalCost MONEY)
		DECLARE @Dias	 TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
		DECLARE @Semanas TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
		DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

		SELECT @Mono = -1, @Color = -1

		IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET @Mono = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
		BEGIN
			SET @Color = 1
		END

		SELECT @StartTime = @StartDateTime
		SELECT @EndTime   = @EndDateTime
					
		SELECT 	@StartDateTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) +  
								 Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
								 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME)

		SELECT @EndDateTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) + 
							  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
							  Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME) 
										 					 			   													
		IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
		BEGIN
			SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)
		END
		
		IF (@StartDateTime > @EndDateTime)
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Data de Inicio de relatório é maior que data de Fim!', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		-- Serão realizadas duas Consultas Se existe ou não a necessidade de ir nos Cubos + Produção, ou apenas Cubos.
		IF ((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0 OR 
			(DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime)   + DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)    + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime))   > 0)
		BEGIN
			IF ((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime) + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
			BEGIN
				--SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
				SET @StartDateTime = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @StartDateTime)
			END

			IF ((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
			BEGIN
				--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
				SET @EndDateTime = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @EndDateTime)
			END

			--//Alteração [4.2]
			--// verifica se tem algo na lista de CCs. Se tem não pode pegar dos cubos primários, só dos secundários
			IF (@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @CCIDList))
			BEGIN
				--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1
				SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

				WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1, 8, 15, 22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
				BEGIN
					IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO
								@dias 
							VALUES
								(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
						END
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

				SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

				WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
				BEGIN
					IF (DAY(@dia) = 1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ini = 1
						SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
					END
					
					IF( DAY(@dia) in (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						BREAK
					END	

					SET @dia = @dia +1

					WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22))
					BEGIN				
						SET @dia = @dia + 1
					END

					IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
					BEGIN
						DELETE FROM
							@Semanas 
						WHERE 
							Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia in (1, 8, 15, 22) 
			
						INSERT INTO
							@Semanas
						VALUES (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	

						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
					END
				END

				WHILE (@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO
						@dias 
					VALUES
						(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

				-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
				SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

				IF (@total > 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

					WHILE(@total > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @total = @total - 1 
						
						SELECT
							TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
						FROM 
							@dias
							
						DELETE FROM
							@dias 
						WHERE 
							@y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
			
						INSERT INTO @temp
							SELECT	C.PrinterDeviceID, 
									CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
												THEN  -1
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
												THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  PSCN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
												THEN  PDCN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
												THEN  PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  PDFN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PDIN 
									END AS MonoPages,
									CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
												THEN  -1
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
												THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CSCN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
												THEN  CDCN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
												THEN  CSFN  
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CSIN 
											WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIN 
										END AS ColorPages, 
									CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
												THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  PSCN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CSCN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CDCN + PDCN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
												THEN  PDCN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CDCN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
												THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
												THEN  PSFN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CSFN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  PDFN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIN + CSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PSIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CSIN
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PDIN 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIN
										END AS TotalPages, 
										totJobs, 
									CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
												THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  PSCV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CSCV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CDCV + PDCV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
												THEN  PDCV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
												THEN  CDCV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
												THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  PSFV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CSFV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  PDFV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
												THEN  CDFV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIV + CSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PSIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CSIV
											WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  PDIV 
											WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
												THEN  CDIV
										END AS TotalCost
								FROM CubePrinterDevice C 
								INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON C.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
								WHERE	DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y AND 
										(@PrinterDeviceID = -1	OR	C.PrinterDeviceID		= @PrinterDeviceID) 
										AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters =0  OR  PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3) )  
					END

								-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

								WHILE(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										SELECT TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
											FROM @semanas
										DELETE FROM @semanas 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										INSERT INTO @temp
											SELECT	C.PrinterDeviceID, 
														CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																	THEN  -1
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																	THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  PSCN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																	THEN  PDCN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																	THEN  PSFN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  PDFN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  PSIN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  PDIN 
														END AS MonoPages,
														CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																	THEN  -1
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																	THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  CSCN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																	THEN  CDCN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																	THEN  CSFN  
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  CDFN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CSIN 
																WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CDIN 
															END AS ColorPages, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																	THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  PSCN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  CSCN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  CDCN + PDCN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																	THEN  PDCN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																	THEN  CDCN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																	THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  PSFN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  CSFN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  PDFN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																	THEN  CDFN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CDIN + CSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  PSIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CSIN
																WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  PDIN 
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																	THEN  CDIN
														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 															
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubePrinterDeviceWeek C 
												INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON C.PrinterDeviceID = PD.printerdeviceid
												WHERE	dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y AND 
														(@PrinterDeviceID = -1	OR	C.PrinterDeviceID		= @PrinterDeviceID) 
														AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters =0  OR  PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3)  )  

									END
								-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

								SELECT
									A.PrinterDeviceID,
									dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(A.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
									dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(A.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceType, 
									0 AS TotalPeriodPages,        	 
									--PD.Model AS DriverName,
									PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
									A.TotalJobs,
									A.MonoPages,
									A.ColorPages,
									A.TotalPages,
									A.TotalCost, 
									1 AS [Counter],
									S.SiteID,
									S.SiteName,
									SD.SiteDivisionID,
									ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
									-1 AS CostAccountID,
			                        '' AS CostAccountName
								FROM
									(
										SELECT
											PrinterDeviceID, 
											SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
											SUM(MonoPages)  AS MonoPages,
											SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
											SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
											SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
										FROM
											(		
												SELECT
													PrinterDeviceID, 
													SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
													SUM(MonoPages)  AS MonoPages,
													SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
													SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
													SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
												FROM
													@Temp
												GROUP BY
													PrinterDeviceID
												
												UNION ALL
												
												SELECT 	
													PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
													COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
													CASE @PrintColorID 
														WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
														WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
														WHEN  2 THEN -1
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE @PrintColorID 
														WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
														WHEN  1 THEN -1
														WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
													END AS ColorPages,
													CASE @PrintColorID 
														WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono)
														WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono)
														WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.PagesColor)
													END AS TotalPages,
													CASE @PrintColorID 
														WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor)
														WHEN  1 THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono)
														WHEN  2 THEN SUM(PJ.CostColor)
													END AS TotalCost
												FROM
													PrintJobs PJ
												WHERE	
													(PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
													AND ((PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) OR (PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN (DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDateTime)) AND @EndTime)) 
													AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0)
													AND (@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0)
													AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
													AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
													AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJ.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) 
												GROUP BY
													PJ.PrinterDeviceID				
											) AS B 
											GROUP BY PrinterDeviceID
									 ) AS A
										  INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON A.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
										  INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
										  INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
										  LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
									WHERE
										A.TotalPages > 0
										AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3) )  
									ORDER BY
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
							END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SELECT
								A.PrinterDeviceID,
								dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
								dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceType,
								0 AS TotalPeriodPages,        	 
								--PD.Model AS DriverName, 
								PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
								A.TotalJobs, 
								A.MonoPages, 
								A.ColorPages, 
								A.TotalPages, 
								A.TotalCost,  
								1 AS [Counter],
								S.SiteID,
								S.SiteName,
								SD.SiteDivisionID,
								ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
								-1 AS CostAccountID,
			                    '' AS CostAccountName
							FROM 
								(
									SELECT
										PrinterDeviceID, 
										SUM(TotalJobs) AS TotalJobs,
										SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
										SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
									FROM
										(
											SELECT	C.PrinterDeviceID, 
																	SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																				THEN  -1
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN 
																	END) AS MonoPages,
																	SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																				THEN  -1
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  CDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN 
																		END) AS ColorPages, 	
																SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + PDCN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN
																	END) AS TotalPages, 
																	SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
																SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + PDCV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV
																	END )AS TotalCost
															FROM CubePrinterDevice C 
															WHERE	(c.Data				>= @StartDateTime		AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)	AND 
																	(@PrinterDeviceID = -1	OR	C.PrinterDeviceID		= @PrinterDeviceID)  
															GROUP BY C.PrinterDeviceID	
										UNION ALL
											SELECT 	P.PrinterDeviceID,
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN -1
																END AS MonoPages,
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																					WHEN 1 THEN -1
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																END AS ColorPages,
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																 END AS TotalPages, COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono + P.CostColor)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
																 END AS TotalCost
												FROM PrintJobs P
												
												WHERE	
														(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
														(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
														(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
														((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
														(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND													
														(@Color =-1			OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
														(@Mono =-1			OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
														(@PrintWayID =-1	OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
														((@JobTypeID =-1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
														(@PrinterDeviceID =-1 OR  P.PrinterDeviceID= @PrinterDeviceID) 
													
												GROUP BY P.PrinterDeviceID		
										) AS B 
										GROUP BY PrinterDeviceID ) AS A 
										INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON A.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
										INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
										INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
										LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
								WHERE A.TotalPages > 0 AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters =0  OR  PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3)  )  
								ORDER BY
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN  (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN  (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
						END
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
					SELECT
						A.PrinterDeviceID,
						dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(A.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
						dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(A.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceType,
						0 AS TotalPeriodPages,        	 
						--PD.Model AS DriverName,
						PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
						A.TotalJobs,
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.TotalCost,  
						1 AS [Counter],
						A.SiteID,
						S.SiteName,
						SD.SiteDivisionID,
						ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
						-1 AS CostAccountID,
			            '' AS CostAccountName
					FROM
						(
							SELECT
								PrinterDeviceID,
								SiteID,
								SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
								SUM(MonoPages)  AS MonoPages,
								SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
								SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
								SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
							FROM
								(
									SELECT
										C.PrinterDeviceID,
										C.SiteID,
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
												END) AS MonoPages,
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN 
													END) AS ColorPages, 	
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2

														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN 													
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + PDCN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  													
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFN  													
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN

														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN

															THEN  CDIN
												END) AS TotalPages, 
												SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2

														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2

															THEN  PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + PDCV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV
```
