```sql
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV
												END )AS TotalCost
										FROM
											CubePrinter C 
											INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON C.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
										WHERE	
											(C.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
											AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR C.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
											AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
											AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
											AND (@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
											AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
											AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3)  )
											--//alteração [4.2]
											--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
											AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
										GROUP BY 
											C.PrinterDeviceID,
											C.SiteID
									UNION ALL
									
									SELECT
										P.PrinterDeviceID,
										P.SiteID,	
										CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 2 THEN -1
										END AS MonoPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
															WHEN 1 THEN -1
															WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
										END AS ColorPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID	WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
															WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor )
										END AS TotalPages,COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
										CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono + P.CostColor)
															WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
															WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
										END AS TotalCost
									FROM 
										PrintJobs P 
									WHERE	
										(P.JobDisabled = 0 )
										AND (((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
										AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
										AND (@Color =-1 OR P.PagesColor > 0)
										AND (@Mono =-1 OR P.PagesMono > 0)
										AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
										AND (@PrinterDeviceID =-1 OR P.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
										AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
										AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID)
										AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
										AND ((@JobTypeID =-1  AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
										AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID)
										--//alteração [4.2]
										--//aqui só pode testar o CC
										AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
									GROUP BY 
										P.PrinterDeviceID,
										P.SiteID
								) AS B 
								GROUP BY
									PrinterDeviceID,
									SiteID
						)
						AS A
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON A.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
						INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = A.SiteID
						LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
					WHERE
						A.TotalPages > 0
						AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters =0  OR  PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3))
						AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
					ORDER BY
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
				END

			END -- Fim do tratamento HH:MM
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				--alteração 4.2
				IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @CCIDList))
					BEGIN
						--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

						SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

						WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
							BEGIN
								IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
									BEGIN
										INSERT INTO @dias 
											VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

						WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
							BEGIN
								
								IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
									BEGIN
										SET @ini = 1
										SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
									END
								
								IF( DAY(@dia) in (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
									BEGIN
										INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								ELSE
									BEGIN
										Break
									END	

								SET @dia = @dia +1

								WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22))
									BEGIN				
										SET @dia = @dia + 1
									END

								IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
									BEGIN
										DELETE FROM
											@Semanas 
										WHERE 
											Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia in (1, 8, 15, 22) 
							
										INSERT INTO @Semanas
											VALUES (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	

										SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
									END
							END

						while(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
							BEGIN
								INSERT INTO @dias 
									VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

        				-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
						
						SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

						IF (@total > 0)
							BEGIN

								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

								WHILE(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										
										SELECT 
											TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
										FROM 
											@dias
										
										DELETE FROM 
											@dias 
										WHERE 
											@y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										INSERT INTO @temp
											SELECT	C.PrinterDeviceID, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END AS ColorPages, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + PDCN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN
														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubePrinterDevice C 
												INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON C.PrinterDeviceID = PD.printerdeviceid
												WHERE	DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y AND 
														(@PrinterDeviceID = -1	OR	C.PrinterDeviceID		= @PrinterDeviceID) 
														AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters =0  OR  PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3)  )  
									END

								-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

								WHILE(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										SELECT TOP 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
											FROM @semanas
										DELETE FROM @semanas 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										INSERT INTO @temp
											SELECT	C.PrinterDeviceID, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END AS ColorPages, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + PDCN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubePrinterDeviceWeek C 
												INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON C.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
												WHERE	dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y AND 
														(@PrinterDeviceID = -1	OR	C.PrinterDeviceID		= @PrinterDeviceID) 
														AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters =0  OR  PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3)  )  

									END
									
								-- Fim processamento ponteiros.
									SELECT
										A.PrinterDeviceID,
										dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
										dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceType, 
										0 AS TotalPeriodPages,        	 
										--PD.Model AS DriverName, 
										PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
										A.TotalJobs, 
										A.MonoPages, 
										A.ColorPages, 
										A.TotalPages, 
										A.TotalCost,  
										1 AS [Counter],
										S.SiteID,
										S.SiteName,
										SD.SiteDivisionID,
										ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
										-1 AS CostAccountID,
			                            '' AS CostAccountName
									FROM
										(
											SELECT
												PrinterDeviceID, 
												SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
												SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
												SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
												SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
												SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
											FROM
												@Temp
											GROUP BY
												PrinterDeviceID
										) AS A
											INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON A.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
											INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
											INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
											LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
									WHERE
										A.TotalPages > 0
										AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3) )  
									ORDER BY	
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
							END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime + 1
							
							SELECT
								A.PrinterDeviceID,
								dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
								dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceType,
								0 AS TotalPeriodPages,        	 
								--PD.Model AS DriverName, 
								PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
								A.TotalJobs, 
								A.MonoPages, 
								A.ColorPages, 
								A.TotalPages, 
								A.TotalCost,
								1 AS [Counter],
								S.SiteID,
								S.SiteName,
								SD.SiteDivisionID,
								ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
								-1 AS CostAccountID,
								'' AS CostAccountName
							FROM 
								(
									SELECT	C.PrinterDeviceID, 
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
														THEN  -1
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PSCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  PDCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
														THEN  PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIN 
											END) AS MonoPages,
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
														THEN  -1
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  CDCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
														THEN  CSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN 
												END) AS ColorPages, 	
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PSCN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCN + PDCN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  PDCN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
														THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CSFN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN + CSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIN
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIN 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN
											END) AS TotalPages, 
											SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV + PDCV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  PDCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
														THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CSFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV
											END )AS TotalCost
									FROM CubePrinterDevice C 
									WHERE	(c.Data				>= @StartDateTime		AND C.Data < @EndDateTime)	AND 
											(@PrinterDeviceID = -1	 OR	C.PrinterDeviceID		= @PrinterDeviceID)  
											  
									GROUP BY C.PrinterDeviceID	
								) AS A 
									INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON A.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
									INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
									INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
									LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
							WHERE 
										A.TotalPages > 0 
										AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3) )
								ORDER BY
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
						END

					END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT	
						A.PrinterDeviceID,
						dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceName,  
						dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(A.Printerdeviceid) AS PrinterDeviceType,
						0 AS TotalPeriodPages,        	 
						--PD.Model AS DriverName, 
						PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
						A.TotalJobs, 
						A.MonoPages, 
						A.ColorPages, 
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.TotalCost,  
						1 AS [Counter],
						S.SiteID,
						S.SiteName,
						SD.SiteDivisionID,
						ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
						-1 AS CostAccountID,
			            '' AS CostAccountName
					FROM 
						(
							SELECT	
								C.PrinterDeviceID,
								--C.SiteID,
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
													THEN  -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN 
										END) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
													THEN  -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN 
											END) AS ColorPages, 	 
									SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + PDCN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN
										END) AS TotalPages, 
										SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
									SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + PDCV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV 
										END )AS TotalCost
								FROM
									CubePrinter C 
								WHERE
									(C.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
									AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR C.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
									AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
									AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
									AND (@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
									AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID= @SiteID)
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//aqui só pode testar o CC
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								GROUP BY
									C.PrinterDeviceID
									--C.SiteID
						)
						AS A
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON A.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
						INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
						INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
						LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
					WHERE 
						A.TotalPages > 0
						AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters =0  OR  PD.EngagedStatus IN (1,3) )  
						AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
					ORDER BY
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN  (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN  (PD.PrinterDeviceName) END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
						CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
				END
		END
	END

END
```

## 621. proc_Reports_RetrieveDigitizingDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveDigitizingDetails]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID,@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2


	DECLARE @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor INT
	SELECT @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ReportDigitizingSumPages'

	SELECT 
		PrintJobID,
		GroupName, 
		Title, 
		DatePrinted,
		Pages,  
		PrintCost,
		JobTypeID,
		'' AS JobType,
		1 AS [Counter]
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT 
				PrintJobID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PrinterDeviceID) AS GroupName, 
				Title, 
				DatePrinted, 
       			CASE WHEN @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = 1 THEN SUM(PagesMono + PagesColor) ELSE PagesMono END AS Pages,
				CASE WHEN @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = 1 THEN SUM(CostMono + CostColor) ELSE CostMono END AS PrintCost,
				JobTypeID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs 
			WHERE
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (JobDisabled = 0) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND JobTypeID IN (4,5)) OR JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  SiteID = @SiteID) 
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR  PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) 
				AND 
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
			GROUP BY
				PrintJobID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PrinterDeviceID),
				Title,
				DatePrinted,
				PagesMono,
				PagesColor,
				CostMono,
				CostColor,
				JobTypeID
		) AS Details
	WHERE
		Pages > 0
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC, 
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC
			
END
```
