## 622. proc_Reports_RetrieveDigitizingSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveDigitizingSummary]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1, 
@SiteID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT 

AS

BEGIN --BEGIN DA SP

      --////////////////////////////////////////////////
      --A partir da versão 4.2
      -- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
      --////////////////////////////////////////////////
      --/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			  SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			  INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario           
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor INT
	SELECT @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ReportDigitizingSumPages'

	IF (@DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			AC.AccountID, 
			D.DomainName, 
			ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](PJ.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName ,               
			CASE AC.FullName 
				WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
				WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
				ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')'
			END AS UserName,
			SUM(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
			COUNT(AC.AccountID) AS TotalJobs,
			SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) AS TotalCost,
			1 AS [Counter]
		FROM
			PrintJobs PJ
			INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJ.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		WHERE
			PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1   OR    PJ.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
			AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (4,5)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) 
			AND (@SiteID = -1 OR    PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
			AND
			--//alteração [4.2]
			--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
			((
				@UseORMethod= 0 
				AND
				(
						(@AccountID = -1             OR          PJ.AccountID                        = @AccountID)                AND 
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR       PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
				)
			)
			OR
			(
				@UseORMethod= 1 
				AND
				(
						(@AccountID = -1             OR          PJ.AccountID                        = @AccountID)                OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR       PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
				)

			))
		GROUP BY
			AC.AccountID,
			D.DomainName,
			PJ.CostAccountID,
			AC.FullName,
			AC.LogonName
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AC.FullName) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AC.FullName) END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) END DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@PrinterDeviceID <> -1 OR @SiteID <> -1)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				  AC.AccountID, 
				  D.DomainName, 
				  ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](PJ.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName ,               
				  CASE AC.FullName 
						WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
						WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
						ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')'
				  END AS UserName, 
				  SUM(PJ.PagesMono) AS TotalPages,
				  COUNT(AC.AccountID) AS TotalJobs,
				  SUM(PJ.CostMono) AS TotalCost,
				  1 AS Counter 
			FROM
				  PrintJobs PJ
				  INNER JOIN Accounts          AC    ON AC.AccountID         = PJ.AccountID
				  INNER JOIN Domains           D     ON D.DomainID           = AC.DomainID
			WHERE
				  PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
				  AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1   OR    PJ.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				  AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (4,5)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) 
				  AND (@SiteID = -1 OR    PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
				  AND
				  --//alteração [4.2]
				  --//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				  ((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							 (@AccountID = -1             OR          PJ.AccountID                        = @AccountID)                AND 
							 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
				  )
				  OR
				  (
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							 (@AccountID = -1             OR          PJ.AccountID                        = @AccountID)                OR
							 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)

				  ))
			GROUP BY
				  AC.AccountID,
				  D.DomainName,
				  PJ.CostAccountID,
				  AC.FullName,
				  AC.LogonName
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN -- Pega dados dos Cubos do Usuário e PrintJobs

			SET NOCOUNT ON

			DECLARE @Dia DATETIME, @Mes SMALLINT
			DECLARE @Ini BIT, @Total INT, @d SMALLINT, @m SMALLINT, @y SMALLINT
			DECLARE @Temp           TABLE (AccountID INT, TotalPages INT, TotalJobs INT, TotalCost MONEY)
			DECLARE @DiAS           TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
			DECLARE @Semanas  TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
			DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

			SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

			SELECT      @StartDateTime    =     CAST(CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) +  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
																  Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME),

						@EndDateTime      =     CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime)   AS CHAR(4)) +   Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
																  Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime)    AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME) 
	                

			IF (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
			BEGIN
				  SET @EndTime = CAST( CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)
			END

			IF(@StartDateTime > @EndDateTime)
			BEGIN
				  RAISERROR('Data de Inicio de relatório é maior que data de Fim!', 16,1)
				  RETURN
			END

			-- Serão realizadAS duAS ConsultAS Se existe ou não a necessidade de ir nos Cubos + Produção, ou apenAS Cubos.
			IF(   (DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0 OR 
				  (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime)   + DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)    + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime))   > 0)
			BEGIN -- BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE VAI PEGAR DA PRINTJOBS 
				  IF((DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) +     DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
				  BEGIN
						SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
				  END

				  IF((DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
				  BEGIN
						SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
				  END

				  --ALTERAÇÃO 4.2
				  IF(@CostAccountID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1)
				  BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO ONDE NÃO HOUVE FILTROS
						--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

						SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

						WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
						BEGIN
							 IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
							 BEGIN
								   INSERT INTO @dias VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
							 END
							 SET @dia = @dia + 1
						END

						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

						WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
						BEGIN
	                           
							 IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
							 BEGIN
								   SET @ini = 1
								   SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
							 END
	                           
							 IF( DAY(@dia) in (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR   (YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime)))) 
							 BEGIN
								   INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
							 END
							 ELSE
							 BEGIN
								   Break
							 END   

							 SET @dia = @dia +1

							 WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22))
							 BEGIN                   
								   SET @dia = @dia + 1
							 END

							 IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
							 BEGIN
								   DELETE FROM @Semanas WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia in (1, 8, 15, 22) 
								   INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)      
								   SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0    
							 END
						END

						while(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
						BEGIN
							 INSERT INTO @dias VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
							 SET @dia = @dia + 1
						END

						-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos               
						SET @Total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Semanas)

						IF (@Total > 0)
						BEGIN --BEGIN DE ONDE VAI PEGAR DADOS DOS CUBOS SEMANAIS

							 PRINT 'CUBO SEMANAL + PRINTJOBS, SEM FILTROS'
							 SET @Total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

							 WHILE(@Total > 0)
							 BEGIN
								   SET @Total = @Total - 1 
								   SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia FROM @dias
								   DELETE FROM @dias WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
	                                 
								   INSERT INTO @Temp
										 SELECT      C.AccountID, 
											   CASE
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
														   THEN  SN + EN
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SN   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EN
											   END AS TotalPages, 
											   TotJobs, 
											   CASE  
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
													  THEN  SV + EV
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SV   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EV
											   END AS TotalCost
										 FROM
											   CubeUserAccount C 
										 WHERE
											   DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y AND 
											   (@AccountID = -1  OR    C.AccountID       = @AccountID) 
							 END

							 -- Processamento das Week/MONTH
							 SET @Total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Semanas)

							 WHILE(@Total > 0)
							 BEGIN
								   SET @Total = @Total - 1 
								   SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia FROM @Semanas
								   DELETE FROM @Semanas    WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
	                                 
								   INSERT INTO @Temp
										 SELECT      C.AccountID, 
											   CASE
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
														   THEN  SN + EN
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SN   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EN
											   END AS TotalPages, 
											   TotJobs, 
											   CASE  
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
														   THEN  SV + EV
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SV   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EV
											   END AS TotalCost
										 FROM
											   CubeUserAccountWeek C 
										 WHERE
											   DAYw = @d AND MONTHw = @m AND YEARw = @y AND
											   (@AccountID = -1 OR     C.AccountID = @AccountID) 
							 END
							 -- Fim processamento ponteiros.

							 SELECT
								   A.AccountID, 
								   D.DomainName,              
								   ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,               
								   CASE Ac.FullName 
								   WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
								   WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
								   ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')' END AS UserName, 
								   A.TotalJobs, 
								   A.TotalPages, 
								   A.TotalCost,  
								   1 AS Counter 
							 FROM
								   (SELECT     
								AccountID, 
										 SUM(TotalJobs)    AS TotalJobs,
										 SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										 SUM(TotalCost)    AS TotalCost
								   FROM
										 (SELECT     
											   AccountID, 
											   SUM(TotalJobs)    AS TotalJobs,
											   SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
											   SUM(TotalCost)    AS TotalCost
										 FROM
											   @Temp 
										 GROUP BY
											   AccountID

								   UNION ALL   

										  SELECT      
											   P.AccountID, 
											   COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
											   SUM(P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages,
											   SUM(P.CostMono) AS TotalCost
										 FROM 
											   PrintJobs P
											   INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON P.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
										 WHERE
											   ((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
											   AND (P.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
											   AND (@JobTypeID = -1 OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) 
											   AND (JobTypeID NOT IN (1, 2, 3))
											   AND (@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID= @AccountID) 
										 GROUP BY
											   P.AccountID                  
										 ) AS B 
								   GROUP BY
										 AccountID
								   ) AS A
									 INNER JOIN Accounts        AC    ON AC.AccountID         = A.AccountID
									 INNER JOIN Domains         D     ON D.DomainID           = AC.DomainID
									 LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts     CC    ON AC.CostAccountID      = CC.CostAccountID
							 WHERE 
								   A.TotalPages > 0
							 ORDER BY
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AC.FullName) END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AC.FullName) END DESC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC

						END --END DE ONDE VAI PEGAR DADOS DOS CUBOS SEMANAIS
						ELSE
						BEGIN -- BEGIN DE ONDE VAI PEGAR OS DADOS DOS CUBOS NORMAIS SEM FILTROS

							 PRINT 'CUBOS SECUNDÁRIOS + PRINTJOBS, SEM FILTROS'   

							 --SELECT @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime + 1--,-@StartDateTime = @StartDateTime - 1

							 SELECT      
								   A.AccountID, 
								   D.DomainName,             
									ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,               
								   CASE Ac.FullName 
								   WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
								   WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
								   ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')' END AS UserName, 
								   A.TotalJobs, A.TotalPages, A.TotalCost,  1 AS Counter 
							 FROM
								   (SELECT     
										 AccountID, 
										 SUM(TotalJobs)    AS TotalJobs,
										 SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										 SUM(TotalCost)    AS TotalCost
								   FROM 
										 (SELECT
											   C.AccountID, 
											   SUM(CASE
														   WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
																 THEN  SN + EN
														   WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
																 THEN  SN   
														   WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
																 THEN  EN
													 END) AS TotalPages, 
											   SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
											   SUM(CASE    
														   WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
																 THEN  SV + EV
														   WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
																 THEN  SV   
														   WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
																 THEN  EV
													 END) AS TotalCost
										 FROM
											   CubeUserAccount C 
										 WHERE
											   (c.Data     >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
											   AND (@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)  
										 GROUP BY 
											   C.AccountID 
	                                                   
								   UNION ALL
	                                                   
										 SELECT
											   P.AccountID,
											   COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
											   SUM(P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages,
											   SUM(P.CostMono) AS TotalCost
										 FROM
											   PrintJobs P                                                                 
										 WHERE 
											   (((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
											   (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
											   ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR
											   (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
											   AND (P.JobDisabled = 0 )
											   AND (@JobTypeID =-1     OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
											   AND (JobTypeID NOT IN (1, 2, 3))
											   AND (@AccountID =-1     OR P.AccountID= @AccountID) 
										 GROUP BY 
											   P.AccountID       
								   ) AS B 
							 GROUP BY
								   AccountID ) AS A 
												INNER JOIN Accounts       AC    ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
												INNER JOIN Domains        D     ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
												LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts   CC    ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
							 WHERE
								   A.TotalPages > 0
							 ORDER BY
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AC.FullName) END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AC.FullName) END DESC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC

						END -- END DE ONDE VAI PEGAR OS DADOS DOS CUBOS NORMAIS SEM FILTROS
				  END  --END DO BLOCO ONDE NÃO HOUVE FILTROS
				  ELSE
				  BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO COM FILTROS

						PRINT 'CUBOS PRIMÁRIOS + PRINTJOBS, COM FILTROS'
						SELECT
							 A.AccountID, 
							 D.DomainName,               
							 ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,				
							 CASE Ac.FullName 
								   WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName   
								   WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
							 ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')' END AS UserName, 
							 A.TotalJobs, 
							 A.TotalPages, 
							 A.TotalCost,  
							 1 AS Counter 
						FROM
							 (SELECT
								   AccountID, 
								   SUM(TotalJobs)    AS TotalJobs,
								   SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
								   SUM(TotalCost)    AS TotalCost
							 FROM
								   (SELECT     
										 C.AccountID, 
										 SUM(CASE
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
														   THEN  SN + EN
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SN   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EN
											   END) AS TotalPages, 
										 SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
										 SUM(CASE    
		  WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
														   THEN  SV + EV
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SV   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EV
											   END) AS TotalCost
								   FROM
										 CubeUser C 
								   WHERE
										 (c.Data     >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
										 AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID) 
										 AND
											   --//alteração [4.2]
											   --//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
											   ((
													 @UseORMethod= 0 
													 AND
													 (
														   (@AccountID = -1             OR            C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
														   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
													 )
											   )
											   OR
											   (
													 @UseORMethod= 1 
													 AND
													 (
														   (@AccountID = -1             OR            C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
														   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
													 )
											   ))

								   GROUP BY 
										 C.AccountID
	                           
							 UNION ALL
	                                 
								   SELECT
										 P.AccountID,
										 COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
										 SUM(P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages,
										 SUM(P.CostMono)  AS TotalCost
								   FROM
										 PrintJobs P 
								   WHERE
										 (((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
										 (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))AND
										 ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR
										 (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
										 AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
										 AND (@JobTypeID = -1 OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
										 AND (JobTypeID NOT IN (1, 2, 3))
										 AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID = @SiteID)
										 AND 
										 --//alteração [4.2]
										 --//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
										 ((
											   @UseORMethod= 0 
											   AND
											   (
													 (@AccountID = -1             OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
													 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
											   )
										 )
										 OR
										 (
											   @UseORMethod= 1 
											   AND
											   (
													 (@AccountID = -1             OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
													 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
											   )
										 ))

								   GROUP BY
										 P.AccountID       
								   ) AS B 
							 GROUP BY 
								   AccountID
							 ) AS A
								   INNER JOIN Accounts          AC    ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
								   INNER JOIN [Domains]           D     ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
								   LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts  CC    ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
						WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

						ORDER BY
						 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AC.FullName) END ASC,
						 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AC.FullName) END DESC,
						 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
						 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
						 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
						 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC
				  END

			END -- BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE VAI PEGAR DA PRINTJOBS 
			ELSE
			BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE SÓ VAI PEGAR DOS CUBOS

				  IF(@CostAccountID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1)
				  BEGIN -- BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS SEM FILTROS

						--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

						SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

						WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
						BEGIN

							 IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
							 BEGIN
								   INSERT INTO @dias VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
							 END
							 SET @dia = @dia + 1
						END

						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

						WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
						BEGIN

							 IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
							 BEGIN
								   SET @ini = 1
								   SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
							 END
	                
							 IF( DAY(@dia) in (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR   (YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime)))) 
							 BEGIN
								   INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
							 END
							 ELSE
							 BEGIN
								   Break
							 END   

							 SET @dia = @dia +1
							 WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22))
							 BEGIN                   
								   SET @dia = @dia + 1
							 END

							 IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
							 BEGIN
								   DELETE FROM @Semanas WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia in (1, 8, 15, 22) 
								   INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)      
								   SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0    
							 END
						END

						while(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
						BEGIN
							 INSERT INTO @dias VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
							 SET @dia = @dia + 1
						END

							 -- Uma vez tENDo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos               
	                           
						SET @Total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Semanas)

						IF (@Total > 0)
						BEGIN --BEGIN SÓ DO CUBOS SEM FILTROS SEMANAIS

							 PRINT 'pega só dos cubos,  semanais, sem filtros '

								   SET @Total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

								   WHILE(@Total > 0)
										 BEGIN
											   SET @Total = @Total - 1 
											   SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
													 FROM @dias
											   DELETE FROM @dias 
													 WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
	                     
											   INSERT INTO @Temp
													 SELECT
														   C.AccountID, 
														   CASE
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
																	   THEN  SN + EN
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
																	   THEN  SN   
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
																	   THEN  EN
														   END AS TotalPages, 
														   TotJobs, 
														   CASE
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
																	   THEN  SV + EV
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
																	   THEN  SV   
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
																	  THEN  EV
														   END AS TotalCost
		FROM
														   CubeUserAccount C 
													 WHERE
														   DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y
														   AND (@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID      = @AccountID) 
										 END

								   -- Processamento das Week/MONTH
								   SET @Total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Semanas)

								   WHILE(@Total > 0)
										 BEGIN
											   SET @Total = @Total - 1 
											   SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
													 FROM @Semanas

											   DELETE FROM @Semanas 
													 WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
	                     
											   INSERT INTO @Temp
													 SELECT
														   C.AccountID, 
														   CASE
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
																	   THEN  SN + EN
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
																	   THEN  SN   
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
																	   THEN  EN
														   END AS TotalPages, 
														   TotJobs, 
														   CASE  
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
																	   THEN  SV + EV
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
																	   THEN  SV   
																 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
																	   THEN  EV
														   END AS TotalCost
													 FROM
														   CubeUserAccountWeek C 
													 WHERE 
														   DAYw = @d AND MONTHw = @m AND YEARw = @y 
														   AND (@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID      = @AccountID) 
										 END
									-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

								   SELECT
										 A.AccountID, 
										 D.DomainName,              
										 ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,               
										 CASE Ac.FullName 
											   WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName      
											   WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
											   ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')'
										 END AS UserName, 
										 A.TotalJobs, 
									 A.TotalPages, 
										 A.TotalCost,  
										 1 AS Counter 
								   FROM 
										 (SELECT
											   AccountID, 
											   SUM(TotalJobs)    AS TotalJobs,
											   SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
											   SUM(TotalCost)    AS TotalCost
										 FROM
											   @Temp 
										 GROUP BY
											   AccountID
										 ) AS A
										   INNER JOIN Accounts        AC    ON AC.AccountID            = A.AccountID
										   INNER JOIN Domains         D     ON D.DomainID            = AC.DomainID
										   LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts     CC    ON AC.CostAccountID   = CC.CostAccountID
								   WHERE 
										 A.TotalPages > 0
								   ORDER BY
										 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AC.FullName) END ASC,
										 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AC.FullName) END DESC,
										 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
										 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
										  CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
										 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC

						END --END SÓ DO CUBOS SEM FILTROS SEMANAIS
						ELSE
						BEGIN --BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS 2 SEM FILTROS 

							 PRINT 'pega só dos cubos, dos secundários -  sem filtros'

							 SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime + 1

							 SELECT      
								   A.AccountID, 
								   D.DomainName,             
									ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,               
								   CASE Ac.FullName 
										 WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName   
										 WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
										 ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')' 
								   END AS UserName, 
								   A.TotalJobs, 
								   A.TotalPages, 
								   A.TotalCost,  
								   1 AS Counter 
							 FROM 
								   (SELECT     
										 C.AccountID, 
										 SUM(CASE
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
														   THEN  SN + EN
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SN   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EN
											   END) AS TotalPages,
										 SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
										 SUM(CASE    
									 WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
														   THEN  SV + EV
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
														   THEN  SV   
													 WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
														   THEN  EV
											   END) AS TotalCost
								   FROM
										 CubeUserAccount C 
								   WHERE
										 (c.Data     >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <  @EndDateTime)
										 AND (@AccountID = -1OR  C.AccountID = @AccountID)  
								   GROUP BY
										 C.AccountID 
								   ) AS  A 
										   INNER JOIN Accounts        AC    ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
										   INNER JOIN Domains         D     ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
										   LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts    CC    ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
							 WHERE
								   A.TotalPages > 0

							 ORDER BY
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AC.FullName) END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AC.FullName) END DESC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
									CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
								   CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC

						END -- END SÓ DOS CUBOS 2 SEM FILTROS

				  END -- END SÓ DOS CUBOS SEM FILTROS
				  ELSE
				  BEGIN -- BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS COM FILTROS 
	                
						PRINT 'PEGA SÓ DOS CUBOS, DOS PRIMÁRIOS, COM FILTROS'

						SELECT      
							 A.AccountID, 
							 D.DomainName,               
							ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,               
							 CASE Ac.FullName 
								   WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName   
								   WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
								   ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')' 
							 END AS UserName, 
							 A.TotalJobs, 
							 A.TotalPages, 
							 A.TotalCost,  
							 1 AS Counter 
						FROM 
							 (SELECT     
								   C.AccountID, 
								   SUM(CASE
											   WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
													 THEN  SN + EN
											   WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
													 THEN  SN   
											   WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
													 THEN  EN
										 END) AS TotalPages,
								   SUM(TotJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
								   SUM(CASE    
											   WHEN @JobTypeID = -1 
				   THEN  SV + EV
											   WHEN @JobTypeID = 4
													 THEN  SV   
											   WHEN @JobTypeID = 5 
													 THEN  EV
										 END) AS TotalCost
							 FROM 
								   CubeUser C 
							 WHERE 
								   (c.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
								   AND (@SiteID = -1OR C.SiteID= @SiteID)
								   AND
								   --//alteração [4.2]
								   --//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
								   ((
										 @UseORMethod= 0 
										 AND
										 (
											   (@AccountID = -1             OR          C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
											   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
										 )
								   )
								   OR
								   (
										 @UseORMethod= 1 
										 AND
										 (
											   (@AccountID = -1             OR          C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
											   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
										 )
								   ))

							 GROUP BY
								   C.AccountID 
							 ) AS  A
									 INNER JOIN Accounts        AC    ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
									 INNER JOIN Domains         D     ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
									 LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts     CC    ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
						WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

						ORDER BY
							 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AC.FullName) END ASC,
							 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AC.FullName) END DESC,
							 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
							 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
							 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
							 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC

				  END  -- END  SÓ DOS CUBOS COM FILTROS 

			END -- END DE ONDE SÓ PEGA DADOS DOS CUBOS
		END
	END
END -- END DA SP
```

## 623. proc_Reports_RetrieveInstalledProducts

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveInstalledProducts]
@Inactive INT = 0, --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
@InactiveDate DATETIME  = '1-1-1',
@Days INT = 3,
@MachineID INT = -1,
@ProductID INT = -1,
@PrinterID INT = -1,
@OrderBy INT = 1,
@FilterType INT= 0 --FilterType pode ser 0 (sem filtro), 1 (Computadores) e 2 (Impressoras)

AS

BEGIN 

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Alterado para colocar hífen na versão quando ela não for encontrada.
	--
	-- Wesley Lemos, 2018-10-31
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT
		ObjectName,
		IP,
		ProductName,
		ProductVersion,
		OperationSystem,
		LastDateAccess,
		Actived, 
		UnActived,
		IsMachine
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				M.MachineName AS ObjectName,
				CASE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
				PR.ProductName,  
				(CASE 
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = 'Não encontrada' THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion IS NULL THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = '' THEN '-'
					ELSE IPR.ProductVersion END) AS ProductVersion,
				OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem, 
				IPR.LastDateAccess,
				1 AS IsMachine,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 0
					WHEN 2 THEN 1
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS Actived,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 1
					WHEN 2 THEN 0
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS UnActived 
			FROM 
				InstalledProducts IPR
				INNER JOIN Products PR ON PR.ProductID = IPR.ProductID
				INNER JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
				INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON M.OperationSystemID = OS.OperationSystemID
			WHERE
				(
					@FilterType <> 2
					AND @PrinterID = -1
					AND
					(
						(@MachineID = -1 OR M.MachineID = @MachineID)
						AND M.Removed = 0
						AND (@ProductID = -1 OR  PR.ProductID = @ProductID)
						AND IPR.LastDateAccess > @InactiveDate
						AND 
						(
							@Inactive = 0
							OR (@Inactive = 1 AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()))
							OR (@Inactive = 2 AND IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days ,GETDATE()))
						)
					)
				)

			UNION ALL

			SELECT
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS ObjectName,
				PD.AddressName AS IP,
				PR.ProductName,   
				(CASE 
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = 'Não encontrada' THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion IS NULL THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = '' THEN '-'
					ELSE IPR.ProductVersion END) AS ProductVersion,
				'-' AS OperationSystem,
				IPR.LastDateAccess,
				0 AS IsMachine,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 0
					WHEN 2 THEN 1
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS Actived,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 1
					WHEN 2 THEN 0
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS UnActived 
			FROM 
				InstalledProducts IPR
				INNER JOIN Products PR ON PR.ProductID = IPR.ProductID
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = IPR.PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE
				(
					@FilterType <> 1
					AND @MachineID = -1
					AND
					(
						(@PrinterID = -1 OR  PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID)
						AND PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3)
						AND (@ProductID = -1 OR  PR.ProductID = @ProductID)
						AND IPR.LastDateAccess > @InactiveDate
						AND 
						(
							@Inactive = 0
							OR (@Inactive = 1 AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()))
							OR (@Inactive = 2 AND IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days ,GETDATE()))
						)
					)
				)
		) AS TB
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1) THEN ObjectName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2) THEN ProductName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3) THEN LastDateAccess END ASC
     
END

--##########################################################################################################################################
--FIM DA CRIAÇÃO DAS STORED PROCEDURES
--##########################################################################################################################################

--##########################################################################################################################################
--INICIO DA ATUALIZAÇÃO VERSÃO DO BANCO
--##########################################################################################################################################
```

## 624. proc_Reports_RetrieveObjectsFromCostAccountSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveObjectsFromCostAccountSummary] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início


		DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

		--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
		DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
		DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
		DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

		SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

					--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
		DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
		DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

		SET @Mono = - 1
		SET @Color =  -1

		 IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
			SET @Mono = 1
		ELSE IF(@PrintColorID = 2 )
			SET @Color = 1



	IF((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType') = 2)
	BEGIN

					


				SELECT * FROM
				(
				SELECT 
						CostPrintersSummary.CostAccountID,
						[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CostPrintersSummary.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
						CostPrintersSummary.PrinterDeviceID,
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName + ' (' + PrintersDevices.AddressName + ':'+  PrintersDevices.AddressPort +')' AS PrinterDeviceName,
						CostPrintersSummary.MonoPages,
						CostPrintersSummary.ColorPages,
						CostPrintersSummary.TotalPages,
						CostPrintersSummary.TotalCost,
						CostPrintersSummary.TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter

				 FROM  ( 
					
					SELECT     
						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,
						PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
     						WHEN 1 THEN  SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
	      					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
     							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostMono)
	      						WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs
					FROM
						PrintJobs
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
						AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
						AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
						AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
						AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
						AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
						AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
						AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID  in (1,2,3))OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
						AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							))

					 GROUP BY 
 						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID
				 ) AS CostPrintersSummary
					INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON CostPrintersSummary.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
					INNER JOIN CostAccounts ON CostPrintersSummary.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
				)AS T
				ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrinterDeviceName) END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrinterDeviceName) END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
		
	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
						

				SELECT * FROM
				(
				SELECT 
						CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountID,
						[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
						CostAccountsSummary.AccountID,
						 CASE Accounts.FullName 
							WHEN '' THEN Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName
							ELSE Accounts.FullName + ' (' + Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName +')'
						 END AS AccountName,
						CostAccountsSummary.MonoPages,
						CostAccountsSummary.ColorPages,
						CostAccountsSummary.TotalPages,
						CostAccountsSummary.TotalCost,
						CostAccountsSummary.TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter

				 FROM  ( 
					
					SELECT     
						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,
						PrintJobs.AccountID,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
     						WHEN 1 THEN  SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
	      					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
     							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostMono)
	      						WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs
					FROM
						PrintJobs
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
						AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
						AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
						AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
						AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
						AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
						AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
						AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID  in (1,2,3))OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
						AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							))

					 GROUP BY 
 						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,PrintJobs.AccountID
				 ) AS CostAccountsSummary
					INNER JOIN Accounts ON CostAccountsSummary.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID
					INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID
					INNER JOIN CostAccounts ON CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
				)AS T
				ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AccountName) END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AccountName) END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc

	END
```

## 625. proc_Reports_RetrievePrintAmmountGraph

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintAmmountGraph] 
@NMonths INT = -1,
@MONTH INT = -1, 
@YEAR INT = -1, 
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @BeginMonth AS DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndMonth AS DATETIME;
	DECLARE @StartDateTime AS DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndDateTime AS DATETIME;

	SET @NMonths = @NMonths -1
	SET @BeginMonth =  DATEADD (mm , @NMonths*-1, CAST(( CAST(@YEAR AS NVARCHAR(4))+'-'+ CAST(@MONTH AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-01') AS DATETIME) )
	SET @EndMonth  =  DATEADD(ss, -1,DATEADD (mm , 1, CAST(( CAST(@YEAR AS NVARCHAR(4))+'-'+ CAST(@MONTH AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-01') AS DATETIME) ))

	SET @StartDateTime = @BeginMonth
	SET @EndDateTime = @EndMonth
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	IF (@AccountID = -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			*
		FROM
			(
				SELECT 
					yearw,
					monthw,  
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS Mono, 
					SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Color , 
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN + CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Total,
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS MonoCost, 
					CAST(SUM(CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS ColorCost , 
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV + CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS TotalCost,
					(CAST(CAST(yearw AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(monthw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(dayw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)) AS datew 
				FROM 
					CubeCostAccountIDWeek
				WHERE 
					(CAST( CAST(yearw AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(monthw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(dayw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME) BETWEEN CAST( CAST(datepart(yy,@BeginMonth)AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(datepart(mm,@BeginMonth)AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-27 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)  			
					AND CAST( CAST(@YEAR AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(@MONTH AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-28 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)) 
					AND dayw = 28 
					AND 
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
					(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
				GROUP BY 
					yearw, monthw, dayw
			) AS TB
		ORDER BY
			datew ASC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--//alteração [4.2]
		--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
		SELECT
			yearw,
			monthw,
			Mono,
			Color,
			Total,
			MonoCost,
			ColorCost,
			TotalCost,
			(CAST(CAST(yearw AS NVARCHAR)+'-'+CAST(monthw AS NVARCHAR)+'-28 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)) AS datew
		FROM
			(
				SELECT 
					YEAR(Data) AS yearw,
					MONTH(Data) AS monthw,  
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS Mono, 
					SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Color , 
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN + CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Total,
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS MonoCost, 
					CAST(SUM(CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS ColorCost , 
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV + CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS TotalCost
				FROM 
					CubeUser
				WHERE 
					Data BETWEEN @BeginMonth AND @EndMonth AND
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR AccountID = @AccountID) AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR AccountID = @AccountID) OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				GROUP BY
					YEAR(Data),
					MONTH(Data)
			) AS T
		ORDER BY
			Datew ASC
	END 
END
```

## 626. proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@Reason INT = -1,
@CancelType SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1,
@Classify SMALLINT = 1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	SELECT
		PolicyID,
		PolicyName,
		PrintJobID,
		Title,
		PrinterDeviceName,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		PrintCost,
		DatePrinted,
		Blocked, -- 0=Usuário | 1=Software
		1 AS Counter
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT
				PJC.PolicyID,
				P.PolicyName,
				PJC.PrintJobID,
				PJC.Title,
				[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName1](PJC.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,
				PJC.PagesMono,
				PJC.PagesColor, 
				(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS PrintCost, 
				PJC.DatePrinted,
				PJC.Blocked
			FROM         
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
				LEFT JOIN Policies P ON P.PolicyID = PJC.PolicyID
			WHERE
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@Reason = -1 OR PJC.PolicyID = @Reason)
				AND (@CancelType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @CancelType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0
		) AS Details
	ORDER BY
		Details.PolicyName ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (Details.Title) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (Details.Title) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PagesMono END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PagesColor END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PagesMono END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PagesColor END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedReleaserDetails]

BEGIN

	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	SELECT
		Blocked, -- 0=Usuário | 1=Software
		PrintJobID,
		Title,
		PrinterDeviceName,
		DatePrinted,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		(PagesMono + PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
		TotalCost,
		1 AS Counter
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT
				PJC.Blocked,
				PJC.PrintJobID,
				PJC.Title,
				[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName1](PJC.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,
				PJC.DatePrinted,
				PJC.PagesMono,
				PJC.PagesColor, 
				(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS TotalCost
			FROM         
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
			WHERE
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@RemovedType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @RemovedType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0

							(PJC.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))

						AND
						(
							(PJC.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				AND PJC.IsReleaser = 1
		) AS Details
	ORDER BY
		--Details.Blocked ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (Details.Title) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (Details.Title) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PagesMono END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PagesColor END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PagesMono END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PagesColor END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.TotalCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.TotalCost END DESC

END
```

## 628. proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedReleaserSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedReleaserSummary]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@RemovedType SMALLINT = -1, -- -1=Todos | 0=Usuário | 1=Software
@AccountID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT
		* 
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				D.DomainName,
				CASE AC.FullName 
					WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName	
					WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
					ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')'
				END AS UserName, 
				CC.CostAccountID,
				ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS CostAccountName,
				COUNT(*) AS TotalJobs,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono) AS MonoPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesColor) AS ColorPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono + PJC.PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
				SUM(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS TotalCost,
				1 AS Counter
			FROM
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJC.AccountID
				INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
				LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = AC.CostAccountID
			WHERE 
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@RemovedType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @RemovedType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJC.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR	 PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJC.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				AND PJC.IsReleaser = 1
			GROUP BY
				--PJC.Blocked,
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.FullName,
				AC.LogonName,
				D.DomainName,
				CC.CostAccountID
		) AS PrintJobsCanceledSummary
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END DESC

END
```

## 629. proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedSummary]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@Reason INT = -1,
@CancelType SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT
		* 
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				D.DomainName,
				ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS CostAccountName,
				CASE AC.FullName 
					WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName	
					WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
					ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')'
				END AS UserName, 
				COUNT(*) AS TotalJobs,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono) AS MonoPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesColor) AS ColorPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono + PJC.PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
				SUM(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS TotalCost,
				1 AS Counter,
				CC.CostAccountID
			FROM
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJC.AccountID
				INNER JOIN Domains D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
				LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = AC.CostAccountID
			WHERE 
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@Reason = -1 OR PJC.PolicyID = @Reason)
				AND (@CancelType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @CancelType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0
			GROUP BY
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.FullName,
				AC.LogonName,
				D.DomainName,
				CC.CostAccountID
		) AS PrintJobsCanceledSummary
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END DESC

END
```

## 630. proc_Reports_RetrieveQueuesDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveQueuesDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterQueueID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1
	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
	BEGIN
 		SET @Color = 1
 	END

	SELECT 
		PrintJobID,	
		JobOriginID,
		GroupName, 
		Title , 
		DatePrinted , 
		PagesColor,			
		PagesMono,
		Pages,   
		PrintCost, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintColorName,
		PrintWayID, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName ,
		1 AS Counter,
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT 			
				PrintJobs.PrintJobID,
				PrintJobs.JobOriginID,
				Accounts.FullName +'  (' +Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName +')'  AS GroupName, 
				PrintJobs.Title , 
				PrintJobs.DatePrinted , 
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
					WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
					WHEN 2 THEN -1
				END AS PagesMono,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
					WHEN 1 THEN -1
					WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
				END AS PagesColor,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono
		     			WHEN 1 THEN  PrintJobs.PagesMono
			      		WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor 
				END AS Pages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono
		     			WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.CostMono
			      		WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor
				END AS PrintCost,
				CASE  
 						 WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
					ELSE
					'Mono'
				END AS PrintColorName,
				PrintJobs.PrintWayID, 
				PrintApplicationID,
				PaperSizeID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs 
				INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
				INNER JOIN Domains ON Domains.DomainID = Accounts.DomainID
			WHERE
				(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) 
				AND (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0) 
				AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
				AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
				AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
				AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
				AND (@PrintWayID=-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
				AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) ) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND ((@PrinterQueueID = 0 AND PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID IS NULL) 
				OR (@PrinterQueueID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = @PrinterQueueID)) 
				AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID) 
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
		) AS Details
	 		 INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
			 INNER JOIN PapersSize ON Details.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC

END
```
