## 631. proc_Reports_RetrieveQueuesSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveQueuesSummary] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterQueueID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT, @Mono SMALLINT
	
	--alteração 4.2 [pega se tem que pegar os dados do usuário, então tem que ser da printJobs]
	IF @AccountID <> -1 
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono  = -1
		SET @Color = -1

		IF(@PrintColorID = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET @Mono = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
		BEGIN
			SET @Color = 1
		END
		
		SELECT 
			PrinterQueueID, 
			PrinterQueueName, 
			TotalPeriodPages,
			MachineName,
			MonoPages, 
			ColorPages, 
			TotalPages, 
			TotalJobs,
			TotalCost,
			Counter
		 FROM 
		 (	
			SELECT     
				ISNULL(PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID,-1) AS PrinterQueueID,
				ISNULL(PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PrintersModels.PrinterModelName + ')','@@WithoutQueue') AS PrinterQueueName,
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
					WHEN 2 THEN -1
				END AS MonoPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
					WHEN 1 THEN -1
					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
				END AS ColorPages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
	     				WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.PagesMono)
		      			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor )
				END AS TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
				ISNULL(Machines.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine')  AS MachineName,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
	     				WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.CostMono)
		      			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor )
				END AS TotalCost,
				COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
				1 AS Counter 
			FROM         
				PrintJobs			
				LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
				LEFT JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintersQueues.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
				INNER JOIN PrintersModels ON PrintersModels.PrinterModelID = PrintersDevices.PrinterModelID
				LEFT JOIN Machines ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID 
			WHERE
				(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) 
				AND (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
				AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
				AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
				AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
				AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)  
				AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
				AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@PrinterQueueID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID= @PrinterQueueID) 
				AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID) 
				AND 
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				((
					@UseORMethod= 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod= 1 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				))
			GROUP BY 
				PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID,
				PrintersModels.PrinterModelName,
				PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName,
				Machines.MachineName
		) AS QueuesSummary 

	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (QueuesSummary.PrinterQueueName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (QueuesSummary.PrinterQueueName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC


	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		SET nocount on

		DECLARE @Dia DATETIME, @Mes SMALLINT
		DECLARE @Ini BIT, @Total INT, @d SMALLINT, @m SMALLINT, @y SMALLINT
		DECLARE @temp		TABLE (PrinterQueueID INT, MonoPages INT, ColorPages INT, TotalPages INT, TotalJobs INT,  TotalCost MONEY)
		DECLARE @Dias		TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
		DECLARE @Semanas	TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
		DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

		SELECT @Mono = - 1, @Color =  -1

		 IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @Mono = 1
			END 
		ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
			BEGIN
				SET @Color = 1
			END

		SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

		SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
											 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

				@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
											 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
				
		IF (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
		BEGIN

			SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

		END

		IF(@StartDateTime > @EndDateTime)
			BEGIN
				Raiserror('Data de Inicio de relatório é maior que data de Fim!', 16,1)
				RETURN	
			END

	-- Serão realizadas duas Consultas Se existe ou não a necessidade de ir nos Cubos + Produção, ou apenas Cubos.

		IF(	(DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0 OR 
			(DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
			BEGIN
		
				IF((DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
					END

				IF((DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
					END

				IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @CCIDList))
					BEGIN
						--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

						SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

						WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
							BEGIN
								IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
									BEGIN
										Insert into @dias 
											Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

						WHILE (cast(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
							BEGIN
								
								IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
									BEGIN
										SET @ini = 1
										SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
									END
								
								IF( DAY(@dia) in (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
									BEGIN
										Insert into @Semanas Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								ELSE
									BEGIN
										Break
									END	

								SET @dia = @dia +1

								WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22))
									BEGIN				
										SET @dia = @dia + 1
									END

								IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
									BEGIN
										DELETE FROM @Semanas 
											WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia in (1, 8, 15, 22) 
							
										Insert into @Semanas
											Values (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	

										SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
									END
							END

						while(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
							BEGIN
								Insert into @dias 
									Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

        				-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
						
						SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

						IF (@total > 0)
							BEGIN

								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

								WHILE(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
											FROM @dias
										DELETE FROM @dias 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										Insert into @temp
											SELECT	C.PrinterQueueID, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END AS ColorPages, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + PDCN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN
														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubeQueuePrinter C 
												WHERE	DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y AND 
														(@PrinterQueueID = -1	OR	C.PrinterQueueID		= @PrinterQueueID) 
									END

								-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

								WHILE(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
											FROM @semanas
										DELETE FROM @semanas 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										Insert into @temp
											SELECT	C.PrinterQueueID, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

																THEN  PSCN

																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN

													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1

															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
														END AS TotalCost
												FROM CubeQueuePrinterWeek C 
												WHERE	dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y AND 
														(@PrinterQueueID = -1	OR	C.PrinterQueueID		= @PrinterQueueID) 

									END
								-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

									SELECT	A.PrinterQueueID, 
										ISNULL(PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')','@@WithoutQueue') AS PrinterQueueName,
										0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
										ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine')  AS MachineName,
										A.MonoPages, 						
										A.ColorPages, 
										A.TotalPages, 
										A.TotalJobs, 
										A.TotalCost,  1 AS Counter 
									FROM (SELECT	PrinterQueueID, 
													SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
													SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
													SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
													SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
													SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
											FROM (		SELECT	PrinterQueueID, 
																		SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
																		SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
																		SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
																		SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
																		SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
															FROM @temp 
															GROUP BY PrinterQueueID
													UNION All	
														SELECT 	ISNULL(P.PrinterQueueID,-1), COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
																			CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																								WHEN 2 THEN -1
																			END AS MonoPages,
																			CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																								WHEN 1 THEN -1
																								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																			END AS ColorPages,
																			CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																			 END AS TotalPages,
																			CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono + P.CostColor)
																								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
																			 END AS TotalCost
															FROM PrintJobs P															
															WHERE	((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) OR 
																	(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND
																	(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
																	(@Color =-1			OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
																	(@Mono =-1			OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
																	(@PrintWayID =-1	OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
																	((@JobTypeID =-1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
																	(@PrinterQueueID =-1 OR  P.PrinterQueueID= @PrinterQueueID) 
															GROUP BY P.PrinterQueueID				
													) AS B 
											GROUP BY PrinterQueueID ) AS A
											left  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON A.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID 
											left JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PQ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
											INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
											left JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID 
									WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

									ORDER BY	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')') END asc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')') END desc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
												CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
							END
					ELSE
						BEGIN

								--SELECT @EndDateTimE = @EndDateTimE + 1, @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime - 1

						
											SELECT	A.PrinterQueueID, 
												ISNULL(PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + Pm.PrinterModelName + ')','@@WithoutQueue') AS PrinterQueueName,
												0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
												ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine')  AS MachineName,
												A.MonoPages,
												A.ColorPages,
												A.TotalPages,
												A.TotalJobs, 
												A.TotalCost,  1 AS Counter 
											FROM (SELECT	PrinterQueueID, 
															SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
															SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
															SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
															SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
															SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
													FROM ( SELECT	C.PrinterQueueID, 
																	SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																				THEN  -1
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN 
																	END) AS MonoPages,
																	SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																				THEN  -1
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  CDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN 
																		END) AS ColorPages, 	
																SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN + PDCN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PSFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIN
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIN 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIN
																	END) AS TotalPages, 
																	SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
																SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																				THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  PSCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CSCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV + PDCV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																				THEN  PDCV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																				THEN  CDCV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																				THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PSFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CSFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  PDFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																				THEN  CDFV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PSIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CSIV
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  PDIV 
																			WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																				THEN  CDIV
																	END )AS TotalCost
															FROM CubeQueuePrinter C 
															WHERE	(c.Data				>= @StartDateTime		AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)	AND 
																	(@PrinterQueueID = -1	OR	C.PrinterQueueID		= @PrinterQueueID)  
															GROUP BY C.PrinterQueueID	
										UNION All
											SELECT 	ISNULL(P.PrinterQueueID,-1), 
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN -1
																END AS MonoPages,
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																					WHEN 1 THEN -1
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																END AS ColorPages,
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																 END AS TotalPages,COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
																CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostColor + P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
																 END AS TotalCost
												FROM PrintJobs P												
												WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
														(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
														((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
														(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
														(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
														(@Color =-1			OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
														(@Mono =-1			OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
														(@PrintWayID =-1	OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
														((@JobTypeID =-1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
														(@PrinterQueueID =-1 OR  P.PrinterQueueID= @PrinterQueueID) 
												GROUP BY P.PrinterQueueID		
										) AS B 
										GROUP BY PrinterQueueID ) AS A 
										left  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON A.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID 
										left JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PQ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
										INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
										left JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID 
								WHERE A.TotalPages > 0
								ORDER BY
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')') END asc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')') END desc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
						END
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
					SELECT	A.PrinterQueueID, 
						ISNULL(PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')','@@WithoutQueue') AS PrinterQueueName,
						0 AS TotalPeriodPages,
						ISNULL(M.MachineName,'@@WithoutMachine')  AS MachineName,
						A.MonoPages,
						A.ColorPages,
						A.TotalPages,
						A.TotalJobs, 
						A.TotalCost,  1 AS Counter 
						 FROM (SELECT	PrinterQueueID, 
										SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
										SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
										SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
									FROM ( SELECT	C.PrinterQueueID, 
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
												END) AS MonoPages,
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN 
													END) AS ColorPages, 	
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + PDCN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN
												END) AS TotalPages, 
												SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + PDCV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV
												END )AS TotalCost
										FROM CubeQueue C 
										WHERE	(c.Data						>= @StartDateTime			AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)		AND 
											(@PrinterQueueID = -1			OR		C.PrinterQueueID				= @PrinterQueueID)			AND 
											(@PaperSizeID = -1			OR		C.PaperSizeID			= @PaperSizeID)			AND
											(@PrintApplicationID = -1	OR		C.PrintApplicationID	= @PrintApplicationID)	AND
											(@JobOriginID = -1			OR      C.JobOriginID				= @JobOriginID)			AND
											(@SiteID = -1				OR		C.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
											--//alteração [4.2]
											--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
											(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))

										GROUP BY C.PrinterQueueID
							UNION All
								SELECT	ISNULL(P.PrinterQueueID,-1),
														CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 2 THEN -1
														END AS MonoPages,
														CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																			WHEN 1 THEN -1
																			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
														END AS ColorPages,
														CASE @PrintColorID	WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor )
														END AS TotalPages,	COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
									 					CASE @PrintColorID	WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostColor + P.CostMono)
																			WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor ) END AS TotalCost
									FROM PrintJobs P 
								WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
										(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
										((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
										(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
										(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
										(@Color =-1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
										(@Mono =-1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
										(@PaperSizeID =-1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
										(@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
										(@PrintWayID =-1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
										(@JobOriginID=-1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
										((@JobTypeID =-1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
										(@SiteID =-1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
										(@PrinterQueueID =-1 OR  P.PrinterQueueID= @PrinterQueueID) AND
										--//alteração [4.2]
										--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
										(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
 								GROUP BY P.PrinterQueueID 	
						) AS B 
						GROUP BY PrinterQueueID ) AS A
						left  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON A.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID 
						left JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PQ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
						left JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID 

					WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

					ORDER BY
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')') END asc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PQ.PrinterQueueName + ' (' + PM.PrinterModelName + ')') END desc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
				END

			END -- Fim do tratamento HH:MM
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @CCIDList))
					BEGIN
						--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

						SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

						WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
							BEGIN
								IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
									BEGIN
										Insert into @dias 
											Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

						WHILE (cast(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
							BEGIN
								
								IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
									BEGIN
										SET @ini = 1
										SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
									END
								
								IF( DAY(@dia) in (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
									BEGIN
										Insert into @Semanas Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
									END
								ELSE
									BEGIN
										Break
									END	

								SET @dia = @dia +1

								WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT in (1,8,15,22))
									BEGIN				
										SET @dia = @dia + 1
									END

								IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
									BEGIN
										DELETE FROM @Semanas 
											WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia in (1, 8, 15, 22) 
							
										Insert into @Semanas
											Values (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	

										SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
									END
							END

						while(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
							BEGIN
								Insert into @dias 
									Values(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
								SET @dia = @dia + 1
							END

        				-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
						
						SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

						IF (@total > 0)
							BEGIN

								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

								WHILE(@total > 0)
									BEGIN
										SET @total = @total - 1 
										SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
											FROM @dias
										DELETE FROM @dias 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										Insert into @temp
											SELECT	C.PrinterQueueID, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN

													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

																THEN  CSIN + PSIN

																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1

																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN
														END AS TotalPages, 
														totJobs, 
													CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																	THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
																WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

																	THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV

												FROM CubeQueuePrinter C 
												WHERE	DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y AND 
														(@PrinterQueueID = -1	OR	C.PrinterQueueID		= @PrinterQueueID)

								-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
								SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

											FROM @semanas
										DELETE FROM @semanas 
											WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
										Insert into @temp
```
