## 638. proc_Reports_RetrieveResumeConsumingPrint

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveResumeConsumingPrint]
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren BIT = 0,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	DECLARE @StartDateTime DATETIME
	DECLARE @EndDateTime DATETIME
	
	SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()--'2013-10-31 10:24'--
	SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
	SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	
	--Quando for dia primeiro, só retorna um registro zerado
	IF(@StartDateTime > @EndDateTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @StartDateTime AS DatePrinted, 0 AS TotalPages
		RETURN	
	END
	 
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT
		*
	FROM
		[dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista com as contas que serão usados
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN		
		--Verifica se é marcado a opção pra trazer os filhos da conta 
		IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Se sim continua como era antes
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos da conta informados
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se não insere apenas a conta informada na tabela 
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList VALUES(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	--'BUSCA SÓ DOS CUBOS, DOS PRIMÁRIOS, COM FILTROS'
	DECLARE @TBPrint TABLE (DatePrinted DATETIME, TotalPages BIGINT)
	
	INSERT INTO
		@TBPrint
	SELECT
		C.Data,
		--C.AccountID,
		--C.CostAccountID,
		SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
	FROM 
		CubeUser C
	WHERE
		(C.Data >= @StartDateTime AND C.Data <= @EndDateTime)
		AND
			((
				@UseORMethod = 0
				AND (
						(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
						AND
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
			 )
			 OR
			 (
				@UseORMethod = 1
				AND (
						(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
						OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
			  ))
	GROUP BY 
		C.Data
		--C.AccountID,
		--C.CostAccountID
	ORDER BY
		C.Data
		
	WHILE (@StartDateTime <= @EndDateTime)
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBPrint WHERE DatePrinted = @StartDateTime)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@TBPrint
			SELECT
				@StartDateTime, 0
		END
		
		SET @StartDateTime = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @StartDateTime)
	END
	
	--Retorno
	SELECT
		DatePrinted,
		TotalPages
	FROM
		@TBPrint
	ORDER BY
		DatePrinted
END
```

## 639. proc_Reports_RetrieveStampLogonSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStampLogonSummary]
@StampLogonID NVARCHAR(32),
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT
	
AS

BEGIN
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Douglas Ribeiro de Macedo
	-- Create date: 28/05/2014
	-- Description:	Buscar relatório resumo por código de rastreio
	-- =============================================

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForQuotasReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT
		dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PJ.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,
		PJ.Title,
		PJ.DatePrinted,
		ISNULL(M.MachineName, '@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
		PA.PrintApplicationName,
		PJ.PrintWayID,
		PS.PaperSizeName,
		(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
		PJ.PagesMono,
		PJ.PagesColor,
		(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) AS TotalCost,
		PA.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM
		PrintJobs PJ
		INNER JOIN StampLogonJobs SLJ ON PJ.PrintJobID = SLJ.PrintJobID
		INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJ.AccountID
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterQueueID = PJ.PrinterQueueID
		LEFT  JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON PA.PrintApplicationID = PJ.PrintApplicationID
		INNER JOIN PapersSize PS ON PS.PaperSizeID = PJ.PaperSizeID
	WHERE
		SLJ.StampLogonID = @StampLogonID
		AND ((
			@UseORMethod = 0 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR AC.AccountID = @AccountID)
				AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		)
		OR
		(
			@UseORMethod = 1 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR AC.AccountID = @AccountID)
				OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		))

END
```

## 640. proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsApps

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsApps] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@PrinterQueueID INT =  -1,
@MachineID INT = -1,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@CostAccountID INT = -1, 
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren BIT = 1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @OriginalStartDateTime DATETIME
	DECLARE @OriginalEndDateTime DATETIME

	SET @OriginalStartDateTime = @StartDateTime 
	SET @OriginalEndDateTime = @EndDateTime 

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	--DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	IF (@AccountID = -1 ) --não foi passado filtro de usuário, então ou não é o relatório de usuários, ou é mas nao tem filtro. Usa os parâmetors genéricos 
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			  SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)
	END
	ELSE -- é o relatório de usuários e tem um filtro, entao pega os parametros próprios para esse relatório
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			  SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID,@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)
	END

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
	--Verifica se é marcado a o~pção pra trazer os filhos do centro de custo na filtragem 
	IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren = 1)
	BEGIN
	--Se sim continua como era antes
	INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
		SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END	
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--Se não insere apenas o centro de custo pesquisado na tabela 
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList VALUES(@CostAccountID)
	END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			  INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario           
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2


	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT, @Mono SMALLINT 

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	SELECT @StartDateTime = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDateTime AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)
	SELECT @EndDateTime   = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@EndDateTime   AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)

	IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
	END
		
	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END
		      
	SELECT @Mono = - 1, @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END

	--alteração da 4.2
	-- esse IF vai entrar se teve (ou não) filtro de usuário;
	--se não teve filtro de usuario, mas AS permissões criaram o filtro, vai entrar aqui tmb.
	-- caso contrário vai entrar apenas nos ifs abaixo
	-- ( @ProjectID =  -1 AND @PrinterDeviceID = -1 AND @PrinterQueueID =  -1 AND @MachineID  = -1 AND @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0)
	IF ((@PrinterDeviceID = -1 AND @PrinterQueueID = -1 AND @MachineID = -1 
		AND @PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 
		AND @SiteID = -1 AND @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0))
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'PEGA DADOS DO USUÁRIO, DOS CUBOS'

		SELECT
			P.PrintApplicationName,
			C.TotalPages,
			P.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.PrintApplicationID,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + PDFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN) 
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime AND                                              
							(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
							(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
							(@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
							(@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID) AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								 @UseORMethod= 0 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1             OR            C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							)
							OR
							(
								 @UseORMethod= 1 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1             OR            C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.PrintApplicationID 
						
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.PrintApplicationID,
							CASE @PrintColorID
								WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
							(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
							((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
							(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
							(P.JobDisabled = 0 )    AND 
							(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
							(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )    AND 
							(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
							(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
							(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
							(@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
							((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
							(@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND                                                    
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
							   @UseORMethod= 0 
							   AND
							   (
									 (@AccountID = -1              OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
									 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							   )
							)
							OR
							(
							   @UseORMethod= 1 
							   AND
							   (
									 (@AccountID = -1              OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
									 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							   )
							))
						GROUP BY
							P.PrintApplicationID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY T.PrintApplicationID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications P ON C.PrintApplicationID = P.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE IF ((@PrinterDeviceID = -1 AND @PrinterQueueID = -1 
			AND @AccountID  = -1 AND @PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1
			AND @JobOriginID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0))
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'PEGA DADOS DE MACHINE'
		
		SELECT
			P.PrintApplicationName,
			C.TotalPages,
			P.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.PrintApplicationID,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + PDFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN)
								END AS TotalPages
							FROM
								CubeMachine C 
							WHERE
								C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime AND
								(@MachineID = -1 OR C.MachineID = @MachineID) AND                                           
								(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
								(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
								(@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
								(@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID) AND
								--//alteração [4.2]
								--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR  C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							GROUP BY
								C.PrintApplicationID 
								
							UNION ALL
							
							SELECT
								P.PrintApplicationID,
								CASE @PrintColorID
									WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
									WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
									WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
								END AS TotalPages
							FROM
								PrintJobs P
								LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON P.PrinterQueueID = PQ.PrinterQueueID
							WHERE
								(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
								(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
								((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
								(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
								(P.JobDisabled = 0 )    AND 
								(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
								(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )    AND 
								(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
								(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
								(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
								(@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
								((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID  IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
								(@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND                                                    
								(@MachineID = -1 OR  PQ.MachineID= @MachineID) AND
								--//alteração [4.2]
								--//aqui só pode testar o CC
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR        P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							GROUP BY
								P.PrintApplicationID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PrintApplicationID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications P ON C.PrintApplicationID = P.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
      END
      ELSE IF ((@PrinterDeviceID = -1 AND @MachineID = -1 AND @AccountID  = -1 
				AND @PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 
				AND @SiteID = -1 AND @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0))
      BEGIN
            PRINT 'PEGA DADOS DE QUEUE'  

            SELECT
				P.PrintApplicationName,
				C.TotalPages,
				P.PrintApplicationResource
			FROM
				(
					SELECT
						PrintApplicationID,
						SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
					FROM
						(
							SELECT
								C.PrintApplicationID,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + PDFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeQueue C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime AND
							(@PrinterQueueID = -1 OR C.PrinterQueueID = @PrinterQueueID) AND                                            
							(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
							(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
							(@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
							(@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID) AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR  C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						GROUP BY
							C.PrintApplicationID 
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.PrintApplicationID,
							CASE @PrintColorID
								WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
							(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
							((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
							(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
							(P.JobDisabled = 0 )    AND 
							(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
							(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )    AND 
							(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
							(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
							(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
							(@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
							((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID  IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
							(@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND                                                    
							(@PrinterQueueID = -1 OR  P.PrinterQueueID= @PrinterQueueID) AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR  P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						GROUP BY
							P.PrintApplicationID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PrintApplicationID 
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications P ON C.PrintApplicationID = P.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
      END
      ELSE IF ((@PrinterQueueID = -1 AND @MachineID = -1 AND @AccountID  = -1 
				AND @PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 
				AND @SiteID = -1 AND @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0))
      BEGIN
		PRINT 'PEGA DADOS DE IMPRESSORAS'  
		
		SELECT
			P.PrintApplicationName,
			C.TotalPages,
			P.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.PrintApplicationID,
						CASE
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN  SUM (CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN + PSCN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN + PSCN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PSCN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN + PSFN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN + PSFN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PSFN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + PDFN  )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN + PSIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN + PSIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PSIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN)
							WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + PDIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN )
							WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN)
						END AS TotalPages
					FROM
						CubePrinter C
					WHERE
						C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime AND
						(@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR C.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) AND 
						(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
						(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
						(@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
						(@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID) AND
						(@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (C.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT printerdeviceid FROM printersdevices WHERE EngagedStatus = @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters)))  AND
						--//alteração [4.2]
						--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR  C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					GROUP BY
						C.PrintApplicationID
					
					UNION ALL
					
					SELECT
						P.PrintApplicationID,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages
					FROM
						PrintJobs P
					WHERE
						(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
						(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
						((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
						(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
						(P.JobDisabled = 0 )    AND 
						(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
						(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )    AND 
						(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
						(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
						(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
						(@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
						((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
						(@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND                                                    
						(@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR  P.PrinterDeviceID= @PrinterDeviceID) AND
						(@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (P.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT printerdeviceid FROM printersdevices WHERE EngagedStatus = @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters)))  AND
						--//alteração [4.2]
						--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR  P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					GROUP BY
						P.PrintApplicationID
				) AS T
			GROUP BY
				T.PrintApplicationID
		) AS C
			 INNER JOIN PrintApplications P ON C.PrintApplicationID = P.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE-- IF ( (@AccountID <> -1) AND (@ProjectID <>  -1 OR @PrinterDeviceID <> -1 OR @PrinterQueueID <> -1 OR @MachineID  <> -1  OR @PaperSizeID <> -1 OR @PrintApplicationID <> -1 OR @JobOriginID <> -1 OR @SiteID <> -1 OR @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters <> 0))
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'PEGA DADOS DO USUÁRIO, DA PRINTJOBS'
		
		SELECT
			P.PrintApplicationName,
			C.TotalPages,
			P.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							P.PrintApplicationID,
							CASE @PrintColorID
								WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
                                WHEN  1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
                                WHEN  2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
							INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = P.PrinterDeviceID
							LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ  ON P.PrinterQueueID   = PQ.PrinterQueueID
						WHERE
							(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @OriginalStartDateTime AND @OriginalEndDateTime)
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0)
							AND (@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0)
							AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
							AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
							AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID)
							AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
							AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
							AND (@PrinterQueueID = -1 OR P.PrinterQueueID = @PrinterQueueID)
							AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR P.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
							AND (@MachineID = -1 OR PQ.MachineID = @MachineID)
							AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (P.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE EngagedStatus = @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters)))
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								 @UseORMethod= 0 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1             OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							)
							OR
							(
								 @UseORMethod= 1 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1             OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							))
						GROUP BY
							P.PrintApplicationID 
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PrintApplicationID 
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications P ON C.PrintApplicationID = P.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
      END

END
```

## 641. proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsPapers

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsPapers]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@PrinterQueueID INT =  -1,
@MachineID INT = -1,    
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@CostAccountID INT = -1, 
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren  BIT = 1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @OriginalStartDateTime DATETIME
	DECLARE @OriginalEndDateTime DATETIME

	SET @OriginalStartDateTime = @StartDateTime 
	SET @OriginalEndDateTime = @EndDateTime 

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	--DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	IF (@AccountID = -1 ) --não foi passado filtro de usuário, então ou não é o relatório de usuários, ou é mas nao tem filtro. Usa os parâmetors genéricos
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)
	END
	ELSE -- é o relatório de usuários e tem um filtro, entao pega os parametros próprios para esse relatório
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID,@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)
	END

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		--Verifica se é marcado a o~pção pra trazer os filhos do centro de custo na filtragem 
		IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren  = 1)
		BEGIN
		--Se sim continua como era antes
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se não insere apenas o centro de custo pesquisado na tabela 
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList VALUES(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario           
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT, @Mono SMALLINT 

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	SELECT @StartDateTime = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDateTime AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)
	SELECT @EndDateTime   = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@EndDateTime   AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)

	IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
	END
		
	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END
		      
	SELECT @Mono = - 1, @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END
	
	--alteração da 4.2
	-- esse IF vai entrar se teve (ou não) filtro de usuário;
	--se não teve filtro de usuario, mas AS permissões criaram o filtro, vai entrar aqui tmb.
	-- caso contrário vai entrar apenas nos ifs abaixo   
	IF ((@PrinterDeviceID = -1 AND @PrinterQueueID = -1 AND @MachineID  = -1 
		 AND @PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 
		 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0))
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'PEGA DADOS DO USUARIO DOS CUBOS'  

		SELECT TOP 10
			P.PaperSizeName AS PaperName,
			C.TotalPages
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PaperSizeID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.PaperSizeID,
							CASE
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + PDFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1                                             THEN  SUM (CDIN)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime AND
							(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
							(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
							(@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
							(@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID) AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								 @UseORMethod= 0 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1              OR            C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							)
							OR
							(
								 @UseORMethod= 1 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1             OR            C.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							))
						GROUP BY C.PaperSizeID 

						UNION ALL

                        SELECT
							P.PaperSizeID,
							CASE @PrintColorID
								WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor )
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
							(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
							((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
							(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
							(P.JobDisabled = 0 )    AND 
							(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
							(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )    AND 
							(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
							(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
							(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
							(@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
							((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
							(@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
							   @UseORMethod= 0 
							   AND
							   (
									 (@AccountID = -1              OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
									 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							   )
							)
							OR
							(
							   @UseORMethod= 1 
							   AND
							   (
									 (@AccountID = -1              OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
									 (@CostAccountID = -1 OR        P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
							   )
							))
						GROUP BY P.PaperSizeID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY T.PaperSizeID  
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN PapersSize P ON C.PaperSizeID = P.PaperSizeID
		WHERE
			C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
      
	--alteração da 4.2
	-- esse entrar aqui é pq teve filtro de computador, e nenhum de 
	--se não teve filtro de usuario, mas AS permissões criaram o filtro, vai entrar aqui tmb.
	-- caso contrário vai entrar apenas nos ifs abaixo

								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)

								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)

								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + PDFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1                                             THEN SUM(CDIN)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeMachine C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime AND
						   (@MachineID = -1 OR C.MachineID = @MachineID) AND 
						   (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
						   (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
						   (@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
						   (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID) AND
						   --//alteração [4.2]
						   --//aqui só pode testar os CCs
						   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR  C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						GROUP BY

						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.PaperSizeID,
							CASE @PrintColorID
								WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
							LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterQueueID = P.PrinterQueueID
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
							(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND
							((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
							(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
							(P.JobDisabled = 0 )    AND 
							(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND

								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)

								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)

								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1                                             THEN SUM(CDIN)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM

						WHERE

				 INNER JOIN PapersSize P ON C.PaperSizeID = P.PaperSizeID WHERE C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY

								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)

								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PSFN + PSCN + PSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CSFN + CSCN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = -1 THEN SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN + PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PSCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CSCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN + PDCN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(PDCN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 2 THEN SUM(CDCN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + CSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN + PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PSFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CSFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN + PDFN  )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(PDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 3 THEN SUM(CDFN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN + PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PSIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CSIN)
								WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN + PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 1  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(PDIN )
								WHEN @PrintColorID = 2  AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND @JobTypeID = 1 THEN SUM(CDIN)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubePrinter C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime AND
                           (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR C.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) AND                                            
                           (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR C.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
                           (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR C.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
                           (@JobOriginID = -1 OR C.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
                           (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)AND
                           (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (C.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT printerdeviceid FROM printersdevices WHERE EngagedStatus in (1,3))))  AND
                           --//alteração [4.2]
                           --//aqui só pode testar os CCs
                           (@CostAccountID = -1 OR  C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						GROUP BY C.PaperSizeID
						
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.PaperSizeID,
							CASE @PrintColorID
								WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
								WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
							(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
							((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
							(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
							(P.JobDisabled = 0 )    AND 
							(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
							(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )    AND 
							(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
							(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
							(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
							(@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
							((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
							(@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND                                                     
							(@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR  P.PrinterDeviceID= @PrinterDeviceID) AND
							(@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (P.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT printerdeviceid FROM printersdevices WHERE EngagedStatus IN (1,3))))  AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR  P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						GROUP BY P.PaperSizeID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PaperSizeID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN PapersSize P ON C.PaperSizeID = P.PaperSizeID
		WHERE
			C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE --IF ( (@AccountID <> -1) AND (@ProjectID <>  -1 OR @PrinterDeviceID <> -1 OR @PrinterQueueID <> -1 OR @MachineID  <> -1  OR @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters <> 0))
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'PEGA DADOS DO USUÁRIO, DA PRINTJOBS'

		SELECT TOP 10  
			PaperSizeName AS PaperName,
			C.TotalPages
		FROM 
			(
				SELECT     
					PaperSizeID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM 
					(
						SELECT     
							P.PaperSizeID,    
							CASE @PrintColorID
								WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
								WHEN  1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
								WHEN  2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
							END AS TotalPages
						FROM 
							PrintJobs P 
							INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = P.PrinterDeviceID
							LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues  PQ ON P.PrinterQueueID   = PQ.PrinterQueueID
						WHERE
							(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @OriginalStartDateTime AND @OriginalEndDateTime)
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0)
							AND (@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0)
							AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID)
							AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
							AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID)
							AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
							AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
							AND (@PrinterQueueID = -1 OR P.PrinterQueueID = @PrinterQueueID)
							AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR P.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
							AND (@MachineID = -1 OR PQ.MachineID = @MachineID)
							AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (P.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE EngagedStatus IN (1,3))))
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
							AND 
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								 @UseORMethod= 0 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1             OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                AND 
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							)
							OR
							(
								 @UseORMethod= 1 
								 AND
								 (
									   (@AccountID = -1             OR          P.AccountID                  = @AccountID)                OR
									   (@CostAccountID = -1 OR       P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								 )
							))
						GROUP BY
							P.PaperSizeID 
					) AS T
				GROUP BY 
					T.PaperSizeID  
			) AS C
			  INNER JOIN PapersSize P ON C.PaperSizeID = P.PaperSizeID WHERE C.TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC

      END
      
END
```

## 642. proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopApps

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopApps]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2


	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	
	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (datepart(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND datepart(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  datepart(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
		END

	IF((datepart(hh, @EndTime) + 	datepart(mi, @EndTime)  + datepart(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
		END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			PA.PrintApplicationName,
			TotalPages,
			PA.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.PrintApplicationID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.PrintApplicationID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PrintApplicationID		
			) AS P
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON P.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			PA.PrintApplicationName, 
			TotalPages,
			PA.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.PrintApplicationID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.PrintApplicationID
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.PrintApplicationID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM 
							PrintJobs P 
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) -- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.PrintApplicationID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PrintApplicationID
			) AS P
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON P.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
			
	END

END
```
