## 643. proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostAccount

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostAccount] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()--'2013-10-31 10:24'--
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT 
		*
	FROM 
		[dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters
	
	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST( CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)
	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data  BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.CostAccountID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime)
							AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) --Precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND 
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY 
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	
END
```

```sql
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,

@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2


	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (datepart(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND datepart(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  datepart(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
		END

	IF((datepart(hh, @EndTime) + 	datepart(mi, @EndTime)  + datepart(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
		END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostCenterName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM (
				SELECT
					CostAccountID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data  BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostCenterName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.CostAccountID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime)
							AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) --Precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND 
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopExcededDisabled] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END


--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (datepart(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND datepart(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  datepart(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
		END

	IF((datepart(hh, @EndTime) + 	datepart(mi, @EndTime)  + datepart(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
		END

	SELECT top 10	C.AccountID, CASE A.FullName 	WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ A.LogonName	
									ELSE A.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ A.LogonName +')'END AS FullName, 
					TotalPrinted, TotalAllowed, Balance 
			FROM (
					SELECT	AccountID, SUM(10) AS TotalPrinted, 
							SUM(20) AS TotalAllowed, SUM(10) AS Balance
						FROM (  

								SELECT	P.AccountID, SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages, 
										100 AS TotalAllowed, 20 - SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS Balance
									FROM PrintJobs P 
										WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
													(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
													((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
													(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
												(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
												(P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3))	AND -- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
												--//alteração [4.2]
												--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
												((
													@UseORMethod= 0 
													AND
													(
														(@AccountID = -1			OR		P.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
														(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
													)
												)
												OR
												(
													@UseORMethod= 1 
													AND
													(
														(@AccountID = -1			OR		P.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
														(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
													)
												))

 										GROUP BY P.AccountID
							) AS T
						GROUP BY T.AccountID		
				) AS C				
				INNER JOIN Accounts			A ON C.AccountID	= A.AccountID
				INNER JOIN Domains			D ON A.DomainID		= D.DomainID
		WHERE ((TotalAllowed - TotalPrinted) < 0)
		Order BY Balance Desc
END
```

## 646. proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopPrinter

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopPrinter] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()--'2013-10-31 10:24'--
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	SELECT @StartDateTime = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDateTime AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)
	SELECT @EndDateTime   = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@EndDateTime   AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)

	IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
	END
		
	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END
			
	IF @AccountID <> -1 
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10 
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID,  
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
			PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
			--PrintersDevices.Model AS DriverName, 
			TotalPages,  
			TotalCost 
		FROM 
			( 
				SELECT 
					PJ.PrinterDeviceID, 
					SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono) AS TotalPages,  
					SUM(PJ.CostColor  + PJ.CostMono)  AS TotalCost
				FROM          
					PrintJobs PJ
				WHERE 
					(PJ.DatePrinted between @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
					AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
					AND (JobTypeID in (1,2,3))-- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
					AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
					AND 
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND  (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				GROUP BY 
					PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS DevicesSummary
				 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID
				 INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY 
			TotalPages DESC 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10
				D.PrinterDeviceID, 
				--dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName ,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
				--PD.Model AS DriverName,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
				TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalCost
			FROM 
				(

					SELECT
						C.PrinterDeviceID,
						SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
					FROM 
						CubePrinter C
					WHERE
						C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
						AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
						AND
						--//alteração [4.2]
						--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
					GROUP BY
						C.PrinterDeviceID
						
				) AS D
					 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices	PD ON D.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
					 INNER JOIN PrintersModels  PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10
				D.PrinterDeviceID, 
				--dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName ,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
				--PD.Model AS DriverName,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
				TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalCost
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT
						PrinterDeviceID, 
						SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
					FROM 
						(  
							SELECT
								C.PrinterDeviceID,
								SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
							FROM 
								CubePrinter C 
							WHERE
								C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
								AND
								--//alteração [4.2]
								--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
							GROUP BY
								C.PrinterDeviceID
							
							UNION ALL
							
							SELECT
								P.PrinterDeviceID, 
								SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
							FROM 
								PrintJobs P 
							WHERE	
								(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR (P.DatePrinted between (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) 
								AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime)) OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
								AND (P.JobDisabled = 0 )
								AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) -- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
								AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))--//alteração [4.2] -- aqui só pode testar os CCs
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							GROUP BY 
								P.PrinterDeviceID
						) AS T
					GROUP BY
						T.PrinterDeviceID		
				) AS D
					 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices	PD ON D.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
					 INNER JOIN PrintersModels  PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC
		END
	END

END
```

```sql
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList

	END
	ELSE

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
```

## 648. proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopUser

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopUser] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()--'2013-10-31 10:24'--
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE (AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT 
		*
	FROM 
		[dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	
	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = CAST( CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			A.AccountID,
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, A.LogonName, A.FullName) AS AccountName,
			A.LogonName,
			--CASE A.FullName WHEN '' 
			--	THEN D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName
			--	ELSE D.DomainName + '\' + A.FullName 
			--END AS AccountName, 
			TotalPages,
			0 AS TotalCost
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					C.AccountID,
					SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					CubeUser C
				WHERE
					C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
					AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
					AND
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				GROUP BY
					C.AccountID
			) AS T
				 INNER JOIN Accounts A ON T.AccountID = A.AccountID
				 INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON A.DomainID = D.DomainID
		WHERE
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			A.AccountID,
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, A.LogonName, A.FullName) AS AccountName,
			A.LogonName,
			--CASE A.FullName WHEN '' 
			--	THEN D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName
			--	ELSE D.DomainName + '\' + A.FullName 
			--END AS AccountName, 
			TotalPages,	
			0 AS TotalCost
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					AccountID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.AccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM 
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID	 = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.AccountID
						
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.AccountID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM 
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) --Precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND 
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.AccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.AccountID		
			) AS T
				 INNER JOIN Accounts A ON T.AccountID = A.AccountID
				 INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON A.DomainID = D.DomainID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC
	END

END
```

## 649. proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTotal

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTotal] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT= -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@PrinterQueueID INT =  -1,
@MachineID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren BIT = 1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE (AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES


	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	--DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	IF (@AccountID = -1 ) --não foi passado filtro de usuário, então ou não é o relatório de usuários, ou é mas nao tem filtro. Usa os parâmetors genéricos
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)
	END
	ELSE -- é o relatório de usuários e tem um filtro, entao pega os parametros próprios para esse relatório
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)
	END

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		--Verifica se é marcado a o~pção pra trazer os filhos do centro de custo na filtragem 
		IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Se sim continua como era antes
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se não insere apenas o centro de custo pesquisado na tabela 
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList VALUES(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = -1
	SET @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END

	SELECT
		CASE @PrintColorID
		      	WHEN -1 THEN ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono), 0)
		      	WHEN  1 THEN ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesMono ), 0)
		      	WHEN  2 THEN ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesColor), 0)
		END AS Printedpages,
		ISNULL(COUNT(*), 0) AS Jobs,
		ISNULL(DATEDIFF(DAY, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime) + 1, 0) AS Days,		
		CASE @PrintColorID
		      	WHEN -1 THEN ISNULL(SUM(PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono), 0)
		      	WHEN  1 THEN ISNULL(SUM(PJ.CostMono), 0)
		      	WHEN  2 THEN ISNULL(SUM(PJ.CostColor ), 0)
		END AS TotalCost,
		ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT(PJ.PrinterDeviceID)), 0) AS Printers,
		ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT(PJ.AccountID)) , 0)AS Users,
		ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT(PQ.MachineID)), 0) AS Computers
	FROM         
		PrintJobs PJ
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
		LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues  PQ ON PJ.PrinterQueueID  = PQ.PrinterQueueID
	WHERE
  		(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
		AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0 ) 
		AND (@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0 )
		AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
		AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJ.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) 
		AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
		AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
		AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
		AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) )OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
		AND (@MachineID = -1 OR  PQ.MachineID= @MachineID) 
		AND (@PrinterQueueID = -1 OR PJ.PrinterQueueID= @PrinterQueueID) 
		AND (@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0 OR (PJ.PrinterDeviceID in (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE EngagedStatus = @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters))) 	
		AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
		AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
		AND
		--//alteração [4.2]
		--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
		((
			@UseORMethod= 0 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
				(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		)
		OR
		(
			@UseORMethod= 1 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
				(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		))

END
```

## 652. proc_Reports_RetrieveUsersDetails

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveUsersDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1, 
@AccountIDOwner INT 

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT
		*
	FROM
		[dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT
		@AccountID = AccountID, 
		@CostAccountID = CostAccountID, 
		@UseORMethod = UseORMethod, 
		@BuildListType = BuildListType
	FROM 
		@Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@CCIDList 
		SELECT
			CostAccountID
		FROM
			dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList 
			SELECT DISTINCT
				CostAccountID
			FROM
				dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END

	SELECT 
		PrintJobID,
		JobOriginID,	
		GroupName, 
		Title,
		DatePrinted, 
		PagesColor, 
		PagesMono,
		Pages,  
		PrintCost, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintColorName,
		PrintWayID, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName ,
		1 AS [Counter],
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT 
				PJ.PrintJobID,
				PJ.JobOriginID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PJ.Printerdeviceid) AS GroupName, 
				PJ.Title , 
				PJ.DatePrinted , 
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
					WHEN  1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
					WHEN  2 THEN -1
				END AS PagesMono,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor
					WHEN  1 THEN -1
					WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor
				END AS PagesColor,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono
	     			WHEN  1 THEN  PJ.PagesMono
		      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor 
				END AS Pages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono
	     			WHEN  1 THEN PJ.CostMono
		      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.CostColor
				END AS PrintCost,
				CASE  
     				WHEN PJ.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
					ELSE 'Mono'
				END AS PrintColorName,
				PJ.PrintWayID,
				PJ.PrintApplicationID,
				PJ.PaperSizeID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs PJ
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE
				(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
				AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0 ) AND	(@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0 ) 
				AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
				AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
				AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
				AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  PJ.SiteID = @SiteID) 
				AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				(
					(
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
				)
		) AS Details
		     INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID
			 INNER JOIN PapersSize ON Details.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END desc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC, 
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END desc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END desc

END
```

## 653. proc_Reports_RetrieveUsersSummary

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveUsersSummary] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@FilterByCostAccountChildren BIT = 1,
@GroupBySiteAndSiteDivision BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT, @Mono SMALLINT 

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT
		*
	FROM
		[dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN		
		--Verifica se é marcado a o~pção pra trazer os filhos do centro de custo na filtragem 
		IF(@FilterByCostAccountChildren = 1)
		BEGIN
		--Se sim continua como era antes
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
		END	
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Se não insere apenas o centro de custo pesquisado na tabela 
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList VALUES(@CostAccountID)
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT @Mono = - 1, @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END 
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END
		
	--Se não tiver a opção de agrupar por site e departamento ou sem seleção de um departamento, pega dos cubos
	IF (@GroupBySiteAndSiteDivision = 0 AND @SiteDivisionID = -1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Dia DATETIME, @Mes SMALLINT
		DECLARE @Ini BIT, @Total INT, @d SMALLINT, @m SMALLINT, @y SMALLINT
		DECLARE @Temp TABLE (AccountID INT, MonoPages INT, ColorPages INT, TotalPages INT, TotalJobs INT,  TotalCost MONEY)
		DECLARE @Dias TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
		DECLARE @Semanas TABLE (Ano SMALLINT, mes SMALLINT, dia SMALLINT)
		DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	
		SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

		SELECT 	@StartDateTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) +  
											Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) +
											Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME),
				@EndDateTime   = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) +  
											Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) +
											Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) AS DATETIME) 

		IF (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
		BEGIN
			SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
		END

		IF(@StartDateTime > @EndDateTime)
		BEGIN
			Raiserror('Data de Inicio de relatório é maior que data de Fim!', 16,1)
			RETURN	
		END

		-- Serão realizadas duas Consultas Se existe ou não a necessidade de ir nos Cubos + Produção, ou apenas Cubos.
		IF(	(DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0 OR 
			(DATEPART(hh, @EndTime  ) + DATEPART(mi, @EndTime  )  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime  )) > 0)
		BEGIN -- BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE VAI PEGAR DA PRINTJOBS 
			IF((DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
			END

			IF((DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
			END

			--//Alteração [4.2]
			--// verifica se tem algo na lista de CCs. Se tem não pode pegar dos cubos primários, só dos secundários
			IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @CCIDList))
			BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO ONDE NÃO HOUVE FILTROS
				--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

				SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

				WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
				BEGIN
					IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @dias VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

				SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

				WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
				BEGIN
						
					IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ini = 1
						SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
					END
						
					IF( DAY(@dia) IN (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						BREAK
					END	

					SET @dia = @dia +1

					WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22))
					BEGIN				
						SET @dia = @dia + 1
					END

					IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
					BEGIN
						DELETE FROM @Semanas WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia IN (1, 8, 15, 22) 
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	
						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
					END
				END

					SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

						SET @total = @total - 1 
						SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia FROM @dias
						DELETE FROM @dias WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
							
						INSERT INTO @Temp
							SELECT	C.AccountID, 
								CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
											THEN  -1
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
											THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN

											THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2

											THEN  PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1

								CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
											THEN  -1
										WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

											THEN  PDCN

											THEN  CDCN

											THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN

											THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN

											THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  CDIN + CSIN
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1

											THEN  PDIN
```
