											THEN  PDCV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
											THEN  CDCV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
											THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  PSFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  CSFV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  PDFV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
											THEN  CDFV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  CDIV + CSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  PSIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  CSIV
										WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  PDIV 
										WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
											THEN  CDIV
								END AS TotalCost
								FROM CubeUserAccountWeek C 
								WHERE	dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y AND 	(@AccountID = -1	OR	C.AccountID		= @AccountID) 

					END
					-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

					SELECT
						A.AccountID, 
						D.DomainName, 
						ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,        	 
						dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
						A.TotalJobs, 
						A.MonoPages,
						A.ColorPages,
						A.TotalPages, 
						A.TotalCost,  
						1 AS [Counter] 
					FROM
						(
							SELECT	
								AccountID, 
								SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
								SUM(MonoPages)  AS MonoPages,
								SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
								SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
								SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
							FROM
								(
									SELECT	
										AccountID, 
										SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
										SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
										SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
									FROM
										@Temp 
									GROUP BY
										AccountID

									UNION ALL	

									SELECT 	
										P.AccountID, 
										COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
										CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																WHEN 2 THEN -1
										END AS MonoPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																WHEN 1 THEN -1
																WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
										END AS ColorPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
										END AS TotalPages,
										CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostColor + P.CostMono)
																WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
										END AS TotalCost
									FROM
										PrintJobs P
										INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD	ON P.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
									WHERE
										((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) OR 
										(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND
										(P.JobDisabled = 0) AND 
										(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
										(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
										(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
										((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND 
										(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID= @AccountID) 
									GROUP BY P.AccountID				
								) AS B 
							GROUP BY
								AccountID
						) AS A
							INNER JOIN Accounts		AC	ON AC.AccountID		= A.AccountID
							INNER JOIN Domains		D	ON D.DomainID		= AC.DomainID
							LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts	CC	ON AC.CostAccountID	= CC.CostAccountID
						WHERE 
							A.TotalPages > 0
						ORDER BY
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END DESC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 1) THEN CostAccountName END ASC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 2) THEN CostAccountName END DESC,
							CASE WHEN (@OrderBy > 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC

				END --END DE ONDE VAI PEGAR DADOS DOS CUBOS SEMANAIS
				ELSE
				BEGIN -- BEGIN DE ONDE VAI PEGAR OS DADOS DOS CUBOS NORMAIS SEM FILTROS

					PRINT 'CUBOS SECUNDÁRIOS + PRINTJOBS, SEM FILTROS'	

					--SELECT @EndDateTimE = @EndDateTimE + 1--,-@StartDateTime = @StartDateTime - 1

					SELECT	
						A.AccountID, 
						D.DomainName,  
						ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName ,        	 
						dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
						A.TotalJobs,
						A.MonoPages,
						A.ColorPages,
						A.TotalPages,
						A.TotalCost,
						1 AS [Counter]
					FROM
						(
							SELECT	
								AccountID, 
								SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
								SUM(MonoPages)  AS MonoPages,
								SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
								SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
								SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
							FROM ( SELECT	C.AccountID, 
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
													THEN -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN 
										END) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
													THEN  -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN 
											END) AS ColorPages, 						
									SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN + PDCN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PSFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIN
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIN
										END) AS TotalPages, 
										SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PSCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV + PDCV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  PDCV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CDCV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
														THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PSFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CSFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV + CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PSIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIV
													WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIV 
													WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIV
											END )AS TotalCost
									FROM CubeUserAccount C 
									WHERE	(c.Data				>= @StartDateTime		AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)	AND 
											(@AccountID = -1	OR	C.AccountID		= @AccountID)  
									GROUP BY C.AccountID	
										UNION ALL
											SELECT 	P.AccountID,
													CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 2 THEN -1
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																			WHEN 1 THEN -1
																			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
													END AS ColorPages,
													 CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																 END AS TotalPages,COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
													 CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostColor + P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
																 END AS TotalCost
												FROM PrintJobs P												
												WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
														(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
														((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
														(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
														(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
														(@Color = -1			OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
														(@Mono = -1			OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
														(@PrintWayID = -1	OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND 
														((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND 
														(@AccountID = -1		OR P.AccountID= @AccountID) 
												GROUP BY P.AccountID		
										) AS B 
										GROUP BY AccountID
									) AS A 
										INNER JOIN Accounts		AC	ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
										INNER JOIN [Domains]		D	ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
										LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts	CC	ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
								WHERE A.TotalPages > 0
								ORDER BY
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 1) THEN CostAccountName END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 2) THEN CostAccountName END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy > 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC


				END -- END DE ONDE VAI PEGAR OS DADOS DOS CUBOS NORMAIS SEM FILTROS
			END  --END DO BLOCO ONDE NÃO HOUVE FILTROS
			ELSE
			BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO COM FILTROS

					PRINT 'CUBOS PRIMÁRIOS + PRINTJOBS, COM FILTROS'
						SELECT
							A.AccountID, 
							D.DomainName,  
							ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,
							dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
							A.TotalJobs,
							A.MonoPages,
							A.ColorPages,
							A.TotalPages,
							A.TotalCost,
							1 AS [Counter]
						 FROM (SELECT	AccountID, 
										SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
										SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
										SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
										SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
									FROM ( SELECT	C.AccountID, 
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
												END) AS MonoPages,
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN 
													END) AS ColorPages,
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + PDCN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1														
															THEN  PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1														
															THEN  CDIN
												END) AS TotalPages, 
												SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
											SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + PDCV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV
												END )AS TotalCost
										FROM CubeUser C 
										WHERE	(c.Data						>= @StartDateTime			AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)		AND 											
												(@PaperSizeID = -1			OR		C.PaperSizeID			= @PaperSizeID)			AND
												(@PrintApplicationID = -1	OR		C.PrintApplicationID	= @PrintApplicationID)	AND
												(@JobOriginID = -1			OR      C.JobOriginID			= @JobOriginID)			AND
												(@SiteID = -1				OR		C.SiteID= @SiteID) AND 
												--//alteração [4.2]
												--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
												((
													@UseORMethod= 0 
													AND
													(
														(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
														(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
													)
												)
												OR
												(
													@UseORMethod= 1 
													AND
													(
														(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
														(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
													)
												))

										GROUP BY C.AccountID
							UNION ALL
								SELECT	P.AccountID,
													CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																			WHEN 2 THEN -1
													END AS MonoPages,
													CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																			WHEN 1 THEN -1
																			WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
													END AS ColorPages,
													 CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.PagesMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.PagesColor)
																 END AS TotalPages,COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
													 CASE @PrintColorID WHEN -1 THEN SUM(P.CostColor + P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 1 THEN SUM(P.CostMono)
																					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(P.CostColor)
																 END AS TotalCost
									FROM PrintJobs P 
								WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR 
										(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
										((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
										(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
										(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
										(@Color = -1 OR P.PagesColor > 0 ) AND 
										(@Mono = -1 OR P.PagesMono > 0 )	AND 
										(@PaperSizeID = -1 OR P.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND 
										(@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR P.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND
										(@PrintWayID = -1 OR P.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
										(@JobOriginID= -1 OR P.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND
										((@JobTypeID = -1 AND P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR P.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)AND
										(@SiteID = -1 OR  P.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
										--//alteração [4.2]
										--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
										((
											@UseORMethod= 0 
											AND
											(
												(@AccountID = -1			OR		P.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
												(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
											)
										)
										OR
										(
											@UseORMethod= 1 
											AND
											(
												(@AccountID = -1			OR		P.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
												(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
											)
										))
										

 								GROUP BY P.AccountID 	
						) AS B 
						GROUP BY AccountID ) AS A
					  INNER JOIN Accounts		AC	ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
					  INNER JOIN Domains		D	ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
					  LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts	CC	ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID

					WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

					ORDER BY
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 1) THEN CostAccountName END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 2) THEN CostAccountName END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy > 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC
				END

		END -- BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE VAI PEGAR DA PRINTJOBS 
		ELSE
		BEGIN --BEGIN DO BLOCO QUE SÓ VAI PEGAR DOS CUBOS
			--alteração 4.2
			IF(@PaperSizeID = -1 AND @PrintApplicationID = -1 AND @SiteID = -1 AND @JobOriginID = -1  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @CCIDList))
			BEGIN -- BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS SEM FILTROS

				--SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime -1

				SELECT @dia = @StartDateTime, @mes = MONTH(@StartDateTime)

				WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22) AND @dia <= @EndDateTime)
				BEGIN

					IF(@mes = MONTH(@dia))
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @dias VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

				SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0

				WHILE (CAST(@EndDateTime - @Dia AS INT) >= 6)
				BEGIN

					IF(DAY(@dia) = 1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ini = 1
						SELECT @mes = MONTH(@dia)
					END
				
					IF( DAY(@dia) IN (1, 8, 15) OR (DAY(@dia) = 22 AND (MONTH(@dia) <> MONTH(@EndDateTime)) OR	(YEAR(@dia) < YEAR(@EndDateTime))))	
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						BREAK
					END	

					SET @dia = @dia +1
					WHILE (DAY(@dia) NOT IN (1,8,15,22))
					BEGIN				
						SET @dia = @dia + 1
					END

					IF(@ini = 1 AND DAY(@dia) = 1 AND MONTH(@dia) <> @mes)
					BEGIN
						DELETE FROM @Semanas WHERE Ano = YEAR(@dia - 1) AND mes = @mes AND dia IN (1, 8, 15, 22) 
						INSERT INTO @Semanas VALUES (YEAR(@dia - 1), @mes, 28)	
						SELECT @ini = 0, @mes = 0	
					END
				END

				WHILE(@dia <= (@EndDateTime))
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @dias VALUES(YEAR(@dia), MONTH(@dia), DAY(@dia))
					SET @dia = @dia + 1
				END

      				-- Uma vez tendo todos os ponteiro para os banco vamos aos processamentos			
						
				SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

				IF (@total > 0)
				BEGIN --BEGIN SÓ DO CUBOS SEM FILTROS SEMANAIS

					PRINT 'pega só dos cubos,  semanais, sem filtros '

						SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @dias)

						WHILE(@total > 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @total = @total - 1 
								SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
									FROM @dias
								DELETE FROM @dias 
									WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
					
								INSERT INTO @Temp
									SELECT	C.AccountID, 
											CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
														THEN -1
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  PSCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  PDCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
														THEN  PSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  PDFN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  PDIN 
											END AS MonoPages,
											CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
														THEN -1
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
														THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
														THEN  CSCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
														THEN  CDCN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
														THEN  CSFN  
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
														THEN  CDFN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CSIN 
													WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
														THEN  CDIN 
												END AS ColorPages, 							
											CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

															THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2

														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN

															THEN  CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + PDCN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  PSFN

															THEN  CSFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN
												END AS TotalPages, 
												totJobs, 
											CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + PDCV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV + PSFV

															THEN  CDFV + CSFV

															THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV
												END AS TotalCost
										FROM CubeUserAccount C 
										WHERE	DAY(c.data) = @d AND MONTH(c.data) = @m AND YEAR(c.data) = @y AND 
												(@AccountID = -1	OR	C.AccountID		= @AccountID) 
							
							END


						-- Processamento das Week/MONTH
						SET @total = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @semanas)

						WHILE(@total > 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @total = @total - 1 
								SELECT top 1 @y = ano, @m = mes, @d = dia
									FROM @semanas
								DELETE FROM @semanas 
									WHERE @y = ano AND @m = mes AND @d = dia
					
								INSERT INTO @Temp
									SELECT	C.AccountID, 
												CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
												END AS MonoPages,
												CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
															THEN  -1
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  CDCN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN 
														WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN 
													END AS ColorPages, 
											CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN + PDCN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIN
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIN 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIN
												END AS TotalPages, 
												totJobs, 
											CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
															THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  PSCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CSCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV + PDCV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
															THEN  PDCV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
															THEN  CDCV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PSFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CSFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  PDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
															THEN  CDFV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PSIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CSIV
														WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  PDIV 
														WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
															THEN  CDIV
												END AS TotalCost
										FROM CubeUserAccountWeek C 
										WHERE	dayw = @d AND monthw = @m AND yearw = @y AND 
												(@AccountID = -1	OR	C.AccountID		= @AccountID) 
							END
						-- Fim processamento ponteiros.

						SELECT	A.AccountID, D.DomainName,  ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName ,        	  
								dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,							 
								A.TotalJobs, A.MonoPages, A.ColorPages, A.TotalPages, A.TotalCost,  1 AS Counter 
							FROM (SELECT	AccountID, 
											SUM(TotalJobs)	AS TotalJobs,
											SUM(MonoPages) AS MonoPages,
											SUM(ColorPages) AS ColorPages,
											SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
											SUM(TotalCost)	AS TotalCost
									FROM @Temp 
									GROUP BY AccountID) AS A
								INNER JOIN Accounts		AC	ON AC.AccountID		= A.AccountID
								INNER JOIN Domains		D	ON D.DomainID		= AC.DomainID
								LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts	CC	ON AC.CostAccountID	= CC.CostAccountID
							WHERE A.TotalPages > 0
							ORDER BY	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 1) THEN CostAccountName END ASC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 2) THEN CostAccountName END DESC,
										CASE WHEN (@OrderBy > 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC
				END --END SÓ DO CUBOS SEM FILTROS SEMANAIS
				ELSE
				BEGIN --BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS 2 SEM FILTROS 

								print 'pega só dos cubos, dos secundários -  sem filtros'

								SET @EndDateTimE = @EndDateTimE + 1

								SELECT	A.AccountID, D.DomainName,  ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName ,        	  	 
											dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
											A.TotalJobs, A.MonoPages, A.ColorPages, A.TotalPages, A.TotalCost,  1 AS Counter 
										FROM (SELECT	C.AccountID, 
													SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 2
																THEN  -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
													END) AS MonoPages,
													SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
																THEN -1
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  CDCN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN 
															WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN 
														END) AS ColorPages, 	
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFN + PSCN + PSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFN + PDCN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN + PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN + PDCN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + CSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN + PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN + PDFN  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN + PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIN
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN + PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIN 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIN
													END) AS TotalPages, 
													SUM(totJobs) AS TotalJobs, 
												SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
																THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  PSCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CSCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV + PDCV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
																THEN  PDCV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
																THEN  CDCV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PSFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CSFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  PDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
																THEN  CDFV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PSIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CSIV
															WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  PDIV 
															WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
																THEN  CDIV
													END )AS TotalCost
											FROM CubeUserAccount C 
											WHERE	(c.Data				>= @StartDateTime		AND C.Data <  @EndDateTimE)	AND 
													(@AccountID = -1	OR	C.AccountID		= @AccountID)  
											GROUP BY C.AccountID	
									) AS  A 
								  INNER JOIN Accounts		AC	ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
								  INNER JOIN Domains		D	ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
								  LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts	CC	ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
								WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

								ORDER BY
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 1) THEN CostAccountName END ASC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 2) THEN CostAccountName END DESC,
								 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy > 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC

				END -- END SÓ DOS CUBOS 2 SEM FILTROS

			END -- END SÓ DOS CUBOS SEM FILTROS
			ELSE
			BEGIN -- BEGIN SÓ DOS CUBOS COM FILTROS

													THEN  PDIN + PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIN 
										END) AS MonoPages,
										SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = 1
													THEN  -1
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFN + CSCN + CSIN
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFN + CDCN + CDIN 
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN + CSCN   
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  CDCN  
												WHEN @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3

												WHEN @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3

									SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1

									SUM(CASE	WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1
