```sql
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PSFV + PSCV + PSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CSFV + CSCV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  PDFV + PDCV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = -1 
													THEN  CDFV + CDCV + CDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + CSCV + PDCV + PSCV   
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PDCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCV + PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  PSCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CSCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV + PDCV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2
													THEN  PDCV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 2 
													THEN  CDCV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3
													THEN  CDFV + CSFV + PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV + CSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFV + PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PSFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CSFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV + PDFV  
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  PDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 3 
													THEN  CDFV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + CSIV + PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = -1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1 AND @PrintWayID = 0	 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIV + PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PSIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 0 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CSIV
												WHEN @PrintColorID = -1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV + PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 1	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  PDIV 
												WHEN @PrintColorID = 2	AND @PrintWayID = 1 AND  @JobTypeID = 1
													THEN  CDIV
										END )AS TotalCost
								FROM CubeUser C 
								WHERE	(c.Data						>= @StartDateTime			AND C.Data <= @EndDateTimE)		AND 									
										(@PaperSizeID = -1			OR		C.PaperSizeID			= @PaperSizeID)			AND
										(@PrintApplicationID = -1	OR		C.PrintApplicationID	= @PrintApplicationID)	AND
										(@JobOriginID = -1			OR      C.JobOriginID				= @JobOriginID)			AND									
										(@SiteID = -1				OR		C.SiteID= @SiteID) AND
										--//alteração [4.2]
										--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
										((
											@UseORMethod= 0 
											AND
											(
												(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
												(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
											)
										)
										OR
										(
											@UseORMethod= 1 
											AND
											(
												(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
												(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
											)
										))

								GROUP BY C.AccountID	
						) AS  A
					  INNER JOIN Accounts		AC	ON AC.AccountID = A.AccountID
					  INNER JOIN Domains		D	ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
					  LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts	CC	ON AC.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID

					WHERE A.TotalPages > 0

					ORDER BY
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 1) THEN CostAccountName END ASC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 2) THEN CostAccountName END DESC,
					 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy > 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC

			END  -- END  SÓ DOS CUBOS COM FILTROS 

		END -- END DE ONDE SÓ PEGA DADOS DOS CUBOS
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN	
		PRINT 'AGRUPAR OU DEPARTAMENTO SELECIONADO, BUSCA DA PRINTJOBS'
	
		SELECT
			AC.AccountID, 
			D.DomainName, 
			ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') AS  CostAccountName,        	 
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
			COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs, 
			SUM(PJ.PagesMono) AS MonoPages,
			SUM(PJ.PagesColor) AS ColorPages,
			SUM(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) AS TotalPages, 
			SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) AS TotalCost,  
			1 AS [Counter],
			S.SiteID,
			S.SiteName,
			SD.SiteDivisionID,
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName
		FROM
			PrintJobs PJ
			INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJ.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
			LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
		WHERE
			PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
			AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0)
			AND (@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0)
			AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
			AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID)
			AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID)
			AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID)
			AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
			AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  PJ.SiteID= @SiteID)
			AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR  PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
			AND
			--//alteração [4.2]
			--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
			(
				(
					@UseORMethod = 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod = 1
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				)
			)
		GROUP BY 
			AC.AccountID,
			D.DomainName,
			AC.CostAccountID,
			AC.FullName,
			AC.LogonName,
			S.SiteID,
			S.SiteName,
			SD.SiteDivisionID,
			SD.SiteDivisionName
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN SUM(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN SUM(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 1) THEN ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') END ASC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 4 AND @Classify = 2) THEN ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](AC.CostAccountID), '-') END DESC,
			CASE WHEN (@OrderBy > 1) THEN dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) END ASC
	END
END
```

## 654. proc_Scheduler_Exists

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_Exists]
@ScheduledReportName NVARCHAR(150),
@OwnerAccountID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Count INT
	SET @Count = 0

	IF (@OwnerAccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			@Count = 1
		FROM
			ScheduledReports
		WHERE 
			ScheduledReportName = @ScheduledReportName
			AND OwnerAccountID = @OwnerAccountID
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			@Count = 1
		FROM
			ScheduledReports
		WHERE 
			ScheduledReportName = @ScheduledReportName
			AND OwnerAccountID IS NULL
	END
	
	SELECT @Count
	
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_Insert]
@ScheduledReportName NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,
@ReportID INT,
@PeriodTypeID INT,
@PeriodDay INT,
@SendToCostAccountManager INT  = NULL,
@SendToEmailListXML image,
@OwnerAccountID INT= -1 ,
@LastSendStatus INT,
@NextSendDate DATETIME = NULL,
@FilterListXML image,
@Language NVARCHAR(5),
@ExtendedType INT = 0,
@ExtendedDayOrWeek SMALLINT = NULL,
@ExtendedDate DATETIME = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@OwnerAccountID = -1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			ScheduledReports (ScheduledReportName, ReportID, PeriodTypeID, PeriodDay, SendToCostAccountManager, SendToEmailListXML, LastSendStatus, NextSendDate, FilterListXML, [Language], ExtendedType, ExtendedDayOrWeek, ExtendedDate)
		VALUES
			(@ScheduledReportName, @ReportID, @PeriodTypeID, @PeriodDay, @SendToCostAccountManager, @SendToEmailListXML, @LastSendStatus, @NextSendDate, @FilterListXML, @Language, @ExtendedType, @ExtendedDayOrWeek, @ExtendedDate)
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			ScheduledReports (ScheduledReportName, ReportID, PeriodTypeID, PeriodDay, SendToCostAccountManager, SendToEmailListXML, OwnerAccountID, LastSendStatus, NextSendDate, FilterListXML, [Language], ExtendedType, ExtendedDayOrWeek, ExtendedDate)
		VALUES
			(@ScheduledReportName ,@ReportID, @PeriodTypeID, @PeriodDay, @SendToCostAccountManager, @SendToEmailListXML, @OwnerAccountID, @LastSendStatus, @NextSendDate, @FilterListXML, @Language, @ExtendedType, @ExtendedDayOrWeek, @ExtendedDate)
	END
	
	SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY()

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_InsertScheduledAccountToSend] 
@ScheduledReportID INT,
@AccountID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Find INT
	
	SELECT
		@Find = COUNT(1)
	FROM 
		ScheduledAccountSend SAS
	WHERE 
		SAS.ScheduledReportID = @ScheduledReportID
		AND SAS.AccountID = @AccountID

	IF (@Find = 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			ScheduledAccountSend
		VALUES
			(@ScheduledReportID, @AccountID)
	END 
	
END
```

## 661. proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllFromOwner

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllFromOwner] 
@OwnerAccountID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	IF @OwnerAccountID =-1
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'USUÁRIO PARCEIRO'

		SELECT  
			SR.*, 
			R.ReportName, 
			'@@' + ReportName AS ReportNameResource  
		FROM 
		ScheduledReports SR
		INNER JOIN Reports R ON R.ReportID = SR.ReportID
		LEFT JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = SR.OwnerAccountID
		WHERE
			NOT ((SR.LastSendStatus = 2 AND SR.PeriodTypeID = 3))
			AND ((OwnerAccountID IS NULL) OR (SR.OwnerAccountID = AC.AccountID))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ShowCountersOnWeb CHAR
		SET @ShowCountersOnWeb = '1'

		SET @ShowCountersOnWeb = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCountersOnWeb')

		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @OwnerAccountID AND PermissionControlID = 1 AND PermissionAccessID = 9))
		BEGIN 
			PRINT 'USUÁRIO ADMINISTRADOR'
			-- Significa que o usuário pode ver todos os CCs 

			SELECT  
				SR.*, 
				R.ReportName, 
				'@@' + ReportName AS ReportNameResource              
			FROM 
				ScheduledReports SR
				INNER JOIN Reports R ON R.ReportID = SR.ReportID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = SR.OwnerAccountID
			WHERE 
				OwnerAccountID IS NOT NULL
				AND NOT((SR.LastSendStatus = 2 AND SR.PeriodTypeID = 3 )) AND
				(((ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '0')  AND SR.ReportID NOT IN  (19,17,16,24)) OR (ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '1'))
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN 
			PRINT 'USUÁRIO N-SERVER: Pega os seus e os de seus CCs gerenciados '
			-- Significa que o usuário só pode ver os seus dados e/ou seus CCs

			SELECT  
				SR.*, 
				R.ReportName, 
				'@@' + ReportName AS ReportNameResource              
			FROM 
				ScheduledReports SR           
				INNER JOIN Reports R ON R.ReportID = SR.ReportID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = SR.OwnerAccountID
			WHERE 
				(OwnerAccountID = @OwnerAccountID OR AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@OwnerAccountID)))
				AND NOT((SR.LastSendStatus = 2 AND SR.PeriodTypeID = 3 )) AND
				(((ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '0')  AND SR.ReportID NOT IN  (19,17,16,24)) OR (ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '1'))
		END
	END

END
```

## 663. proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllToSend

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllToSend] 
@SendDate DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	--**************************************************************************************
	-- ROBSON , 01/06
	-- ALTERADO PARA O UPDATE 4.12 PARA NÃO DAR MAIS ERRO QUANDO O ULTIMO CAMPO ERA NULO.
	-- APLICADO NA 4.11 NO DC.
	-- Alterado tmb para deletar eventuais agendamentos de usuários que nem existem mais
	-- RAFAEl, 26-05-2014
	-- Adicionando a coluna ErrorDescription ao select.
	--**************************************************************************************

	DELETE FROM 
		ScheduledReports 
	WHERE
		OwnerAccountID IS NOT NULL
		AND OwnerAccountID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM Accounts)

	SELECT  
		ScheduledReports.ScheduledReportID,
		ScheduledReports.ScheduledReportName,
		ScheduledReports.ReportID,
		ScheduledReports.PeriodTypeID,
		ScheduledReports.PeriodDay,
		ScheduledReports.SendToCostAccountManager,
		ScheduledReports.SendToEmailListXML,
		ScheduledReports.OwnerAccountID,
		ScheduledReports.LastSendStatus,
		ScheduledReports.NextSendDate,
		ScheduledReports.FilterListXML,
		ScheduledReports.Language,
		ScheduledReports.ExtendedType,
		ScheduledReports.ExtendedDayOrWeek,
		ISNULL(ScheduledReports.ExtendedDate,GETDATE()) AS ExtendedDate, 
		ISNULL(ScheduledReports.ErrorDescription, '') AS ErrorDescription,
		Reports.ReportName
	FROM 
		ScheduledReports
		INNER JOIN Reports ON ScheduledReports.ReportID = Reports.ReportID
	WHERE 
		(datepart(DAY,NextSendDate) =  datepart(DAY,@SendDate)) AND
		(datepart(MONTH,NextSendDate) = datepart(MONTH,@SendDate) ) AND
		(datepart(YEAR,NextSendDate) = datepart(YEAR,@SendDate) )  AND 
	    (LastSendStatus = 1 OR LastSendStatus = 3 ) --Status ToSend ou Status Failed

END
```

## 666. proc_Scheduler_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_Update]
@ScheduledReportID INT,
@ScheduledReportName NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,
@ReportID INT,
@PeriodTypeID INT,
@PeriodDay INT,
@SendToCostAccountManager INT  = NULL,
@SendToEmailListXML image,
@OwnerAccountID INT=NULL,
@LastSendStatus INT,
@NextSendDate DATETIME = NULL,
@FilterListXML image,
@Language NVARCHAR(5), 
@ExtendedType INT, 
@ExtendedDayOrWeek INT, 
@ExtendedDate DATETIME = NULL,
@ErrorDescription NVARCHAR(255) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	--**************************************************************************************
	-- RAFAEl, 26-05-2014
	-- Adicionando a coluna ErrorDescription ao update.
	--**************************************************************************************

	UPDATE
		ScheduledReports
	SET 
		ScheduledReportName = @ScheduledReportName, 
		ReportID= @ReportID, 
		PeriodTypeID = @PeriodTypeID, 
		PeriodDay = @PeriodDay, 
		SendToCostAccountManager = @SendToCostAccountManager,
		SendToEmailListXML = @SendToEmailListXML, 
		OwnerAccountID = @OwnerAccountID, 
		LastSendStatus = @LastSendStatus, 
		NextSendDate = @NextSendDate, 
		FilterListXML = @FilterListXML,
		[Language] = @Language,
		ExtendedType = @ExtendedType,
		ExtendedDayOrWeek = @ExtendedDayOrWeek,
		ExtendedDate = @ExtendedDate,
		ErrorDescription = @ErrorDescription
	WHERE 
		ScheduledReportID = @ScheduledReportID

END
```

## 671. proc_SiteDivision_Update

## 673. proc_Sites_Exists

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Sites_Exists]
@SiteID INT = 0,
@SiteName NVARCHAR(255) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM Sites WHERE SiteID = @SiteID OR SiteName = @SiteName), 0)

END
```

## 674. proc_Sites_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Sites_Insert]
@SiteName NVARCHAR(255)

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @SiteID INT
                
	INSERT INTO Sites (SiteName, IsDefault) 
	VALUES (@SiteName, 0)                             

	IF (@@Error <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @SiteID = SiteID FROM Sites WHERE SiteName = @SiteName
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @SiteID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END
                               
	SELECT @SiteID 

END
```

## 678. proc_Sites_RetrieveIDDefaultSite

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Sites_RetrieveIDDefaultSite]
AS
 
BEGIN

	DECLARE @SiteID INT

	SELECT 
		@SiteID = SiteID
	FROM 
		Sites 
	WHERE 
		IsDefault = 1

	IF(@SiteID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE 
			Sites 
		SET 
			IsDefault = 1 
		WHERE 
			SiteID IN (SELECT SiteID FROM (SELECT TOP 1 COUNT(*) AS C, SiteID FROM Machines GROUP BY SiteID ORDER BY C DESC) AS T)

		SELECT 
			@SiteID = SiteID
		FROM 
			Sites 
		WHERE 
			IsDefault = 1
	END

	SELECT ISNULL(@SiteID, -1)

END
```

## 681. proc_StampLogon_Exists

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_StampLogon_Exists]
@StampLogonID NVARCHAR(32)

AS
BEGIN
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Douglas Ribeiro de Macedo
	-- Create date: 13/06/2014
	-- Description:	Verifica se o código de rastreio existe
	-- =============================================
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM StampLogonJobs WHERE StampLogonID = @StampLogonID)

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

END
```

## 682. proc_SubNetworks_Find

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_SubNetworks_Find] 
@SiteID INT = 0,
@SubNetworkID INT = 0,
@subNetworkAddress NVARCHAR(15) = NULL
AS

 SELECT SubNetworkID 
 FROM SubNetworks 
 WHERE(
    (SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID OR @SubNetworkID = 0 )   AND 
    (SiteID = @SiteID OR @SiteID = 0)  AND
    (subNetworkAddress = @subNetworkAddress OR @subNetworkAddress IS NULL)
  )
```

## 683. proc_SubNetworks_Insert

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_SubNetworks_Insert]
@SiteID INT,
@SubNetworkAddress NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@LowerIP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@HigherIP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL
AS

BEGIN

	INSERT INTO
		SubNetworks (SiteID, SubNetworkAddress, LowerIP, HigherIP ) 
	VALUES
```

## 685. proc_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll]
@SiteID INT = 0,
@IgnoreSiteID BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
 

	IF (@IgnoreSiteID = 0)
	BEGIN

	    IF (@SiteID <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID = @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
				ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID <> @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
	END
END
```

## 686. proc_SubNetworks_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_SubNetworks_Update]
@SubNetworkID INT,
@SiteID INT,
@SubNetworkAddress NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@LowerIP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@HigherIP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @OldSiteID INT
	SELECT @OldSiteID = SiteID FROM SubNetworks WHERE SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID
 
	UPDATE
		SubNetworks
	SET      
		SiteID = @SiteID,
		SubNetworkAddress = @SubNetworkAddress,
		LowerIP = @LowerIP, 
		HigherIP = @HigherIP
	WHERE
		SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID
	
	IF (@OldSiteID <> @SiteID)
	BEGIN
		--ATUALIZAR EQUIPAMENTOS
		--machines
		UPDATE Machines SET SiteID = @SiteID WHERE SiteID = @OldSiteID AND SiteForcedByUser = 0

		--impressoras
		-- AS imnpressoras serão atualziadas conforme chegarem. 
		-- Além disso é preciso criar AS filas de processamento para elas então não pode ser aqui

	END
	 
END
```

## 690. proc_TransactionEventsStatus_Update

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_TransactionEventsStatus_Update] 
@TransactionID INT,
@Status INT,
@Error NVARCHAR(2000)

AS

BEGIN

	UPDATE 
		TransactionEventsStatus 
	SET 
		LastDateExecuted = GETDATE(), 
		TransactionStatus = @Status, 
		ErrorDescription = @Error 
	WHERE 
		TransactionEventID = @TransactionID

END
```
